Kylie and Toms studio is comfortable, affordable and surrounded by farmland that makes it the perfect little hideaway. Ticks many boxes!

Beautiful spot, great hosts, can't thank them enough for such a good place.
Thank you K&T!

We enjoyed our stay at Kylie and Tom’s studio. It was close to all the wineries at Barossa Valley and close to the main road which had night lamps, so it was easy to find. Well equipped with all the necessary amenities as well. As it’s surrounded by nature, do expect the random insects but otherwise the apartment was clean and comfortable!

Lovely little place to get away from reality and reconnect with the beauty of nature. This was the perfect Airbnb for a couple nights stay.
Airbnb host were very friendly and helpful with recommendations within the barossa.
Would 10/10 recommend.

Such a peaceful spot and a perfect place to wine down at the end of a busy day exploring the area. Exceptionally clean! A great sized space, and quite new. Kylie and Tom are super helpful and friendly. Would recommend!

This is a great spot if you are wanting a break from life’s hustle and bustle. Not within walking distance to local places but only a short 10-20 minute drive to most local towns around the Barossa, so very easy to get around the region.  The studio is comfortable and homely.

The Shea-Oak Log cabin is homely & cosy, with plenty of space for 2 guests.  Very friendly & helpful hosts, with great communication.  Situated about a 15 minute drive from the township of Tanunda, the cabin is a great base to explore the Barossa Valley.  We have stayed there twice now (the first time was 7 years ago), & would definitely love to stay again if we visit the Barossa again in the future.  Highly recommended.
beautiful place to stay for a few days away.
great unit, nice & quite, very clean and close to everywhere I needed to go, would recommend:)
Clean, cosy home perfect for our weekend getaway. Great location, close to restaurants, wineries and grocery stores.

The perfect place to stopover and spend the week! The space was clean, and had everything I needed (and more!). A beautiful outlook to the surrounding paddocks, and great sunsets. Thank you for having me!
Had a great stay at Kylie and Tom’s. The Studio was perfect for our needs and a close enough drive to all the wineries and sites of the Barossa.
Kylie was a very good host. She quickly responded to any requests and was extremely helpful in recommending places to go and things to see.
Good size living area, bed adequate. Modern bathroom. Well located with easy access to all of the Barossa Valley features.
I loved my stay in the Barossa. Kylie and Tom’s place was perfectly located for the wedding I was attending, but also to the towns of Tanunda and Gawler. It was peaceful and private

Perfect stay for the time we were there, easy to get to and the bed was super comfortable. There was a few cleanliness issues that I have communicated to Kylie and Tom and they were very quick with their response and taking on the feedback. Overall very happy with our stay and if the issues brought up get attended too, it's a perfect stay for anyone wanting a trip away 😊

The mattress was too soft for our liking, so one of us ended up sleeping on the sofa. We also found the pillows were hard and lumpy. We bought a pillow from Kmart to solve this.
On the positive side, being in the Barossa Valley was a bonus and the place is spacious.

We had a wonderful 2 nights at Kylie and Tom's AirBnB.  A cleverly converted farm shed to a stylish and comfortable place for travellers visiting the area.   it was clean , comfortable bed  and good shower.  Lots of coffee and tea options as well as basic pantry items for cooking.  A good base to explore thr Barossa.  I highly recommend this accommodation.
What an amazing studio, we were very comfortable and it’s beautifully appointed and easy to access.
We love staying here! It’s so sentimental to us and our relationship. Kylie and Tom are very responsive and always so happy to help :)
From the outside we thought it might be disappointing but inside it ticks all the boxes. Clean and spacious. Pantry much better than usual. Very comfy bed. Huge kitchen area. Great value for money.

Fantastic place, with a clean, comfortable and spacious kitchen lounge and separate bedroom and bathroom for a Barossa stay. Thanks for hosting us at your place Kylie and Tom, we would definitely recommend to anyone else.
Good location and well appointed Airbnb. Tom and Kylie were always responsive and willingly accommodated our travel companions caravan on the property.

An amazing place to stay if visiting the Barossa! Small and cozy, but very private. Kylie and Tom were very helpful and always responded quickly to any questions we had. Easy check-in, clean place, and amazing value! Would stay again

The place was clean and cozy with incredible views to match. Don't fret that it is near the highway as this was not an issue during our stay. Check in/out was simple and straightforward. Also loved the windows that allowed natural light in. The studio had everything you could need.
Kylie and Tom were great hosts - thoughtful and responsive throughout the duration of our stay. Thanks so much for having us! We will definitely be back 😁
Kylie helped us settle in and was a great communicator.
Thanks Mark and Fiona. The cottage is cosy and we felt very comfortable there. Lots of things supplied for the comfort of guests too.
Clean and tidy home and a convenient location halfway between different towns. Mark and Fiona were great to deal with and checking in was seamless and timely!

Mark and Fiona’s cottage were amazing. Perfect location for a visit to the Barossa region. The cottage was clean and had everything necessary for the stay. Came with snack and coffee and tea, fire wood and toiletries. Amazing. If all of that wasn’t enough. The staff went further, going above and beyond for my mums 60th birthday. The staff surprised my mum with a homemade banana cake. Mum felt incredibly special. And it was 10/10 delish!!! Can’t recommend enough. Will stay again :)
A cute little place with everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
Warm and comfortable. Within in easy reach of the wineries

A lovely place to stay. We had an enjoyable time touring the Barossa from this central loacation.
Don’t forget to bring your own food and wood. Thx for a lovely holiday.
Wayne
Great stay, just what we were looking for.
Great location. We stayed with our 9 month old, and it suited us well.
We had a super stay at your beautiful home. It was really well positioned within walking distance of several great wineries. Handy too for the Barossa valley.
Mark and Fiona's accommodation was very conveiently located and comfortable! It being dog friendly was a massive bonus as well.

Thanks very much for a lovely stay at Barossa Country Cottages. A very comfortable stay - felt like we were in the bush when we were just on the edge of town! So peaceful and we found everything we could have needed.
Thanks so much.

Great location, lovely quiet place surrounded by trees……lovely to hear the birds.  Place was comfortable & suited us.  The caretaker Bridie was very friendly and responsive.  Would definitely stay again if I was in the area.
Nice quiet village to stay. Good location to discover the Barossa Valley. Had a good time.
We had a wonderful stay. The accommodation is clean, comfortable and peaceful.  Mark and Fiona were very helpful and friendly. Highly recommended.

Rather basic but little choice in the region. Clean and tidy, good hot water and the bed is fine. Not much in the way of kitchen utensils/glassware etc, especially for a wine region. You will need to supply your own fire wood if you want more than a couple of hours of fire.
Nice little place for a short stay.  Friendly and welcoming.
We really enjoyed staying at Mark and Fiona's. It had everything we needed. Exploring the Barossa was easy, and Lyndoch is a lovely quiet town with everything you need. We really enjoyed the fire!
Mark and Fiona’s cottage was perfect for our wine weekend getaway in the barossa valley! They were responsive and helpful, and their home was exactly as described. Would recommend!
We loved our stay. Was nice, quite and very relaxing 😌

What a wonderful place to spend 5 days. Great location and walkable to the local pub- who love playing pool!
A must stay place- clean, tidy and peaceful.

the place was compact, comfortable, peaceful, and it has everything you need. the pub and bakery was walkimg distance. Mark and Fiona was great to communicate with and Bridie the caretaker was very helpful, and she lives in the main house, so easy to reach out to when you need her.
all in all the place is great and comfortable. we loved our stay at the cottage.
A beautiful and quiet cottage with stunning surroundings. We were even greeted with kookaburra laughter. Highly recommend!
Great location, the cottage was clean and cosy. Very close to wineries and towns. We had a great stay. Mark and Fiona were very helpful and proactive at communicating.
Beautiful cottage and, excellent location near Barossa wineries! Responsive hosts. Definitely recommend staying here.

Thank you for a very enjoyable stay
We would recommend it to others.
Danny & Val

Our recent stay was wonderful. The home had all the basic necessities and it’s pet friendly, which is important for us with a young pup.
The cottage was walkable to the town center and had beautiful scenery for walks around the immediate area.
The cottage is also primely located to drive to the many cellar doors in the area.
I would recommend this to anyone wanting a peaceful and accessible stay in Barossa.
The cottage was in a convenient location for us, particularly travelling to the Adelaide Hills area, and it was also one of the few good budget options for accommodation with our dog.
A lovely cottage stay with firewood provided. Felt at home with my senior small dog and partner.
Lovely pet friendly home to stay in. Nice touch with Tim Tams in fridge. Very quiet and peaceful
Thanks for making our stay so memorable. We love Lyndoch it’s so close to Adelaide. The fire was toasty warm!!
This place was cozy, comfortable and perfect for a short stay. Thanks for having us! We had a wonderful time.

Lovely, cozy and clean cottage.
Great location, close to wineries and shops.
Mark and Fiona were very responsive, kind and hospitable to our queries and concerns. Thanks for the Timtams😊

Great location but the less than warm welcome from the caretaker was a bit off putting as well as their big barking dogs. We weren’t aware that the unit was 1 of 2 and they are right next to each other so not a lot of privacy.

Overall it suited our purpose but I wouldn’t stay there again and thought it was overpriced for what you got.

Fiona and Mark were the best hosts. Their cottage was lovely and clean. All the communications were clear and the check-in instructions we so easy to follow. We really recommend the Barossa Country Cottages and we'll definitely be back again.
We had a fantastic break in beautiful Lyndoch in a peaceful location. A 7 minute walk to the town centre with two bars and some lovely restaurants and cafes. And best of all another 10 minutes walk to Kies Family Winery, one of the best in the Barossa.

We had a lovely stay
Great location easy walk to the pub for dinner

Mark and Fiona were easy to communicate with and were immediately responsive to all my queries. Bridie the housekeeper was just delightfully attentive. The cabin we rented felt so homely and the garden surroundings was so serene it just reeks of Barossa Valley serenity. Will DEFINITELY come back for another planned Barossa holiday.
Had a lovely stay at Mark and Fiona’s! Their cottage had everything we needed during our stay and the location is fantastic.
great spot for a barossa wine trip!
Enjoyed the stay. Thanks!

A great place to stay when visiting the Barossa region. The cottage contained everything we needed for a 3 day stay and being pet friendly was particularly attractive to us.
The cottage is well presented and as described. The hosts and caretakers were very friendly and provided clear instructions to access the cottage and were on hand if needed. They were very accommodating when a last minute change meant we had 1 more guest than expected.
Overall, pretty good value for money and a great location for visiting the Barossa.
Cottage suited our needs for dog friendly accommodation.

Location was convenient and quiet. Accomodation was clean and had a rustic feel to it. We especially loved the fire place!
Bridie, the caretaker, was especially friendly and helpful.
Mark & Fiona were very responsive and helpful too!
Welcomed with a warm fire and a cosy cottage on a wet and windy weekend. The caretakers were friendly and responsive. Would definitely come again.
Great stay with our kids and dog! Was the perfect place to explore the region. Thanks!
We really enjoyed our stay, the house was great as was the area we stayed in. The house was very quiet and private and had e everything we needed
We enjoyed our stay, beautiful quiet farm house.

Everything about our stay exceeded our expectations.  Our hosts were extremely friendly, hospitable and informative.  Bill even took us out to help feed the sheep on his farm!  If you're looking to stay on a peaceful farm in a homely granny flat that is just a short drive from Adelaide and Barossa Valley, Bill's place is perfect.

Bill and Angela made us feel very welcome and were accommodating of an unexpectedly late arrival. The bungalow was comfortable and cosy and set in the midst of their large farm but close to Gawler. We enjoyed our stay.

Bill and Angela are very nice and prepared all the things we need, with sunny smile and local knowledge.

The whole family enjoyed the quiet farm, sighting the new lambs being born, sunrise.

Great experience and thanks a lot!

The room with ensuite bathroom is fitted with a very comfortable queen bed (with electric blanket), one extra single bed, heater in both rooms, television and fridge. There were also bread, cereal, juice and milk, on top of cutlery and dishware.
I would say the pictures are an understatement of how beautiful the property is, especially with the view outside. You will also wake up to the sheep bleating and birds chirping. The perfect getaway with wonderful hosts.
A pleasant stay on a working farm the highlight of which was the opportunity to see a shearer in action.

A warm and welcoming couple that we enjoyed chatting with.

A very pleasant little slice of country life, with all care taken to provide homely comforts.
What a truly wonderful and relaxing experience! Bill and Angela are both delightful, the views are stunning and  Bills homemade bread in the morning just topped it off. Will definitely be back!

Hosts Bill and Angela are congenial hosts making us most welcome on arrival and providing helpful advice in advance.
Our nine night stay, covering the final week of December, was very comfortable even with the seasonally high temps. As listed, the unit is well appointed. The unit and it's outside seating make for a most relaxing view of an attractive ornamental garden and views extending across the fields to the hills of the nearby Barossa.
It is only a short distance of unsealed road to access the property and the reward of experiencing the comforts and hospitality offered are well worth a return visit.

Bill and Angela ( and wonder dog Max!) were fabulous hosts we arrived in time to watch some of the shearing of their stud sheep and were then shown through our self sufficient accomodation adjacent to the house in a lovely garden aspect. We had heard all about Bills home made bread from previous vistor reviews and weren't disappointed every morning a couple of large thick slices were waiting for us in the fridge, along with, jam, fresh orange juice, milk and a selection of cereals plus tea and coffee. The location was perfect for us a short drive across the main highway to Gawler and our family we came to visit but quiet enough for us who usually live in the country. Highly recommend and look forward to staying again when we next return to SA.

Bill and Angela welcomed us warmly. Angela pointed out the location of the food and amenities that they had provided for our breakfasts. As it was late and the shops closed she suggested a local tavern where we could  get some dinner. We really appreciated Angela's advice. Bill was very busy with lambing but took time out to talk with us and explain the operations of the farm. Our flat was very cosy, clean and comfortable. We really felt "at home"and would love to return some time. Bill's bread made for nice crispy toast!! We really enjoyed being in a country farm environment. Thanks Angela and Bill.

Angel and bill were so nice , we had a perfect dinner , share our story and country curtlure , we were really enjoyable , beautiful house , beautiful view ! I think I will never forget this day , thanks so much ! Hope can see u guys in somewhere again !

Bill and angela are just good  decent country people that would take the shirt off their backs for you. My visit was short but amazing, they feed me at short notice after the weather turn rather horrible as i was heading out  but decided not to. Bills bread that he cooks fresh for breakfast is amazing. Wish i had more time to spend with them and would of loved to see more of there beautiful property. If im ever in the area again i would be staying with them with out a doubt. Thanks again for my lovely stay.

Thankyou Bill and Angela for being so accomodating. I had a lovely, short stay- wish it was longer! The space was clean, bed was super comfortable and there was lots of goodies provided.
Thankyou once again for a good, carefree stay.

I am glad that I found this property and met Bill and Angela.  They made my weekend of having to work locally much more bearable.  Very welcoming and comfortable place to stay.  I hope to be back again and bring hubby with me next time for a longer stay.  Even the family dog made me feel very welcome.

We really enjoyed our stay on the farm and Bill and Angela were excellent hosts.  They were very friendly and helpful, ensuring we enjoyed our stay.  We would really recommend this accommodation for anyone wanting a quiet country escape.  Max the dog was a real plus!
We bad a lovely stay at Bill and Angela's. Angela was very obliging when we needed a couple of things. Thanks Bill and Angela for your hospitality.
Had a great stay, very comfortable and clean. Hosts both very accommodating and friendly

Bill and Angela are exceptional hosts. They made us feel at home and looked after us well. I'm a single dad with primary school age children who love farms and animals. Bill let us join in all his farm work and he was brilliant with the kids - so patient and inclusive. We visited in time for the start of the lambing season. Bottle feeding lambs was a treat for the kids.
The farm is absolutely beautiful. We were lucky enough to see a lot of the land and some of the old buildings made of local materials.
Comfortable beds and quality linen had us sleeping well after our days of fun, fresh air and exercise. The cottage is very clean and was freshly painted before our visit.
Finding the farm was easy. Bill's directions are accurate and the address is easy to find on google maps also.
We will be back for sure.

This place is a real get-away from everything, very relaxing and super friendly hosts. Especially good if you want to experience some farm-life. Nice B&B style, and not too far to drive for dinner etc.

This was my second visit with my kids. We loved our first visit so much the kids were begging me to go back. This place is so pretty in the winter when it's all green. Bill and Angela are wonderful hosts and made us feel very welcome once again.
Great self contained room - brought my own food which I didn't have to as there was breakfast laid on every day which I didn't use.
Bill’s place was just magnificent, you get the idea of peace and serenity immediately you arrive, we will be looking forward to another stay in future.

Bill and Angela are fantastic hosts; they are friendly and hospitable and I found the farming operation very interesting. They look after you well with home-baked bread and condiments, and are very happy to share their local knowledge. The cottage is very comfortable with lovely views out across the countryside, and a very pleasant outdoor patio to enjoy "sundowners" and snacks in the evening. The trip into the northern parts of Adelaide is quick and convenient (approx 30 mins). The proximity to the Barossa is an added bonus. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb.

Small space but perfect for 2-3 people. About 30 mins from Tanunda (main town of the Barossa Valley). They have kettle and tea/coffee but no microwave or kitchen amenities. Hosts are wonderful and very friendly and helpful :) the accommodation is on their farm next to their house but still feels private.

We really enjoyed the location and beautiful surroundings of the property. The apartment is small but cosy. Unfortunately the wifi only worked for the first night and then would not work again. Also the apartment was quite dusty and had cobweb corners. But everything else was clean and tidy. The continental breakfast provided was very nice and it was nice to have our dishes cleaned up for us each day. Overall we did enjoy our stay and found it comfortable.
Great little space with beautiful views and beautiful hosts.

Bill and Angela’s hospitality was outstanding, they helped us during the stress of moving house. Their beautiful home has helped us de-stress and relax during this crazy time, fresh bread everyday and a little tour of the farm made our stay extra special.
Great location to explore the mid North from. Very friendly hosts and generous continental breakfast.

We had an excellent experience staying at Bill's place. The place was very relaxing and provided my husband and myself a much needed break. His two dogs provided excellent pet therapy! Bill & his wife were very friendly and offered plenty of suggestions for places to eat, things to do etc. The daily provision of freshly baked bread was just the icing on the cake! We look forward to staying here again when we visit next.
So comfortable and great views
Great farm stay, bill and his wife were very hospitable. The fresh baked bread was delicious and the dogs were a great addition

Great experience for a recharge. Very clean and tidy place. Max the sheep-dog is addicted to a tummy rub, so be ready to give some love and receive some.

Bill and Angela were such warm and welcoming host. Thank you!

We booked this accommodation for two of our workers who needed to complete a job in the area.  The location was excellent and as far as I can ascertain, all went without a hitch with the booking.  There were no complaints from our guys and the accommodation worked out well.
Excellent spot for star gazing!!!

A cute little place with outstanding hospitality, and an excellent taste of farm life. Close enough to explore around the Barossa Valley by car. I would definitely recommend a stay with Bill & Angela.

We stayed for 2 nights at Bill and Angela’s. My daughter said the best holiday ever and must stay place at Adelaide. Really loved farm staying, appreciated Bill and Angela’s great hospitality. hopefully we visit you sometime soon!
Love the country setting. It was peaceful and would definitely go back if I am in the area. The host were very generous!!
it is really a good choice

Bill, Angela and family are fantastic hosts. They are extremely welcoming, they offer local knowledge and are great to talk to. I would definitely recommend staying at Bill and Angela’s.

Great Host, very friendly and helpful. gave us lot of information about barossa valley

Bill and Angela were amazing hosts. The scenery was beautiful and they have lovely animals! Awesome hospitality and location.

A return stay for me and once again I had a lovely stay with such a welcoming family. My 10 year old loved the games and movies. He’s already asking when we can go back.

Phillip and his wife met us on arrival abs showed us around the house. They made us feel very welcome and the house was lovely. Plenty of space which was great with 6 of us sharing. The surrounds were peaceful but not too far from anywhere in the Barossa. The bird life in particular was a delight for me. We would definitely stay again.

Despite our late arrival, Mary was gracious enough to wait for us patiently and provide us with helpful information about the location. The property is beautiful and the home is welcoming, spacious and well looked after.

This beautiful Mt McKenzie property is the perfect retreat - spacious rooms with plenty of natural light, modern kitchen and bathrooms, comfortable beds, outdoor seating areas to enjoy the sunshine and an incredible view. Phil is very helpful and welcoming. It's an easy drive to Barossa towns and wineries. My friends and I loved our stay and left feeling refreshed and relaxed. We highly recommend this property.
An amazing stay in a beautiful location.

We loved our time at the Mt Mckenzie raspberry farm. Phillip was very easy to communicate with and friendly. He greeted us on arrival, was very welcoming and introduced us to what we needed to know about the log cabin. The pictures are an understatement to the beauty that surrounds this property and we were happy to share the experience with the wildlife. Apart from this, the cabin is well equipped with everything you need. Excellent fire and a homely feel! The nearest town Angaston is also a treat and only ten minutes down the road with nice restaurants, a grocery store and a the famous Barossa cheese company shop. A relaxing getaway in a beautiful region! Thanks again Phillip! Much appreciated! :)

We were met by Mary, who did an excellent job of telling us about the place and the surrounding areas including some great wineries.

The place was tidy and clean and well equipped. It is very large and comfortable. As the pictures show, it's in a beautiful setting.
Phil was there to greet us when we arrived and helped us via a phone call when we got lost! He had the fire going and gave us some helpful advice about some of the local wineries
Very comfortable, fully equipped kitchen, great views and wildlife. Overall I would stay there again.

We had a really lovely stay at Mt McKenzie Raspberry Farm. Phil and Mary were lovely, and most accommodating of our late arrival. The property is wonderful; beautiful views and very comfortable, so much so that we felt no need to leave during our stay...and we probably wouldn't have, had the attractions of the Barossa not been so accessible. We will definitely return!

Phil was very friendly and prompt in all his communications. The place was exactly as is in the pictures!  views and surrounds were beautiful. Gorgeous property and a very good price for the Barossa. Wouldn't definite stay here again!

We had a great stay! Phil made us feel very welcome. The location was very picturesque and peaceful but also quite close to Angaston, great restaurants and wineries. The house facilities were great and very cosy with the wood burning stove.

Raspberry Farm is a stunning location. Guests are met with magical views across the valley, an abundance of bird and wild life and an utter sense of tranquility.

The house itself is very comfortable, tastefully designed and well equipped with everything you may need for a getaway.

We arrived on Monday afternoon and were met by Mary who welcomed us and showed us around her lovely home.   The home was so clean, fresh and very warm with the log fire going.  Our host was always quick to get back to us with any questions we had, and his directions to get there were spot on. The kitchen had everything we needed to cook each night, everything was easy to find. The farm was a lovely base to come back to as we toured around the Barossa or just going for long walks during the day.  Evenings were spent around the fabulous dining table where our family just spent the night talking away, it really felt like home.  We really did get value for money and this is a place that we would love to return to one day and it was sad to leave on the Saturday. It really was a perfect place for the six of us just to enjoy, relax and spend time together. Our family wholeheartedly recommends staying at the Mt McKenzie Raspberry Farm.  Thanks to Phillip and Mary.

This is a very spacious cabin suitated within a beautiful surroundings. Getting up in the morning and having breakfast at the dining table over looking the surroundings is a wonderful experience. There was a friendly kangeroo roaming in the yard too. If we werent so busy running around the Barossa visiting wineries, it would have been a wonderful place to have a relaxing slow day and have a BBQ and relax.
Phil was there waiting for us on time (we were 10min late) on the arrival date.
We are very pleased with the place
It was a lovely getaway with a lovely view and really enjoyed our stay. We stayed with another couple and there was plenty of space.  I would highly recommend this place to others.

Raspberry farm is set a short way up a dirt road in the idyllic BarossaValley. Mary met us and showed us the well set up house and fabulous kitchen. Everything was exactly as described including the beautiful views across the valley.
Fantastic house - private yet rural and close to all the wineries and highlights in the beautiful Barossa - we loved our stay - highly recommended

A wonderful place to stay.
An impeccable attention to detail.
In beautiful rural setting.

We had four adults and an 18 month old and found the place great.  Lots of space and great layout for multiple families.  No cot but we managed just fine.  The place was comfortable and quiet in a secluded area but convenient to wineries and restaurants.  We hope to be back again.
We loved this house! Great location to visit the wineries by day, and then relax outside in the evening enjoying the view! I'd love to come back during winter to enjoy the fire and chimenea.
Fantastic location to enjoy the Barossa and Eden Valley. Beautiful view and comfortable home with all the staples you need to enjoy your stay.
A great place to stay and fantastic hosts!
Recommend for a quiet break in a lovely house and grounds

Would absolutely recommend this place to anyone. My friends and I had a lovely time on the farm, fantastic views, very clean house, close to heaps of wineries, the fire place was bliss and check in was a breeze. Thanks so much for the stay 👍🏼

Couldn't have asked for a better place to celebrate my birthday with a small group of friends. We had three couples in total and we felt at home, surrounded by beautiful scenery and a fully catered to kitchen, which allowed us to cook our own meals. Other than the beautiful sounds of nature, there were no noisiness from passing cars or commuters. A highly recommended place for a quiet getaway.

Beyond our expectations! Three generations suited us all! Perfect quality spilling from every corner of the house! Gorgeous walking areas, peaceful tranquil and just so ideal! More like a fully equipped home away from home ! Wanted for nothing , many thanks just awesome, taste of Euroaussie
A beautiful place..everything you need and more...beds comfortable...beautiful fire...outlook amazing..phil very very helpful
Photos don't do this place justice, absolutely stunning, incredible views, stunning sunrises & a very comfortable BnB providing a great homely vibe.

Lovely house in beautiful countryside, within good distance of the Barossa wineries. A great weekend away with friends, 7 people fit in the house well with3 doubles, 1 single, 2 bathrooms and a large living space. House is nicely furnished and very clean and well equipped.
Great location,Phil and Mary are lovely host and the fireplace is a big bonus!
We loved our stay at Rasberry Farm. The house was very well appointed with beautiful views. Hosts were friendly and communicated well.

A wonderful place to stay, beautifully presented and clean and with a wonderfully stocked pantry. We had a great time relaxing, walking and visiting various parts of the Barossa. We highly recommend Phillip's Place, we had a very memorable time.
An amazing house in a great location not to far from Angaston with a great outlook. 😊

Phillip is a lovely host and made us feel very welcome. This cottage is set beautifully in the hills of the Barossa Valley, not far from a small town with nice restaurants and shops, and many, many vineyards! Also very close to the Collingrove Hill Climb Track.
It is just as described, cosy and welcoming. It was lovely waking up to the sounds of wildlife. Highly recommend it!

If you are looking for a quiet retreat where the only sound is the birds tweeting and the sheep bleeting then look no further. A beautiful space with a wonderful panoramic valley view. Well appointed and equipped accommodation in easy reach of local amenities and the wonders of The Barossa. We will definitely be back!

Even If the star rating options were higher than those shown - we would score Philip and Mary’s place the max possible.
The attention to detail and the amenities offered are truly above and beyond.
Everything is so close to Mt Mckenzie that any Drive to wineries even the ‘far’ ones like Seppeltsfield or Wolf Blass are only ~15-20mins away.
There is nothing a traveler could want for by staying at this wonderful log cabin which is so cosy and yet so spacious with more than enough accommodation for a family of 5 or 3 couples.
Cannot reccomend Rasberry Farm high enough
Thanks again to Philip and Mary - excellent hosts

Fantastic place to stay - location was perfect with just a short drive to Angaston, house was beautifully clean and tidy and very well equipped with everything needed for some relaxing time away. Very spacious, even for a group of 5 adults and lovely surroundings. Phil was a great host and made us very welcome. Highly recommended!!

Beautiful views & lovely hosts. The place is set up high on a hill & it feels very private. Phillip & Mary were easy to communicate with & welcomed us on arrival. Well appointed kitchen & eating areas. Can thoroughly recommend.

Raspberry Farm is comfortable and well appointed with tasteful decor.
Highly recommend!
An acheivement in tranquillity, the sights, sounds, scenery and stay was lovely. Perfect location for our needs...the house itself was just lovely, Highly recommended.
Wonderful location, stunning picture window, clean and well appointed.

Absolutely beautiful location and place. Philips place was everything we expected and more. It was also really nice to meet Philip when we arrived and his tips on wineries to visit in the Barossa Valley were spot on. The place was clean and well kept. Beds were comfortable and the sunrise was spectacular from the front porch. Loved watching the kangaroos hopping around in the valley.
Couldn’t recommend more highly. The place is lovely and homely and has a great view. It is very close to Angaston and all the wineries. Phil is an excellent host, he is very responsive and helpful!
Beautiful home with a fantastic view-lots of bird-and kangaroo-watching! Very close to Angaston and a perfect base for touring the Barossa with overseas visitors. Hope to be back again soon!

Great location for exploring the Barossa from quite special accomodation. Nice to be met by hosts on arrival too. Happily recommend to others and would be a priority selection if we come this way again.

Such a lovely remote cottage with great character, we loved the peacefulness and watching the roos bounce by each morning. The fireplace was wonderful to snuggle up in front of too.
Everything was very clean and the kitchen well stocked with everything we needed.
Very quick and friendly communication with hosts. Thanks Phil.
Just gorgeous, and absolutely everything you need.

What a magical experience, would go back again and again. Beautiful hosts who did everything and beyond to make the colder weather more enjoyable. Electric blankets, eggs and milk in the fridge, home made jams! Absolutely awesome.
Thank you for having us, we will be back!

Great communication. Loved our stay and especially enjoyed the beautiful views. Sipping wine in front of a burning wood fire at night made our stay as did eating around the large family table. Great location and we are already spreading the word to friends and family to stay here when they visit the Barossa Valley.
Great house to stay with friends for an enjoyable Barossa Valley wine tasting holiday!

Thank you Phillip and Mary for sharing your special place. It was perfect to bring our overseas visitors to and to come home to after busy days exploring the Barossa. Everything we needed was there and we easily self catered each evening. The ability to be outside, walk, hear the birds and lambs, pick a lemon of the tree, and just be, was awesome. A perfect getaway space in close proximity to all we wanted to do. We hope to be back. THank you
Great house in an idyllic setting. Loved our stay!
Couldn’t give a high enough recommendation. Simply loved it!

We have stayed here twice & love the view & the peaceful surroundings. The birds that come to the garden are lovely to watch and the house has everything you could possibly need. A wonderful place to stay close to everything in the Barossa
You couldn't ask for better peace and quiet than at this beautiful farmhouse! The views are stellar, the amenities are thoughtful and the comfort is unmatched. We would definitely return.

Phil and Mary gave us a friendly welcome and gave us lots of ideas of places to visit during our stay in the Barossa.  The house was large and comfortable and set in beautiful countryside. We loved the tranquility of the setting. The house was so well equipped and the availability of pantry staples was great. Thank you so much for letting us stay in your home while we explored this vibrant and historic region.
We had a very enjoyable stay - the house was spacious and homely with everything we required and only a five minute drive to the nearest town. We would definately stay there again.
Lovely peaceful stay
Phillip's place was fantastic, held a group of 5 of us very comfortably and the hospitality of Phillip and his wife was exceptional
Great location to experience life in the Barossa Valley farming area
Fantastic location, quiet, comfortable with all you need to make a trip to the Barossa amazing. We highly recommend this place and the owner was great with being available when we had questions.

Lovely rustic home with fabulous views and all our needs exceeded, close to everything in the Barossa with lots of birds and wildlife. We travelled for a month and this was my favourite place to stay.
A unique large home situated on a hill with a panorama of the valley and hills including kangaroos and many birds. Ideally located on the edge of the Barossa Valley. Well worth a stay.
Wonderfully well appointed, spacious and very clean space with scenic outlook. A great base to explore the Barossa.
Spectacular views, serene atmosphere, lots of space and great kitchen facilities. Lots of space for the family. Spectacular sunrise!

Our group of two couples had a great stay at Phil’s place. We loved the view from the house, the extra homely touches, and the location being only 10 minutes drive from Angaston was perfect. The house was sparkling clean, and Phil was very easy to communicate with, happy to offer his local tips. We will be recommending our friends and family to stay here, and hope to be back ourselves!

This was our first Air BnB experience, and very successful it was. Our hosts ensured we were able to find the house, waited for us to arrive in the evening with the lights on and heater going. The bottle of wine from their own small vineyard, was an unexpected touch and greatly appreciated by the wine drinkers in our group. The kitchen was stocked with useful items, like herbs and spices, milk, jams and sauces etc. A big collection of DVDs and CDs to handle anybody's taste. Lots of towels. Lots of nicknaks and photos on the walls gave a very homely feel. We really enjoyed our stay.

We had a pleasant surprise when we arrived. The cottage is situated on a lovely spot, it was spacious, well equipped and very comfortable. Our hosts are gracious genuine people. I would love to come back to stay again.
Phillips place offered us a great opportunity to stay in  the wine regions of SA. His cottage was well appointed clean and cosy. A perfect getaway for two retired couples.

Wow, what a great spot. Beautiful views of the valley with grazing sheep and kangaroos. Phil has thought of everything, milk, butter and eggs in the fridge. High quality bed linen on comfortable beds and lots of wood for the wood heater.
Alison

Phil is an outstanding host who really goes above and beyond to make his guests feel at home. His house is located in an absolutely beautiful area of the Barossa, and we were only a stone's throw from major points of interest and towns where we could stock up on basic necessities. The perfect getaway and host for anyone, from families to couples to a getaway with close friends.
We had a fabulous time at Phil & Mary's.  The house is beautiful and the setting so serene.  We'll be back!  Thanks again, Megan & Robyn
A gorgeous rustic house, with a well-organised open plan arrangement.  Postcard views over rolling hills. We loved our stay. Thanks Phillip.
Fabulous location - beautiful views - ancient trees - so connected to nearby villages - great amenities and a generous host

A fantastic place to stay and a wonderful host! Philip and his wife made us feel at home from the moment we walked in the door. The house is absolutely stunning and particularly snug with a toasty fire to keep you warm if you happen to stay on a particularly rainy weekend (like we did). We had six people in our group and felt like there was lots of space for everyone to do their own thing, whether it was cooking, playing card games, reading or watching a film. The wonderful little extras that we found in the house made our stay truly memorable. Cannot wait to come back again and would definitely recommend to anyone wanting to stay somewhere magical in the Barossa.
Great cabin in peaceful location. Great for our group of 3 couples. Lots of room for us all. Would recommend!
Really enjoyable easy place to be!
Perfect location to explore the barossa from. Welcomed in person with a log fire pre prepared to keep us warm. Thank you
Very comfortable spacious accommodation . Beautiful peaceful views. Spotlessly clean . Very well equipped. Perfect location for visiting Barossa Valley, wine farms and markets.

If your looking for a peaceful place to disconnect look no further, beautiful place close to everything you could possibly need or want for a lovely getaway. Phil was so accommodating and helpful for our stay, would definitely stay again in the future. Thanks for a great weekend Phil!

Phil’s house was a wonderful place for the 6 of us to unwind and enjoy the peace and quiet. It had everything we needed and allowed us all enough space so that we were not on top of each other.
Phil met us on checkin and was great with information with the house and the local wineries.

Phil's place is a great space for a family or group of friends. It's well located for tours of the Barossa Valley. He was a great host with some good local tips, and he was really flexible with check in even though our plane was delayed. Would definitely stay again.

It’s an exceptional location, close to Angaston and the wineries of the Barossa, yet rural and peaceful enough to feel like you’re away from it all. The property is beautifully presented, with everything you could need to be comfortable. We would love to visit again next time we’re in the Barossa!
Phillips place is lovely- we had a great stay. So much beautiful nature and good wineries to explore nearby! Phillip was a great host - would highly recommend.
Quiet place with all the amenities you need for a comfortable stay . Very close to Angaston . Highly recommended

What a lovely spacious log cabin with views over the North Para River. Angaston, Nuriootpa and other villages in the Barossa wine region are within very easy reach. Phil and Mary have a well supplied kitchen, with breakfast supplies, including some homemade goodies like jam, marmalade, sauces, and they even gave us a bottle of their wine. Lots of wildlife, bird book plus leaflets for local exploring.
A gorgeous spot to really soak in. Gorgeous views - a lovely welcome bottle of wine that was crafted by Phil himself. A lovely detail and communication was perfect. Definitely will look to go back!

Fantastic property. So cosy with everything you need. Gorgeous views and close to Angaston wine region . My family loved it (particularly the electric blankets) . Would recommend Rasberry Farm to others . Thank you Philip for wonderful stay.

What an amazing place to be. Our experience started with Phillip welcoming us in a very friendly manner. There already was fire in the fire-pit and the house was really warm and cozy, which gave us a real feel of being away from the city and close to nature.
On the following day we woke up to an amazing view of the mountains. We went on nature walks, saw some sheep and kangaroos and had an amazing stay. Thank you Phillip!

Phillip’s place was a hidden gem! Raspberry Farm is the perfect getaway if you are looking to switch off and unwind. The scenery is breath taking and felt immediately relaxed as soon as we arrived. We definitely recommend this place to everyone. It’s clean, spacious and has a warm homey feeling. Thanks Phillip for sharing your beautiful home with us.
Log cabin loveliness surrounded by green. A rustic getaway!

Couldn't have asked for a better getaway! Great location and stunning views. Phil greeted us with a lovely bottle of wine and a toasty fire. All bedrooms also had electric blankets. Well equipped kitchen and great location, only a short drive to wineries. Will definitely be back!
Fantastic House, Location and Host!

Great location and absolutely great ambiance of estate! Thoroughly enjoyed our time here and it is definitely a place worth going back and recommending it to people who are looking for a secluded and quiet place to hang out, chill and relax.
Host was great and very welcoming! The place was well kept and clean and all amenities were great.

The Mt Mackenzie Raspberry Farm is a very special place. Wonderful view, very relaxing, & a house that has everything that you could possibly need. Our family have enjoyed many visits & we hope we will have many more it is a home away from home. Thanks Phillip for another very happy family holiday.
Lovely rustic cabin, close to all the Barossa has to offer. Tasteful furniture, beautiful views. We enjoyed our stay.

Raspberry Farm is a large, well positioned holiday home on the side of a hill. It has everything that you could possibly want. Homemade jam, free range eggs, butter, etc. There is  plenty of room to relax and books to read. Very comfortable lounge suite and plenty of outdoor seats and tables. There are kangaroos and many varieties of birds. It is so relaxing and beautiful. We highly recommend that you stay. Phillip is an excellent host.
Location was beautiful and the house was spacious with great amenities. Great home base to explore the Barossa and surrounding areas from.
Relaxing and beautiful experience!
Perfect location for winery hopping. Delightful house, with spectacular views. Phil was very reachable and helpful. Will 100% go back next time we’re in Barossa
Fantastic hosts. The house had everything you need in an idyllic location.
We loved our stay here, would definitely recommend.
The house felt warm and cosy on the cooler nights and beautiful and bright during the day. Great country view and in a good location to the vineyards.
Phil's place is amazing, if you are looking for a sign to stay there, then this is it. Nothing better than a glass of red with a fire.
I had a fantastic stay with my family at Mt McKenzie Raspberry Farm. Big warm fires, beautiful views, gorgeous garden, great location. Totally loved our stay!
Terrific place to stay. A little out of the way but that really is the charm of the place. We were an adult family group of 6 and really enjoyed our stay. Highly recommended.

Mt McKenzie Raspberry Farm is a wonderful place to stay if you want a charming Log Cabin, breathtaking panoramic views, ancient old gum trees and kangaroos for neighbours! Our family was fortunate to stay for the June long weekend and enjoyed every moment.
From the cosy lounge with a tremendous log fire, comfy Chesterfields and open panoramic windows to the valley below,
the very well equipped kitchen with eggs, butter, oils etc provided plus a bottle of wine. Very comfortable heated beds and quaint furnishings, isolated enough for perfect peace, but also very close to all the beautiful Barossa has to offer.
Thank you Phil for the opportunity to stay at your beautiful cabin and for all your help and consideration.
John and Anne.

We had a beautiful stay at Phillip's house, it was so wonderful, the garden, the view, everything was perfect! and the house was very comfy with everything that we needed.
We highly recommend it! and we hope we will be able to visit again!!

Our Family getaway was beyond Awesome.
Great Communication with Phillip all through our stay.
Spacious kitchen, Dining table and Lounge areas, with everything you could possibly need provided, with combustion heater keeping all 3 areas very warm.
Massive garden area with fresh herbs and fruit.
Neighbouring Kangaroos, Sheep and bunnies visited us on our stay.
Plenty of colourful Bird life.
3 spacious double bedrooms with luxurious comfortable bedding.
Loved the fact that we were isolated away from everyone but close enough for local taxi company to pick us up.
We all thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend it to anyone that needs a break to have quality time with loved ones 😊

Phil’s place was so lovely. Had everything we needed for 5 nights (we love to cook), was near enough to the action when we felt like taking in the Barossa and was far enough out at Mt McKenzie for some quiet time with the birds and roos. Phil was great with his communication. Really enjoyed our holiday!

Really enjoyed our stay on the  property and the serenity of the place! Enjoyed the wildlife and convenience of the location! We'll certainly be back if we're in the area again! Phil was an awesome host and always responsive!!

A really peaceful and scenic cottage with wildlife everywhere. We loved it! The location is so handy to Angaston , Tanunda and Nuriootpa. Eden valley wineries make delicious stuff and there are good ones within 10 minutes of the cottage.

We loved Phil's place. The surroundings are amazing and the cabin had everything we needed for a wonderful stay of 5 nights. We appreciated all the little extras and had everything we needed right there. So easy to access the wineries and enjoy all the Barossa has to offer. We would love to stay here again.

We loved our stay at this location, easy to get to everything/everywhere and far enough away to enjoy the serenity. Best equipped place I’ve stayed at. Very comfortable in every regard, nice welcome with complimentary bottle of wine.
I’d Recommend this stay without hesitation.
Thanks so much Phil.
Lovely place
One of the most peaceful and "rural dream" places I've stayed, at an excellent price with amazing views. Would highly recommend :)
We enjoyed our stay with a starlit night Friday, lots of birds visiting and a view to enjoy a cheeseboard and wine lazy Saturday afternoon/evening.

We had a fantastic family weekend away at Phil’s place. He was very accomodating with our stay. The house is beautiful and in very peaceful surrounds. Was extremely well equipped, especially the kitchen and cooking facilities. Would highly recommend.
Enjoyed being in the “ bush “, close to wildlife and peaceful.

Philip's house was exactly what we needed for a catch up with friends and some quiet time, easy access to all the attractions of South Australia. Due to the drought property very dry , nothing that could have been changed but we were not disappointed in any way with property , Phillip a great host.

Phillip place was very peaceful with beautiful surroundings. The house was tidy and clean!
We very much enjoyed our stay. Thank you Phillip
Hidden little gem. What a wonderful place for a relaxing getaway in the Barossa Valley

We had such a beautiful stay. The sunrise is not to be missed!
Thanks so much Phillip!

Great views, lovely house and good location.
We had a wonderful stay with the family, such a peaceful relaxing place.
The fire kept the house warm and cosy.
We enjoyed our stay in Mount McKenzie and will be recommending it to friends and family.

Our stay here was PERFECT the house is warm and comfortable with absolutely stunning views. It was a short drive to all of the best wineries and restaurants in the Barossa. The outdoor and indoor fireplaces made the place extra cozy. It is peaceful and we spotted a few kangaroos while eating our breakfast. I would stay here again in a heartbeat

I celebrated my 60th birthday with my family at Phillip's Raspberry Farm.
It was ideal. Plenty of space inside the house for all of us, plenty of comfort items provided by Phillip including an abundant supply of firewood, games and electric blankets on all of the beds. Beautiful quiet retreat, only a short drive from the must do wineries of the region.
Thanks Phil, we loved it.

Two 60+ couples who thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Raspberry Farm.
Great farm location close to town. Very peaceful and surrounded by nature.
The property itself is perfect for a relaxing self contained holiday with everything you need in the house.
Wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.
We had an enjoyable stay! Phillip is an exceptional host, and we felt right at home.

Phil's Mt McKenzie comfortable 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom cottage is a superb rural stay, just a short drive out of Angaston. Set on hill with a view over the valley and surrounded by trees and pasturelands, we loved the view from the living room and dining area, and enjoyed being serenaded by the abundant birdlife of the area. A well equipped kitchen and outdoor dining added to remarkable Barossa stay.

McKenzie’s Raspberry Farm is a comfortable secluded log cabin in the hills east of Angaston. The surrounding property is very picturesque with rolling hills, huge river red gums and a never ending parade of birds and wild life, especially kangaroos! The house is well equipped and spacious with three bedrooms and two bathrooms. If you want to unplug and experience life in the country, this place will be perfect!
Great place to get away from the hustle & bustle. Just loved the rural setting -  wildlife and bird life!

Great place! Beautiful, peaceful surroundings. The house was exactly as described and spotless. The kitchen was well stocked and the beds were comfy. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would definitely return when we visit again!

We stayed at Raspberry Farm for just under 2 weeks, and even before we arrived, Phillip was more than accommodating, giving me help on how to find the place and other bits of information I may have needed. On arrival the place was immaculate, and Phillip had left a bottle of his own red wine as a welcome gift (which we more than appreciated after such a long journey, and we went on to buy a couple more bottles from him!). The house has everything you could possibly need, and the garden was a perfect place to relax. Here we enjoyed watching the kangaroos and different birds from the table and chairs. I would 100% stay here again. Extremely friendly and responsive host butnhad complete privacy. Thanks for a fantastic stay.

We were looking for somewhere quiet and remote, so it was perfect! Especially lovely was the birdlife surrounding the property. And it was just a short drive to some lovely wineries. Although we bought all our own supplies we were impressed by how there were lots of condiments on hand in case we needed them. Great selection of books to choose from. Very comfortable beds!
Thank you Phillip!
A true pearl of a house surrounded by peaceful and scenic hills. Phil was such a wonderful host and we hope to have a chance to visit another time.
Such a peaceful rural retreat with excellent amenities. Great location to explore all that the Barossa has to offer. Communication with Phillip was excellent.

Beautiful surrounds and Barossa views, very clean and well appointed kitchen and bathrooms, very comfortable beds and linen. Appreciated the pantry and especially the tea selection and coffee provided, and the lovely wine. Enjoyed a fabulous family sojourn and highly recommend this relaxing location so close to many wineries. Would definitely return!
Phil was a great host, very responsive and helpful. Beautiful location in the lovely Barossa.
A good retreat from the city’s hustle and hustle.
We enjoyed a wonderful few days in the cabin and exploring the Barossa Valley. Lovely to have the wood fire keeping us warm.

Absolutely beautiful property. The views and peace, only hearing the birds and sheep was lovely! Conveniently located for day shopping and touring the Barossa. Everything you need, will definitely be visiting again.
We absolutely loved our stay and will definitely be back! Great location wise and comfortably fit our group size. The views were incredible and you really felt like you were in a slice of heaven.

Phils place was absolutely beautiful.
The place was well equipped and clean.
I would definitely recommend staying there.
Its in a beautiful part of Australia with lots of little towns and sightseeing.
Thanks Phil xx
Large spacious accommodation in a peaceful rural setting. Very handy to the Barossa Valley. Well equipped kitchen.

Andrew's place offers an authentic Australian shed add-on experience - clean, comfortable, convenient, with all the basics (en suite bathroom, tea and coffee making facilities, bar fridge, TV, wifi). Andrew is a friendly, helpful host with a great knowledge of the local area. Andrew and Belinda were happy to provide anything extra I needed. As I was their first guest, they were still putting the final touches to the accommodation. Andrew's place was good value for money, especially for a budget conscious traveller.
Friendly & generous host.  All needs were met with ease. Perfect for the Traveller or for business. Will be back.

We couldn't have had a more friendly or helpful host, he made us very welcome. We only stayed for one night when we went to 'a day on the green' and what do you need the most? A comfy bed for a good nights sleep - and that's what we had. In the morning we discovered that the fridge had fresh fruit and milk (the things we needed for breakfast) and a host of other options. Recommend if you need good clean friendly accomodation.

Andrew and family were lovely! Friendly, helpful and made us feel very welcome. Located in the heart of the Barossa, the separate backyard unit had everything we needed during our stay. Would definitely stay here again!

Andrew and Belinda were both very welcoming and friendly. Their room had everything my partner and I needed and we felt very comfortable there during our stay. On top of that, we had a lot of privacy because it was a separate building from the house.

Absolutely beautiful cottage in a perfect location, very cosy. Would not hesitate to stay again.

Wonderful cottage. Lots of special little extra touches that made it more welcoming. Nice drop of port. Thanks

fantastic again - thanks Wendy

Beautiful garden
Beautiful cottage and great location. We really enjoyed our stay.
Wonderful stay, the place was clean and cozy!! So close to Tanunda restaurants and wineries, a perfect spot for a couple retreat! Would return 100%.
This little cottage is warm and comfortable. Lots of welcoming touches and everything you might need is there.
Great little cottage, close to wineries and town. Excellent bed and bedding and has everything you need for an enjoyable stay.

Very well equipped. Very Comfortable lounge and bedding. Nice setting. Good bathroom. Home away from home, not like a motel. Electric blankets, heating works great. Undercover parking. Everything you need
A lovely, quaint cottage. We didn't stay long enough to appreciate the lovely outdoor area. However, the inside was clean, well set up and just right for two.

Awesome location and a very nice and quite place to stay.

Very comfortable stay and felt relaxed in an instant. Completely met our needs and thoroughly enjoyed all the comforts of the cozy cottage to go along with the food and wine experience we had.
the cottage was super cosy. my husband loved lighting a fire after a long day of wine and exploring. in such a great spot!

Beautiful little cottage with a gorgeous private yard and BBQ area. Fantastic location! We walked to beautiful wineries and into town for dinner.
Wendy has thought of everything that one would want on a special holiday, we felt spoilt. Thank you!

Beautiful comfy cottage with all the amenities and attention to detail that hotels have no hope of matching, a perfect spot to the wineries, amazing hospitality from the Hosts, highly recommend!

Would definitely stay again.
Great little Cottage! Wendy is a great host and we felt right at home

At Little Para Cottage you will feel welcome, find everything you could need and plenty of it…even a set of encyclopaedias…we would certainly suggest that this is a great little Airbnb in a fantastic location.

This is a little hidden gem on the outskirts of Tanunda with everything you can ask for during a weekend getaway. The cottage is cosy and rustic, everything is neatly fitted in. The garden is lovely! Wendy was extremely helpful and friendly - a fabulous host.

Little Para cottage was beyond expectations, beautifully and thoughtfully decorated and appointed. Wendy has an exceptional attention to details, from the complimentary wine and biscuits to the cosy cushions and throw rugs.  We would highly recommend a stay in the Barossa at this sweet cottage.
Lovely well equipped cottage and cute garden on the edge of Tanunda.  Close to everything- several excellent wineries in walking distance. Thanks Wendy for hosting our stay.

Wendy's place was beautifully furnished and on a cold weekend was cozy. Everything you could possibly need was provided. Very comfortable cottage with lounge room, kitchen and  large bedroom with good wardrobe and drawers space. Large outdoors areas with fire pit, lounge chairs and tables and chairs. Undercover parking is a bonus. Overall a great find with incredibly responsive hosts

Lovely little cottage in the middle of everything.

wendy was lovely the entire stay, we had no issues with anything at all and it was absolutely perfect to have a quiet spot to just relax

Wendy’s place was a great spot to base one’s self for a tour of the Barossa.
Great value cottage with all the facilities

Cute little cottage, nestled in a tranquil little garden with private access. We were welcomed with wine and chocolates left for us to enjoy. Small but cosy with nice thoughtful touches. Just what we needed. Would definitely stay again

Only superlatives to describe this little cottage. Secluded, quiet, private & very cosy. We loved it!

Beautiful cottage with everything you need - extra personal touches making it a special experience✨

Little Para Cottage is a wonderful place to stay in the Barossa whilst exploring the region Whilst there are many wineries in the area there are also 2 chocolate factories nearby too or just chill out in the cottage and enjoy the peace and quiet Wendy is lovely although I didn't meet her, she answered questions quickly and in a friendly manner I can't wait to go again

Clean and well located in Nuri. Keys were obtained from the cellar door and Tush was very helpful. They even gave us a few bottles of wine to enjoy during the stay.

We were made to feel really welcome with a bottle of wine on our arrival and our host recommending restaurants and wineries to us before we arrived. When we come back to the Barossa we will most definitely stay here!

The stay at Elderton Lodge was great, we received a warm welcome from Tush, the lodge was comfortable and convenient to all amenities.

We enjoyed tasting the wines at the tasting room and sharing a bottle kindly provided by the lodge.

Would recommend this to others wishing to explore the Barossa.

Elderton Wines lodge was a clean and comfortable house. It is well located within walking distance of most locations in Nuriootpa. The support at the cellar door was excellent and we enjoyed tasting the range of wines. Would recommend as a base to explore the Barossa region.

We loved our staying in Elderton Guest house. House is perfectly located near to all the shops and restaurants.  Best part was the park near by which kids enjoyed every day. I would say it is perfect place for small family of two adult and 2 kids to group of 4 to 5 adults.

What an amazing Place. Elderton guest house is the perfect base for exploring the Barossa. The house was close to the centre of Nuriootpa and right next door to the Elderton vineyard.

On arrival, a bottle of red and a bottle of white were awating for us in the house. The place was very clean and tidy with everything and more than you need.

Tush thank you so much for being such an amazing host, and indulging us with a wine tasting. I recommend this to anyone who stays there. Tush is also a wealth of knowledge on what to explore in the area and also made us feel extremely welcome.

We will definitely be back.

Lovely clean comfortable home, fully equipped with nice welcoming touches.

We were four guys enjoying a golf and wines experience. Communication leading up to our stay was terrific. Once there, everything was at or above expectation. All voted for a return next year.

Comfortable and cozy stay. Great location. Stayed here with 6 guests  (2 couples 2 friends ) and it was a good size, not too small. The hot water stayed hot for everyone and the heating kept the house warm. Nice complimentary touches that made our stay enjoyable.  Recommended to anybody.

Very close to all amenities and some amazing wineries. Check in was smooth and the guest house is actually on a seperate street (roughly 50m away) from the Cellar door, so you can enjoy some privacy.
There was 6 of us, and we had a fantastic stay at Elderton. Some nights spent enjoying the Barossa, and some cooking at home. Very enjoyable!
Thank you!

Great house in a fantastic location, would recommend to any one coming to Noori!

A group of 6 friends stayed here on our way to Clare for a wedding. The staff at Elderton were very welcoming. The house was exactly as we expected, very spacious and comfy beds. Beautiful home close to the winery. Very central and so close to the grocery store. Bottle shop is also walking distance.
Very lovely place 😊
Nice, clean and comfortable accommodation, and lovely quiet neighbourhood for relaxing.
A great place with a good location. The team at Elderton were very lovely to deal with and we will happily visit again. Thank you!!

Beautiful and comfortable cottage and the continental breakfast and wine provided were very much appreciated and very good. Local tips were useful and location was central to everything in the Barossa - thank you for a great stay!

Elderton guest house was exactly what we needed in the Barossa - close to all the great wineries and we even did a tasting at the Elderton cellar door which is beautiful. The house was clean and comfortable and perfect for couples travelling together.
Lovely house, well appointed, comfortable beds & great location
A lovely place that felt like home! Lovely and warm and had all that we needed!

Great stay, comfy beds, easy communication

A very comfortable and spacious house, with all the thoughtful touches for a lovely weekend in the barossa. Well located and perfect for our family with 2 young kids, including high chair etc. and fenced yard.

Great place to stay,

Great place to stay and visit all the local wineries. Nice and quiet location and very homely.

great place to visit nice and near the wineries

Tracey was a lovely host! Very responsive and helpful. The Barossa Seasons Studio was a compact living area which was clean, comfy and cosy. I would recommend to anyone to wants to visit and stay in the Barossa Valley for a couple of nights. It very close to the shops, restaurants and cafes just as decribed. Thanks a bunch Tracey!
Tracey was a wonderful host. The studio was perfect for a couple to use as a base to explore the Barossa and a short few minutes walk into the centre of town.
Nice cosy accomodation and very close to Tanunda's main town facilities.

Unforgettable anniversary getaway!

Fantastic experience.

100% would recommend and we are already planning to stay again!
Great location, very clean, great host, everything we could’ve wanted!

Cozy little retreat after a long day of tastings and eating, was an absolutely perfect place for the 2 of us to retreat for the weekend. Tracey was very helpful and had the place sparkling clean for us and was a fantastic host.

We had an amazing stay here for a couple of nights in the Barossa. Tracey was lovely and the room and bathroom were gorgeous.

Great location, easy to walk to cafes and restaurants. Short drives to local wineries.

Perfect house for a large group (10 people fit comfortably), amazing view and great location. Tracey was also lovely to deal with, quick to respond and very accommodating. We had a great long weekend!
A beautiful property with lovely views, walking distance to everything you may need, house was equipped for the comfort of a large group. Communication fantastic, couldn't be happier!

Tracey's house is in an amazing position in Tanunda, with an incredible outlook from the lounge overlooking the Barossa. Tracey was a pleasure to deal with. The location was excellent and I would highly recommend this to anyone traveling to the Barossa.
A perfect property for large groups. Well situated in town with a beautiful view.

Looking forward to coming back for our next holiday.

Tracey is a wonderful host and extremely responsive before, during and after our stay. Thank your Tracey for being a wonderful host. You were very accommodating and flexible. Your house is lovely, convenient and generous in space and amentities. Cheers
