Kay's B&B was perfect for our getaway to the Barossa. You feel like you're out in the country but only a 5 minute drive from the main strip in Tanunda. The studio is very homely, the bed is comfortable and Kay kindly supplied us with the basics - milk, juice, bread, choccies and port. She is also a local and gives fantastic suggestions for places to visit and local knowledge. We loved our stay in the Barossa.

Kay was amazing. We may as well have been meeting a relative or family friend who could not have tried harder to make our stay a special one. The spot is incredibly iconic, to walk through her little farm with its metalwork sculptures and rustic outdoor setting looking over a river was an experience in itself. This was coupled with a very cute little private house and a bath supplied with lavender salts and a kitchen with freshly laid eggs! Everyone in the town knows Kay and she was able to point us in all the right directions. Kay, you will be receiving all of our visiting family members who come your way!

Staying at Rowland Flat was a pleasant experience for us. The compact and beautifully designed space is private and very comfortable. Kay is a gracious host who made sure we were well looked after. The property is full of beautiful gardens and bountiful chooks, whose lovely eggs were in a basket in the fridge when we arrived. The kitchen is new and nicely done. The old brass bed is not only gorgeous but ver very comfortable. All in all a very good Airbnb experience. Thanks Kay! from Coralie and Peter McKinn
Lovely place and surroundings

We loved staying at the stables. The exquisite garden was about to burst into spring colour with the backdrop of vineyards, along with a few sheep and chooks. Our hosts were very welcoming and friendly. We loved walking on the bike track through the vineyards which was easy to get to at the back of the property. It was also a very central but quiet location for visiting local cafes and wineries and generally imbibing the joys of the Barossa.

Kay and Madeline were exceptional hosts at their beautiful converted stables in the Barossa. The accommodation was just stunning, well set up with everything you need for your stay. The property has vines, gardens, a pool, a deck overlooking the river, sculptures, animals and more! A great location, close to everything, yet far enough away to feel rural. The highlight for me was the hospitality from the ladies... Thankyou for the conversation and the laughs! Will be back again next year!!

Kay is a welcoming and engaging host. Stables is a quaint, rustic well-appointed cottage set in a serene garden with Kay's own Shiraz and Grenache vines within close proximity to the Barossa wineries. It would have been easy to stay extra days and get to know Kay better as she is vibrant and obliging host.

Kay made us feel very welcome. She is an excellent host. The Stables is a beautiful, quiet place to stay. Every little detail has been thought of. Comfortable & super clean. Lovely touches like free range eggs, home made jam & port. We can't wait to plan our next trip to the Barossa to stay at Kay's place.

Kay was fantastic!!! we loved every minute at the stables!!!! Kay supplied eggs, fresh bread, milk and juice for our stay along with some  yummy choccies and port! We loved waking up to the beautiful gardens in the morning! Kay helped us with choosing wineries to visit during our stay and was a pleasure to be around! The property is fantastic and close to everything! We will make sure we stay with Kay again on our next visit to the beautiful Barossa!
Great place in fact perfect for us. Close to vineyards and everything you expect in this area. Caring hostess.

Kay was such an amazing host! I was visiting the region with a group of friends (who were staying at the Novotel), and she was really accommodating with the time of arrival (late afternoon, after some wines!). The place was very clean and tidy. It had everything I needed, including some delicious eggs from her chooks! The whole place is beautifully done.

The Stables are a charming and beautiful BNB. The hosts are very friendly and helpful and our stay was made extremely pleasant by their interaction and manner. The rooms are exactly as described and very homely and comfortable. Spring had certainly sprung in the surrounding gardens full of lavender, roses, rosemary and fruit trees. Rowland Flat is very close as is Tanunda, both charming towns full of stone cottages and interesting shops, restaurants and cafes. The Stables is conveniently located in the Barossa Valley and is close to many famous wineries. We drove from Adelaide through Lyndoch to Rowland Flat which I would recommend to others. This journey is through the Adelaide Hills and although slower than the motorway far more picturesque.
We loved our 3 day stay at Kay's 'Stables'. It is comfortable and in a lovely, quiet part of the Barossa Valley, yet close to everything it has to offer. It live up to the description and then some.

A perfect weekend in the Barossa with fantastic hosts. Thank you for the lovely accommodation with the amazing garden, and your winery suggestion was spot on. Highly recommend a weekend at the Stables - we will be back!

This gorgeous cottage is everything as described and more! It's private but still close enough to everything that you need and a perfect little retreat to return to after a day of touring the beautiful Barossa! Kay is so wonderful and helpful and really made our stay memorable! Wine and nibbles on the deck is a must!

We had a wonderful 3 night stay with Kay and Madeline! They have a beautiful property with wonderful gardens and 2 lovely kelpies! The property was as described a very cute cottage! It was spotlessly clean and it felt like a home away from home. Breakfast was supplied with muesli and free range eggs from the chickens! It is an ideal location for exploring the Barossa and surrounds and Kay and Madeline made us feel very welcome! We will be recommending this property to friends and family when traveling in the Barossa area! Thanks for our lovely stay!

Kay and Madeline made us feel very welcome on their beautiful property (chickens, sheep and gorgeous Kelpies too!). They take great pride in their gardens and the hard work has certainly paid off - wow! The property is even better than described and cleanliness absolutely exceptional. Breakfast was supplied, with eggs coming from their very own free-range chickens. The location couldn't have been more perfect for exploring the Barossa and we will certainly be coming back to stay; we have never felt more at home at someone else's place and never before welcomed with such love! Thank you Kay and Madeline!

The best Airbnb we have ever stayed in. The cottage was equipped with everything you need for a short stay. Kay and her partner are lovely people and excellent communicators. The property is completely dreamy. Highly recommended to anyone visiting the Barossa Valley.

We absolutely loved our stay we Kay. The setting is gorgeous, the stables provided all we needed as well as added bonuses such as fresh eggs from Kay's chooks! Kay was accessible and full of great recommendations for our stay in the Barossa. It was fabulous to be able to access the bike/walking track at the back of the property and great that so many vineyards were so close by. I would definitely stay with Kay again when next in the Barossa

I would highly recommend this place if you are heading to the Barossa. Very good location with many wineries only a couple of minutes away. Also very close to Lyndoch, which is a small town with restaurants and cafes. The property itself was beautiful, it was like a quaint English cottage. The house has everything you could need, with eggs and milk provided in the fridge and your own private outdoor seating area. It was truly idyllic. And Kay was a fantastic host! She was very welcoming and accomodating. Couldn't have asked for a better place to stay!

If you are looking for a relaxing getaway then this cottage is  the perfect answer. Madeleine welcomed us with open arms and an array of information about the area and what we can do. The cottage was equiped with everything we need. It is very comfortable and its decor is beautiful. The bike path is next to the property and Jacob's Creek is in walking distance - this proved very handy. Thank you to Madeleine and Kay for a very relaxing getaway. Would recommend this cottage to anyone who is looking for a relaxing Barossa getaway. Thank you again.

Upon arrival we were greeted by the welcoming committee of Tibbs & Jassie, Kay's gorgeous dogs. Kay showed us to our accommodation and settled us in and made us feel at home right away. There aren't enough superlatives to describe how gorgeous the accommodation and property were. The cottage was stocked with everything we could have asked for, and the free range eggs from Kay's chickens were about the best we've ever had. We cannot recommend this property enough and we wouldn't want to stay anywhere else the next time we visit the Barossa!

We had the best time staying at The Stables, from the first smiley greeting from Kay to the last hug when we left. What a great place, perfect for scenic walks meandering up to Jacobs Creek winery, the gorgeous gardens, dip in the pool to the comfy bed! We just loved it and will definitely be back to stay again
Thanks for having us, The Creeks xx

Kay's cottage is gorgeous and a lovely place for a romantic stay for two people in the Barossa. It is immaculately clean and surrounded by beautiful gardens in a convenient location. Kay has provided some lovely personal finishing touches to make the stay memorable and thoughtful. We had a great time and would recommend Kay's cottage to visitors to the Barossa.

Peaceful, idyllic and homely at the same time. The stables is a beautiful Airbnb for a perfect weekend away.
The set up is perfect with a private patio, which leads straight to the pool.
Kay is a genuinely helpful and joyous host who truly loves having visitors stay. Thank you Kay for having us, would highly recommend your BnB.

I would highly recommend Kay's place. Every inch of the house oozes comfort, style, and rustic farm-style charm. Although I planned to spend time in the gorgeous claw-foot bath, I found myself too busy enjoying the pool which was a welcome relief from the summer heat. The most gorgeous little hand-made stools offer a lovely view of a beautifully tended and well-thought out garden. Kay left eggs from her hens in the fridge for us so we were fully equipped for a little breakfast. She was gracious and old wordly enough to even leave out some complimentary port! We were thoroughly comfortable there and Kay was a bit of a delight to meet and chat with. The grape vines are literally just over the fence offering a beautiful outlook and there is also a little stream nearby to soak up the sunset at a portable set of table and chairs. I can't rave about it enough. Just go. Stay a while. Barossa a lot.

From the moment we arrived we felt comfortable and relaxed. Kay is a wonderful host. From the comfortable accommodation to the gardens and surrounds, our stay was amazing. Our trip to the barossa will be remembered not only for the wineries, food and location, but also the gracious hospitality of our hosts. Outstanding.
excellent accommodation if you want to stay near vineyards in Adelaide

Kay is an wonderful host, who made us feel welcome the moment we got out the car. Her home is just gorgeous and everything has been thought of here. The gardens are beautiful and a must to wonder through. The time and energy that has been spent to create this is obvious.
Loved it!
Beautiful spot in a perfect location with an excellent host. Fantastically situated for a trip away to explore the Barossa. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the stables.

Fantastic! Kay and Madeline were lovely hosts, great to have a chat to and made us very welcome in their home. The guest cottage was spotlessly clean, full of character but with all the modern conveniences and my favourite the claw foot bathtub! Lots of thoughtful touches like local milk and eggs in the fridge so you can prepare yourself breakfast before heading out to explore the Barossa. Would love to come back! Thanks again

The Stables was everything that we expected and more. The cottage is very well appointed and has everything you will need for an amazing stay. Great location for the wineries. Would highly recommend this place to anyone.

What can we say, our stay was more then we ever imagined. Both Kay and Mads were simply wonderful. We fall in love with the cottage, the animals, the surroundings but above all our hosts. We absolutely will be back - without a doubt. This weekend away was exactly what we needed. Thank you both so much! Jess and Craig x x

We absolutely loved our stay. There is a feeling here, waking up with the sun streaming in,fresh Barossa orange juice in the fridge, perfect gardens, carefully restored surroundings, and the warmest welcome. A very personal view of two people's perfect version of Barossa life, generously shared. Finesse, character and location. Thank you!

We had the best time! Kay and Madeline are a hoot! The stables is a true Barossa experience that has now left us wanting more! Perfect hosts, divine environment, farm life and nature outside your door. We absolutely loved our stay here..thanks again to you 2 cool cats! Jos and Mark
This is a fantastic cottage and we felt like we were staying in a Homes and Gardens magazine. Our hosts were super and made sure we had everything we needed.
We loved staying at Kay's place.  If you are looking for somewhere with 'character'  then you have found it.  It has everything you need.
Kay was a wonderful host and the property is absolutely stunning - we'll definitely be back again!
Kay's place has a lovely private accommodation. She makes a special effort to make you feel welcome. I particularly enjoyed her small personal touches to the stay. Many thanks again.

We loved the private location and gorgeous cottage garden full of amazing hidden sculptures. The Stables are well-equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. Standouts were the crisp, fresh linen and the farm fresh eggs for breakfast - yum! Great location for a few days stay to explore the Barossa and surrounds.
Beautiful place! Thanks for having us, we had a great time 😊

This place is amazing . Ideal for a romantics getaway . Renovated stables are comfortable and very tastefully decorated. Even a gorgeous swimming pool to cool off in . The location is perfect - peaceful countryside but minutes from town, wineries and restaurants . Hosts were very hospitable whilst allowing you privacy. Fresh fruit and veggies from the property were a bonus .

I can't think of anywhere better to stay in the Barossa. Kay and her place are both absolutely lovely. Kay is inviting, generous and knowledgeable and her place is beautiful, cozy and relaxing. Will stay there again one day!

Perfect for those who love a rustic country vibe, the old stables are beautifully renovated and very comfortable. Kay is a warm and welcoming host and will go to great lengths to keep everyone happy. If you stop for a chat with Kay you will learn so much more about the local area, food and wine. Perfect for that romantic weekend away!!

I stayed with Kay in the days leading up to my wedding and my wedding night. Kay and her partner were fantastic, caring and helpful - even helping to fix my father's boutonniere, which had the rose head fall off while we were getting ready on my wedding day.
It was the little touches too, like a congratulatory note on the chalkboard, a bottle of bubbles and an awesome bath bomb for our wedding night.
Kay and Madeleine are fabulous hosts, with perfect accomodation in an idyllic setting. Great access to local wineries and all Barossa has to offer. Their place is special - thanks Kay and Madeleine!

Wow. Wow. Wow. If you're looking at somewhere to stay in the Barossa, stop looking and stay at the Stables. From the scented garden, free ranging chickens to the warm hilarious hostesses with the mostess. We had such a chilled food frenzied long weekend in the Barossa and couldn't think of a more gorgeous place to stay. The Stables are straight out of a country style editorial. Perfectly refurbished with all the right touches. Highlights were eating fresh eggs for brekky, taking a soak in the  claw foot bath, and binging on books on the verandah. Thank you for making us feel so welcomed in your slice of paradise Kaye and Madeline XX

Kay and Madeleine are wonderful, welcoming hosts! This Air BnB is comfortable, cosy and well equipped with everything you need. The bed was fantastic, the bathroom deluxe and the serenity was second to none. There were fresh eggs and coffee in the morning, topped off by a peaceful wine on the deck, at night. We loved watching the Kelpies and Polly the horse roam free, amongst Kay and Madeleine's home grown vines.
The location was perfectly placed between Lyndoch and Tanunda, allowing for a short drive to many wineries - there are even a few that are in walking distance!
We felt extremely safe and secure whilst staying here and would absolutely visit again.
Thanks to Kay and Madeleine for a relaxing and refreshing long weekend! They're truly welcoming humans with a knack for running a BnB.
Loved our stay

Kay and Madeleine are the most lovely hosts. They were very welcoming and friendly. We loved the breakfast provisions provided of muesli, the home made jam, fruit and the fresh eggs.
We enjoyed our walk on the property to see the river and along the bike trail at the back of the property.
The place is tranquil and we wish we could have stayed longer. I'd love to stay again one day!
Kay and Madeleine were very welcoming and went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and relaxed. What they offered was outstanding and we thoroughly enjoyed every minute! We will be back.

We had a great time at this lovely little cottage. The property is very pretty with a nice garden and outdoor decorations. The cottage itself is cute and clean. We really liked the bath and sitting on the couch with a glass of port. There were some yummy breakfast supplies and found the hosts extremely friendly and helpful. We would certainly go back for another trip!
Thank you Kay for sharing your little piece of paradise with us. We could have stayed longer it was so enjoyable and comfortable.
Kay and Madeleine were wonderful hosts! The cosy house is nestled amongst beautiful gardens and we also loved the complimentary farm produce: rustic bliss!

Thank-you Kay & Madeleine!
We very much enjoyed your unique accommodation, beautiful garden and it was lovely to meet all your companions :)
It was the perfect location for us to get around the Barossa Valley. Its now our favourite wine destination in Australia :)).
Our stay was far too short, and we can't wait to come back again!!

What a wonderful little secret place this is.
Rustic charm , warm friendly hosts made it so easy to relax.
A beautiful place to stay and perfectly placed to explore the Valley.
Wonderful
Paul and Helen
Kay was an amazing host. Full of suggestions of things to do and places to visit. Her property is amazing, absolutely stunning. We had a fabulous time.
Kay made us feel very welcome and was great at recommending local restaurants.

One of the best air bnb's I've stayed at! Kay was so welcoming from the first contact, was an extreme wealth of knowledge and had the perfect spot in the barossa. I couldn't recommend staying here enough!! You will leave with the biggest smile on your face and the best memories.

We loved our stay at The Stables. Gorgeous quaint cottage, picture windows filled with sunlight, beautifully furnished with personality and stunning surrounds. Kay really has nailed the set up, thinking about all the little needs and delights that guests hope to find and provided a lovely brekkie with self-contained kitchenette to cook it up in! Highly recommend walking past the vineyard, past the horse and chooks, up to their deck which overlooks the river. If you are a light sleeper you may hear the odd vehicle on the nearby road during the night, although nothing to put us off coming back. Thanks very much for having us Kay and your hospitality.

Kay's stable is beautifully appointed and spotlessly clean. She is a most welcoming host and is full of great information and special tips.
The stable is well situated in the Barossa, well equiped and perfect for a short stay close to the beautiful Tanunda pines Golf Course.

Fabulous! The Stables was really the perfect accompaniment to our trip to the Barossa Valley. Kay and Madeleine were such wonderful hosts - warm, welcoming, and so hospitable. They were very willing to offer suggestions and recommendations for out-of-towners. The Stables is in a great location - at the start of a nice stretch to Tanunda with more than a handful of wineries on the way. We definitely recommend borrowing the bikes - the bike path is beautiful (slightly challenging for a wine lover but definitely worth it for the view - and the wineries along the way!). The Stables was the epitome of country charm - it was lovely to wake up with a view into the private gardens, enjoy a long hot soak in the claw foot bath, and partake in a leisurely breakfast of local produce including home-made preserves and fresh eggs! We wouldn't hesitate to recommend this AirBnB and hope to visit again soon.

Kay's place is a perfect base for your visit to the Barossa Valley. The cottage was small but perfectly self-contained. The heating was very warm, the bath was big, the bed was snuggly and she even provided a simple breakfast for us. The location is ideal and very close to many excellent wineries. Kay can give you suggestions for where to go and if you want to stay put then she has a pretty deck overlooking a creek, perfect for afternoon drinks. We can't wait to come back.

Kay and Mads were sensational hosts with the most beautiful property. We loved the high standard of this gorgeous little cottage from the roll top bath through to the kitchen amenities. We would absolutely stay again!

This place is beautiful and Kay and Madeleine were so welcoming. We got there late but they were around with the electric blanket and heater on:) There was coffee, muesli eggs and bread in the fridge for breakfast and a carafe of Barossa port to ease us into it.
This is a great location if you have an event at the Novotel as it's walking distance. Kay hires out bikes and you can easily ride or drive to Tanunda and a whole bunch of great restaurants and wineries.
We had a great stay, highly recommended.

A fantastic little spot in the Barossa! Exactly what we were after end a great little stay. Kay and Madeline are great people and offer a wonderful stay. A highlight is their private deck area by the Jacob's Creek River. Perfect!

The most beautiful little farm house! Kay was such a great host, providing us with fresh produce from her farm for breakfast.  A very cosy and inviting place to stay. Thanks for making our Barossa experience even more memorable!

The Stables is an absolute delight - straight out of the pages of 'Country Style' magazine.  Kay is a wonderful host and couldn't do enough for us, from homegrown oranges, lemons, eggs, jam, wine to name but a few!  The location is peaceful and beautiful - we would love to return someday, in the summertime, to take full advantage of the lovely garden and pool set amongst the vines.

This place is FABULOUS. Close to everything important but removed enough to feel like a  true getaway. Chooks, a horse and beautiful gardens...it's truly a fairytale. The bed is super comfy and the home is equipped with everything you'll need, not to mention a deep claw foot tub with homemade bath salts and candles. The place backs up onto a sprawling vineyard and a short walk takes you to a verandah overhanging a beautiful river below. It's a little paradise. Kay is absolutely fabulous and even left us fresh eggs and bread and port. We had a lovely stay and are dreaming of returning one day.

Thanks so much Kay and Madeline,
Your little BnB is just so perfect, from the produce in the fridge, loaded citrus trees and little extras everywhere. A perfect place to unwind and enjoy another tranquil world for a while. We enjoyed walking and riding the nearby trail, enjoyed the river views, their dogs and friendly horse.
Looking forward to returning one day
A beautiful property - very homely and satisfying. Kay and Madeleine were wonderful to get to know and we will back again - no doubt!
Thanks so much! A beautiful little getaway and we will surely be back in the future for our annual trip 😊

My wife and I enjoyed our stay immensely, we were very well looked after. Favourite part would be having fresh eggs to cook for breakfast, this was amazing along with fresh herbs and fruit from the garden surroundings.
Was well worth it.

We felt instantly at home the minute we pulled up at The Stables, especially after the very warm welcome we received from Kay and Madeline. Such lovely hosts, its hard not to feel like you are visiting old friends.
Its the little things that make The Stables special - the provisions left in the fridge, home made bath salts, the ironed bed linen (AMAZING!), cosy decor, gardens and surrounding views, the list could easily go on! We can't wait to return, perhaps in the summer when the pool is in action.
Great place to stay and lovely hosts. We will definitely be back!

Loved the atmosphere and location of this place. Modern facilities and the garden was wonderful. Definitely recommend​ walking up to the deck area for an afternoon chill. Loved seeing all the animals too.

Kay and Madeleine were the perfect hosts for an amazing weekend stay! The place was so nice and well put together, surrounded by amazing gardens and farmland. From the awesome deck overlooking the river to the little touches like fresh eggs in the kitchen (delicious by the way), I would highly recommend The Stables to anyone looking for a getaway in the Barossa. Thanks for all the great local tips as well!

Welcoming and very friendly.
Great location and full of character.
Will return one day
The Stables provided us a super comfortable and aesthetically delightful sanctuary to enjoy our Barossa getaway from. So much more than we expected- we look forward to returning again.

I can highly recommend The Stables. Kay is a great host who really makes you feel welcome. The property is great with a highlight being the deck that overlooks the creek. We found the location very convenient too.
Kay & Madeline were wonderful hosts. Their property is beautiful and the cottage is just perfect. Tanunda is also a lovely town.

After a liesurely cruise through the barossa vineyards we found our secluded retreat nestled serenely in the beautiful australian landscape. Kay greeted us with the warmth of an old friend and provided us with a continental breakfast and complimentary port. The place was quaint yet spacious, heritage yet contemporary and with plenty to explore including an intimate meeting with a beautiful horse. We've fallen in love with the place and know we'll be back. We just hope the secret of this enchanting place doesnt catch on too much.
We would highly this accommodation. Beautiful place in a beautiful area. The personal touches really made the difference.

Kay and Madeline offer a true Airbnb experience. The Stables is a unique accommodation destination that reflects the style of these two amazing women. It is both quirky and stylish and offers a truely great base from which to explore the delights of the Barossa. Kay is a wealth of knowledge from what restaurants to try to essentials like “the best bacon in Australia”.
There are delights around every corner for visitors to discover and I am sure we will return as we felt like old friends when we left,

This place is the best! Absolutely perfect to escape and slow down, relax and enjoy the beauty of the region. Gorgeous place and gorgeous hosts. We felt so welcome and loved the authenticity of the place. We loved it!

The photos don’t do it justice! It was a beautiful place to stay, despite the heat! Even so we were able to cool off in the pool with the vineyards as the backdrop. I would 100% recommended a trip up here and I will be going back again when ever I’m going to the Barossa.

In a word, "Perfect."  It was the little extra touches that made it special.  Home made bath salts, free range eggs and a wonderful welcome.  I can't wait to go back again.  I also received some wonderful tips for local wineries and restaurants. Thanks so much.
Kay is a wonderful host and made us feel most welcome. Some lovely thoughtful touches including the choccies and those wonderful eggs from her chucks! We will remember our stay for a long while

Kay's place is stunning, Kay was an excellent host - showing us around and suggesting the best places to go. The place we stayed in was perfect, great spot which is close to all the best winery's, the apartment/little house was gorgeous, clean and had special little touches left by Kay. 100% best place to stay in the Barossa Valley! :)

Kay and Madeleine are wonderful welcoming women with a super space for rent.  The place is really well equipped and stylish and comfy.  The bbq, river deck and pool are real bonuses.  And the chocolates were great!  Highly recommended.  Thanks ladies!  Had a lot of laughs.
Lovely place! Would recommend!

Kay and Madeline were absolutely wonderful hosts and the B&B an absolute gem. Between the fruit trees, vines, dogs, horses and chickens - what a fun experience. And the stable cottage was beautiful with small touches everywhere - including apple juice, chocolates and a tasty dessert liqueur. I rented a bike and hopped on the convenient bike trail (literally along their property) and easily toured the local wineries and road into town for some food.  After a long day of riding, I came home and took a bath in their amazing clawfoot bathtub with some provided bath salts. What a great place. Highly, highly recommend!

Great host. Beautiful property.
We had a great time relaxing at Kay's Barossa hide-away. Would definitely recommend to a couple

Beautiful and charming little studio cottage, only a short drive from many of the exquisite cellar doors in the Barossa. Kay has been a wonderful host who welcomed us with warm and open arms. I would recommend anyone who is wanting to stay in the Barossa to stay with Kay, as the experience is one you won't be able to get anywhere else.

If you are looking to base yourself in barossa valley to explore the wineries etc in the area you will find this central and close to everything! There are bike trails near if you don’t want to drive but we did find having a car to get around very convenient..10 mins in any direction and we found ourselves in another awesome winery etc. the property is beautiful and serene and Kay is a brilliant host! Planning to return back to this place!
Lovely spot! Would highly recommend it!
Beautiful quiet little place! Kay is friendly and helpful. Would definitely recommend

The whole premises is loaded with work of art, which gives the whole a very special character. We loved sitting on the terrasse and having a glas of wine. It’s a nice retreat for those who need a break from the everydays stress in the city for a view days. Kay was very nice and knows everything around this area, helping to find the places your looking for.
The Stables is a home away from home in stunning surroundings. Spacious, clean and well equipped. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Highly recommended.
Amazing place to stay. Kay is very welcoming and made us feel at home. Great location to lots of winery's.

Highly recommended - very comfortable with a warm host and friendly canines too. The stables have everything for a couple, even home grown eggs! A charming setting with a developing cottage garden. Handy to Tanunda and the Barossa.

Kay’s very cute little cottage was absolutely amazing. Stunning gardens, lovely homely interiors, gorgeous bath, great breakfast bar - it has everything you need for a truly comfortable getaway. Kay is definitely the nicest person in the Barossa (or maybe even Australia). From gorgeous homemade jams, fresh happy chicken eggs, homemade bath salts, and the list goes on, you won’t find anywhere better to stay in the Barossa. Kay and Madeleine (also equally nice) have two very cute dogs, two very friendly horses, their own vineyard, pool etc. In terms of location, the are very close to so many wineries and cute towns. Overall I already want to go back - Kay made her home feel like our home.

The Stables was a beautiful spot for my husband to be and for his groomsmen to get ready for our wedding in Lyndoch.

Kay the host was just lovely in every way and so welcoming and warm.
She gave us a little history tour of her land and it was very interesting.
She was fantastic and the house Our Best man stayed in was lovely and clean. Beautifully decorated and thoughtful touches everywhere.
Would definitely recommend anyone to stay here. Will be returning customers for sure!
Really enjoyed our stay at Kay’s beautiful place, thank you for being so welcoming

The Stables is a wonderful place to relax with easy access to the Barrossa's best wineries. We felt so comfortable there in the beautiful garden and bush surroundings. Everything was just perfect.  Highly recommended.

Kay was a wonderful host that was extremely welcoming and friendly. It is a beautiful little cottage on an amazing property with beautiful views. The deck overlooking the river was our favourite spot. We had a fabulous time exploring the area and even got engaged while we were there. Definitely will be coming back and recommending to friends and family!

We loved our two nights at Kay's place and next time we will stay longer. Kay has set up a beautiful place in a great location . Spacious for a couple with very comfortable and tasteful decor. Nice touches such as fresh eggs, quality bread and coffee. The surrounding property has lovely garden areas and a deck which overlooks the river at the back. We had some great chats with Kay who is super friendly. Highly recommend this little gem.

Kay’s place is perfect. From the beautiful fresh eggs to the lovely roll topped bath you could not ask for more. The location is fantastic and the farm animals are so cute especially the horses. We cannot recommend the Stables highly enough. You will love it.
Our holiday at Kays couldn't have been better. She absolutely went out of her way in every way to make it perfect. A great Barossa location!!

Beautiful accommodation, close enough to easily get to all the best vineyards and attractions but far enough away to get away, from city hustle and bustle. Lovely hosts, who were very helpful in suggesting where to go and what might be best to do.
If you intent to stay in the region I strongly recommend this Host and Accommodation.

This is a delightful property, luxurious and full of character and charm. Gorgeous property, great location, and couldn't ask for a better host. You will not be disappointed!

Kay and Madeleine are delightful super hosts. They are passionate about their private piece of paradise and a wealth of knowledge for the local area. I recommend leaving some spare time to ponder their sensational garden, homegrown produce and enjoy a tipple on their deck, perched over the Para River. Their puppers are super friendly welcoming committee.

Perfect spot and a perfect room. We really enjoyed staying at the stables. Great welcoming hosts who have done an amazing job with this property. The dogs and chickens give the place a warm homely vibe. Delicious breakfasts and friendly pats.
Make sure you watch the sunset on the riverside deck for a perfect afternoon.
Thanks again Kay and co and hopefully we will see you again someday.
Brilliant accomodation and fabulous host! The house has so many beautiful touches including delicious breakfast! The surroundings of beautiful vineyards is an extra touch. Highly recommend!

Amazing place! Kay was a fantastic host, friendly, very responsive and great to have a few chats with while we were there. The cottage was set up very well with a well equipped kitchen. There were also some great personal touches throughout. And the property is great. The deck down the back, the gardens and plenty of space to explore and walk around. Plus Daisy and Tib were always there to welcome us back. Highly recommend and hope to be back again some day
We had such a lovely time at The Stables. Kay is a wonderful host. Highly recommend if your planning to visit the Barossa!

A wonderful place to stay. Close to the many great wineries in the area. The cottage is clean, cosy and comfortable. The gardens are superb. There is a wooden landing on the property, looking over the creek, complete with a hanging chair - so relaxing.

An incredible spot to stay for a weekend in the Barossa! So peaceful there and we spent more of our time relaxing and enjoying the beautiful  property and didn’t feel the need to do too much else, we will definitely recommend to our friends and family!
A wonderful spot to stay in the Barossa. Lots of thoughtful touches by the hosts, quiet and overlooking the lovely garden.

Kay's place was a fantastic base for all of our adventures in the Barossa. The place itself was lovely to stay in, and was not too far from Tanunda, and other areas of the Barossa we visited. Kay and her partner were extremely welcoming, and we absolutely look forward to a future stay at the Stables!

Cannot recommend The Stables more highly. A perfect place to set up and explore everything that the Barossa Valley has to offer. The private deck over the creek was a perfect spot for sundowners and a cheese board. The bike and walking trail through Jacobs Creek and St Hallets was gorgeous.

If you’re thinking about booking it, just book it! This is by far my favourite Air BnB. Not only is ita perfect location to explore the Barossa, but Kay and Madeline are the most beautiful hosts. The cottage is surrounded by the most stunning gardens (Kay has a brilliant green thumb) to enjoy relaxing, reading, a swim in the pool, or a wine on the deck. We’ll definitely be coming back hopefully soon.

Simply stunning is the only way to describe The Stables accommodation and it’s surrounds . We enjoyed 9 nights here and didn’t want to leave . This beautiful accommodation is enhanced by two brilliant hosts who are very accommodating. The Stables is a great place to enjoy all the Barossa has to offer .
What an amazing stay, the pictures don’t do this place justice. Really lovely stay and great hosts! We loved the location, a real base to explore multiple towns and vineyards!

Kay and her partner were exceptional Hosts.They championed the Barossa and all it has to offer. The accommodation was perfect for a weekend Homestead getaway. The cottage was exceptionally clean and plenty of extra provisions were provided as a pleasant surprise. We look forward to returning soon!

10/10. The photos of the Stables and the property on Airbnb do not do this place justice. The accommodation is well thought out and has all the creature comforts one would need. The property surrounding the Stables is gorgeous and the perfect place to unwind. The location is great- the town is a short drive away, and there are wineries that are close enough to cycle too. On top of that Kay and Madeleines hospitality is second to none. We loved staying here and can’t wait to come back.
What a fantastic location & accommodation, the hospitality was beyond compare, it was a shame to leave so soon

Absolutely loved my stay. Kay was very friendly and accommodating. Beautiful and peaceful place. Great location and delicious fresh produce provided for a hearty breakfast. Looking forward to my next visit!

Charming B&B with everything you need for a comfortable & relaxing stay, nestled in a beautiful garden setting. A short walk to the deck which is ideal for sunset drinks & we enjoyed a refreshing dip in the pool.  Friendly hosts who made us feel very welcome as they shared their piece of paradise with us.  Thanks also to Dixie & Tibs for making us feel welcome with lots of tail-wagging.

Just gorgeous.
Lovely cottage in a beautiful setting.
Lots of special home grown treats.
The place itself is well equipped, very clean, beautiful bathroom with a fab bathtub.
Don't hesitate, book this place.

The best Airbnb we’ve ever stayed in! The most amazing little space to relax and enjoy the Barossa right on your doorstep. We can’t wait to recommend Kay’s place to our friends and family. Just the best!

Fantastic little place in Rowland Flat. Minutes away from Tanunda, tucked away in a valley.
With a garden and back area full of free range chickens, fruit trees, sculptures and native flora and fauna its a perfect retreat.

MUST STAY!!
You will be doing yourself a dishonour if you do not stay at The Stables when in the Barossa.
A very cute cozy stay. Super clean and everything you could need.
In the heart of the Barossa with all the wineries only a short drive away.
Kay was an awesome host. She has created the most amazing private oasis. A great location, with heaps of personal touches, nestled within a stunning garden. Highly recommended!

What a beautiful little gem! The house while quaint and cozy, has everything you need, I particularly loved the bath tub. But the real magic is in the grounds! From the patio at the far end, the fire pit, the pool, to my favourite, all the metal art work, you can really feel the love and care that has gone into creating this wonderful experience. Also loved all the fruit trees 😊 Thank you Kay for sharing your home!
The Stables were a perfect base camp for exploring the Barossa, lovely hosts and beautiful property, and we were tempted to kidnap the dogs who made the stay even more special! Highly recommend

Very pleasant stay in the Barossa countryside - farm stay with all the conveniences. Wonderful hosts, comfortable lodgings.
Perfect time of year, very photogenic.
Merci and highly recommend.

Quiet, quaint little place away from the main road set amidst gardens and vineyards. Bed was reasonably comfortable and shower was good. Nice breakfast provisions supplied and kitchenette pretty well equipped with essentials.
Everything was easy and as described. We loved the location and setting. The little touches of fresh eggs, chocolate  and port were greatly appreciated.
What a restful 2 night stay! Bed was great, big bath, close proximity to wineries, cycle/walking path at back gate that goes all the way to Tanunda, lovely hosts!

The stables is more than just accommodation the host Kay is charming and quite the character. The charm of the cottage is amazing and the cleanliness next level. It is amazing to look out at an immaculate garden and be able to pick your own oranges for juicing in the morning to have alongside fresh eggs from Kay’s chickens. Thank you for such a lovely experience in a very beautiful part of the world.
Cheers
Glen & Kim
We would highly recommend this Airbnb. Wonderful little touches with fresh eggs and other treats and Port. We felt very at home and comfortable. A wonderful location too!

This holiday stay in Rowland Flat at “The Stables “ is an marvellous place to unwind from the city rat-race. We had fresh farm eggs, fruit trees to pick from - an excellent comfortable bed. Kay & Madeleine are such helpful hosts. Their design of the cottage, rescued from the old stone walls of times past is beautifully done. It’s a tribute to good taste! Enjoy
Patricia & Michael
the Stables are a perfect spot in the Barossa to base one's self for a few days. Kay is a superb host and her amazing house and garden are the stuff dreams are made off.
Booked this beautiful place for a little Barossa weekender. Loved it! So much charm and character. And Kay was an absolute delight.
Great location and wonderful accommodation, such a friendly host in Kay!

The Stables is an absolutely beautiful place to stay and I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting the Barossa. The Stables has a small kitchenette and barbecue so it was easy to cook meals. We loved walking through the paddocks to the veranda on the creek. It was a beautiful spot to watch the sun go down and sip wine. The Stables is a short drive from Tanunda where there is a grocery store, and lots of shops and cafes. Most of the wineries are a short drive away, and there is a good taxi service available. Kay and Mads are wonderful hosts and offered us lots of great local tips! We can’t wait to visit again soon.

The Stables is a character filled cosy cottage surrounded by beautiful gardens, vineyards and all the charm of The Barossa. Kay is a warm host who has added many special artistic touches to this wonderful place. It was a delight to meet Polly the shetland pony and spend time contemplating the lovely views.
Our trip to nearby wineries, including Rockfords and Bethany, was really memorable. Coming back to our warm and inviting accomodation at the end of the day was a treat.
THe Stables is divine. I cannot find the words to truly express our gratitude. We will be back yearly for as long as Kay will have us. Do yourself a favour and stay here!

If you’re looking for a warm welcome and a relaxing stay in a beautiful location you should definitely stay here at the Stables.  Kay and Madeleine are delightful and so generous of their time. We loved it  and absolutely recommend. I’d love to come back and stay again.

Such a find!
Buildings and gardens touched by love and magical hands; head
Redeeming history from stones,
The crafting of walkways and spaces for reflection and birdsong
With the weaving of fruitfulness of farm......
Definitely a hidden gem - with the feel of a home from home. At the end of a day out, "Let's go home!" And we did - back to the Stables!

Gorgeous gardens, wonderful and warm host and super clean accommodation. We enjoyed the scenic  walking trail with a private deck overlooking the north para river. Our second time in the Barossa and we have found  the perfect accommodation for the next time we come back.
Beautiful place in a beautiful location with wonderful hosts. Thank you for our stay!

We had a wonderful stay in Kay and Madeleine’s garden of paradise!  Great location from which to explore the Barossa, Heysen Trail directly behind the property, cosy romantic cottage for two,  port and chocolates, free range eggs and fresh oranges 🍊. Kay and Madeleine were so welcoming, warm and personable … just lovely people!  St Hugo’s Restaurant highly recommended and also Rockford Wines.

Absolutely delightful accommodation! Very peaceful, some lovely dogs to keep you company and the sounds of nature just really set the scene for an amazing time. Kay is a great host and very knowledgeable of the area. Location is pretty central, close to all the major wineries in the Barossa Valley. Highly recommended!

This is the perfect place to stay at the Barossa! Kay and Madeleine are so welcoming and make your stay truly special. Their garden is absolutely stunning and they provide you with food for breakfast, some port and of course let you say hello to the other residents (chickens, beautiful dogs, and very special little pigs and a pony). We cannot wait to stay again

An exceptional location for a Barossa stay. If you are a couple looking for a peaceful, tranquil villa type setting in the beautiful Barossa, this is your place.
Kay and Madeleine are exceptional hosts.
I cannot speak highly enough of their attention to detail and accomodating approach.

Kay was extremely welcoming an lovely to chat to. Place was really beautiful to stay at. Her property was stunning an was a very relaxing weekend all round. Definitely will go back one day an highly recommended.

A gorgeous little place to stay amongst a beautiful garden, and cute farm animals. There is a spacious bathroom,  well stocked kitchenette (Port and chocolates, milk, eggs, cooking oil, juice, cereal, frech press cofee, foil, clingwrap etc), comfy couch, and the bed and linen luxurious.  We enjoyed a quiet time reading and occasionally swimming a few laps in the pool, or sitting under the verandah, having a sip or two of a cold bevvie. The indoors is comfortable and cool, and the air conditioner and ceiling fans ensure a comfortable nights sleep with overnight temperatures around 21 degrees (Aussie summer).  Kay came to meet us and farewell us, and is a very friendly and approachable host!  This was a really positive experience for us (a couple) celebrating our wedding anniversary in style and comfort. We dined at Seppeltsfield (Fino), and made use of the weberQ provided at The Tack Shed to prepare our own meal. Tanunda and  Lyndoch are not far away. We'll be back for sure!

Second stay at the stables, fantastic location. Close enough to everything that it is convenient and far enough away to feel secluded and relaxed.
Recommend highly.
Tom
We couldn’t have asked for anything more. Beautiful property, fantastic women and superb location. Thank you both :) we loved everything about it.
Beautiful accomodation… amazing pool . Great host !!

We had a really wonderful stay at Kay’s property - such a beautiful setting, lovely accommodation, rustic and charming.  Everything was very clean and comfortable.  Kay and Madeleine were extremely friendly and helpful hosts.  We also enjoyed meeting the dogs and piglets!  Lovely, country walks close by and a great deck overlooking the creek.  A very special place with such welcoming hosts.

Our trip to the Stables in Rowland Flat was just perfect. A little piece of relaxing paradise. Sweet stone cottage with all the amenities you require. The garden was just beautiful, the deck at the edge of the property an oasis of calm overlooking a stream and lovely flora and fauna, and the swimming pool a joy. Kay has 2 wonderful friendly dogs who live on the adjoining property but who are happy to visit! 2 cute pigs and several chickens. The property is surrounded by vines and the vibe is delightful. Kay is very welcoming and stocked the fridge with essentials and fresh eggs from her chooks. Highly recommended and very central for Barossa Valley winery visits. Thanks Kay for a lovely visit.
We had a wonderful stay at the Stables.  It was just the perfect place to stay and relax.  The amenities were great and we loved the beautiful pool too.
Fabulous location- close to wineries and towns, fabulous apartment- comfy bed, great bath, kitchen and lounge, fabulous outdoor areas and fabulous hosts, both human and animal! Highly recommend.

I booked The Stables as a birthday present for my father. the booking was for my parents and Kay was in regular contact with me to help make my parent's stay extra special. My parents gushed that they were feeling very spoilt, the adored Kay, the property and the garden, and of course the animals. Thank you for making their stay so special. I highly recommend Kay and the Stables

Beautiful place in a lovely country setting. Picked pears off the trees. Dogs Tibs and Dixie and pigs Eric and Scarlet were adorable. Enjoyed Rockford Cellar Door close by and Maggie Beer’s farm shop. Lovely hosts Kay and Madeleine.

Kay and Madeleine are such friendly hosts, who are more than happy to give recommendations to do and see in the Barossa valley. Our accommodation was immaculately clean with all the facilities you could ask for. If we are in the Barossa again we will definitely stay again!
We loved the peaceful farm environment; there was everything we wanted and Kay was very helpful with suggestions in the neighbourhood

We enjoyed every minute of our stay at Kay’s place. It was in a great location close to all the wineries we like to visit and on the same road as the Novotel if you feel like a nice dinner out. It was cosy and quaint just like the photos. Kay was very welcoming and the dogs were gorgeous. We will be back!
Very clean and comfortable, with tasteful styling all set in a lovely rural setting.  Walking trail at the bottom of the garden too.  Kay a very friendly host.  Can recommend 100%.
Wonderfully quiet and private. Close to towns and wineries. Kay is a very friendly and warm host. Thanks for the stay.

The Stables is a little piece of paradise, tucked away in the Barossa. This lovingly restored building offers everything we needed for our three night stay. The added touches including farm fresh eggs from the feathered girls were truly appreciated.
The surrounds augment the setting with a stunning country garden, pool and beautiful rural vista. We particularly loved Stella and Eric the pigs who welcomed us with enthusiastic grunts. The dogs were friendly and welcoming.
Kay and Madeleine are the perfect hosts, greeting us like long lost friends, with entertaining tales of their journey to restore this property.
Loved every minute here and can’t recommend it highly enough.

Kay was incredibly welcoming and friendly towards my partner and I, and was more than accomodating providing us with fresh eggs, bread and spreads along with spotless amenities.
Being only an 8 minute drive from Tanunda, the stables are in an incredible location for someone looking for some peace and quiet while still being close by a town and some of SA’s best wineries.
Cannot recommend staying here enough

Kay is really nice and easy to speak to.
the place is really nice and quiet.
I really recommend it.

We had a very enjoyable stay in this beautifully restored building. There was everything we needed and it was homely without being too cluttered. We liked being close to the cyling/walking path. Excellent to have a bin for compostable waste, in the kitchen, too. Host was friendly, but not intrusive.

Beautiful spot next to the cycle/walkway. It is central to the Barossa villages and vineyards. They are great hosts who go the extra mile to make your stay enjoyable. It is set in a pretty garden close to the river.
Great place, beautiful accomodation and the friendliest most helpful host you could wish for - it was a lovely stay
A nice stone cottage on Kay's property. Lovely garden area with a pool, backing onto vineyards. Friendly and considerate host; we only wished we were able to stay longer. Definitely hoping to return.

Fell very lucky to have found such a beautiful place to stay, absolutely breathtaking.
Hosts were amazing, friendly, approachable & so welcoming.
Will be back for sure. Lee.

My partner and I loved exploring the property, saying hello to the animals and admiring the gardens and the bird life it attracted. Our stay in The Stables was comfortable and cosy and a great location from which to explore the Barossa.
Very quaint great for a couples getaway
Kay’s place was fantastic, a beautiful property, lovely garden and cottage. Great for a relaxing weekend. Very friendly and helpful host.

My husband and I had such a beautiful stay at The Stables for our 1st year wedding anniversary. Kay was so welcoming and accommodating with all the extra touches. It truly was a special place to stay and we will definitely be back. Thanks again Kay & Madeleine. 😊

The Stables is one of Australia’s crown jewels. The place offers great views to a beautiful vineyard and to a well organized farm. It is also offer an awesome experience when you meet Kay, Madeline and their animals. They all are wonderful. Another major drawcard about their property, it is beautifully preserved as it was built in 1920 but yet is equipped with modern amenities. I will definitely come back

This was our second stay at The Stables. We would give it more than five stars if we could, as it really is a beautiful place to stay and relax.
Kay and Madeleine are wonderful and very friendly and fun hosts, and gave us some really good recommendations on where to eat, and what to do whilst in the area.
Plenty of breakfast provisions, a lovely big swimming pool, outside deck with beautiful views overlooking the North Para River, farm animals, and a magnificent garden were just a few of the many things provided to enjoy the stay.
Thanks again! As Arnie (Terminator) would say, I’ll be back!
Piece of heaven on Earth!! We absolutely enjoyed our stay. Loved the chickens, pigs and dogs! And even more Kay and Madelaine! It’s the perfect stay for your trip to the Barossa.
Kay and her partner are awesome hosts. The Stable is a superb couple retreat in the green and peaceful atmosphere. Kay See you again….

We loved our stay at Kay’s place. Kay was there to welcome us when we arrived and show us through the accommodation.
The cottage was charming with lots of thoughtful touches throughout that gave it a warm homely feeling.
The pool was an awesome feature especially during a rather warm weekend. Great for bike riding along the bike trails to the neighbouring towns. Hope to return when the Para River is flowing. Kay and her partner were lovely hosts and I recommend staying at The Stables.

Kay’s place was a wonderful little getaway for two. It was close to many of the Barossa wineries. Plus the pool was a great cool down after a hot day. We enjoyed getting to meet the chickens, dogs and getting to know Kay. Thanks for a lovely time!
Kay and Mads were just lovely - very fortunate to have found this place. Big love to Eric and Stella!
Fantastic getaway location, wonderful property and host. Definitely a must for a peaceful romantic baroaas holiday.

We loved our stay at The Stables.
The accommodation is gorgeous, spotlessly clean and extremely well set up with quality items (crockery, cutlery, glassware, bbq etc).
Kay supplied amazing provisions: free range eggs, great bread, orange juice, plunger coffee, port and chocolates!!
The accomodation is surrounded by beautiful gardens, and I loved sitting at the breakfast bar watching the birds in the morning. It was fun finding lots of quirky garden ornaments. The property is adjacent to the Barossa Trail, so great for walking, cycling and geocaching.
Kay, Madeleine and the dogs are all incredibly friendly and embraced us as members of their family.
Kay certainly deserves her 'superhost' status! She (&Madeleine) have gone above and beyond in providing a top notch B&B and overall experience.
Thank you both so much for a wonderful stay!

We felt at home from the moment we arrived. The surroundings are beautiful, the cottage is delightful and very well appointed.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

One of the nicest Airbnb stays I’ve ever had. Kay and Madeleine were super helpful and great hosts. Kay took us for a walk around the property and we got to feed the pet pigs. Fresh eggs every morning for breakfast was a nice touch too. Would love to come back for a longer stay and enjoy a few more Barossa wineries and restaurants.

We enjoyed a beautiful stay at Kay’s place. The location cannot be beaten, with picturesque gardens and scenery, and only a short drive to Barossa attractions. Kay was a very warm and welcoming host, and we really enjoyed our tour of the property, as well as feeding her pet pigs and patting her friendly dogs. Can’t wait to come back!!
Lovely location, beautiful gardens - and friendly hosts.

Such a relaxing and beautiful little get away. Kay and her partner Mads are such nice people and really welcoming. We even got to feed their pet pigs Erik and Stella 😍
Such a great stay would recommend
Kay was a great host to us.  Her property was amazing, well decorated and had the cutest animals. We recommend all who is visiting Barossa valley to stay at her place.
This is a great place to stay - great location, all the essentials and Kay is very friendly.
Beautiful, peaceful & wholesome stay with friendly & attentive hosts. A wonderful experience felt right at home! Highly recommend.

The Stables is a fantastic spot for a getaway.  It’s peaceful, charming and the farm animals are adorable. Kay is the friendliest, most welcoming host and really made us feel at home. Highly recommend this place.

We had a wonderful stay at the Stables! Kay is a fabulous host and ensured we had everything we needed. It was exceptionally clean and had so many lovely extra touches that made it feel like home away from home.
It was also a real highlight to spend time with the animals. Highly recommend staying here. Thankyou for having us Kay and Madeline!
Blown away by Kay’s place - a really special spot in the Barossa Valley. Hope to visit again!

The Stables was such a great getaway. Exceeded expectations and was super relaxing. Kay was very friendly and welcoming and has set up the place so comfortably with lots of thoughtful touches. Great breakfast, the cutest little lambs, beautiful gardens and an easy (and enjoyable) drive to Tanunda and other cute towns of the Barossa. Thanks so much Kay - wish I could have stayed longer!!

What a beautiful spot. This is our second visit and again it exceeded our expectations. Kay is a lovely and fun host, nothing is too much trouble. The balcony overlooking the creek is a stand out and a perfect spot for an evening wine. I’ve been to 5 star resorts that can’t match this. The unit was comfort and cosy and met all our needs. Till next time. Cheers.

Kay is so lovely, and the property is gorgeous. Perfect for a couple's retreat and very close to  Tanunda and local wineries. You could easily just stay at the Stables for your whole trip though and have a gorgeous time. Highly recommend.

Had an amazing stay at The Stables. Kay was so lovely and helpful. Very happy with all the little touches Kay added, like fresh eggs for breakfast from her beautiful chickens and some choccies. The place was immaculate with stunning surroundings. Highly recommend staying at The Stables. We will definitely be back!
Our second stay, welcomed back like old friends. Access to cycling /walking trail is a real bonus via the lambs and the piggies! Have no hesitation in recommending The Stables.

I came by myself and Kaye was there to welcome me and tell me about the B&B. I loved the ambience of the cottage and its beautiful garden. I walked down to the sitting area at the Parra River which was delightful too. Everything worked very well and I felt totally safe and relaxed at ‘The Stables.’

We had a wonderful stay at The Stables -at Kay and Madeline's place.
You Made us feel so welcome, and like we were part of the furniture 😆
The accommodation was so beautiful and peaceful and so close to the wineries and walking tracks.
We loved meeting all the animals ,and Eric and Stella the pigs were too funny .
Thankyou for all the extras bits to eat 😋 also.
We just loved being around you and your amazing knowledge ❤️
Will definitely be back .
Matt and Annie x

We thoroughly enjoyed our time at The Stables. We felt very welcomed and spoilt by Kay. The accommodation is beautifully and lovingly restored with so many thoughtful touches. We enjoyed the peaceful surroundings as well as some local wineries. Highly recommended and can't wait to return. 😊

What a delightful stay in a beautiful peaceful cottage, everything was 10/10, spotlessly clean, comfortable 4 poster bed with fresh linen, large bathroom with good shower head, nicely stocked fridge with fresh eggs.  Added attractions on the property chickens, pigs and two working dogs.  Stunning verandah and pergola covered in divine roses, every window had a view of the garden.  Highly recommended

My husband and I enjoyed two blissful nights at the Stables. Everything was perfect and we wished we were staying longer. The cottage is gorgeous, oozing with vintage country charm, meticulously clean and with every comfort catered for. There was a claw foot bath to soak in and a delicious breakfast supplied. The surrounding gardens are absolutely beautiful and we loved meeting the resident dogs and pigs. Kay and Madeleine welcomed us warmly and we thoroughly enjoyed our chats with them. We would definitely recommend their lovely bnb to others.

Our stay greatly exceeded our expectations. The cabin was beautifully appointed, and spotlessly clean. The cottage garden engendered a much needed sense of peace and the platform, overlooking the river just a short walk  from the cabin was a perfect  place to savour the sounds and smells of the Australian bush in the early evening. Kay was a perfect host.

Kay and Mads really made our weekend so stress free. The stables was perfect for our child free weekend. They were so welcoming & friendly. They were helpful and approachable while also giving us our own space and privacy. We will be revisiting in the future & allowing more time to just explore and relax on the beautiful property.  Five stars from us ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Loved staying at Kay's place, it was quiet and relaxing. Really enjoyed meeting Kay and the animals around the property, especially Dixie and Tibs 💗
No stove top for cooking was a bit disappointing but there is a BBQ if you wanted to cook up the fresh eggs supplied.
The claw foot bath was a treat, along with the homemade bath salts.
Thanks for a great stay.
Had a fabulous wedding anniversary weekend. Loved the pool and all our new animal friends 😁 Kay was a lovely host and let us check in early, we will definitely be back!

We loved our stay with Kay, could easily have stayed a week. ‘The Stables’ was a beautifully presented, spotlessly clean B&B.
Plentiful breakfast provisions in a well equipped kitchen.
Beautiful garden setting with a pool…refreshing on the 37 degree day of our arrival.
Very convenient location to Tanunda and Seppeltsfield Estate where we attended a concert.

We absolutely loved Kay’s place.
It was just right for our SA get away.
So very comfortable with a great bed, beautiful pool & located so close to restaurants, wine tasting & gorgeous providore food outlets.
We also very much appreciated Kay’s suggestions, friendly nature and hospitality.
A gem of a B’N’B.
Highly recommended.
We loved our stay at the stables! Kay is a fantastic host, who is super friendly. We’ll be back again!

Kay was very helpful and friendly. She brought us fresh fruit from her trees regularly which was absolutely delicious! The breakfast food available was outstanding with fresh eggs, butter, cereals, orange juice, tea, milk, coffee and more supplied. We were introduced to her partner and overall it felt like a home away from home. Many thanks
Always a pleasure staying at the stables . Thanks Kay .

We had a great two night stay in the Barossa at Kay’s & Madeleine’s place. They made us very welcome showing us around. The house is spotless and there are plenty of nice things/ treats inside ! Which was lovely. The pool was great to use after our 40 c days and very private. Bed was very comfortable. We would highly recommend their home to other travelers. Looking forward to a return stay. Delightful couple!
Cute accommodation with swimming pool.. great place to  relax and unwind close to many wineries and local towns
The place was stunning and Kay and Madeline were amazing hosts and very helpful.

Kay was amazing host during our two nights stay.
We felt like home.
The house was very comfortable, sparkless clean with nice touches.
Lovely pool and surroundings.
Nice and quiet paradise.
We'll visit again.

An oasis of calm and friendliness. Everything seems designed to make you smile. Kay is a most wonderful host, always friendly, intelligent and interesting to talk to. Breakfast provisions were more than adequate and the eggs from her hens were delicious. Comfy bed, cooling swimming pool and two adorable but unobtrusive dogs. Can’t wait to return.

A gorgeous, cosy cottage set amongst a lovely garden. It's peaceful, it's quiet and it feels like a 'home away from home'. Everything was spotlessly clean and tidy. A walking/bike track runs alongside the property which takes you to Jacob's Creek. To Kay and Madeline, thanks for being such warm and friendly hosts.

My partner and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Kay’s place. Great location, close to many great wineries and to the cozy town of Tanunda.
Kay was friendly and accommodating, and we enjoyed our chats. We also loved interacting with her animals: the chickens (providing yummy eggs for breakfast), her dogs but the highlight, the pigs!
If we’re ever back in the Barossa Valley we hope to be able stay here again. Sad we didn’t have the time to stay longer.
Thanks Kay!

We LOVED our stay at the Stables...
super hosts, couldn't have asked for better breakfast makings (fresh eggs!) Super convenient to town and all the wineries. Would highly recommend.

If you want to spend a few days in the Barossa, I couldn’t rate Kay’s ‘the Stables’ highly enough… from welcome to departure I was made to feel at home,  I loved the quirky but totally functional furnishings and decor, loads of little extra’s for breakfast such as her own rye bread and eggs plus organising a private wine tasting at a neighbors vineyard. 5 Stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We loved staying at The Stables. Well appointed B&B, homely with nice touches. Great unique property and easy access to walking trail. Kay was great host, very friendly and hospitable. Would definitely stay again and recommend to family and friends.
The Stables was a lovely place to stay. Comfy, cosy and very well appointed. Kay was very friendly and willing to share local info and attend to any requests. Quiet and Private. 😃

Kay’s place was wonderful! Extremely clean and lovely furnishings as well as lots of extras!
Kay and Madeline were great hosts and very easy and accommodating.
We will stay there again👍

A beautiful setting and cozy place with all we needed for a weekend retreat. Enjoyed sitting around the fire pit at night and on the deck looking over the creek in the afternoon. A warm and friendly welcome and a chat along the way  to top it off. Thanks so much Kay!

This was by far our favorite stay during our week in South Australia. Kay and Madeline are the most welcoming and friendly hosts. 😊 The cottage, gardens, and animals were absolutely delightful and so cozy. We loved everything about our experience and can’t wait to come back soon!
Home away from home without the hard work!! Kay was the ultimate host. Thank you to you & Maddy.

We absolutely loved our stay at The Stables! Kay and Madeline are the most welcoming and friendly hosts. The cottage and surrounds are absolutely gorgeous. We had an incredible weekend exploring the property, enjoying a wood fire and sipping coffee over the stream on the viewing deck. We 100% reccomend booking this cottage for your next Barossa getaway

Our stay in this lodge was just awesome! We were pleasantly surprised by how big the place was and all the lovely details that made it so pretty and cozy. Robyn and Andrew were very nice and warm, great hosts! Thanks so much Robyn, we will surely recommend this place to our friends!

Highly recommended accommodation!!! The interior is beautifully decorated...thank you Robyn and Andrew for thinking of everything and making our stay perfect. Would definitely come back for longer next time.

We have just had a wonderful stay at the Angaston Masonic Lodge !
Firstly we were welcomed by a cosy fire, a surprise platter and a bottle of wine . Then a spacious apartment that was both very comfortable and clean. We were really appreciative of off street parking being on the main strip of Angaston.
The Masonic Lodge was a perfect central location for the Barossa wineries and HOSPITABLE eateries as well.
We found Robyn to be a thoughtful host that is clearly passionate about creating an appealing , homely and relaxing "bnb". We look forward to returning to Angaston Masonic Lodge again !
Anna and Friends.

I am so excited to write this review. We had the most wonderful experience staying in Angaston at The Masonic Lodge - and it was all because of our host Robyn.
This was my first holiday travelling with Bub, 8 months old, and we were flying so I was pretty nervous.
When I told Robyn we were travelling with a baby, she went well above what I ever expected.
Robyn organised a high chair, change mat, helped me organise a portacot, made me feel confident there was a supermarket / chemist across the road that had everything I needed. Which was perfect we were flying.
We arrived to a smiling face and a welcome pack of nibbles, cheese and wine - aircon was on and the lodge just felt like a home.
We stayed for 5 nights and I just didn't want to leave! The bed was so unbelievably comfy!
It just kept shocking me of all the things Robyn thought of, from supplying absolutely everything we needed (shampoo/conditioner, body wash and I mean top quality products), to a little medical kit of panadol and bandaids!
As we were new to the area, I texted Robyn throughout our stay and she assisted with our every request.
The lodge had such a glorious heritage feeling and the styling just made me feel like I had stepped back in time, from the original piano (I think over 100 years old!) to the high ceiling (I mean very very high!)
I informed Robyn we wanted to have a BBQ so she set up an outdoor area with an umbrella with all utensils, oils etc.
I would highly recommend in staying here, we will definitely be back :)
Thank you Robyn for your incredible hospitality. Angaston is an incredible little town and The Masonic Lodge is right where you need to be.

The check in procedure, facilities and service was super!!
Loved the local wine and cheese board waiting for us along with food for a great cooked breakfast the next morning

Brilliant accomm, right in the middle of Angaston in the midst of the wineries, great, big, comfy space to relax, celebrate and have a great time! Thanks Robyn for all the extra little touches to make our time even more special, from the cheese board to the Easter eggs, it made our time even more enjoyable.

the house was great.   new, modern and had pretty much everything you needed.     the house was clean,  lots of space if you had a big group.   2 sitting areas, outdoor dining table, modern appliances.  it had clean modern bathrooms.    it was close to the main street of town and about 5 minutes to some of the best wineries.

The house, as well as the hosts' service and responsiveness, exceeded all our expectations. The house is quite large, easily fitting our group of 4 couples. And it was in immaculate condition. Only minutes drive from the best wineries in the region, this place makes a perfect base for a short holiday.
The hosts' responsiveness was also perfect, with communications prior and during our stay. In fact, during our stay the responses to our emails were almost immediate.
A 5 star experience all around.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Little House in Barossa. John and Bianca were very responsive throughout the booking process as well as being available for questions on arrival via text and phone. We certainly appreciated the welcoming bottle of wine they left for us!
The house itself is contemporary in style with all the convenience of new modern appliances. There is a washer and dryer in the huge laundry room for longer stays. More than enough room to accommodate our large family event with 3 queen bedrooms and one room with a bunk bed and trundle. Individualized heating for different zones of the house was nice as well. Very comfortable, clean and spacious.
The location is perfect for getting to wineries and activities inThe Barossa. We are extremely happy we found such a wonderful house.
Our only suggestions would be the following: in communications just prior to arrival it would be nice to have been given the house number. That or put a sign on the house saying 'Little House in the Barossa'.
Secondly. For the amount if money we spent per night, we feel that there should be wifi included in the price particularly in todays connected world.
Overall we rate this 5 stars and really loved our stay. Thank you John and Bianca

A fantastic little home in the heart of the Barossa. We had a group of 9 girls and there was plenty of room without feeling like we were constantly on top of one another. Everything was very clean and tidy and comfortable for our long weekend stay. John and Bianca were very friendly and accommodating prior to arrival and I would definitely recommend this place to others.
Bianca was very helpful. Had a great stay!

Great place in a safe and quiet location. The house is spacious and has an open plan kitchen/dining/lounge area that makes entertaining easy. The house was very clean, had nice range of kitchen appliances/crockery etc and featured contemporary decor throughout.

I really appreciated the prompt communication from the hosts. They happily provided a range of suggestions of places to eat whilst visiting the Barossa-and their suggestions did not disappoint! Thanks again Bianca & John.

The good:

Had a great stay. Great communication with owners with great information about the area. Clean and comfortable. Would recommend others to stay during their time trying out the beautiful winery's in the Barrossa area.

The place is fantastic, very modern, and in a great location for those wishing to visit the Barossa.....it's even walking distance to a few of the local wineries. There was plenty of space both inside and outside for our group of 6 and would highly recommend it to anyone coming this way.
Great modern new built house central to the wineries in he Barossa.

Great spacious home.

incredible time!

Spacious and modern home on a quiet part of town. There was plenty of room for the 6 of us without being on top of one another. John and Bianca were great in their quick responses to my questions and queries.

Great accommodation and location.
Great place we would come back here!

Spacious, clean and well appointed home on the outskirts of Nuriootpa - perfect for our group of 7 adults. Located in the suburbs but a perfect launch pad for all the Barossa has to offer. The home was clean and bright on our arrival and had everything we needed. John and Bianca very easy hosts, and responsive to all messages.
Great house in great location.

John and Bianca's place was amazing. The house is very new with a lot of amenities  and very clean. Great location amongst all the wineries around. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone and would infidelity be back next time I'm in the Barossa!
Great home with lots space. Convenient area if travelling in the barossa

This is a really lovely home, the hosts were really easy to deal with.
A modern and spacious 4 bedroom home, with great facilities, in a quiet area.
Beautiful home in a great location. Perfect for big group accommodation and our wedding day bridal preparations.

This was the second time we have visited John and Biancas house, and it was just as pleasant as the first time.
I highly recommend the stay if you are in the barossa!

Great property, great location for getting around the Barossa.  Good communication during booking.  Recommend this property to anyone travelling to the region.
John and Bianca had great communication. The place was plenty big enough for 5 guests! We had a great stay!
