Lovely place to stay with the family.  Very hand location as well.

A wonderful abode in the Barossa, perfectly located in a quiet street yet still just a quick stroll to all of the best locations in Tanunda. A delightful place to stay, uniting historic charm with renovated polish. We look forward to returning again soon!
The location was great, the house was fantastic and we are looking forward to the next visit when we can hopefully stay in Kym's Tin House again
Beautiful house in a great location. Perfect for a young family like ours - close park, comfortable beds and a backyard to explore. Thanks for having us!
The Tin House is in a great location with plenty of space for up to six people. Cosy lounge room with open fire, and fabulous gardens front and rear.  Would be great to see all the roses in bloom!
A beautiful place, spotlessly clean, great gardens and centrally located. We couldn't ask for more.
Lovely house - comfortable - clean - close to town - perfect....
Great location, only a short walk from the main street of Tunanda. Perfect for a weekend get away.
Convenient to all Tanunda and ideal for 2 - 3 couples to stay
Great house, near everything you need. Well equipped with all we needed.

Lovely period cottage in an excellent location - walking distance to cafes, wine bars and restaurants. Great size and facilities for 3 couples wanting an authentic Barossa experience. Cosy and warm with a wood fire and aircon. Responsive communication and customer service.

It would be hard to find a better located property in Tanunda. The Tin House was spacious, with a nice backyard to enjoy a morning coffee or a glass of vine in the afternoon. I wouldn't hesitate to stay in the property again on our next visit. Thanks Kym! Michael

This is a great place, right in the heart of Tanunda! You are within a short walking distance of several great coffee shops and restaurants, that would satisfy even the most demanding tastes. Great location and very close to the centre of town...

Great location, Squeaky clean, Amazing facilities, Cosy and Warm, Beautiful house, Spacious and comfortable

The house was clean, spacious and well-located. It looks nicer than in the pictures. The fireplace was pre-setup with firewood and kindling already built to use, which was great.

However - the house is advertised as having a spa, however when we went to shower there was no hot water. The management company rang us and gave us instructions to change the gas bottles, which we followed (this was outside in the cold late at night), but to no avail. They must have all been empty. Steve, who we spoke to on phone, was incredulous that they would all be empty, but he drove in to check/change them. He was working on them at midnight, and they must have turned out to be empty or some other issue, as he came back at 1am to continue/finish. This meant we slept very poorly despite the comfortable bedding (he tried to be quiet, but our room was on the same wall as the gas bottles...).
We had hot water the next morning, thanks to Steve, but didn't have time to use the spa as advertised. Also, when I finally got to have my shower, the nozzle adjustment module was broken so it sat at the bottom of the bar and I couldn't fit under it. I could only fit under it to wash by hair by holding it up with one hand.
I reached out to the management company before submitting my review, but they didn't respond to my email (I sent it 11 days ago at time of writing). Overall we didn't get the value and features of the house we paid for, and could have found more affordable accomodation.
A related-tip: these days there are many airbnbs run by accomodation managers, regardless of the listed owners. Many of them are also listed on booking dot com, for much cheaper. I found some houses run by Getaways in Tanunda for $200 cheaper on booking dot com than airbnb (as in the same house is on both sites). Too late for me as I'd booked already. For the quality, the lower prices are probably fairer, not sure why airbnb has gotten so expensive.
Central Location and Quiet.
Awesome location and beautiful gardens! We were surprised there wasn't a comfortable dining table or more than two wine glasses in the kitchen, but otherwise a nice base for a weekend in the Barossa.

Tanunda's Tin House

Was a tidy place with a great fire place and nicely located.

We stayed at a property that felt like it could use some attention. The house itself seemed a bit dated and could benefit from some maintenance, as there were a few minor issues that needed addressing.

On a positive note, the host was very kind and responsive when our son had an allergic reaction. Unfortunately, we had to cut our stay short after just one night, but we appreciated their help during a stressful time
Wow!  Amazing building, brilliant location, tip top hosts, and every conceivable extra.  Too many special touches to list.

Robyn was very welcoming, and provided delicious snacks, drinks and food for breakfast, which made our stay wonderful. The bedrooms were cosy and warm, and the main room was huge, with pool table, music and fire (but it was a bit smoky from opening the fire door). The location is easy to find and walking distance to many places in Angaston, and easy to access the rest of the Barossa with car or taxi.
Robyn was great to communicate with in the lead up to staying at the Angaston Masonic Lodge. This is a unique building and a comfortable place to stay in the heart of the Barossa.

The Masonic Lodge at Angaston was by far my best Air BnB experience yet. She made recommendations of what to do and where to go, and all the restaurants are within easy walking distance.
So many little touches made such a big difference to our stay, from the picnic that she organised for us to take on our bike ride around the Barossa, to stacking the fireplace, providing candles and a bath bomb for the spa, and supplying a beautiful fresh breakfast. You could not find better than this! 10/10

We booked the Masonic Lodge for a road cycling holiday base in the Barossa and it turned out to be perfect for our needs.  Robyn's communication was truly excellent and responsive.  The lodge was spacious, clean and had a real uniqueness to it.  We were welcomed by a well stocked fridge and a bottle of very good local Shiraz.  The local town of Angaston is quiet, but has good selection of restaurants and shops nearby.  The coffee from Blonds next door was excellent too.  We honestly could not have asked for much more out of this lovely place.

This place is amazing! Great little spot in the Barossa. Right in the center of Angaston and easy driving distance to all the great wineries. Robyn was a lovely host. If your looking for a historic stay in the Barossa - this is it!

Robyn went the extra mile (literally, she drove many extra country miles) to ensure my friends and I made the most of our short stay in the Barossa. Would recommend to anyone wanting to set up a base for touring the Barossa.

Robyn is a fantastic host. The breakfast ingredients were of the highest standard, local Barossa bacon, eggs, tomatoes, avocado, asparagus and spinach. Cheeses, salami, biscuits, nuts, wine none of which I was expecting. Robyn also took us for our lunch reservation and picked us up. She was very helpful. We loved the place, the pool table and the fire. Great location in a beautiful town. Would definitely recommend.
Fabulous place to stay in the Barossa, easy reach of local attractions. Robyn & Andrew were awesome hosts, made our stay very enjoyable & easy. Would highly recommend.
Spacious living area, ideal for families or groups. Lots of fun around the pool table. Very central to town and Barossa.
Gorgeous quaint lodge for 4 although huge enough to easily accommodate more people with some modification.

Great communication from Robyn from booking to check-in. Robyn provided us with tips on the local restaurants and offered to prepare to accommodate for our toddler with portacot and high chair. The accommodation itself was amazing and beyond our expectations. We thoroughly enjoyed our night and the amenities provided. The local produce for breakfast was delicious. Would highly recommend. We ourselves intend to rerun for the winter experience.
Robyn's place is stunning, absolutely loved our stay!

Robyn’s place is outstanding. Amazing place with super high ceilings. 2 rooms with extra comfortable beds. There is plenty of space and then some and is set up well for whatever you desire- sitting on the couch, listening to music or even getting on the mic for a song.
We didn’t give ourselves enough time to enjoy the breakfast provisions but were impressed at all the food that had been left for us.
Great location right on the Main Street on Angaston. We will definitively come back again.

Robyn was our perfect host. The ‘lodge’ is centrally located in the town of Angaston. We were charmed by its history and character, so many little touches were included. We loved a game of pool with a glass of Barossa red at the end of each day. The kitchen is small but we coped. We had a lovely stay.

Beautiful heritage place very centrally located. The house was warm and clean and to add on there was spa which we thoroughly enjoyed. Robyn had also arranged tour to the wineries and had packed us nice lunch. Very friendly host recommend to all
A stunning building. The living area is immense- absolutely loved the wood fire and pool table!

Robyn has been a great host and thoroughly attentive from the moment I made the booking to the Saturday night making sure we were wam and comfy. Andrew even popped in to help us with the fireplace!
A magestic building with all the mod cons set in a town steeped in history I thoroughly recommend this experience! For us it was the perfect stay with great hosts! Thank you Andrew and Robyn!

What an amazing weekend we had at Robyn’s place! From the crackling fire that was ready for us when we arrived to the bottle of wine on the table welcoming us to the beautiful Barossa region, everything was just perfect. There’s something really special about coming home to such a beautifully preserved historic building and sitting in front of the fire. There was great local produce stocked in the fridge for breakfast and wine-touring snacks which we certainly tucked in to! But, if you’re after a more active weekend than we had, Robyn was full of suggestions. Cannot recommend this place enough!
Many thanks again - love Caitlin, Wiktor and Wolfgang!!

Throughly recommend staying here should you travel to the Barossa. Convenient and with ample character, the Masonic Lodge feels like a home away from home. Robyn could not have made us feel more welcome and went to great lengths to accomodate our infant son.

Fantastic place. The space was amazing and breakfast was excellent. The little touches where nice, flowers, preparation, newspapers, cheese platter and wine. Enjoyed the pool table and chess.
Sean & Wendy
Loved stayed on the main street. Wonderful hospitality from Robyn.
Amazing retreat. Incredible appointments andthoughtful touches.
Great location to tour the region. The place is beautifully decorated and no expense has been spared. Loved the piano!
Awesome space, great location!

Thank you Robyn for a wonderful stay, the property is in such an amazing location, couldn't ask for a better location.  Really appreciate all the advise and help - it made our stay that much better. The pool table and chess board were a massive hit with the family.  We loved the history of the house.  Recommend to couples and families.
The lodge is an interesting place to stay right in the heart of the Barossa Valley. Thanks for a comfortable place to lay our heads

Great location and an interesting, quirky building. Comfy beds, combustion heater was set ready to light and we were welcomed with a bottle of wine and a generous cheese platter. Breakfast provisions were even more generous. The pool table was fun.

Amazing house and in a beautiful part of the Barossa. The main street is very quiet at night (we stayed a Saturday). The house exceeded our expectations, the photos don’t do it justice! Robyn also supplied a full breakfast and a few other amenities which was very appreciated! We’ll stay again for sure!

Amazing experience to stay at this property like reliving history. We had a wonderful time in this house, and enjoyed this lovely historic Barossa town.
My daughter absolutely adores the beautiful decor and style in both bedrooms. Great work Robyn!

Great spot in the middle of Angaston - straight across the road from food works. We loved the pool table and all the antique furniture, plus the historical explanations as to how the space has been used. We had extensive debates about the potential for haunting!  Also loved the cheeses, wine and fruit plus breakfast stuff. This place has everything you need for a lovely stay in the Barossa
Just wow!! we stayed here for our wedding anniversary and were blown away by the experience. Highly recommend
Wonderful, comfortable beds. Amazing breakfast provision. 15 foot ceilings. Expansive spaces. The pool table was a huge hit!
Truly exceeded our expectations. In an online world, for the first time in my life, the actual experience was beyond our imaginations, the place is majestic and a global favourite.
Fantastic stay . Lovely unique accommodation.Robyn was a wonderful host and even drove us to lunch at Seppeltsfield and picks us up .

Beautiful space that is just amazing to see and spend time in. Thoughtful touches, amazing breakfast selection, incredible rooms all beautifully put together and clean. Beds were comfy and we had great tips on where to eat out. Thanks Robyn we lived our stay and it was perfect for 2 couples
Very historic!
Great old building with lots of character and space. Robyn was a very thoughtful host who made us fee very welcome.
Lovely location,beautiful building and Robyn went to a lot of trouble adding lovely finishing touches to make our stay really comfortable and enjoyable.
Great location to explore Angaston.
A truly hidden gem!! The best presentation of any B & B we have ever been in. And the breakfast goodies were amazing! Cannot recommended highly enough!

This place was awesome and great value for money compared to other places in the region. It’s a little dated but that adds to fun of staying here and fits in well with the wine tasting experience. The activities such as the pool table got good use and Robyn leaves you food for breakfast and snacks which is nice.

Cannot beat this place for location being situated smack in the middle of Angaston's main strip with all its cafe's and restaurants. Great base to explore the Barossa and especially Eden Valley. The Lodge is spacious with cavernous 20 foot ceilings and all amenities and goodies for a memorable stay. Highly recommended. - Glen & Karen

Such a wonderful and unique way to experience the area! The hall was massive and well situated on the Main Street close to cafes, grocery store etc. The host went over and above leaving food and wine, plus the place was well stocked with blankets, toiletries, kitchen utensils etc. Pretty much anything you need or  might have otherwise forgotten was there! The fireplace was also a highlight for us. Thankful for a wonderful stay and would 100% recommend to others!

We really enjoyed our stay at the Masonic Lodge. Fantastic location in the heart of Angaston - it has a lot of history and something a touch unique. It had everything you could want including a comfy bed, great breakfast provisions and a fire to keep you warm whilst playing cards as you enjoyed some of the local wines bought during the day.
Would absolutely stay here again. Thanks to Robyn for a fantastic weekend, we loved it!

This was our second stay as we’d done a cheese making course at the cultured cheese school in tanunda. We enjoyed it as much as the first, it was a cold weekend but the wood fire and heaters in the bedroom helped with the chill & the electric blankets.
Such good value for money with breakfast provisions, cheese and wine on arrival which was very welcomed. Amazing location too, short stroll to the local pubs and a food land across the road. Great host who is very accomodating, will stay again!

This historic icon is amazing. A truly beautiful structure with character and warmth.
The bedrooms are so lovely and the living area is incredible.
Robyn is a kind, friendly host who wants you love the place as she does.
For 2 couples this place is amazing. The pool table and fire was well used on a gold winter night watching the footy.
Very generous provisions left for guests.
We would not hesitate to book here again and recommend to everyone due to such a lovely host.

Uniquely fantastic venue.  Location couldn't be better.  Very clean and comfortable with everything you need for a fun stay.  Perfect for two couples or a few friends looking for a special experience.
Such a special spot. I can only say good things about this place.
Robyn's place was such a unique and fantastic stay! The place is very clean, has fantastic facilities and is an excellent location. Would highly recommend staying here!
was bigger the inside than we expected. very beautiful and the wood heater worked a charm.
great customer service, nice homes
The Masonic Hall was great! It's large and Angaston is a fun little town.

We had a great stay at Robyn’s unique listing - historic outside + having everything modern/ we need inside.  Robyn prepared the house so well including clear instructions and some wine & cheese on arrival, a lovely big breakfast, making us feel so welcome.
Great host, great little spot to explore the Barossa from.

The Masonic Hall is truly something special. We enjoyed our stay with our three generation family and our baby absolutely loved the space. The grocery store is located on the other side of the road. It is located a close drive to many excellent wineries. Robyn provided a great welcome and nice ingredients for breakfast. Highly recommend a stay at the Masonic Hall if you are in the area.

Perfect location for our weekend away in the Barossa. Kitchen bit small to do you own cooking.
Lots of lovely touches. Generous breakfast supplied.
Bedrooms very comfortable.
Wi-fi wasn't working.

Good location & nice old building. A few issues with amenities - No functional wi-fi. No operational bbq. Tv speakers malfunctioning. Breakfast provisions were not enough for 4 people for 2 days. Provisions listed on Airbnb were not supplied, ie cereals & spreads etc. For the higher price point, we expected everything to be supplied as per listing, so we were a little disappointed.

Jacqueline and her assistant Judy were really communicative in the lead up to our stay at the barn and this made finding the property and gaining access to it a smooth process. The barn is a stunning, unique space full of  original artwork and gorgeous soft furnishings. We did feel as if we had stepped into the pages of a design magazine! At the same time, however, the barn still felt homely and relaxed. Many of the original features such as the cattle trough and exposed brickwork remain. We were welcomed with a selection of provisions including milk, bread and other sweet treats. Kapunda was an excellent base for exploring the Barossa and we couldn't recommend staying at the Barn highly enough. Thanks Jacqueline.

My friends and I had a wonderful time staying in the barn. It was a beautiful, cosy, clean and perfect for a large group to enjoy dinner around the big kitchen table or relax in front of the fire. Jacqueline was very welcoming, leaving breakfast provisions and a fire laid. She also dropped in on the first day and shared lots of helpful tips and ideas for things to do locally. I wouldn't hesitate to visit again.

Wow is all I can say, what a beautiful place, it was warm cozy yet colourful and artistic! There is not one element of the barn that I would change it was a magical stay and the fact it was only a short drive away from the main areas of the barrossa meant we could enjoy the great wineries and come back out of the  hustle bustle and sit by the fire and enjoy some great reds. The support also from Judy and Nicole was magnificent whenever we had a question they were right there to help out. Thanks guys for a wonderful stay!! I would recommend the barn to anyone!

The house was absolutely stunning and we loved the garden. For foodies the kitchen was well appointed to enable some home cooking
The art work was beautiful and the place so tranquil- just what we needed. Ideal of you are looking to unwind

A lovely place to stay with more than adequate resources available and extremely well equipped. It was a very clean house and was great to come back to after a short trip to the Barossa. Food provisions and a laid out fire were very welcoming and made the stay much nicer and more comfortable.  I highly recommend the house to anyone, Jacqueline and her assistant were easy to reach and the entire experience was very comfortable and extremely enjoyable. Thanks for the great stay!
A wonderful place. In fact, the photos don't do it justice. Jacqui was incredibly helpful too. Highly recommended.

Such a beautiful relaxing stay. The barn is truly gorgeous with original art work hanging on the walls and a lovely rustic yet homely feel. Jacqueline was such a treat, messaging us tips and tricks of where to go and eat and telling us to make sure we enjoyed some wine in front of the fire and was always easily contactable. This property is one not to miss and definitely one I'll recommend to others and try come back to myself.

A lovely and unique converted barn yard a short drive from the main Barossa Valley centre, we had a lovely stay just relaxing in front of the fireplace. Comms with Jacqueline were straightforward and the place was set up well for our arrival. Would highly recommend to others.
Wonderful
Great place - beautiful garden - spacious bedrooms. A delight.

We had an amazing time at the barn- it is absolutely beautiful and a really unique place to stay. Every room is beautifully decorated with plenty of amenities for everything you need! Jacqueline was also great with communication and gave us tips and advice.
We had a brilliant stay at Jacquelines gorgeously renovated barn! Would definitely recommend, we plan on heading back!

Such a unique and interesting home...very charming and comfortable.
Bigger than I anticipated, for two of us the barn was huge. Great property as well.
It had everything we needed and the owner was very kind enough to include breakfast items and a bottle of wine. Just a minute from town which was convenient.
Two things to point out...
1. If you are tall...be careful. I walked away with a few lumps on my head from the beams in the upstairs bedroom/hallway.
2. We had a few encounters with spiders...a few dead and a few alive. We are cuty dwellers so this was an adjustment. 😀
Highly recommend.

Absolutely gorgeous location and the perfect place to stay for a trip to wine country. House was immaculate and homely - the perfect place to return to for a few after a day of visiting the local wineries. Jacqueline provided some delicious food and also had great recommendations for the region. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting the Barossa and would have no problems booking again.

Jac' place is lovely, bigger than the photos show, and located in a large private garden. Unfortunately after we checked in late afternoon, we found there was no power to any GPO sockets due to a faulty breaker, so a majority of amenities not available. (E.g. loss of included breakfast supplies as fridge not working, unable to store cold drinks & food supplies we brought with us, unable to charge Phones/iPad, limited kitchen e.g no Fridge, Dishwasher, Kettle, Toaster, Microwave, no WiFi or TV, no Washer or Dryer, limited Wood Heating without fan, no Hair Dryer of Iron etc). This made the stay impractical. We were unable to easily resolve the fault after several calls/msgs & trying to reset the breaker ourselves. Unfortunately Jac was overseas and the local contacts provided were unable to assist. We are not claiming any compensation for first night, but have requested refund of second night as we checked out a day early. I should add that Jac was very apologetic, and we realise it was just very bad luck.
Amazing! Loved it
Thoroughly enjoyed our time at the Barn. It's  an awesome space with plenty of room. The gardens, the fire, the decor all made for a enjoyable short break from the city. Loved it❤️
Beautiful property. Cosy with the fireplace. Super romantic and cute. Everything you want for a weekend away 😊
Gorgeous creative home, which is completely private and makes a good base for following the wine trail. Enjoyed our time here and would stay again. Thanks Jacqueline
Fantastic base for exploring the Barossa, wonderful & helpful host and one of the nicest places we've stayed at so far.

We found it randomly and it was a long way from where we were intending to stay. Once we saw the description of an old barn turned into a much loved & peaceful Home, we had to take a chance and give it a go.
Jacqueline was excellent on email, all was considered so we didn’t go without but it was the unique and comfortable nature of the place that had us falling in love with it.
A glass of the local, non labeled wine at night as the sky goes pink allows you to drift off to the south of France, with only the many pink Galahs to bring you back to a real Australian experience.
We even read a few chapters of Jacqueline’s book (and later bought a copy) which explained why the place has so much love invested.
Almost like an adventurous cubbiehouse, we highly recommend it for a lazy time to experience the Barossa.
For us, it was our first holiday as a young family and the comforts allowed us to sleep on our 3 month old’s times. It made this special time in our lives very unique and well worth looking a little outside the vanilla box.
Many thanks,
Brent, Saraya and baby Havana

Charming cottage. A tiny bit out of the ways but we managed with local taxis etc. Loved loved loved the house, styled beautifully, amazingly actually. Perfect touches like fruit, bread, butter etc. Would love to go back!

Jacqueline's Barn in the Barossa home was a lovely stay location over the June long weekend for our family of 3 (including our 1 year old, thank you for supplying us with a foldout cot!). It is a beautiful renovated barn with all the modern amenities, spacious yet cosy & we were toasty warm despite it being winter 😊 Good location to come home to after being out & about in the Barossa, would definitely recommend to others! 😊

Lots of quirky treasures to discover.  Main bedroom well heated by fireplace! Open spaces including spacious bathroom without screens, curtain or glass - just watch the overspray. Fabulous access to the Barossa and surrounds. Thanks Jacqueline!!
Beautifully renovated and styled. The fire was very warm, downstairs and upstairs. About 20mins away from Barossa Valleh wineries and restaurants.

It was a very modern yet vintage space. Everything was very clean and well organized. It was very spacious and could easily fit 6 people. There was minimal artificial lighting to allow for the sky lights to fill the house with beautiful natural sun light. Although there was a stunning wood fire there was also 3 heaters spread throughout the home for added warmth. All the amenities were sparkling clean and the whole house was beautifully decorated to compliment the style of the home itself. There was a large book of recommendations for food and fun throughout the Barossa on arrival along with fresh eggs, bread, milk, orange juice, water chilled, tea, coffee and spreads amongst many others. It was a stunning space inside and out. It was so hard to say goodbye to and couldn't flaw a thing.

This is a lovely and unique place to stay in the Barossa; you'll feel as though you are in the south of France. And the mix of arty and rustic decor is very attractive.  Spacious bedrooms and very comfortable bed.  It's an easy drive to the wineries and eateries in the area, and the town of Kapunda has its own history and charm. Jacqueline provided some great tips for activities you might not discover on  your own as well as info on places to eat.
We had a lovely stay here! Location was great and I would highly recommend it to anyone. On our arrival the fridge was nicely stocked with some brekkie goodies which was highly appreciated.
Beautiful barn, creative touches and restful place. Lovely fresh eggs and supplies for breakfast definitely recommended.
Loved this place. Would stay here again if we returned to the Barossa
Pictures do not do this gorgeous barn justice. Had the most relaxing weekend away, close to the wineries and was great to come back here and have a wine outside and enjoy the garden. Great place!
Great stay!

Such a wonderful place! Very stylish and had great amenities/facilities, and Jacqueline was really fast with responses and any questions we’d had. Lovely hospitality, perfectly situated, and well maintained and perfectly presented. Do not hesitate!
A lovely stay not too far from the vineyards. Fridge stocked with goodies and loads of fire wood.

Jacqueline's place is charming. The converted barn is full of character. Jaqueline had stocked the place with snacks, juice, milk, wine etc for our arrival. The weekend was cold with 4 degrees overnight but we were very snug with the heaters and very effective pot belly fire. Check in was smooth and Jaqueline communicated fantastically. The accommodation is the prefect base to discover the Barossa but also a great place to hang out and enjoy dinners in.
Had a lovely weekend at the barn and would definitely come back when I have the chance. Good location and a great space to enjoy a few glasses of wine.
Charming Barn in the Barossa

The barn is an old world charm
so peaceful, birds chirping, yet all you need at your finger tips.
great place to rest , unwind and relax

We had such a wonderful girls weekend away at Jacquelines place.  The barn is absolutely beautiful and would equally be lovely for a romantic couples holiday.  It was very homely and had everything we needed.  Before we arrived, Jacqueline let us know the barn was having some wifi issues, so she left a bottle of rose in the fridge for us.  It was this open communication and personal touches that made the stay that much more special.  Would return without hesitation!
This place is far grander than the photos. Simply stunning with wonderful hosts and a beautiful garden surrounding.
Had a fantastic stay. The barn is exactly what we needed for a get away. Great location to go out and explore the surrounding area. Jacquline was always quick to reply and super helpful.
Awesome relaxing place to stay for a quiet getaway. Fireplace is amazing and Jacquelines communication was fantastic. Watch out when using the shower though because the floor will get wet.

A calm, beautiful and cozy home that was just what we needed for a weekend away. Jacqueline was very thoughtful  and helpful especially when it came to local recommendations. We loved the place so much we’ve recommended it to friends and family looking for a getaway from the city. Looking forward to staying there again next time :)

A lovely old barn building in Kapunda, near the Barossa, this is a wonderful spot to stay in an interesting old copper mining town.
Very beautifully appointed, warm and full of paintings and treasures, the house is comfortable and generally well appointed- log fire and bath being my two ‘must haves’ for a lazy weekend away in winter. The house is very spacious and it also has a gorgeous rambling garden that hints of a much loved history. It would be a wonderful spot for meals in summer I’m sure…
There are most basic provisions available, but If you are planning to cook and eat in (and there’s good reason to stay in and enjoy the cozy old-world charm here) I would suggest bringing a good cooking pot with lid and any special bits you might need for cooking. Some of the plumbing is a bit impractical (no shower curtain in the bathroom with a lovely rain shower over the bath makes showering a very wet event, and the kitchen sink is easy to flood with the tap position), but these are small details that I mention only so you are ready for them!
I would happily return. Thanks Jacqeline!

Jacquline’s Barn is a beautiful & peaceful space & was perfect for our family of 4 with 2 teenagers. We enjoyed the lovely surroundings, unique furnishings, artwork & the generous breakfast provisions. It is a short drive to the Barossa Valley.
Very nice, would stay again.

This is an excellent place to stay, I could not more strongly recommend it. Jacqueline has done an incredible job on the place. The garden, living and kitchen areas and welcoming mezzanine bedrooms. We also appreciated her hospitality and extras. Well located with a drive to the wine regions and other towns. Great place, thanks for having us.
Amazing place! Thoughtful and artistic touches and breakfast provisions. Garden is beautiful and great stable conversion design. Will be back for sure

We had the best time at the barn and beautiful Christmas. What a gem it is and central to everything in Barossa. It is bigger (inside and outside) than showed in the photos - plenty of space for a big family or enough intimacy for a couple.
This was like staying in my Italian country home (which I never had). Jacqueline has made sure this place has everything, including original artwork around the barn. We'll be back!

Jacqueline’s place was lovely, full of personal touches and beautiful artwork. The beds were so comfy! My one caution would be that the lightning is very dark in the bathroom (I’m vision impaired, this was fine during the day but problematic at night) and the stairs are (as expected and noted in the listing) narrow and steep.
All in all we loved our stay at Jacqueline’s place and would recommend to anyone looking for a base close to the Barossa but away from the crowds of Tanunda.

The architecture of the barn is amazing and we thoroughly enjoyed the garden. Unfortunately that is where it stops.
The barn itself was dirty and needed TLC. For instance the bathroom was dirty with the toilet having pubic hair on the seat and under the seat - It also was unclean to touch, hair in the bath, and tiles. The bed had hair in it. The kitchen was filthy and needed cleaning. The plates, cups and mugs also needed a clean before use, dust everywhere and a there were a few spiders in the pots and pans. We also could not close the windows in the roof with birds nesting in there it made for a very echoing and noisy night!

The house has lovely rustic charm and has some nice touches.  It is set in a quiet area of town and if you are older I suggest you have a vehicle available to go shopping as the supermarket is quite a hike.  The grounds are quite large but on out visit the driveways were becoming overgrown and could have done with a tidy up.  The upstairs area is nice and roomy but there is a bit of water spill when showering as the shower is over a free standing bath.  The stairs are steep but manageable with a good handrail. The touches that were supplied in food and the accommodating nature that allowed for early check in was appreciated.
Brilliant. Spacious. Welcoming. Warm. Highly recommended.

We loved our stay at the Barn. The photos truly don’t do it justice, it was much bigger than we expected. The Barn itself and garden were lovely. Jacqueline was a wonderful host and provided us with ample food, drinks and info. We would definitely stay here again
Really enjoyed our stay, Barn in the Barossa is such a dream place to stay. Jacqueline recommendations of place to see and eat were brilliant
Lovey get away. Awesome host. Quick responsive and loved the little extras
A beautifuland tranquil place to stay .  The fireplace was all ready to go when we arrived late in the day.  Amazing variety of art work to admire.  Can’t wait to rebooand explore the area more.
One of the nicest places I have stayed at  - you’ll feel welcome from the moment you walk through the door.
Well worth the stay, lovely place for a few days away.

The Barn is a unique place and we loved being able to stay in a place that was full of interesting things and had an interesting history.  The fireplace was so cosy to sit in front of with the added advantage that it warmed our loft bedroom so well.  Great location for us to explore both the Barossa and the Clare Valley.
Enjoyed the stay! Cute spot and very thoughtful touches including the fresh produce in the fridge.
Lovely spot for access to Kapunda and surrounding areas. The barn and fire were well-stocked. Slightly less ‘rural’ than we expected but the garden was lovely.

A beautiful barn conversion in a quiet town, Jacqueline was a great host- easy to contact and quick to reply. The breakfast provisions were a lovely touch. The house is well equipped and there’s plenty of room to relax, the wood burner fireplace worked a treat and the garden was beautiful. Great spot for a break.

Jacquelines cottage is everything you could ever dream of! the place is immaculate and very comforting which is exactly what you need for a little getaway or even just to have some leisure time in the barossa!

Lovely place. Perfect for anyone that wants a quiet weekend away whilst still remaining close to all there is to see up in the Barossa and surrounds.
The facilities provided and the setup of the property was delightful and perfectly put together.

The barn was very clean and tidy and had everything we needed for a quick getaway. Location was close to town but on a road that could be noisy at times - there was also no curtain on the bedroom window so hopefully no one saw us from the main road! The barn was a great place to relax but could do with a bit of TLC/refreshing. The fireplace was amazing and overall our stay was comfortable.

This is our second time staying here and I don’t think it will be the last. The place is open and bright, yet cosy. It feels rustic and relaxed, yet luxurious. It seems perfectly set up for two couples or young families, but we love it as a getaway just for us.
The scented candles, fresh towels, and big bath make it feel like you’re in a luxury spa.
I absolutely love the skylights with natural light everywhere.
It’s well set up for cooking and relaxing. We barely left to explore the wineries as we were so well set up in the barn :)
An excellent space in a sleepy little town a stones throw from Barossa and not far from the Clare Valley. Recommend a soak in the tub and a night by the fire after a day touring the wineries.
Very nice place! We loved our stay 👌

A gorgeous character stay in a wonderful part of SA. We booked the barn for a quick getaway from Adelaide and couldn't be happier with our stay in such a gorgeous place. Jacqueline also had plenty of suggestions on what to do (and eat) while we were there.

What a magical ‘urban barn’ experience. Incredible looking place both on the inside and outside. Jac left us milk, juice, eggs, butter, bread and other goodies, such a treat. Incredible garden. Slightly too close to the road, a bit of truck and car noise, but only noticed it on occasion. Would stay again for sure.
The barn was really nicely decorated. I thought it was going to be a little less rustic given the price.
We had a wonderful stay in Jacqueline’s Barn in the Barossa! The location was great and the barn was very intimate and cosy! would definitely stay again!

What a beautiful place to stay.
The house is filled with art and is so full of character. We bought amazing local produce to cook up and sat for hours around the big kitchen table. It was so enjoyable. We will definitely come back again.
The barn provided a lovely, peaceful holiday, and a good base for exploring vineyards of Greenock and other places.

Had a pleasant stay in this retrofitted barn. Plenty of kitchen utensils and good stovetop, accessories etc, comfortable bedrooms in loft upstairs (stairs are steep, mind your head on the way up!), good communication from host. Thanks Jacqueline!

Nice cozy place, lots of character, great supplies and amenities. Very quiet and Peaceful location - but only a short drive to the Barossa wineries. Kapunda has a lot of history and amazing architecture of the buildings, so worth checking out. The converted barn accomodation was a very unique place to stay.
Great stay and unique. The host is wonderful, great communicator, and provided a comfortable place and a warm welcome. We enjoyed it. Thank you.

A beautiful and very cosy place to stay, Jacqueline made us feel very at home with food supplies, firewood and a super comfy bed! Awesome location too, perfect for anyone looking for a variety of things to do from wine tours to walking.
Such a beautiful home and garden, photos don’t do it justice. Great communication and really thoughtful of the hosts to leave the fridge stocked with fresh ingredients for breakfast. Highly recommend

We really enjoyed our stay at The Barn!! It is an amazing place, high ceilings, beautiful fireplace, an giant mirror in the dining room great for pictures! We were floored and spent ages exploring when we arrived!
The fireplace was already set up ready to be lit and there was more than enough firewood and kindling for our stay. The fridge was stocked with eggs, sausages, mushrooms, juice, which was a generous touch! It’s a great location, only a quick drive to the main drag.
Couple of small points (which really are nothing things but worth mentioning) - If the high windows are open, you will be awoken by the birds singing. Also the shower - it is a beautiful rain head shower but it goes over the bath and the floor and mats becoming soaking wet everytime the shower is used.
We would honestly stay again, we had such a great time, was perfect for the two of us and was great to unwind and relax after a day of touring the local area.

An enjoyable stay in the countryside, the barn is surrounded by lush gardens and lots of wildlife. It is very spacious and the wood fire warmed the entire barn easily. Breakfast provisions are very generous.
One of the bedrooms has a skylight over the bed so pack a sleep eye mask if you need a dark environment. The TV isn't a smart TV but had a HDMI port if you wanted to connect to a laptop.
Fantastic stay at this wonderful property. Beautifully presented and so nice to stay somewhere a little different.
One of a kind property with everything you need provided. Stunning gardens!

A charming and quirky house in a gorgeous garden setting. Good communication and prompt attention to a minor issue when it came up. Jacqueline left us some lovely breakfast food for our arrival. Thank you Jacqueline.
Amazing house, much bigger than it looks in the photos!
lovely character home.
Peaceful property in a quiet location

This property is beautiful. The barn itself is so inviting and love the internal fireplace. The garden is very special and makes you feel like you are so secluded, there were birds chirping and bees everywhere - so lovely!
Located well within driving distance to the Barossa.
Would definitely come back when next in the Barossa.
This was such a cosy place to stay with so much space and aesthetic flare. It exceeded expectations and is exactly the kind of unique experience I look for when travelling.

Great host who made it all very easy and welcoming, well stocked, beautiful garden. Everyone enjoyed staying there. A couple of practical things made it a bit tricky for me personally - i'm tall so hit my head on a number of things, and the shower was a mess but that's a trade off for staying in such a quirky interesting barn! Thanks for the experience.

We had a relaxing few days away. Loved the big bath! A note for future guests that the staircase is steep with narrow treads and has a low overhead beam which requires ducking and careful footwork for tall people. The door frames are also low in keeping with the old barn. The character of the barn and artwork is great.

Such a beautiful property. The photos don’t actually do it full justice. Very peaceful, beautiful gardens and such a unique old barn conversion. I would love to stay there again in the future. Jacquline was lovely to deal with and a great host. Highly recommend.

Beautiful property. I had my two year old and 9month old with me and the place was great for them too. The stairs were never an issues. Shower/bath definitely needs some tlc with the leak but honestly with how beautiful the place is this is my only complaint as the floor became very slippery when getting little people out the bath. Wouldn’t have bothered me if I was on my own.
We urgently needed to stay an extra day due to coming down with a bug and they were very flexible with that being the second time I had to extend my stay. Thank you, would definitely come and stay again and recommend 🙏🏼

A lovely, peaceful, relaxing place to stay just a short drive from so many delicious restaurants and wineries in the Barossa region. We especially enjoyed sitting outside in the garden, which felt very private and secluded, and relaxing in the bath tub.
Beautiful building with lots of lovely art and a wonderful garden like the south of France

We enjoyed a blissful 5 days in Jacqueline's beautiful barn. Wonderfully peaceful and relaxing. It was an easy walk into town. We would definitely recommend her place as a great base to spend time in the Barossa.. Hope to return soon..
Thanks for having us. We liked the character of the old building and having a place to sit in the garden outside.
We really enjoyed our stay in this lovely converted barn. The place is really clean, spacious and wonderful to relax in. would stay again and recommend to others.

We stayed at the Barn for 2 nights for a girls weekend getaway. We chose the accommodation based on the look and feel of the place which reminded us of a fairytale cottage. It was complete with warm comfy beds, a fireplace and even a morning wakeup call from the chirping birds. We were pleased to have a well stocked fridge upon arrival with eggs, milk, bread, butter, jam and orange juice. The only recommendations for improvement is the option for a later checkout as 10am was a little too early. Also, the kitchen sink and shower floods the floors when used, which caused a slipping hazard.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay at the Barn and had a really fun weekend in the Barossa.

The barn and gardens are all beautiful and quirky, plenty of firewood provided and the place is bigger than you would think from the photos.
A little disappointed with cleanliness, mainly dusty and cobwebs/critters on most of the downstairs furniture.
Kitchen appliances were a little dirty, for example kettle was a bit gross inside, plates and cutlery had some old food stuck on, things like that.
Provisions in the fridge were a very nice idea but the bread was stale and the eggs were unfortunately off, so we couldn’t use most if it.
Using the shower completely floods the bathroom, and there are drips through the ceiling below, my partner had a little slip (no damage done!)

I had a great stay at the barn & was sorry to leave Jaqueline’s little slice of Provence in the Barossa!
Highly recommended

The barn is a unique property in a good location about 15 mins drive from Barossa towns like Tanunda. It’s a great aesthetic but could do with a little TLC to justify the price. Jacqui was great, she gave us lots of personal recommendations for food and wine which were spot on.

Our stay at Jacqueline's Barn was just what we needed. So suited to the Barossa and surrounds with old stone work and beautifully designed. The fireplace, art work and classic touches gave the home all the vibes to help relax and enjoy every minute.
Thanks for the getaway.
Jacqueline is a lovely host, she is very accommodating and will make you feel right at home. Thank you.
Beautiful barn with gorgeous designed interior - such a relaxing getaway for the long weekend!
Lovely location

Jacqueline was a lovely host, very communicative and more than happy to give recommendations. The breakfast foods dropped off just before our stay were very welcome.
Being in the middle of a regional area and a converted barn, know that there might be some bugs that make their way in. The property is rustic and imperfect (echo the comments about the bath), but has all the creature comforts you'd need in WiFi, air conditioning, fans, etc. and is warmly decorated.
Beautiful location to do a bit of nighttime star-gazing.
Jacqueline was a friendly and highly responsive host. Her Barn in the Barossa lived up to its name as a quaint and rustic abode in the Barossa Valley. We would recommend this Airbnb to future guests.
Pretty house, good location. Jaqueline gave some amazing local recommendations for food and activities.

We had a great couple of days away at this accommodation. Lots of room for a couple of families, kids had a ball in the big back yard & exploring down the creek.  Spa bath was an added bonus. Robyn was extremely helpful and loved all the little extras too, breakfast was glorious. Thanks for a great stay Robyn & Andrew, would highly recommend and we will be back.

We stayed here with 2 other couples over the June long weekend & had such a wonderful relaxing time.
Robyn & Andrew thought of everything to make our stay as comfortable as possible.
The house is very clean, tidy & spacious. After we cooked dinner in the full sized kitchen and bbq out side, we all sat infront of the fire place in the lounge or played boardgames on the big dining room table.
It's really close to the main street in Angaston so we could walk down and visit the local shops.
The bed were very comfortable, the hosts are very easy to deal with and the scenery is beautiful & relaxing.
Thanks for a great stay Robyn & Andrew

Couldn't fault one thing about our stay at winter by the creek! Robyn made our stay so welcoming and enjoyable. We will be back and will highly recommended it to our friends and family. Thankyou once again Robyn
Hosting and responsiveness great. Spa and fire made it. Will be back and highly recommend.

We had an excellent trip to the barossa. Robyn was there to show us around when we got there. She had provided us with an amazing cheese and wine spread, beautiful breakfast selection and some local biscuits. It was more then we expected. The house was super comfy with enough space for 7 of us.
The only thing was the smoke detector kept going off with cooking but there is a BBQ outside.
Definitely recommend this place

Everything about our stay was just perfect. Couldn't recommend more. Robyn & Andrew went above & beyond to make our stay smooth and comfortable. From coming over to help with the fire, to organising a driver, to providing the most wonderful welcome hamper... We fell in love
With the place & hope to come back one day. Thank you!

Hi Robyn & Andrew, thanks for a lovely stay. We had a great time in Angaston, drinking wine, relaxing and eating yummy cheeses. We were very impressed with the home we stayed in for 5 nights. The wood fire was extremely cosy and the jaccuzi was a pleasant way to end each cold night. Some lovely extra touches were included in the stay and this was much appreciated.  Highly recommended. Thank you :)

Robyn was very helpful in communicating about our needs for disabled access.  The provisions were excellent and a huge basket of fruit was provided.  There is plenty of wood for the log fire which ran all the time and kept the house warm and cosy in winter.

Thanks Robyn for such a lovely retreat.  The house was lovely and warm on arrival, fire glowing, and lovely and generous breakfast provisions for both days.  We thoroughly enjoyed our experience and would definitely return again (with or without the kids!)

Robyn was a fantastic and friendly host. Great communicator. Location in Angaston was very convenient. Fresh eggs each day from the chooks were delicious. BBQ was great. Backyard fire pit was great. House was warm with great heating options. Beds and rooms were large and comfortable. House was clean and well presented. TV was excellent and lounge chairs very comfortable. Showers hot and water pressure excellent. Bathrooms will need new tiles fairly soon but no big deal. Highly recommend Robyn's place.

Wow! On entry to the property you are taken back by the amazing gardens and warmness of this cosy log cabin. Equally amazing is the kind and friendly host, Robyn, whom goes the “extra mile” for ensuring a comfortable, relaxing, trouble free stay. From being greeted with a food platter with wine to assistance with re-starting the log fire, you truly feel the host has considered your every need.
I booked this place for my wife’s surprise birthday getaway with our three daughters (aged 6 to 12) for two nights. And Yes, in her eyes, I hit a home run :) The only regret was not booking for longer! The place itself is centrally located in Angaston and fully equipped to accommodate for all your needs, regardless of age. I highly recommend this listing if you are looking to treat yourself to a peaceful and relaxing escape in one of South Australia's oldest towns.
Thank-you Robyn & Andrew for opening up your beautiful home! We had the most amazing experience and look forward to returning in the near future.
The Saumi’s.

Robyn was very welcoming and the house is lovely. With nice gardens, outdoor area, inside was very clean, comfy beds and she left us with heaps of food for breakfast and a cheese patter and wine on arrival:)
I will defiantly recommend this place.
Had an amazing time - lovely home and we found our host to be extremely caring and helpful. Highly recommended, thanks again.

This place could not be more magical. We had six guests stay and there was so much room and the place was absolutely gorgeous. Think the perfect swiss chalet in the middle of the Barossa. Angaston is the perfect location to access the Barossa, and there were little cafes and restaurants close by for the days we didn't want to leave. Honestly - everything about this place is exceptional.
Robyn was very understanding and helpful despite last minute changes. The  house was perfect for the weekend.

Robyn was the perfect host. She welcomed my family into her home with a smile.
My children loved every moment and had the best time exploring the garden and creek.
Robyn had games and toys for them play with on rainy days.
The delicious nibbles and wine for the adults were enjoyed and a lovely touch.
The fire was warm and welcoming on our arrival.
Robyn went out of her way to help organise meat trays and birthday cakes, which she kindly offered to collect and was waiting for us when we arrived.
Robyn also assisted us with directions to her property and helped with information on doctors when our daughter became sick. I can not fault her helpfulness.
The location was perfect, with just a short walk to shops and playgrounds.
The house was comfortable and warm and well stocked with everything needed for family life.
I totally recommend this property to anyone wanting a peaceful break away in the Barossa.
You couldn't ask for a nicer host.

Robyn was lovely, she met us upon arrival, showed us around and got the fire going. Her place is perfection, 4 spacious bedrooms, quiet area and the place has everything you need. Would definitely go back again, Robyn was a great host and provided loads of fresh local great produce. Highly recommended. Thank you for having us!

Robyn was an excellent host, couldn't fault her or the house. The house was set up perfectly, breakfast and snacks supplied was full of local, first-rate delicacies. Robyn supplied us with lots of tips on what  to do during our trip that we found very useful. The house itself was perfect for our long weekend visit, hot tub, fluffy towels and plenty of games and dvd's. Our kids were particularly delighted with being able to collect eggs from the chickens each morning! We had an excellent stay, would highly recommend!

We had a lovely stay in Angaston at Robyn's house. Warm fire on arrival with cheese platter, wine and fridge stocked with an amazing spread for breakfast.
Robyn was extremely helpful in giving us ideas of restaurants/ activites.
We will definitely be back!!

We had the most enjoyable stay at Angaston by the Winter Creek, we were greeted on Friday afternoon as planned at the property and our stay was faultless.  Robyn was a fabulous host, everything was there for us, we just had to arrive with the attitude of having a great time! We did just that.  The weather was perfect, the spa was utilised and the grassy patch in the garden was a lovely place to spend Saturday afternoon, indulging in local produce we had collected throughout that day.  Breakfast supplies were ample and attention to detail made our stay homely and comfortable.  Thankyou from all of us "the bookclub"!

Robin was a perfect host, she went out of her way to make us feel at home, we loved her cosy house, and it was close to everything we needed, if we are back in Angerston again, we wouldn't hesitate contact Robin.
Hanne and Soren

One word - PERFECT!
We were staying in the Barossa for a wedding so this was the perfect location, walking distance to the main street, shopping cafe's and restaurants. Very central for all that you may want to see and do around the Barossa.
Our host Robyn - one word again - PERFECT, fantastic communication from first contact, very flexible with our booking as we weren't sure on how many were staying with us right up until the last few days but Robyn was very accommodating
Our welcome - warm and homely as soon as we walked in the door, with the wine and cheese on the dining table to farm fresh local produce breakfast ingredients in the fridge - and that was just the beginning - there was nothing for us to think about, right down to the fluffy white bath robes and slippers!!..
Great experience, great house and fantastic to share with friends and family, would highly recommend...and already have :)

This place was fantastic. Everything was perfectly, cleanly and lovingly presented.
Robyn has all bases covered, and more, for whatever you could need at this house.
We would definitely stay here again.

We could not rate Robyn or her accomodation highly enough. Prompt and friendly communication, Robyn was so helpful with any query we had, both about the house and the surrrounds. Perfect accomodation for a group of people, lovely secluded outdoor area with hot tub, and the most delicious brunch in town thanks to Robyns recommendation! We'll definitely be keeping this accomodation in mind for our next trip to the Barossa. Thankyou!!

What a relaxing spot! Everything has been thought of, location is a perfect base for exploring the region and Robyn was a wonderful host. All the little touches really make the difference - from fluffy robes to quality toiletries to delicious local produce and treats...thanks Robyn! Made for a fantastic girls weekend away!
This is a great place to stay. Beautiful garden, comfy beds, spa bath and more. Great for a group of friends or family.  Robyn is a welcoming and generous host.

We ( 3 couples) just spent a lovely week end in the Barossa.

Angaston by the Winter Creek was a rare find with 4 bedrooms, 3 of which had queen beds and 2 + bathrooms. This in itself is not the norm and is what attracted us to the home as well as its outside area of BBQ, spa and eating area.

We appreciated Robyn's effort with the breakfast, nibbles and wine left for us to enjoy and the high quality products for guest's use in bathrooms.

An enjoyable stay.

Robyn would have to be rated as a fantastic host.  The additional extra touches were greatly appreciated by the whole family.  Robyn greeted us and explained  the house layout and how to use all the facilities.  The cottage was exactly as described and presented immaculately.

House was quirky, with everything we needed for 5 adults. Local pantry items were tasty. Gardens hard to leave for other destinations. Handy to wineries and good choices for dining. A lovely weekend place.

We really enjoyed our 4 night stay over Christmas. The house was perfect for our needs - plenty of room for 5 adults, close walking distance to angaston's main street, and very effective air conditioning. The lovely back deck and beautifully maintained grounds were a bonus. We were particularly impressed by how well stocked the kitchen was - so many lovely local treats and loads of quality kitchenware and wine glasses. Check in was a breeze and Robyn went out of her way to assist and make us feel welcome (she even put up a delightful little Christmas tree for us!). A great experience all round.
This place is peaceful, quiet and tastefully decorated and equipped for a great get-away. Certainly a thoughtful host.

This was a perfect retreat for 6 friends for a chilled but fun-filled new years get-away!
Robyn and Andrew were lovely and gave us a tour at check in so we knew all the ins and outs of the property (and spa!) which was a welcoming start to our stay. Robyn even provided some treats and sparklers for our NYE celebrations!
One of the most difficult decisions we faced was choosing our rooms! All are lovely and have their advantages!
The property offers many different areas where you can play sport, suntan, lounge, spa, eat, bbq and in the colder months even sit around a fire pit! Luckily we had three nights to try a bit of everything in the beautiful warm weather.
Even though the property is in the sweet suburbs of Angaston, it feels like a secluded farm retreat. You can walk to the local shops in 5 minutes.
We loved our stay and would love to come back!

Robyn was a wonderful host, she takes care of every little detail to make sure your stay is perfect. The property and home is very lovely, clean and well equipped. W e especially enjoyed the garden and spa. It's a 10 minute stroll or very short car ride to the shopping strip of Angaston. We would definitely recommend.
Warm friendly greeting, accurate description, well located and serene location.

Robyn was a terrific hostess. The personal welcome and lovely array of goodies provided, was way beyond expectation and much appreciated. We loved staying at this house! It was cosy, private and walking distance to shops and restaurants - a fantastic and beautiful location. Will definitely recommend this house to friends and family.

Wonderful place to stay at. 5 stars for sure. Everything we wanted, it had it plus more. Great location from the vineyards, hot tub was awesome, wish we could have stayed longer. We'll be back. Thanks Robyn

We had a group come to stay for several nights and had a wonderful time at the house.  The spa was amazing and the hosts provided us with lots of outdoor entertainment (backyard cricket, croquet, etc) on the beautiful green grass outside - which was also nice for sitting back and relaxing! We were welcomed with many good surprises - wine, cheese, fresh fruit, breakfast, delicious biscuits, plus more.  It was a very spacious house fitting our group of 3 couples nicely.  Robyn was very accommodating to our needs and was able to help us organise some meat from the local butchers (delicious!) as well as provide us with information regarding transport during our stay.  We would highly recommend!!

This was my best AirBnB experience ever, and I've stayed in homes all over the world. The house was excellent, even better than in the photos, and Robyn was an incredibly thoughtful host- the snacks and treats were a lovely surprise, and one we were very grateful for after a long drive! A lovely area, and the house is a short walk to the the little high street with a couple of cafes, pubs, a wine bar and restaurant, not to mention the excellent cheese shop that is well worth a visit. If I could give six stars I would.
This place is amazing. Robyn is so friendly, helpful and fantastic to deal with. The house is big and a great space for entertaining. I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.

Robyn was so generous and helpful! It was our wedding and the bridal party stayed in the house. Robyn even helped us source beauticians! On arrival the fridge was full and the house was just perfect! Will absolutely recommend this beautiful home to everyone!
This property is close to the main street of beautiful Angaston.  It is spacious.  The children enjoyed the spa very much.  The breakfast supplies were amazing.

Angaston on the Winter Creek is a wonderful, comfortable place to stay, and Robyn is a generous and gracious host. We were struck by how well appointed the house was, and how much was available in the way of housewares, linen and towels, and so on. Also, Robyn was very generous with the breakfast provisions and other pantry items she left. She is going to be a hard act to follow.

We were blown away by the beautiful log-cabin style house and stunning garden and surrounds. Although two streets away from the Main Street in Angaston, the location was very quiet. Angaston was the only interesting town in the Barossa this weekend--all the others closed their shops at 12 noon. The house was roomy and comfortable--with 4 double beds in 4 bedrooms--perfect for groups of friends. There are only two rooms that are next to each other, the others are spaced out around the house. There is a huge 8 person spa with TV and dining table under the private veranda out the back. Inside there is a kitchen w a generous amount of provisions for breakfast and other treats!! There is a Nescafé coffee pod machine and gas stove and all the cooking utensils you could need to cook a dinner party! There is a huge dinner table for 10 and you can relax in the lounge room later with massive TV and dvds. We just loved it there and it was a hit with our guests too. Just book it you'll love it!!

Where to begin!! Robyn and Andrew's house is perfect for a group of friends looking to enjoy the Barossa from a beautiful and comfortable base. The house is just a few minutes walk from the main street of Angaston and a 20 minute drive to most of the Barossa wineries, but is in a quiet neighbourhood on a large block.
The house is decked out with everything you could possible need. The linens are lovely, it is spotlessly clean and there are plenty of things to do in the house - games, cricket, a spa, sound system and a huge TV (great for footy). There is also an open fire which would be amazing in winter (it was way too hot when we were there).
Robyn really is the hostess with the most! She left the fridge full of delicious Barossa goodies including wine, cheese, eggs, bacon, fresh bread, tim tams, fruit, vegetables and even Maggie Beer icecreams! We had a delightful breakfast in the garden alongside the creek one morning. Robyn also offered to help out wiht transport (which in a wine region is a huge plus).
We will definitely be back. Robyn's place was great value, accurately described and the hospitality was second to none.
Angaston is a great base for the Barossa - it's small and quaint but has everything you need. We ate at the Wine Bar in town which was excellent and visited the farmers market on Saturday morning - amazing.
Thank you so much Robyn and Andrew! We will see you again. Kind Regards, Nicole, Noel, Josie, Ben, Martine and Dave.

We had a great stay here. Leading up to our holiday, Robyn went above and beyond to provide up with email information about the house and the local area. Check in was easy and Robyn even made the effort to come by and show us around the house and how everything worked (e.g. The awesome spa!). The house had more than enough space for our group, with a large kitchen for cooking as well as huge indoor and outdoor dining tables. Robyn provided loads of local foodie treats, like smoked bacon from the local butcher and wine from a local vineyard. We would definitely return for another holiday.

Robyn's place is AMAZING. We had two couples stay there but you could easily accomodate another four people / two couples in the house as there's a lot of space both inside and out. Robyn has thought of everything in this place, from a lovely welcome snack, to outside dining and fire pit, games corner, awesome home theatre, even a karaoke machine! There's a great kitchen if you love to cook as it has all the essentials and more. It is the perfect house for a fun relaxing getaway but also close enough to walk into town if you feel like venturing out. We based ourselves there for four days and it was a nice easy drive to a whole range of amazing wineries. The house is perfect, I would highly recommend it, and it's made even better by Robyn's helpfulness and thoughtfulness. We will definitely be back!

Great house for a family or group of people! Central location for the Barossa and close to the shops in the lovely town of Angaston. Robyn left us little surprises and I would highly recommend this property to anyone!
A lovely place to stay and a great host. Robyn is extremely helpful and ensures that all your needs are met. Thanks Robyn!
An absolutely perfect spot to enjoy both the Barossa wineries, but also enjoy the lovely cafes & bistros of Angaston...followed by a dip in the hot tub! A marvellous weekend!
Thankful for a beautiful stay. Lovely  quiet weekend away with the girls. The spa was great and we loved all the treats.

Angaston by Winter Creek is exactly as described. It is super spacious, yet very cosy, especially with the combustion heater. Robyn met us at the house and gave us suggestions about where to go and what to do. The house was very clean and the fridge was stocked with local produce. It is also in the perfect location, just behind the main street of Angaston. We would definitely be back.  Thanks Robyn.

Clean, spacious, warm, cosy, well equipped house with unique structure. Enthusiastic, detailed host. She even prepared special bath gel and sweets for my son! Thanks Robyn, this is one of the best stay I have ever had!

Robyn's house is wonderful. She really has thought of everything and it was just what we needed for a weekend away. I would recommend this house to my friends and family and would love to stay here again next time I'm visiting the Barossa.

Robyn is a terrific hostess and has a gorgeous place! I celebrated my 30th birthday in the Barossa with 6 friends at the beginning of winter and her cabin-style home was perfect.
-There were local treats left in the fridge, freezer and kitchen in case anyone needs a snack after their journey or before stepping out for groceries/dining locally.
-The property was adequately heated (it was the beginning of winter) but if you are still cold there were robe options, throw blankets and slippers.
-The main street is just one block over and is a very short walk.
-It easily fit 7 people without feeling crowded at all.
-The grounds are gorgeous and there are outdoor dining options (we had our final breakfast near the hen house on the outside tables in the sun, it was amazing).
-If anything is on in town or the surrounding towns, Robyn is very considerate and will let you know in case you'd like to add it to your itinerary.
-It sounds silly but I was worried if there'd be enough towels for the spa, but I needn't have! There were plenty of big beach towels for all of us and still plenty of bathroom towels to shower with.
Thank you for allowing us to have an absolutely wonderful experience in your airBnB home! I cannot recommend it enough!
Thank you for allowing us to stay at such a wonderful home. The food and goodies were a pleasant surprise.

Second visit was as perfect as the first.  The special little touches and Robyn and Andrew's service and warmth makes all the difference.   Everything you need is there.  Once you've been there, nothing else will do.  Highly recommended.

This place is such a beautiful, inviting, warm place to stay we couldn't fault it. Such a lovely earthy feel, with wonderful hosts who just went above an beyond what is needed. Leaving delicious fine cheese platter, lovely breakfasts and such great communication. I would love to live there it is a must for cabin lovers with a beautiful surrounding. Very spacious and comfortable room for families. Thank you and we highly recommend to anyone looking to hire this place go for it!

We had 4 couples stay at Robyn's house for 3 nights and we couldn't fault the experience. Robyn made check in very easy and walked us through the house. She stocked the fridge with amazing local produce for us to have breakfast cook ups including fresh eggs from her chooks in the backyard. The house has a lovely outdoor spa and she supplied 8 fluffy robes to make the experience feel even more luxurious. Robyn also supplied body wash, shampoos and all the little necessities in case you forgot to pack! The fire pit in the backyard can be used for $25 extra per night and is well worth it! The house is located a short walk from angaston town and this was a perfect location to access the Barossa wineries each day! Overall an absolutely wonderful stay that I would recommend to anyone!

Robyn greeted us when we arrived, and provided us with a thorough overview of the houses amenities, and even started a fire for us.  The cottage was the perfect mix of rustic with all the modern conveniences of life, making this place a perfect place to stay while exploring Barossa.  We really enjoyed the home and the surroundings!!

Robyn's place is incredible. Situated perfectly for daily Barossa trips and also equipped with a hot tub tv and bbq for those comfy nights in! Any small issues we had were dealt with quickly and we can't thank Robyn enough for her help during our stay. Highly highly recommended.

This house has everything the family travelers need and more! We visited with a 1 and a 3 year old and they loved the beautiful yard and daily trips to the chook pen. The house is clean, comfortable and well stocked with the essentials including a great selection of cheese, and local produce and a delicious breakfast platter. Robyn has thought of everything and provided clean and safe children's equipment and linen. A great location in the heart of Angaston in easy walking distance to the amenities and restaurants. Look no further, you've found your B'N'B!!

Robyns place was simply fantastic. It was the ideal place to base our group get together in the Barossa Valley. The accomodation is as described in the pictures. All communication with Robyn was easy and she was quick to respond. Check in was simple.  We all agreed that we should return if ever back in the region. Would definately recommend. Allan

Robyn went above andbeyond to make our stay enjoyable.  in each room there were small additions and special touches that made us feel at home and allowed us to relax and enjoy our stay.  By far the best Airbnb my family has been to thus far

Robyn certainly went out of her way to accommodate us. Lots of yummy food, a bottle of wine, flowers and nice soaps etc. were appreciated.  An upstairs bathroom would be good, but plenty of room and the spa was nice. Cheers.
Very nice place with great entertaining areas outside.

Perfectly located home for exploring the Barossa and then relaxing at the end of the day.  Great outdoor entertaining area and spacious garden area.  Superb hospitality including wine, cheeses and breakfast items. Robyn made sure we had everything we needed for our stay, including accomodating our very young children (e.g: high chair etc).  Her tips for enjoying the area were really helpful too.  Fabulous!

Communication was excellent and especially the extra touches of fresh flowers,  breakfast provisions including fresh eggs, cheese platter and special ice cream treats - all very much appreciated.  Also having an Expresso coffee machine was great and saved us searching for that "elusive great coffee" in the area.  Robyn also offered to arrange fresh seafood for us for the festive season which was another unexpected gesture.  Would love to visit again in Winter. for that really warm and cozy experience.    Giselle

Good clean accommodation and excellent breakfast provisions plus extras such as a bottle of wine.  Lovely table setting outside and great lawn area.  Angaston was a bit quiet on New Year's Eve, not that it worried us.
Great location and fantastic hosts.
Really nice and quirky cabin. Looks like a lovely place for a couple families... big yard that we didn’t use! Appreciated the wine & cheese on arrival.
Great home, great location, great value and thoughtful additions that were not expected. Thanks Robyn for your hospitality.  Kind Regards Laurie.

Robyn’s place is amazing. I just wish I’d had more time to appreciate it!! Beautiful garden setting, stylish house. Robyn also provided extra treats with food and even organised to have the Advertiser delivered on the days we were there. Amazing
Very clean and Robyn’s communication is great.

Robyn was extremely helpful and communicated well throughout our stay. Her house is beautifully furnished and comfortable, and was topped by Robyn’s generous hamper left in the fridge along with some delicious port! Excellent stay, highly recommended!

Robyn was a lovely easy going person to communicate with and helped us in anyway she could. The breakfast and cheese platter were amazing and the BBQ dinner (optional extra) was superb and would recommend to take up the offer for a little extra money was totally worth it. Very relaxing place to stay. We loved every minute of it. Thank you again Robyn
Great location and house has a lovely homely feel . Robyn is an excellent host. Nothing is too much trouble.

Robyn hosts a wonderful house here in the Barossa. Thank you for having us
Kindest Regards
Natasha

Absolutely fabulous, we had 3 generations sharing this wonderful home. Beautiful inside and out,  Robyn welcomed us with a great spread of local produce so no need to do any shopping the night we arrived. The only problem was we werent there long to really settle in and just enjoy the place.

This was a lovely place to stay for my friends and my long weekend in the Barossa Valley. There were lots of nice touches to the property and Robyn was a great host.
My friends and I loved the spa, fireplace and overall ambience of the house and garden.

Robyn was so helpful and the place had everything we needed and more. My kids and husband suffer badly from asthma and this house was spotlessly clean and they had no problems breathing at all! We got the bbq pack and it was absolutely fantastic fresh and tasty food! Everything was easy! We’d definitely stay here again!

We were a group of four ladies spending a long weekend in the Barossa. We were so pleased we chose Robyn's place to stay. We each had our own comfortable room with electric blankets, very comfortable bed and pillows. The living area was warm and cosy and there was plenty of wood supplied for the fireplace.
Robyn was extremely generous with the provisions supplied and the kitchen had all the appliances you would need. As well, there were plenty of glasses, plates, cutlery etc. We spent our first night sampling the bottle of very nice Shiraz left for our enjoyment. The gardens and grounds of Robyn's house are beautiful and would imagine they would be more so in the Spring and Summer months.
We did not use the spa or bbq so can't comment on those, but the area they are in is very nice indeed and would be great to enjoy on not such a cold weekend.
The Barossa Farmer's Market on Saturday morning is highly recommended. We also had wonderful meals at Vintners, Angaston and 1918 in Tanunda.
I would wholeheartedly recommend Robyn's house for your stay in the Barossa.
