Do note however, that there is no early check in available unless you pay for an extra day in advance.

Robyn's place was beautifully appointed with lots of thoughtful touches. She went above and beyond as a host by meeting us on arrival to show us around and by driving us to our dinner reservation at Hentley Farm.
Particularly special features included the fireplace, spa, fresh local produce for breakfast and the chooks!

Our stay was lovely. Robyn was really accommodating and the house was wonderfully cosy and perfect for what we were after. The house had everything it said it would and is a great location to Tanunda.
Robyn truely deserves her super host  status. Absolutely every thoughtful touch was evident in all she did. Great local cheese and fruit plus a beautiful bottle of wine to welcome us.

A fantastic stay in Angaston. This house had everything. 4 comfortable rooms, multiple bathrooms, a great kitchen and dining table for big meals and it was walking distance to the shops and pub.
The hot tub was HOT but very relaxing and the karaoke machine certainly got a workout. What a fantastic stay we had with a few other couples. Thank you.
A fabulous place to stay if you want to see the Barossa, perfect host, lovely thoughtful touches. We loved the girls’ eggs & the food was amazing.
Robyn's place was lovely... beautiful comfy beds, great kitchen! Such a great place to stay.

Robyn & Andrew are wonderful hosts! They go above and beyond to offer fenomenal service. We can’t thank them enough for all the help with our wedding logistics and for helping us organising a lovely family picnic the day after the wedding. Most importantly, they made us feel at home. We had the best time at their place, it’s a beautiful house, sparkling clean and equiped with all the required items that you could possibly need. We travelled with my two months old niece and Robyn & Andrew made sure she had all that she needed. We will definitely stay there again!

An amazing property. The second time now that I have stayed there. Robyn has thought of every little detail and supplies the house with great local produces. Very relaxing enjoying a wine in the spa or by the wooden fire. The photos really do not do the house justice. An amazing stay and Robyn is so helpful with suggestions. Will be booking again forsure.
Fabulous house with character and lots of features. Garden is beautiful- perfect for birdwatching from the veranda.
An amazing house oozing with character. Robyn was lovely and our stay was a delight.

This was a wonderful getaway with lots to enjoy in the accommodation - spa, fire pit, pretty outdoor areas. Food provisions were generous and extensive. It suited our family well with lots of rooms for everyone and facilities for little children available. Highly recommend!

Excellent location, lots to do nearby (Robyn gave us loads of options and ideas) or plenty of space to relax at the property (especially the spa). This was our return  girls trip for the second year ..very relaxing 😌 The side garden facing the creek was pure bliss...we all sat out there and became totally “zen” 👌🏻

What an incredible place. Fantastic location for wine touring, excellent communication and wonderful fresh, local produce provided for delicious breakfasts (and some wine for the spa). Beautiful gardens to relax in and karaoke box for a fun evening. Can't wait to stay again. Thanks for being a wonderful host Robyn.
Perfect little spot for a few nights away. Host is awesome. Spa is fun too. Clean and quaint house!

Lovely home, great location a short walk into town.  Robyn goes above and beyond to assist her guests, our fridge was stocked to the brim.  I would highly recommend staying here, it’s like having your own little oasis.

This place is spectacular. There were little touches everywhere that were great, like shampoo, soap, makeup remover in the main bathroom. The spa was fantastic and it was a bit too warm to have a fire but the fire pit was all set up for us anyways. We had a great time using the karaoke machine and it was so nice to be able to cook up a breakfast with the fully stocked fridge provided. The beds were so comfortable as well. Robyn even pointed us in the right direction for restaurants etc and kept communication with us the entire time in case we needed something. We will be back to the Barossa and will definitely book this home again.

Our stay here was wonderful! The hospitality provided by Robyn & Andrew was wonderful. Made for a great weekend in the Barossa!
The winery tour and grazing lunch was wonderful! They took us to a little ‘diamond in the rough’ winery which was very special! Would recommend!

Thank you Robyn for providing such a gorgeous property. Extremely spacious, very relaxing surroundings and conveniently close to the town centre (without feeling like it). All four of us who stayed for our girls weekend found the beds to be comfortable and the linen immaculately clean. The food that was left for us was amazing, we made up a wonderful platter to enjoy on the back deck. All in all we had a fantastic time and definitely recommend!!!
Really well equipped place, had everything you could possibly need and plenty more. Very accommodating host, great location and value for money with all the extras provided. Really enjoyed our stay.

Robyn provided us with beautiful local produce and a bottle of wine on arrival. We spent the day touring around Barossa with her suggestions and transport - lots of fun had. She made an amazing platter for lunch which was to die for! Highly recommend.

Good base for exploring the barossa. Clean and comfortable accomadation. Nice place with a private and spacious surrounding.
Nice touches throughout the home from the host.
Highly recommended.

Highly recommend this gorgeous house in its beautiful setting. Robyn was excellent to communicate with and the amenities were more than we expected. We thoroughly loved our stay and hope to be back one day soon. It's a credit to you Robyn.

This house was fabulous to stay in.  From the wood burning stove already stoked, and the hot spa, to the amazing breakfast supplies and wine and cheese platter.  Robyn is an amazing host, she met us at the house gave us a tour and explained how everything worked, and where to find things.  The house is in a great location with loads of wineries close by and the farmers markets.  Highly recommend it and would love to stay again!
Truly the best weekend of my life, cannot recommend highly enough. Book here if you want to have an amazing time.

Robyn's house in the Barossa is absolutely fabulous for a group.  It's so close to the gorgeous township of Angaston (literally 5 min walk if that).  Robyn is one of the most generous hosts, leaving delicious provisions and treats, ample towels (including spa towels), outdoor blankets, umbrellas (we didn't need them) and anything else you can think of to make your stay first class.  There was plenty of heating to keep us warm and the beds were comfortable and beautifully made-up.  We had a ball with 3 generations on the karaoke machine, playing coits, even got the twister game out!  So much fun, thanks so much Robyn.

Robyn was the perfect host!!! She organised us a beautiful tour through the Barossa, including wine tours, an amazing lunch and a gin tour!! Her welcome cheese platter was amazing, as was the ridiculously awesome local breakfast provisions.. the spa was great as was the fire - overall this was the best Airbnb I’ve ever been to, thank you!!!
Great location and very spacious place.
Robyn is a great host and truly is a wealth of information about the local area. We really enjoyed our stay!

We were blown away by all the extra touches Robyn left for us.  So many treats - we’ve stayed in a lot of Airbnb places but never had this before! The space was perfect for two families and Robyn provided a baby cot, high chair, changing mat and toys which were all in great condition.  Lovely comfy beds and bed linen, plenty of towels and thorough instructions on how everything works.   It’s a very homely log cabin - and perfectly warm for a cool spring weekend.  We loved it and would definitely recommend.
Robyn is a wonderful, thoughtful host. We were extremely comfortable in her house and were spoiled with all the treats she left for us. We couldn’t have asked for anything more! Thank you Robyn.
Really nice house. Right in the middle of everything.

Delightful stay for our 'home base' during a long weekend of family time and celebration.
Robyn and Andrew were ever so gracious and the local produce and treats were a lovely addition to what is already a perfect spot. Such a lovely time was had by all. Thank you!
We had an amazing time at Robyn’s place, we really enjoyed our stay. Thank you again.
We had a great getaway with our family for a few nights. The fire was very cozy and lots of space for the kids to run around outside
Lovely host lovely  place
A wonderful house in Angaston township. Beautiful garden, relaxing spa and loved the indoor fireplace. The extra touches of board games and amenities made the experience a fantastic Barossa getaway.

Robyn’s place was great for our stay, we were in the area for work but I’m planning to go back to beautiful Angaston and hopefully stay again, communication with Robyn was very easy and she was more then helpful, highly recommend Robyn’s beautiful home

This gem in Angaston is an amazing stay. The gardens and lawn are beautiful, the interior of the house is stunning, and the amenities such as the spa were incredible.
There were so many places locally to see and no shortage of things we could do. The town is beautiful and the local area around it hides some sweet spots in our stay like the Tanunda Bakery which had so many treats, we had to come back the next day.
After dark there was ample space to play board games with friends and spread out in the lounge and share a story or two. The spa was the icing on the cake and we used it both nights we stayed and even considered cheekily using it before we left.
Robyn was an outstanding host and went incredibly far to make us feel comfortable and to give us recommendations on great places to go while we were in Angaston.
If you're a group of people looking to get away for a weekend, you simply must stay here. It will be the highlight of your trip.
Very cute place, big open living spaces make nights in a breeze.
Great place, easy to get around. Very picturesque!

While this property offered plenty of accommodation and amenities for our family, we were disappointed in the lack of attention paid to cleaning, in particular, the oven. We found the decor tired and dingy rather than cosy and comfortable.
Some of the items left in the “complimentary breakfast” were past their used by date. It all added up to us feeling a bit “ripped off” as it wasn’t cheap accommodation. We can’t believe the comments by previous occupants. We’re we really staying in the same place!

The host is great, nothing too much trouble. Provided us with all the information we needed to enjoy our stay. The property is set in lovey grounds, the spa was great to relax in, there is a sound system inside and out so we were able to play music from our phones. Lovely quirky place perfect for a weekend getaway.
The perfect place to base yourself for a Barossa trip. The house has a lot of character and all the amenities you need. Loved the spa in particular!
A lovely and comfortable house to stay in and very nice welcome basket with lots of goodies to enjoy. Location is also great.
Robyn's place is beautifully nestled in Angaston, the pictures don't do it justice. We had a great relaxing weekend here, everyone loved it!
Thanks so much for having us stay Robyn, such a picturesque place! stunning gardens perfect for our wedding 2.0 photos. everyone loved the spa & all the little touches. Thanks again. Legend🤙😘🥂

We had a girls weekend away at this cosy two-story log cabin and we couldnt have been happier with our choice! Robyn was very helpful with local tips, and the house is an easy walk to the main street for some cafes. The lounge, dining and outdoor areas gives you ample space for a larger group (we had 3) or a family. Would love to come back again.
Beautiful and quiet, great base for a getaway!

We loved our stay at the property. It has a special homey feel to it that made everyone feel relaxed. My son enjoyed the collection of childrens books in the living room that kept him busy for hours, we loved our afternoon picnic at the garden and our breakfasts at the back. Its a great place to spend time with family and friends.
Cosy house with great outdoor space in a convenient location. The best wine/cheese plate and breakfast platter we’ve ever had at an airbnb! Very thoughtful touch.

What a great little getaway to Angaston! Loved the welcome platter and bottle of local Shiraz to start off our weekend away. Breakfast provisions were a fantastic to start our Saturday with a small feast.
Robyns home is a great location being so close to all the good wineries and restaurants not to mention just a short walk from the Main Street.
I would definitely recommend and be more than happy to stay again.
Robyn was an excellent host and the place itself was lovely. Additionally, Robyn was responsive to any queries we had :)
Absolute charming Place

Robyn puts the BnB part back into the platform. Upon arriving, we were greeted with a bottle of wine, some local cheeses, breakfast provisions, a fully set combustion heater and warm jacuzzi. Robyn was a delight to deal with and her house is beautifully kept - clean, plenty of extra blankets and a kitchen that's stocked just like you would keep at home. All these little touches, and a great location within striking distance of the Barossa wineries, really made the place stand out amongst all the other AirBnBs I've been to.
Oh, if you happen to leave the front door open during the day expect a visit from the friendly brown hens.

Loved our stay at Robyn's place in Angaston. We found the house to be very neat and well appointed, and close proximity to the town centre and vineyards pickup's and drop-offs. Additional touches like a breakfast hamper & complimentary wine went a long way in making us feel welcome. Would recommend!

We had an amazing stay at Angaston by the Winter Creek. 2 x couples enjoying a fantastic few days wine tasting in the Barossa.
Communication with Robyn was perfect on the lead up to the trip and Robyn was able to organise for us to be driven around for a few days by John with Barossa beyond
We all highly recommend Robyn and John . The house was amazing with so many little thoughtful touches like the welcome bottle of wine and cheeseboard. Breakfast basket was fantastic with local area products
We had lots of laughs and a great relax by the fire and a soak in the spa at night after all day wine tasting
5 stars doesn’t feel like enough for the fun we had ! We will definitely recommend Robyn and her amazing place to anybody our friends wanting an incredible time in the Barossa
Thanks for having us !

Robyn’s place was so much more spacious than we expected. It was like being in a Canadian ski lodge! There were so many  small, well considered touches that made it all feel very special. The place was well set up and we found it very easy to get settled in and enjoy the spa, fireplace, food and wine! Robyn provided a breakfast and we also purchased a bbq tray and picnic. These were sensational and I highly recommend them. There was  ample, high quality Barossa produce provided and we were more than satisfied! Robyns place was great for our family but it would also really suit larger families or groups of friends wanting to ‘lock in’. I can highly recommend this as a fantastic Barossa accommodation.

Such a lovely part of the Barossa to base yourself for a few days, to enjoy the wineries and great food. Large 4 bedroom home big enough for families or groups of friends. Very responsive host. Extremely clean and well stocked house that my family felt so comfortable and relaxed in.
Bigger and better than it looks in the photos. Great location.

Super clean and cosy. Great location!
Much better than the photos. We really enjoyed our long-weekend stay and would definitely recommend this lovely house to those who seek a relaxing holiday and want to get away from it all.

Loved it- an awesome place. Loved the location, the garden, the log fire and outdoor area.
Will stay again :-)

Perfect accommodation for a weekend away in the Barossa, we loved the indoor fire pit and comfortable chairs, as well as the spacious wooden lodge style house with its gorgeous outdoor garden area. Would definitely stay again!
Fantastic, quirky place to stay. This was my second stay at Robyn's house. It's a lovely large house with stunning gardens and the kids LOVE the spa. Location is great and we will be back again.
Great setting with plenty of space. good facilities.  easy walk to the main street / shops. host was very helpful. rook advantage of the winery tour - great day out
A beautiful log cabin in a gorgeous setting. Very well equipped home

Perfectly located, just minutes away walking away from Angaston’s fabulous restaurants and wine bars, and a short drive to the amazing farmers market for a Saturday breakfast. A quirky and interesting house set in beautiful gardens. The spa and fire pit were the icing on the cake.  We were welcomed with some local produce and wine and cheese. Thank you for an amazing stay!!!

Location was the highlight for this property .
the house was in good condition and had plenty of space for adults and kids
We love staying here - it's our second visit and we will stay again. :-)
What a gorgeous getaway. The house was cosy and spacious. The garden delightful and the hosts very helpful. Robyn took us on an excellent wine tour - highly recommend.
The place was clean and had everything we needed. Robyn was very helpful and proactive in her communications.
It takes 15 minutes to the supermarket and we could enjoy cooking.

A beautiful place, will definitely stay here again. It had everything we could need, so many little details thought of. It fit our whole extended family for Easter, and we all still had our own space and privacy. A beautiful garden and surrounds, perfect for an Easter egg hunt! Our whole family agreed what a special place to stay, thank you so much Robyn for hosting us all.

Great location to explore the Barossa valley. A short walk to the main street of Angaston for food and supplies. The house itself is a step back in time, a little quirky and straight of the late 1980s. But there is 4 bedrooms with comfy beds and everything else you need in a house. The spar was clean and nice and warm, we used it every night.
Robyn left some delicious supplies including a scrumptious bottle of red wine which went down a treat after a long drive.
Unique and comfortable accommodation - perfect for a family group.

The accommodation was amazing, dealing with Robyn was really good with great communication. It was very relaxing, the breakfast basket waiting in the fridge was fantastic along with the cheese and wine.  Thank you for allowing us to stay at your beautiful property.

We have stayed with Robyn approx 5 years ago and just loved the country feel.  The main lounge was a little run down with carpet burns from the wood fire and cleanliness when furniture was moved.  We did still love the style, location and hospitality.  Communication was a little confusing for bedding, provisions, checkin and checkout as well as wood supplies should we require the fireplace.  I put this down to having to communicate with AirBNB for the original reservation of 8persons and direct with the host for the extra 2.  Overall we had a great 2 nights and catch up with some very dear and close friends.
A cute and very cozy cottage. The welcome basket was a delight…..Just perfect for the 4 of us.

Robyn and John went above and beyond for my friend and I. I have never experienced such unfaltering hospitality. From start to finish everything was exceptional and their service impeccable.
Robyn’s service includes a one stop shop in the Barossa Valley with nothing asked being too hard or without question. Robyn was an excellent communicator, kind, punctual and generous with her time. I couldn’t recommend more highly. We will be back!

Had a great stay at Robyn's place in Angaston, although it did get cut short due to a family emergency back at home. This place feels steeped in history, with the stone and wood work, beautiful high ceilings and stained glass windows. The hot tub was fantastic out the back to relax in after a long day exploring and the kitchen had everything needed to cook up a storm with the wonderful selection of ingredients left by Robyn. Very happy with your stay and would gladly return.

Everything was perfect. Plenty of room for everyone plus a welcome basket with wine, cheese and breakfast foods. The stain glass windows at the front of the house were so beautiful. Would recommend. Thanks for letting us stay!
Relaxing stay at Robyn's place. Beautiful surroundings and Robyn had left generous provisions for breakfast
Lovely cabin with beautiful surroundings filled with the sounds of nature.

Robyn’s place is a classic country cottage located in the heart of the Barossa Valley. It was very comfortable with plenty of space. The garden was beautiful with lovely peaceful surrounds. A great place to relax, unwind and explore the area. Robyn communicated well and left tummy breakfast provisions.

Angaston by the Winter Creek served as the home for nearly my whole bridal party over the weekend, and we all absolutely adored it. It was a very comfortable stay surrounded by a beautiful garden and view, and the jacuzzi was definitely the highlight of the weekend.
Great big house with excellent entertainment area.

Angaston by the Winter Creek was a fine place to stay but could definitely use a good clean and a bit of love. We had to rewash a lot of the dishes before using them, the dishwasher was very stinky too, the place has a lot of dust and cobwebs. Not a massive deal and it was an inexpensive stay so we weren't too worried. There was a possum causing quite a racket but the host kindly dropped off some earplugs for the second night. The grounds are lovely. The spa is pretty dated and could use a good clean out too. $65 for a night of firewood as an additional charge was a bit rich (we had our own thankfully). Overall the place was fine for the cost and we had a lovely weekend away in the Barossa. The host left a lovely bottle of wine, cheese and crackers and breakfast provisions - all of good quality. The bedding / towels etc were comfortable and clean. Communication with the host was easy and access to the property was seamless.

Had an wonderful stay with family.  Place was accessible which was amazing.  My 97 year old grandmother was able to navigate with ease.   Plenty of bedrooms, bathrooms, hot tub, fireplaces,  verandah (where we had our morning coffee and listened to the birds).  Many thoughtful touches such as spa towels, jigsaws, games, breakfast which accommodated our vegan and gluten free needs.  we will be back.  :)

We had a four nightly stay.
The house was as described, and had everything you need plus more.
Due to the circumstances of our visit we were not actually at the house most of the time so did not get to enjoy all the facilities on offer unfortunately.
We did love the complementary wine and cheese as well as the breakfast basket. Lovely soft robes were also great. Communication was easy and Robyn offered assistance to make our arrival and stay easy.
Would recommend the house for groups and families as there is lots of space for all.

A lovely place evoking a log chapel that actually exceeded group member's expectations from the photos.
The hot tub was most enjoyed by our group and the provisions and amenities were also fantastic, with a surprisingly great sound system. We are keen to return.
Beautiful house, really enjoyed our stay and would defiantly stay again
Beautiful property.

The house was in a great location and quite big. We went as a party of 2 families and fit easily. The house itself is clean, but rustic. There is only free to air TV, which wasn’t great for the kids.
Robyn was always nice to deal with though and the location was perfect.

I am confused about all the 5 star reviews for this place.
The location was convenient and Robyn was very helpful. But the house was far from what is described.
The photos are old and the house is very tired. Some of the issues were Stained towels and sheets, uncomfortable beds, old furniture, walls wafer thin you can hear a person breathe in the next room. There was even water leaking from the roof in the rumpus room.
The list can go on!
I must mention a huge safety issue with the front steps. Not only were they slippery with moss (real easy to fix) but they were on a 90 degree angle and falling apart.
My child and I both slipped and fell very heavily, we were lucky to not sustain any serious injuries.
I feel this place is way overpriced for the condition it is in. If it was half the cost then maybe it would reflect the condition.
Robyn please attend to these issues and spend a few dollars on this house as it has a lot of potential. But there is way better value out there.

Quaint log cabin style in comfy walk to main street of Angaston. Lots of towels and we liked the robes.
Spa was excellently presented and easy to use.
A few cobwebs in the tall ceilings and a little mould in bathrooms.

My friends and I enjoyed our weekend at Robyn’s place.
The house is well equipped and offers some great spaces for relaxing. The beautiful garden space out under the trees was just perfect for a sunny afternoon drink / chatter with friends.
The house is older in style & decor but clean and comfortable, if your looking for modern this isn’t the place, but if your looking for character and comfort this certainly met that brief.
Robyn provided easy instructions and everything was as described. My family had a great time staying for my wedding.
Beautiful place to stay. Exactly what we thought it would be like. Clean and tidy with no issues at all. Would definitely go back. Thanks Robyn!

We loved staying in the log cabin. The beautiful local produce on arrival was delicious and the fridge full of breakfast ingredients and fresh sourdough made for an amazing breakfast. Anyone providing Shultz’s bacon automatically earns 5 stars!! Was super cosy and the lounge room and tele was a perfect place to sip the complimentary bottle of red and watch the footy. While we were 3 brothers sharing the space we said we could’ve easily have been there with all our families. The Barossa is already a home away from home for us and Robyn’s place was the perfect home away from home in our home away from home.
Missing the soundtrack of ducks already.

Rebekah and Ed's place was gorgeous. Simple yet stylish and as noted in the description based on the 1950's era. Very clean with all the things we required for our stay. Beck was easy to contact and her communication was very prompt. The main Street of Angaston was less than ten minutes walk and we enjoyed trying out some of the suggestions for dining including Roaring 40's pizza and Vintners Inn. Bed was brand new and very comfortable. Bathroom had just recently been renovated and was spotless. Would recommend this place for anyone visiting the Barossa.

This is a beautiful house in a quiet neighbourhood of the Barossa valley. The house is a good size for 2-4 guests with vintage furniture to complete the look. Rebekah was very helpful and quick to respond and was happy to leave us to our own devices. With a car it's very easy to get around the area but we recommend booking a tour if you want to indulge in the wine. We went for a fantastic dinner at Vintners Bar and Grill, just outside of Angaston.
The house is a short walk into town, where you will find a couple of pubs, cafes, a wine bar and food store.

What a delightfully gorgeous 50's house - so full of charm. Rebekah has prepared the house perfectly for guests - the style, cleanliness, little extras, comfortable beds and beautifully renovated bathroom and laundry are a delight.  We highly recommend it for anyone travelling in the region - close to the main street of Angaston and a few short kilometres from Tununda. Rebekah's hospitality was second to none. Thank you so much for sharing your home with us.

Rebekah is a fabulous host. Quick to respond when you need her. House is quiet and cosy. Heaps of space inside with lots of cute little outdoor spaces in the garden. Large bedrooms with extremely comfy beds. Very practical and clean kitchen, bathroom and laundry. Lovely walk into town. Slight hill coming back. Gas heater was much appreciated and warmed the house quickly. ❤️
Cool little house, clean and great location. Rebekah was very attentive to our needs. Highly recommended.

We had a lovely stay at the 1950s retro cottage hosted by Rebekah. Rebekah was very quick to respond and made sure everything was ok with our stay. There was a delicious bottle of red left for us and some breakfast provisions.
It's a short walk to the main street of Angaston with a good choice of restaurants and shops. Angaston is a pretty town and a great spot base a Barossa visit.
It's like stepping back into the 50's brought back many childhood memories. Good value for money
Lovely host, clean and tidy, nice set up.

Angaston is a great base to see the Barossa from  and this property is a total delight ! A short walk to the pretty township for a meal, drink and food shop. The Host is excellent to communicate with and offers a gorgeous 50/60's period decorated house, that s perfectly fitted out for a stay - good kitchen facilities and utensils for a night in with with great Barossa Produce.
Really great property. We loved the 1950's style. The place was very clean and we even got a little treat upon arrival. Next time we are in the area we would definitely stay there again

Accommodation as described
Very clean and functional Lovely retro furniture. Location easy 10 minute stroll to main street. Communication with Rebekah very easy. Highly recommend as barossa accommodation location. For me Angaston is the loveliest of the towns in barossa tegion

Perfect location for exploring all the Barossa has to offer. Easy walk into Angaston for restaurants, supermarket, etc. Great wineries and scenery within a short drive. Very clean and a cool decor, easy check-in. Well-equipped kitchen if you want to take advantage of the great local produce - check out the Farmers Market on Saturday mornings in Angaston. Highly recommended!
Nice place to stay when in the Barossa.  Very clean.  Comfy, warm bed.  Great hosts.
This is a great house to stay in, comfortable and close to shops. Rebekah is a great host and makes you feel welcome!
Perfect for weekend or week long getaway!

Lovely Retro house! The beds were super comfortable and the shower was amazing! Lots of space inside and out with a lovely big backyard full of beautiful roses. The house was in walking distance to Angaston town centre and a good area to stay to visit wineries in the region. Would definitely stay again!

Easy access to this property is so convenient and the yard is beautiful to sit and enjoy a glass of wine. Everything was immaculate. We made use of the washing machine and hung our clothes to dry, greatly appreciated after traveling for two weeks.  We spent three days at Rebekah’s and found it very central for exploring the Barossa Valley. Fantatic time, and if we are ever back this way would certainly stay here again
Very clean and beautiful space. Bed and sofa not very comfortable. Nice area for walks

This was our second visit to Angaston.Also our second stay at Rebekah’s beautiful Airbnb.
This place has Everything travellers need and more.
Lots of extra touches.
Very comfortable beds with quality bed linen and towels.
The garden has been transformed a lovely area to sit and have a glass of wine which Rebekah provides.
It’s in a quiet residential area but easy access to shops and wineries.
Great restaurants within easy driving or some walking distance.
Keep up the great standard us travellers really enjoy finding such comfortable places.
We will be back.

Our stay in this retro cottage was perfect. It was well appointed with everything that we needed for a comfortable stay; especially the beds! The house is a short stroll from the main street of Angaston and in the heart of the wineries. The kitchen had everything we needed for self-catering but we took the opportunity to enjoyed dinner at Vintners one night as well. Handy wifi and laundry facilities (with powder!). There are plenty of cafes in walking distance with great coffee.
The attention to detail was incredible. From the authentic 1950’s décor, through to the modern luxuries (love that they give you TWO kinds of pillow!) this place is a joy to stay in. Did I also mention there’s wine provided for you, that’s made personally by the winemaker owner?? Can’t wait to come back for a longer holiday!”

My daughter and her friend had a wonderful stay!

Great location, quaint & charming space.  Really suitable for 2 singles travelling  together or 2 couples. Lovely outdoor space and gardens. Thanks Beck & Ed.

We enjoyed our stay.

We couldn’t have found a more beautiful place to stay for our first visit to Angaston and the Barossa. Bek and Ed are thoughtful hosts and their place is ideally located, stunningly presented and the most spotlessly clean AirBnB we’ve ever encountered. Highly recommended!

This is a lovely house. Has all the amenities.
Walking distance to many restaurants.
Great location for visiting Wineries. Would easily stay again.
Really enjoyed our stay in the accommodation. The location is great Angaston is a very pleasant town with great facilities. The vineyards in the local area were great for lunches and premium wines.

A lovely stay.

This place is amazing and I would highly recommend anyone to stay here, it was absolutely immaculate, so clean and neat and in fantastic condition.

We loved everything about Retro Barossa Style. The property is meticulously maintained in authentic retro style. Rebekah's Retro accommodation is great! Spotlessly clean, excellent amenities, super comfy bed, and a great vibe. Communication, before and during our stay, was very responsive. Home away from home. What a beautiful place. It has been decorated perfectly.  Will be back that way November next year will come back for another visit.

We had a lovely stay in this delightful cottage, Jim was very welcoming and gave us some good recommendations for our weekend in the Barossa Valley.

Says something about the place when the best part of each day - and of our visit to the Barossa Valley - was coming home to nestle in the coziness and comfort of Casa Rossa and the warmth of a toasty fireplace.
The place was fantastic and exceeded expectations. Nice location, spacious and a few great homely touches that made our stay great. Thanks again to Maria
Great place to stay in the Barossa - well presented and clean, roomy house. Very comfortable stay.

The house was lovely, and we would definitely stay here again. We booked this home for a family stay for my father's 70th. We were welcomed with a personalised card and a bottle of wine and some chocolates. It was a really nice touch and we enjoyed the delicious wine on our first night under the stars out in the alfresco dining area. The photos don't do it justice, the house is lovely, warm and homely, yet beautifully styled. The communication was excellent and Maria recommended some great restaurants, wineries and cafes for us to try. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay, thank you again Maria.
Great quiet and private location and a fantastic house, would definitely recommend for a family group looking to visit the Barossa Valley and stay close to the local wineries.
Great spot for a few days in the Barossa region. Incredibly spacious. Really well-stocked and excellent communication throughout our stay. Thanks for making it such a memorable trip!
Amazing place! Very spacious and comfortable. We had a great time. Thanks Maria
Such a pleasure to stay. Thanks for making the trip so special with such a fantastic base to stay at.
A great place for a quiet, relaxing getaway. Close enough to the great restaurants and cellar doors in Lyndoch. Lovely outlook onto the vineyard.

The post on Airbnb says it all. Actually Casa Rossa is even better! It is quite a luxurious home away from home with everything provided. If you don‘t like comfort, tranquility, lavish vineyard views then you should stay home.  Casa Rossa is handy to everything the Barossa Valley has to offer. I would return in a heartbeat.

This place was a great stay for our family trip to the Barossa. Although it was only four of us, there was still lots of room to have another family and not feel crowded. The bathrooms are renovated and feel modern while the rest of the house has a classic feel to it. The kitchen had everything that we needed including utensils, paper towel, wraps etc.
We will definitely stay here again on our next trip and bring another family.

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
The rooms are spacious and well appointed. The layout is great and the location is in a beautiful quiet area.
Kitchen is well stocked with all the necessary utensils. Very comfortable.

What a beautiful Airbnb to stay at for a girls weekend away! It was very neat & tidy making for a relaxing weekend. Maria has gone above & beyond providing guests with complimentary breakfast & local wine. Couldn’t recommend it enough! Thank you for making our stay in the Barossa so memorable.
Great accomodation in an easy location for exploring the region. Appreciated all the extra touches like the complimentary breakfast and wine.

We had a great stay at Casa Rossa with our 5yo daughter. This modern farmhouse is spacious, clean, quiet, and beautifully furnished and decorated. We really loved the modern bathrooms (the shower products were lovely too) and the super comfy bed. The location was also great being close to cellar doors in the BV region.
Amazing outdoor setting that we didn’t get the chance to use due to the wet weather. But we thoroughly enjoyed the views of the private vineyard from the kitchen and even spotted a kangaroo hopping past. The fully equipped kitchen also comes with plenty of cooking pots and pans to whip a lovely family meal.
Special touches such as a complimentary bottle of wine + chocolates awaiting us, a cupboard full of fun board games to play, and the night lights along the long hallway and in the bathroom (very thoughtful especially for family with young children) were all appreciated.
Overall a wonderful experience. This place had everything you need for a comfortable stay.
Great experience staying at this beautiful house. Location was great but the the main highlight was the warmth the house provided.

Perfect for 2 or a group. Great location being close to everything but a private spot. Why stay in a cramped little place when you can have this full house. Excellent clean kitchen and bathrooms. If you enjoy a bath then you will love the one here. It’s huge. Comfortable beds and everything you need is here.

Magnificent! A beautiful home, a convenient location and a truly fabulous host! Accommodation exceeded our expectations and the place was sparkling clean! Every little detail was thought of! Would absolutely recommend and will visit again when next in the Barossa! You won’t be disappointed!
Beautiful house on a beautiful estate. I was also staying there for work but would definitely return for some RR

Casa Rossa is a great accommodation for one or two families. Loved the location as it is very close to all the local wineries. We even spotted a kangaroo and a rabbit during our stay. The kitchen is well stocked and the bedding linen are top quality. The showers are renovated. There is a big stock of  board games to enjoy time indoors too. Overall we loved  this accommodation and recommend it as a great place  to stay for anyone visiting Lyndoch.

Perfect spot for a long weekend away! Beautiful house in a beautiful location. The breakfast and wine Maria left for us was amazing and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
Highly recommend!
Very nice property
Beautiful home, great location, has everything you need.

We had a lovely stay at Maria’s in the Barossa. The house inside is beautiful, very clean and homely. The outside of the property isn’t great but there’s a nice outlook of the trees from the living room and kitchen.
The house is located within a short drive to wineries and Tanunda. There’s not much in Lyndoch but a couple of nice stores.

Terrific stay at Casa Rosa. Spacious rooms , comfortable beds and lovely personal touches! Ie, wine and chocolates and ample breakfast provisions for both days for four of us. Very clean and appreciated the fluffy white towels. Communication with Maria and the team was outstanding. Close to great wineries and everything you need for a very pleasant stay in the Barossa Valley. Many Thanks! Sheena

Wonderful place, we loved our stay! Lovely kitchen and outdoor area and whole house nice and secluded. Lots of welcoming touches with a lovely bottle wine and plenty of options for breakfast. Just a short 15 minute drive to Tanuda and the wineries. We would certainly stay again!

The property is in a fantastic location to access all the Barossa wineries.
With a kitchen and laundry, this was the perfect place for us to stay for a week.
The added touches were amazing and we are a very grateful for all the small things added.

Down the end of the lane just behind the shed is a little spot of loveliness- Casa Rosa. Beautifully decorated, spotlessly clean, complete with quality touches - crisp white bedding, thick towels, hot strong showers, comfortable beds, a bottle of wine to welcome you. We could not have asked for a better place to stay to explore the amazing Barossa.

Absolutely beautiful home! All the amenities and special touches were greatly appreciated, and the location was perfect for exploring all the Barossa has to offer. Breakfast provisions were fantastic, and the complimentary wine was a delightful touch. Would definitely stay here again! Thank you Maria for creating the most wonderful stay!

Casa Rossa is a beautiful family home in the Barossa with its own little vineyard! We loved the fire place at night and breakfast in the kitchen overlooking the vines. Easy parking, checking in & out, and communication with the property manager. Thanks for having us stay.
Well appointed house in a good location. Loved the provision of breakfast and a bottle of wine, it was very much appreciated.

Beautiful place, it has everything you need including breakfast provisions, in a great location and very comfortable. Bethany was a fantastic host, communication was easy and she left us a lovely card and some Easter eggs and a bottle of wine on arrival which was so nice! We loved it and would love to come back again.

We had a wonderful stay at Casa Rossa. It's a spacious, clean, warm, beautifully decorated home. The hosts have gone above and beyond to cater for everything a guest would need. The generous breakfast provisions, wine and chocolate were a welcome treat! We enjoyed relaxing by the fireplace in the evening and eating breakfast together in the sunny kitchen. Bethany was a star, super helpful and welcoming!

We loved the open fire and the attention to detail - hot showers, fluffy towels, crisp bed linen, comfortable beds and sparkling clean. The wine, chocolates and breakfast provisions were great. The owners have thought of and provided everything guests might need. We would happily book again.

We loved our peaceful Barossa escape at CASA ROSSA. The home was beautifully presented with all the comforts and amenities needed for our stay. The outdoor area overlooked a private vineyard, a perfect way to end each day with a few glasses of good wine (complementary!!) and delicious cheeseboard. The breakfast provisions were also a thoughtful touch. We had such a great time - highly recommended! Thank you Maria.

Lovely stay, accurate listing. Missing firewood on arrival but was dropped off the next day. Jess very attentive on replying.
Tip for future guests - tricky driveway when arriving in dark so be careful.
Otherwise all very lovely and good value. Thanks for having us!
Thanks so much for the stay! The photos really don't do the house justice. Such a lovely area and lovely little touches in the house that made our stay super special!
Stunning Airbnb. Such a beautiful place to stay when visiting the Barossa region. Well presented, with those special extra touches. Thanks for sharing your home.
What a wonderful home away from home! Just perfect for our weekend away.

Absolutely loved our stay, it was everything we dreamed of. Clean and fresh beautiful home. Gorgeous breakfast platter supplied which we enjoyed on the bbq. We did run out of fire wood pretty early in the stay but Maria was very quick to respond to our message to help us out. 10/10 stay loved it.

Casa Rossa is one amazing place to stay! A beautiful home away from home. Everything you literally need is there. It's a very homely accommodation and everything has been thought out very carefully. The beds were comfy, they even had electric blankets to top it off. Even the towels were quite plush too. Maria and Beth were quick to respond. Thank you for having us :)

Brilliant, large, spotlessly clean house situated on quiet private block overlooking vineyards. Perfect for the 6 of us, all adults. Excellent ducted air-con and open log fire made it toasty warm in the middle of winter. Well-equipped country kitchen, generous breakfast provisions left, catering for dietary requirements, and a lovely bottle of wine, chocs and port included. Plenty of room for us all to spread out, cook and relax. Would highly recommend. Maria was excellent at corresponding promptly to my emails, and flexible with catering to check-in and food requests, which was much appreciated.

Clean and spacious place with lots of charm. Thoughtful touches such as bacon and eggs and orange juice for breakfast , a bottle of wine and chocolates were an unexpected and a lovely inclusion. The sunsets were gorgeous , lovely to sit by the fire to watch with a glass of red . Easy access to the Barossa .
The house is excellent! Had everything we needed, generous breakfast supplies, warm and cosy. Would definitely recommend

Large home with a very modern fit out.
Perfect for a comfortable get away in the Barrosa.
Lovely look out to the vines.
Amazing fire place and large comfortable bedrooms.

We had a great stay in at Maria’s’ place. House was well appointed, clean and super comfortable bedding. We loved the extra touches like breakfast provisions and treats. Great place. Highly recommend
Very comfortable house with lots of areas for hanging out inside and outside. The kangaroos feeding right outside were a highlight
The place is lovely, it has everything we need and it was very thoughtful that breakfast were also provided. We enjoyed our stay very much.

House was presented beautifully inside. Well stocked fridge for a couple days breakfast supply. The only heating was an open fire which we had to pay for extra wood after the 1st use and we were there for 3 nights which wasn't any cheaper after the 1st night

Thank you so much for having us Maria! We had such a beautiful stay. Can’t rate this place  highly enough - great location, exceptionally clean, stunning decor and beautiful vineyard views. A must stay when visiting the Barossa Valley!
Great stay at Casa Rossa! Beautiful house with stunning views of local vineyards. We enjoyed doing big cooks up and relaxing around the outdoor dining table/space. Would recommend a visit.
Casa Rosa was a perfect home away from home and the perfect base from which to explore the Barossa.

it was lovely staying at Maria's beautiful home. the house was just like the pictures and was a nice and peaceful part of town.
thank you for the wine and chocolates that was a nice touch as well as some basic items for breakfast, which did come in for handy!
the only thing i would say is the aircon is not super strong for a hot summer. but i think that is something that couldnt be helped so there were fans in every bedroom which was a life saver. dont think we would be able to sleep without them otherwise as leaving the aircon on at night is a bit nosy (only i found, so really depends if you're a light sleeper)
also make sure you read the blue handbook before drinking from the kitchen taps. the right hand side tap is rain water and not drinkable! I had recommended a sign to be added just to avoid confusion with any thirsty guests! :)
over all a great stay and would definitely stay again :)
Such a beautiful and clean property. Very relaxing. Didn't want to leave. Will definately go back. Doesn't disappoint and will recommend to friends.

Maria has a stylish, well-maintained, well-stocked place in Lyndoch.  Photos match Airbnb, and there is plenty of space for a group (we were only 3)! Only challenge was the central aircon struggled to keep up with the heat (esp in the bedrooms), as temperatures reached 40C/100F, for the week we were staying in the Barossa.   Kitchen was well-stocked (Nespresso, OJ, lots of plates, utensils etc).
The house is perfect with great amenities…nice view of the vineyard with kangaroos & rabbits to enjoy. The garden was very tired and needs attention but still an enjoyable stay.
Can’t thank you enough for an awesome stay and for arranging everything at such short notice. You really have created such a perfect home away from home. We are already planning our next trip down.

Casa Rosa was located in a peaceful area overlooking some vineyards. Our stay was comfortable and we enjoyed sitting under the tree with a glass of wine each afternoon. A lovely breakfast was provided for the duration of our stay. We loved how central the property was to many Cellar Doors

Absolutely love staying at Casa Rossa. Beautiful home, very relaxed and beautifully decorated, while feeling right at home.

thank you again

Casa Rossa is a must in the Barossa. We’ve stayed at a few Airbnbs there through the four-years we have lived in South Australia and Casa Rossa was just perfect for us. Casa Rossa is a 10-minute drive from our favourite wineries and walks and we will definitely return. Thank you for everything, and best of luck.

Great home base to explore the wonderful Barossa Valley! Stunning house with charming interior and beautiful garden (roo visitors included). The house has lots of space and is perfectly equipped. A bottle of wonderful Grenache waited as a welcome gift - a beautiful drop! Highly recommendable!

We (the 4 of us)thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Casa Rosa which was very comfortable and welcoming. The setting amongst the vineyard and the visiting birds and kangaroos were a nice unexpected addition. We were very grateful to find refrigerator and pantry staples and other lovely welcome surprises like a lovely wine and chocolates. Thank you. Those made our stay so much more welcoming.
The home is located in a great area and we highly recommend staying at this lovely place.

Lovely stay, beautiful location. Will be staying again 😃
Loved our second time staying. Lovely location and very quiet and relaxing

Such a lovely place to spoil my mum for her 60th birthday! Very comfortable, clean and clean we loved the extra little touches ✨
Thank you!
Tranquil and relaxing

We would recommend the Casa Rosa to anyone wanting to visit the region.
The accommodation was absolutely top notch; from the location, the quality of the accommodation, right down to the quality wine glasses they had!

No one will be disappointed with staying here

My friends and I loved our stay at Cassa Rossa. it felt just like a beautiful home. So cosy and welcoming! Maria really did think of every little thing to ensure we had a wonderful stay. I highly recommend to anyone staying in the Barossa region!

We enjoyed our stay at Maria’s place. It was exceptionally well equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. The host could not have been more helpful or friendly. We particularly enjoyed the neighbors ( the kangaroo family). Thank you for a wonderful stay.
Me and my friends enjoyed our weekend stay at Maria’s place, it was a lovely getaway. Very peaceful and relaxing. Thanks Maria!

We absolutely loved our stay at Casa Rossa. It was a perfect honeymoon away from home for our two young families. We loved the way the house was set up, the amazing amenities, big kitchen island and of course the open fire place. Perfect for sitting by, drinking wine and playing boardgames while it was freezing and drizzly outside! We would love to come back again.
This is a fantastic place to stay and the added extras a real treat!
needed a pest control as we were inundated with ear wigs.

Casa Rossa surpassed all our expectations!
The communication and friendliness of the staff was exceptional.
The welcome pack of wine & chocolates was a lovely welcome, as was the bacon & eggs waiting for us to cook up.
The linen, cushions and towels were exquisite quality & all the furniture was beautiful and comfortable.
The kitchen was fully stocked with everything you need with lovely kitchenware.
This home was beautifully appointed with everything you could need.
An oasis in the heart of the Barossa.
We will definitely be back to stay for a longer visit.

We had a wonderful stay at Casa Rossa. Extremely clean and welcoming home, very well equipped and left with thoughtful provisions that added a lovely touch. The place was perfect for my wife’s 50th birthday weekend and the outdoor courtyard made an idyllic spot to enjoy drinking bubbles amongst the vines.
The host was amazing to deal with too and very friendly. We’d definitely return again one day.

This place was such a wonderful retreat. We were a little apprehensive about the 1.5 bathroom description but it actually has 2 showers,  1 bathtub, and 2 toilets. The view of the vineyards is a real treat. As are the family of roos that visit in the morning and evening. The welcome basket of eggs, bread, milk, bacon, butter and wine from the estate was such a nice surprise. The house is nicely furnished and the surroundings are tranquil and relaxing. Would love to stay again. Thank you Maria and Louise for hosting us at Casa Rossa.
The house was beautiful, very cosy, very big. We really enjoyed staying there.
We had the best time staying at this place. The hosts were very supportive and easy to communicate with. Shoutout to Renee!

Casa Rossa is a perfect location for exploring the Barossa Valley area. The house is exactly as it appears in the photos and is clean and spacious. Everythinlg you need is there and the kitchen is well equipped. There is no ensuite and one bathroom is quite a walk down the corridor, but bothe are sparkling clean. Maria and Louise communicate all necessary information well and promptly.  The breakfast supplies and bottle of their own wine was an added bonus. The house is perfect for two couples. Can thoroughly recommend.

Old Mill Cottage in Kapunda is a beautiful place to stay. We were surprised how historic the cottage was, being built in 1864! It has since been beautifully renovated. It provided us with a great base for both Clare Valley and Barossa.
Cute rustic place with everything you need. Location is in a town centre, so not rural, but there is a beautiful backyard to hang out and drink wine in.

We really enjoyed our stay at Old Mill Cottage, the place itself is private and quiet and has a cosy feel. The cottage was well presented and clean, and the heating facilities are good as there is both a wall heater and a cast iron fire to light up for extra heat and ambience. Yvonne was helpful and quick to respond to all our needs. She was also able to provide us with a portacot which was a bonus. The kitchen doesn't have an oven, but has everything else required to cook family meals. The master bed is very comfy, with lovely soft bedding! All in all this is a very nice little hideaway, only 20 mins drive from tons of big name wineries.

The cottage was beautifully renovated with quirky themes. My partner needed more than 10 snapchats to cover all the things she liked about the design.
It was very comfortable and made for a lovely weekend away from Adelaide.
The cottage was lovely, clean and everything we expected. Thanks for a great weekend in the Barossa Valley!

The most gorgeous cottage you will find, great, cosy space, all very well designed, stylish with many personal touches, many wow moments for sure! The garden smells dreamy - with all the blossoming flowers we were just enjoying wonderful wine whilst sitting outside! I would recommend this place to anyone, we also booked a wine tour and they picked us up and dropped back at the cottage which was lovely. Thank you

Yvonne's cottage was absolutely perfect for a weekend getaway with friends to the beautiful Barossa Valley!! Kapunda is so close to everything, the garden is a gorgeous spot to sit in the sun and relax with a wine and enjoy a BBQ. It was still cool at nights so we sat by the wood fire inside and chatted. We had dinner one night at the Kapunda North Hotel which was also amazing.
A coffee machine would be a great addition to the kitchen and some extra pillows would also be good.
Fantastic & cosy cottage, close to local shops etc - Yvonne was a great host

Had a wonderful weekend stay. Walking and bike riding distance to the main street is a plus, very quite and peaceful. Styled and equipped to a high standard. Beautiful garden setting. Views of the garden from every window.

We had a lovely stay at the Old Mill Cottage. It was such a pretty place to stay in, and the welcome of eggs, butter, bread, milk and juice was just so special after weeks of being on the road. The Old Mill Cottage was in a convenient location to check out Kapunda and the other towns in the Barossa Valley. We would highly recommend a stay here :)

Great place, tucked away on a quiet street, next to what looks like a reserve. We came on a very hot day and the air-con was super efficient. Loved the old stone walls & polished floorboards combined with a modern kitchen and bathroom. If you're after a large claw-footed bath to soak in and dream away the day, this is the place!
We had a great stay! Beautiful little cottage and gardens! Thanks Yvonne!

Yvonne's place is the perfect spot for a getaway to SA's beautiful wine regions. A 15 min drive to the Barossa and a scenic 50 min drive to the Clare - it's in a great location. The place itself was easy to find, clean and well designed. We were very happy with out stay here - the beautiful outdoor area was perfect to sit back and relax with a glass of wine after exploring all day. Would definitely recommend! Thanks, Yvonne :)
Lovely cute cottage. Walkable to town. Beautiful area. Breakfast was provided

This little cottage provided a perfect spot for a winter getaway. The log fire gave off lovely warmth and a cosy feel, adding ambience to each evening by the fire.

Yvonne’s place is perfect for a cosy getaway! We loved being so close to the barossa valley wine region and enjoyed the charm and coziness of the cottage. Perfect for couples or small groups of people. Thanks again Yvonne!

Clean & full of character cottage in a great position.

Great fire. Nice setting. Comfy bed. Greenock tavern good pie. Nth Kapunda hotel good food

Snuck into the Barossa for a friday wedding and booked this cottage without any hassle. The place was easy to find, easily accessible and very very clean inside. It had all that was needed (and more) including linen, towels, some breakfast supplies, toilet paper, wood for burning (if thats your thing), books, DVDs, a TV and a portacot. My wife was a huge fan of the supplied marmalade. The shower and bath is a cracker, and the hot water system is quick and excellent.
The location was outstanding with a reserve next door (including a large pond with plenty of ducks to see) and a nearby park 3 min walk away with a full size steam locomotive to play on - these were appreciated by my 2 year old daughter. Overall the place was great and I'd highly recommend booking it if you wanted to base yourself in Kapunda for a barossa trip. We ended eating at the North Kapunda Pub and FermentAsian which I highly recommend.
The place itself is great - and I have given it 5 stars. However if there was anything negative to note about the place, then its the following:
- there is a tiny tiny amount of termite damage on one doorway - but this doesnt effect your stay
- there are not many fly screens on the windows - so if you're keen to open up the windows and doors and let the breeze through you may need to be aware that bugs may join you inside.
Overall a lovely cottage
would highly recommend the Old Mill cottage. Such a cosy and clean place with great amenities and space. GREAT VALUE!

Lovely old cottage with great charm in a good location with a beautiful lake literally at the backdoor where the ducks and geese can be fed. Good amenities. Aircon in kitchen couldn't really cool the bedroom sufficiently for us.

If the host addresses the above the cottage is worthwhile staying.

Beautifully renovated, clean and comfortable. Great mix of new and classic design. Ammenities great as were breakfast provisions provided. Couldn’t fault it in any way. Would stay again.

The hosts go to so much extra effort to provide absolutely everything you could ask for in an AirBnB. They provide all kinds of food, drinks, kitchen items, tea, coffee etc... that goes way above and beyond expectations.

A beautifully decorated and comfortable stay in a lovely and well situated historical town.

Old Mill Cottage is such a treat to stay in! From the beautiful decor, super comfy beds, luxurious outdoor bath and yummy breakfast provisions, it's a cut above other accommodation!
