Peter and Marijan's property is in easy reach of Barossa Valley wineries and sites, numerous walking trails like the Heysen Trail and mountain bike routes. It is also perfect for relaxing. It is an interesting and historic property important for the history of the Barossa. Our accommodation was above the original barn, simple, functional, exceptionally clean and a little old fashioned. We loved Marijan's pikelets, the tour of the main house and the efficient combustion heater in the cold winter's weather. Thank you Marijan and Peter for minding our bags and the enjoyable stay.

Peter and Marijan's place was lovely. It was on a road less traveled but the property was charming and old worldly. Because it has a history - the property is getting restored bit by bit and it's wonderful to step back in time and take in the atmosphere. We wanted a break and a breather from the city and the place was exceptional. Billy and Sterling (the Alpacas) were adorable and we loved the tour of the property. Our son got to experience what it is like to be a farmer. Overall it was a wonderful stay and because it's a short drive to Williamstown, Tanunda and Angoston, we enjoyed the local eateries and delicacies as well. Wonderful place to stay while on holiday.

Oh my goodness if you want to experience a beautiful rustic retreat then this is the place to go. We were greeted with a warm cottage and some friendly alpacas. Our beds were so warm and cosy had the best sleep and that fresh country air just added to it all. Do your self a favour if you're going to the Barossa stay here.
Thank you for the very peaceful  and warm stay at your beautiful place. the whole place was perfect and the hosts are super friendly, i couldn't have hoped for anything more

Quiet, secluded, fresh air, very special farmhouse type ambience.
Marijan is a very welcoming host.
The home itself is simple yet comfortable, like walking back 40 years in time and some of the furnishings and implements match that era.
Lovely to wake up and see "Dorper" sheep grazing outside your window. The legendary Roos did not make an appearance but we didn't miss it!
The surroundings are lovely for walking and exploring
and offer ruins, pine forests, streams and vistas of rolling hills.
For a family used to life in inner Adelaide, this was quite magical.
Lovely farm style stay in beautiful rural surroundings. Thank you for hosting 😊
A fantastic location amongst the hills. Beautiful backdrops and very helpful hosts. Recommended to all

Very friendly and welcoming. Nothing was a problem. House was large enough to sleep all 6 males in our group comfortably.
Very well set up place to stay

We had a lovely time at the cottage. It was very picturesque. Marijian was very accommodating and was genuinely interested in making our stay enjoyable. We even got to feed her adorable hand-reared lamb!
Lovely property, with awesome views on the way there.  Great facilities and just like the description - highly recommend

Don't miss the opportunity to stay at Martinsell and Pewsey Vale! Marijan and Peter have created the most beautiful place here -- the cottage is in such a glorious setting, and the sheep, alpacas and old gums make it really special.  Marijan has thought of everything, and their tips for outings and places to eat were spot on. Our son will never forget helping hand-feed the baby lamb and the alpaca gents. Thank you so much for a gorgeous couple of days -- we hope to be back!

We would highly recommend this as a stay for groups both big and small. The property is incredibly picturesque and is ideal for relaxing outside or taking walks.
The cottage was spacious and comfortable with everything we needed. The host Marijan was very hospitable in offering us a tour of the property; the stories behind the manor and the gardens added a tremendous amount of enjoyment for us as a group.
The area is easily accessible with a car and the local wineries and town markets are a short drive away. Without a doubt we would love to go back.

We had a great time at Martinsell Cottage and would return there anytime. We loved the pleasant and unique rural location. Marijan met us at the gate (it was drizzling) and welcomed us in. We learned the history of the property, which we partly knew, enjoyed the convivial atmosphere and the guided tour of their property.  Mt Crawford and Martinsell is a great place to visit.

Wonderful greeting with freshly cut roses and plenty of helpful advice regarding the Barossa from Marijan. The location was excellent with everything a nice driving distance, yet very quiet and tranquil. Thoroughly recommend for anyone visiting the area.
Peter and Marijan were great  hosts who warmly welcomed us....a lovely touch of paradise and a wonderful place to stay in the Barossa ...highly recommend...

Marijan and Peter are amazing hosts and we will book their beautiful house again.
Thank you very much, kind regards,
Hélène and Michael (from Hobart)

Beautiful cottage in a stunning part of the world. Marijan and Peter were fantastic hosts- so welcoming and helpful in every way. The alpacas and sheep were a huge hit with our young girls and the location is fabulous. Very close to all the attractions of the Barossa.

Marijian helps a lot and very friendly.
Very relaxing place with the nature.

Peter and Marijan made us feel so very at home in their beautiful cottage. Marijan even gave us a private tour of their stunning sprawling property! There are sheep and alpaca running around, all very friendly, and the cottage has everything you need. A quiet and cozy place, 20 minutes drive from the centre of the Barossa. I recommend staying here as the drive to town is beautiful, with a limit over the region as you drive in to town. I can't wait for them to finish the work on their château, as it is already looking amazing and luxurious, and a great alternative to the cottage.
Very friendly, comfortable house, spotless clean and Marijan and Peter will be the best hosts of your trip!!

Marijan has been an absolutely wonderful host! She has given us local tips on where to eat and visit, showed us the manor (including recounting its heritage), and also allowed us to visit her wonderful sheep and alpacas. The place itself is very peaceful and the air is simply so fresh and crisp. We would love to visit again!
Beautiful cottage in secluded stunning country with flora and fauna only a stones throw away from Barossa valley and Adelaide
Fantastic spot to get away from hustle and bustle,  quiet and secluded,  comfortable beds and very attentive hosts!  Definitely recommend!

Thank you for a lovely stay - really appreciated the tour of the estate and feeding the animals, as well as your recommendations for activities and restaurants. Beautiful spot and very comfortable. We wished we could have stayed longer. See you next time!
Great spacious place in a bountiful rural setting. Only 20 min from the central Barossa. Perfect for walks and for people on horseback.
Great location, beautiful property and nice hosts.

Absolutely wonderful place to stay with exceptionally attentive hosts. Well maintained and clean accomodation with fresh linen and everything you need for secluded country interlude, including wood fire. Close to a wide range of high quality restaurants and wineries in the Barossa with plenty to see and do. Highly recomended and we will definitely be going back..

Great hosts with local knowledge, interesting, helpful hints and information.  Great spot for a couple of a family.  A little distance from town though an enjoyable and beautiful drive towards the heart of the Barossa.  Highly recommended!!
Great location neat and tidy accomodation. Nice to have a tour of the property and see the manor house
Stunning property, exceptional hospitality and super cosy - couldn't have asked for more from our wonderful hosts. I'll be back!
Beautiful location. The llamas were cute :)

The Cottage was so spacious,  well furnished with everything you could want, a lovely wood fire as well as the reverse cycle meant the main living area was toasty and warm.  The hosts are really lovely people who could not have been more friendly and approachable.  The property itself is magnificent, with  the most beautiful gum trees and grounds with wonderful old buildings full of character.

This gorgeous cottage is in an absolutely picturesque location. Waking to see the magnificent sunrise over the vineyards and walking amongst the grounds is a magical experience. The cottage is warm and has everything you need to enjoy it’s peaceful location. We simply LOVED our stay.
Lovely county property. The hosts are super friendly We had a great time at Martinsell Cottage ..

I highly recommend Marijan and Pete's Martinsell Cottage. The place was big, clean and had everything we you could possible need.
Marijan gave us great recommendations on places to eat, to visit, best scenic roads, and was very helpful every step of the way.
My favorite part of the holidays spent in the Barossa was the tour around this property, we fed the sheep and the alpacas, had a walk around the vineyard and heard the amazing history behind this beautiful property. There is no money that could pay to make up and go for a walk around Martinsell Place, I completely love the property and would love to go back.
An amazing weekend away in the most perfect place. I feel so rejuvenated and will definitely be returning.
We had a lovely stay on this beautiful property, and also enjoyed great hospitality
Wonderful place.  Peaceful and beautiful.
Fantastic fireplace, air conditioning, good kitchen and the hosts are super friendly (in a good way).

The Martinsell Cottage sits alongside Martinsell Manor. Both are listed on Airbnb although the cottage is where we stayed, due to our more modest budget! We found it to be of great value and the hosts were wonderful - Marijan even took us on a tour of the grounds and manor, which was very interesting. Marijan and her husband Peter are meticulously recovering and renovating the manor and other parts of the property.
The cottage is clean and pleasant. The kitchen is fully functional and comes with tea, coffee and basic breakfast supplies. The bathroom is clean and large, and the water is hot with reasonable water pressure. So lovely to have a fireplace in the lounge room also! While there are no facilities for babies, Marijan was more than happy for us to bring our 3 month old, and we just brought our own portacot.
The Martinsell Cottage is a convenient and comfortable base for exploring Barossa wineries by car, and we would definitely stay there again!

Amazing place.  Quiet, slightly out of the way but close to every thing you need in the Barossa.  Lie in bed in the morning and only here the animals, birds and bees.  Huge place from two people to six, would be great place for large family with kids also.  Tour of the property is a total added bonus.  What has been achieved in two years is mind boggling.  Conserving all that history!  I will be back.
We had a lovely stay at the cottage. Great communication and hosting from Marijan and Peter. Would love to be back.

A perfect getaway that allows you to switch off and relax. The property is amazing, so nice and relaxing. The cottage is also really good ...perfect for a young family. Highly recommend, the owners where so friendly also which made the experience so much better!

Fantastic rural location deep in the Barossa vineyards. Peter & Marijan were lovely hosts & gave some great advice about wineries, etc. Very interesting main house, stunning grounds and nice to meet & feed the Alpacas. Would love to have stayed longer.

we loved our stay in this beautiful old cottage. lovely rural propery with sheep bleating. good base to explore barossa and adelaide hills. Marian was a warm and generous host and gave aus a tour and history of the property.
Awesome views and great place to be to relax and unwind among the sheep.
The Cottage was just perfect ! Set on a picturesque farm with beautiful views and an outstanding property rich with history & a great feel. We loved it !

We stayed for two nights in Marijan and Peter's cottage on their very scenic property.  The cottage itself was extremely comfortable, clean, and well equipped.  Marijan was a perfect host, meeting us on arrival (and very flexible when we changed our arrival time late in the day) and giving us a very interesting tour of the property, including the manor house, fitting in with our schedule to do so.  We had some marvellous meals in the cottage, prepared in the well-equipped kitchen.  When a (rare and brief) power cut, caused by an intense electrical storm, threatened one of our dinners Marijan came over straight away and helped us with setting up a BBQ.  It was an excellent and restful stay in a beautiful part of the country.
Quiet, relaxing hub for visiting the Barossa.
Very peaceful, great hosts, tranquil, relaxing and a good base to explore the Barossa from.

This was the place we just couldn't get enough of, even after 5 days there. Peter and Marian are such good folks, very accommodating hosts, and full of helpful tips for what to do and see.  You basically will have your own country estate, complete with a spacious house, a small flock of sheep amongst the enormous red gum trees, the occasional kangaroo, and two friendly alpacas. The furnishings in the house are simple but quite adequate. The house itself and the other buildings on the property are lovingly restored from their early days, and are wonderful. It's out of town and up in the hills, but still an easy drive to shops, wineries, etc. The more rural setting added a lot to its appeal for us. We loved it!

The cottage is an amazing space that is just perfect as a base to explore the Barossa valley. The cottage has everything you need, and is consistently styled in the 1970’s theme. The kitchen is fully equipped, and there are plenty of blankets for cold nights. It was just the two of us staying, but the space can comfortably fit three generations with the three great bedrooms and multiple bathrooms. The views on the property are stunning. We were able to walk around the property, even to their vineyard which was so great. There’s lots of amazing animals on the property too, and you can spy sheep, alpaca, and kangaroos from the cottage. The location is totally private, and yet conveniently located to cellar door locations for making the most of the region. We also got a tour of the manor, which is suited for a very luxurious stay. I would highly recommend it, and would come back here again

If you want to escape to a peaceful oasis at the end of busy winery and township touring, this is just the place to stay. This comfortable, spacious cottage, nestled among ancient gums and towering pines is a perfect, economical  refuge with wildlife, vineyards and livestock within metres of the door! A place of very interesting Australian history and a chance to witness great work-in-progress on the nearby stone buildings by the hosts. Don't miss this!

Martinsell Cottage is in a lovely setting which is peaceful and quiet. Marijan and Peter are friendly and helpful and the cottage has everything you need. It was a perfect base for our Heysen Trail walks not too far from Williamstown or Tanunda. It was lovely to look over Martinsell Manor and see all the work they have done there. We thoroughly enjoyed our two night stay.
Great place to stay in the Barossa if you love country and farm animals. Great host too and we really enjoyed our stay.

A great place to get away from it all. Our kids loved feeding the sheep and thinking they were farmers for a few days. Peter and Marijan were lovely, helped us out with local tips and showed us around their property. The house decor is unashamedly straight from 1982, but everything works and it is part of the charm. Very scenic property and outlooks, it really does make you shift gears while you’re there. Enjoy!

Martinsell cottage is a hidden treasure in every way. Magnificent property quiet and private very relaxing.  Comfortable bed lovely warm wood fire. The tour of the farm premises is very worth the time. We can recommend this accommodation.
Wonderful experience. Peaceful surroundings and friendly hosts. Would recommend the cottage to everyone.  Gorgeous scenery and lovely walking trails. Fabulous  all round.
Amazing views so beautiful

Quiet and tranquil. A beautiful place to rest and enjoy nature. Superb hospitality. Can’t wait till we go again. Highly recommended.
Thanks again. 👌👍

Very lovely place and host. Warm greeting was great, tour of the property. The cottage has a really awesome ambiance and feel to it, really thoughtful decoration but also practical.
Fire place was really cozy and the beds were very nice looking and comfortable.
Classic cottage that I know will be enjoyed by many! And peter and Marijan were more than lovely and very helpful in helping us experience as much of the area as we could!
If you are looking to spend time in a truly rural environment, where stress is at a minimum, or actually non existent, this place is for you
We really enjoyed our stay here in the Valley. So beautiful and very relaxing space. Looking forward to staying here again.
Relaxing location for a retreat. Friendly and accommodating hosts, thank you for having us.
Nice place in the heart of  Barossa valley,absolutely loved the farm animals

Martinsell cottage is in a fantastic location to Explore the Barossa.  The hosts are amazing and go out of their way to make you feel welcome and  ensure your stay is comfortable and enjoyable.  I was there for an extended duration of several months with work couldn't ask for a better place or people to stay with.  Many thanks Peter and Marijan.
Fantastic place and people

Beautiful historic cottage, warm and cozy during these wintery days. Loved our stay and hope to be back, our toddler son hopes to see baby sheeps soon❤Dear Marijan and Peter, thanks for your warmest hospitality.

Very welcoming hosts who have taken on the restoration of a historic property.
The cottage was very comfortable and warm during some very chilly winter nights. The property is set in the quiet country side of the Barossa Valley and close to walking trials but still within close proximity to all tourist attractions and wineries. The best of both worlds.

A lovely place situated on a huge farm.   Perfect for autumn - surrounded by oaks and eucalypts with a large combustion heater in the lounge room.   A serene get-away that is ideal for couples and families.

Such a great time away, was a cold July weekend but the cottage was warm and cozy. Beds were so comfortable. Our kids really enjoyed the farm and didn’t want to leave. Peter and Marijan were so nice and thoughtful. Marijan even brought a tub of LEGO down for my kids to play with one night and supplied some froot loops for them - they were wrapped. We also enjoyed exploring their property and were totally in ore of their magnificent homestead and tranquil gardens. It was like nothing I have seen before. They have put so much work and heart Into their property and it really shows... Hope to return for another visit in the future. I can definitely recommend.
Such wonderful hospitality in a glorious location. Highly recommend.

Martinsell Cottage is a wonderful place to stay. Warm log fire, games and videos, well-equipped kitchen and plenty of comfortable beds made it a perfect place for a family of 6 adults to stay. The location is divine - set among gorgeous trees and surrounded by sheep, lambs and alpacas. Marijan was a lovely host who made us feel very welcome and  showed us around the manor garden and property, imparting the local history to us. The Heysen trail is close by. The rest of the Barossa easily accessible. We wish we could have stayed longer. A really lovely place to stay. Thank you!
Highly recommend for a family holiday.  Baby lambs just gorgeous!  Billy and Stirling the Alpaca's also need to get a mention!  Cozy cottage and breath-taking scenery!
The setting is peaceful and private, the beds are exquisitely comfortable & we highly recommend Peter & Marijan’s Airbnb.
Fabulous 1901 cottage in a beautiful area of SA. Hosts were welcoming and promptly responded to all questions prior to our arrival. We would definitely stay there again.

Amazing grounds and hosts. Marijan had great information about the Barossa and surrounds. The cottage was very spacious and homey, which made our weekend very pleasant. Highly recommend staying at Martinsell cottage if you want a weekend to remember.

Absolutely wonderful stay! The photos don't do justice to how quiant and beautiful the cottage property is. Loved seeing the sheep and little lambs roaming around and the fire was great. Great communication with Marijan. Would love to stay again, perfect little getaway.
Beautiful grounds, lovely cottage with friendly greetings from the hosts throughout our stay.
A great place to have a quiet peaceful break from the stresses of liife

It’s a beautiful historic place on a beautiful piece of land. Marijan has a lot of knowledge of both the area and the property itself. The cottage is a repurposed old shearing shed which is great. The amenities are simple and the overall aesthetic of the inside is a bit rustic, however, you can see this clearly in the photos and at this price point you can’t be beaten. The oven takes quite some time to preheat but it is fully functional. The animals are very cute too. You will love this place.
Outstanding property and location! Nothing to fault at all! Come and enjoy...you will not be disappointed...Jenn
Highly recommend! Waking up amongst the alpacas and sheep in that setting was amazing!

Very special thanks Marijan and Peter for your friendly hospitality, with your welcome, presentation of the spacious cottage, and thoughtfulness of a bonfire & BBQ - a great evening!  And providing us with a beautiful 'farm-stay' and gateway into the magnificent Barossa region for 5 superb days / nights of activities.  We will be back!  Warm regards, Rob & guests

The cottage is the old shearers quarters from the early 1900s. I love old architecture! The quarters were wonderfully cosy like staying at Nanna's. Everything was clean, tidy, comfortable... warm! We loved having the fire going as it was the last traces of Winter. The sounds of the sheep during the night was magical. We hope to come back and explore some more another time.

This place is marvellous but if you have been reading the reviews you already know this.  Please note there is no Wifi and the signal comes and goes.  But we managed very well.  Please note that at the gate that you have to open and drive through, there is a cattle grid.  For those a little unsteady on their feet you have to be very cautious.  When we were there (October 2020) many of the wineries were closed, some only opened on weekends and some that were open charge a fee for tasting, supposedly because of extra precautions that have to be taken due to Covid (at least that was what one winery told us).  Not certain this is the real reason.  I get the feeling that, unlike McLaren Vale that doesn't usually charge for tastings, this is the go in the Barossa.  So plan well.  Overall it was a wonderful stay enhanced by unexpected little treats.  It is certainly great value for money.
Amazing location, tranquil, peaceful and loved having the sheep and Billy and Sterling nearby!

This cottage is in a lovely countryside setting.  The owners were happy for us to walk anywhere on the property, including through their beautiful garden area.  The cottage itself is comfortable and spacious and there are sheep and alpacas on the property.  Peter and Marian are friendly hosts who are great custodians of the history of this special place.
Very friendly hosts who are full of local knowledge. The cottage is fantastic and definitely in the 1970’s theme which is awesome.

We had an absolutely lovely time at Peter and Marijan's place. The flat is spacious, comfortable and with a superb view from each window. It rained a bit while we were there, but that didn't matter as we were perfectly happy to spend the time inside.
Peter and Marijan met us on arrival, filled us in on the local area and Marijan later took us on a tour of the garden. The property has an abundance of land on which to walk and just hang out amongst the trees, and the towns of Williamstown, Lyndoch and Tanunda are just a short and beautiful drive away.
If they'll have us, we'll be back at Peter and Marijan's in the not too distant future.
Highly recommended.
Martinsell Cottage is lovely and the hospitality is great. Perfect location to explore Barossa Valley.

We absolutely loved our weekend away. We explored the garden took multiple photos of the beautiful buildings. Explored nearby the old school house on the edge of the forest and the heysen trail. If you love places steeped in history you’ll love this place. Thank you to Marijan and Peter for your ease in booking, the clean space and the sharing of the proud history. You’ve done a marvellous job with it all.

The Martinsell property was beautiful - the big old gums, free ranging animals, beautiful manor and gardens.
The cottage itself was comfortable, clean and had lots of extra touches that make it very homey. We enjoyed reading about the history of the place, and the kids loved the bridge to the entrance!
Thanks for having us 🙂

Breathtaking spot. The cottage is so charming and felt so comfy. The gardens were beautiful and it was incredibly peaceful being here. Our hosts were so kind and lovely and extremely knowledgeable about the history of this beautiful site. 5 Stars!!

Peter and Marijan’s cottage is located in a beautiful property where you can choose to be based to visit close by wineries, or just stay for as long as you want and unwind by reading a book, observing their sheep and alpacas or walking around. Totally recommended, and both of them will be up for a chat and give both local tips and extensive background on the region if you ask them :)

A lovely place to stay, with all the comforts of home. Beautifully quiet setting with friendly sheep and alpacas. Very convenient to Barossa wineries and cafes, but a world away from them. Highly recommended.

The cottage was absolutely lovely and perfect for our family of 8 (including 2 young kids). We spent a fantastic few days touring the Barossa Valley wine region and the cottage was in a great location. Marijan met us upon arrival on the first day and gave us a great overview of the area and some very helpful tips. Throughout the stay, she was very accessible for any questions we had and the check out process was similarly seamless. We had a great experience and we would highly recommend staying in the place and look forward to revisiting in the future!

We recently enjoyed a two night stay at Martinsell Cottage. Peter's welcome was warm and genuine and Marijan responded promptly to the few inquiries we had during our stay. Martinsell Cottage is a charming stone building that sits beautifully in its rustic environment.  And as you look further into the distance, the scenery really is lovely.  The sheep and alpacas add to the idyllic rural picture. The cottage is comfortable and the air-conditioner in the living area assured we were toasty warm in the unseasonably chilly summer weather.  We set up nibbles on the front porch (it's small space but a bit of a sun trap and quite sheltered from the wind - worth the effort) and spent a couple of restful hours enjoying wonderful local produce and wines, chatting and watching the animals quietly move about.  We principally used the cottage as a base to explore the local area.  Tanunda is a pretty half hour drive away.  So many place to see.  I can thoroughly recommend Gomersal Wines on Lyndoch Road (a lucky stop despite the premises normally being closed on Tuesdays - the host, Gaby is a delight) and Fino Seppeltsfield.  All in all a lovely stay.
Comfortable self contained cottage away from the big house with a lovely vista.  Peter and Marijan are very welcoming and friendly and happy for guests to wander in their lovely gardens.
Inviting and private. Homey and a great escape. Worked well for us as a young family. Accommodating owners.
Such a lovely old, historic place to relax and unwind. Marijane and Peter helped with local knowledge and showed us around the beautiful property.

Peter and Marijan's place was definitely our pick of the bunch when staying in the Barossa region - with good reason! They had a beautiful historic cottage in a very convenient location to wineries and restaurants. There were lots of little touches that made it feel extra homely. The property itself was also lovely, a massive amount of land with alpaca and sheep that we loved. Our group of 4 agreed that we could've easily spent more time there. Marijan was very hospitable, lovely to talk to, and had so much excellent local knowledge. We would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a quieter area to stay in whilst visiting the Barossa, without compromising on location.
Clean and basic. Perfect if you’re looking for isolation.
entirely as described. lovely place
Quiet, clean and comfortable place to stay.
All thumbs up, a really nice place to stay, pubs and cafes are just 10-20min away and we had a great time all in all. 🙂
Charming place!
Worth a stop if you want some nice peace and quiet! Loved having the animals around. Not far out of the Barossa valley.

Fully recommend this cottage to base yourselves to explore Mount Crawford and the surrounding wine regions.
Great hosts and a tranquil environment.
My friend and I had a wonderful experience starting at the cottage. The property is beautiful and Marijan and Peter were exceptional hosts.
A wonderful stay, secluded but close to great wine regions.
Lovely cottage and lovely welcoming hosts in a beautiful part of the country and working farm.  Recommend staying here for a peaceful and picturesque weekend away.
A lovely cosy cottage, located in a beautiful countryside. We enjoyed the gardens and the log burning fire.
Amazing location and incredible hosts. I can't wait to stay here again!

We were lucky enough to stay when there were lots of lambs around so that was wonderful. It's a quiet place where you can easily head out into the bush for a walk. The fireplace was heavenly and the electric blanket kept us warm at night. A perfect place to recharge for a couple of days.
We really enjoyed our stay in this beautiful place, so close to everything yet it feels like a million miles from anywhere. A highlight was the old schoolhouse.

A great stay. Very peaceful. Great to watch the animals from the cottage windows. Loved the log fire in lounge. Marijan greeted us warmly and told some information about the property.
Will be back :)
Amazing place to stay! We loved it for a weekend away.
Comfy beds, nice fire and close to walking tracks. We had a great stay!
Lovely rustic cottage

Lovely house, hidden in the Barossa which is exactly what we wanted. The fire in the lounge was just lovely and perfect for roasting marshmallows on a cold night. The two queen sized beds were comfortable with a range of pillow choices. The back room with the two bunk beds was comfy and a good size. It was nice that there were two bathrooms too.

Beautiful, private, quiet, cosy, clean and centrally located in the middle of the Barossa. Everything is close by and it was absolutely amazing and relaxing.
Peter and Marijan are knowledgeable, kind and humble hosts and extremely helpful.
I highly recommend the cottage to anyone looking for a getaway.
Fantastic place to stay. Peter and Marijan have a little slice of paradise with a lovely little cottage to match!
Highly recommend for a peaceful retreat with amazing views and landscape.
Beautiful grounds and location
a beautiful cottage with everything we needed. friendly welcome by marijan - showing us their little friendly sheep. overall a lovely warming stay. ☺
Nothing short of spectacular. Will be back again.
Beautiful restored cottage on stunning grounds. A great choice for a family staying in the area. Peter and Marijan were very active communicators and were flexible and accommodating.

This was our second stay and has got to be one of the most reasonably priced BnBs that we have ever stayed at.  It's got everything you need and more.   If you get a chance, visit Luhrs Cottage at Light Pass (Ph: 0417 859 205) for a self-guided tour. Gold coin donation.  It was one of the highlights of our stay.
Beautiful property with nice scenery

Lovely cottage with all the amenities you need.
Peter and Marian were very friendly and helpful.
In a great part of the country for exploring wineries and restaurants.
Also peaceful with the animals around.

Beautiful property
Well maintained house
Worth staying again
Check your phone coverage as no Wifi
perfect location for all the barrossa attractions
Such a relaxing and peaceful stay! Wood fire was perfect for the cooler weather. Lots of nice walks aswell.

Peter and Marijan's place is a wonderfully situated cottage high above Williamstown in the Barossa valley hills.  We spent a glorious week going for long walks in the local area and exploring the Barossa region.  The whole property is around 77 acres and you will be surrounded by peace and tranquility, just the sounds of nature!  The cottage itself is very spacious with everything you could possibly need for a short or long stay.  The slow combustion stove is fantastic on a cool evening and the bath is wonderful for a long soak after walking in the hills.  Peter and Marijan are terrific  hosts and communication with them was smooth and efficient.  We would thoroughly recommend Peter and Marijan's listing to anyone seeking a unique experience on a large property with easy access to the Barossa area.
Fantastic property and great hosts!

A fantastic cottage located in pure nature!
We enjoyed the stay a lot and it fit our needs and expectations perfectly.
Thanks for the great time!

Lovely cottage for our family catch up. Had everything we needed.  We enjoyed the R & R and the kids loved the sheep wandering around. Note for an extended stay that grocery shopping is 20 minutes away. We had a lovely meal at the Williamstown Hotel for a change from the BBQ.  The cottage is not luxe but we didn’t need that & enjoyed our stay very much.
Great hosts.  Marijan took time to explain the history behind the property.  It is great for families looking for some peaceful time.  Williamstown is just 7 km away with a great bakery.
The Martinsell Cottage is a large rambling accomodation perfect for families and good value for its cost. The property is private with sheep and alpacas on your doorstep.
Lovely rural property. Struggled with reception on the phone so maybe message the hosts 5 minutes before you arrive on the road leading up.
The place was lovely, a beautiful stay around animals and nature. Everything we needed was there!
Martin sell cottage was a great spot to base ourselves to explore the nearby Barossa Valley and other towns nearby. A peaceful quiet property with an interesting history.
The place to go to for peace and quiet. Or to base yourselves from where to explore the Barossa. You will look forward to returning to the natural beauty after the shopping and wine-tasting.

A great little costume, country escape. Wonderful and friendly hosts are very welcoming, and the views of the sheep, alpacas and old gum trees is a very Australian way to wake up each day. A 30 min drive to most of the beautiful wineries on offer in the region, and lots of other lovely attractions nearby too.

A lovely place tucked away in the Crawford forest! It was a great plac to relax and access the Mawson trail! Close to loads of towns! lovely guests with lots of knowledge on the history of the place! would recommend!!

a nice secluded location. we stayed the before and after our wedding, and hosts were so flexible in letting a photograph and family members who weren't guests come into the property. there is very limited phone signal out there though. and the building got very cold at night, but the electric blankets and wood fire were more than sufficient (and very cosy!)

This is a beautiful and remote property with a very interesting history: perfect for disconnecting from city life. The cottage is spacious, cozy and well-equipped. The beds are very comfortable. Heaters and fans are provided along with ample bedding. The kitchen has a variety of utensils. There are many sheep and 2 alpaca - very gentle and peaceful. Our hosts were very communicative and responsive. Marijan orientated us well on arrival. Things to be prepared for are 1. No wifi and possibly no 4g (my Vodafone didn't work at all and my husband's Optus 4g worked a bit). 2. The property is a fair bit away from Tanunda /Lyndoch. 3. The cottage is separated from the manor and one should not presume that one can stroll about around the manor.
A lovely quiet location to kick back and enjoy nature. The cottage was exactly as described. Marijan gave us tips and information about the area and was very welcoming.

Idyllic location if you are looking for peace and quiet but there is also plenty to do within a short drive. The accommodation is spacious, very comfortable and has everything needed for a relaxing stay. Hosts, Mirijan & Peter, were close by if needed, but gave us our privacy. Will certainly recommend to others.
We had a lovely time at Martinsell cottage, fantastic location in beautiful surrounds
Great location, beautiful property, perfect little weekend getaway!
We loved our stay 🙂

A lovely weekend away with friends. Cottage was spacious. Very basic and somewhat dated finishings but comfy beds and cosy fire which were great.
We enjoyed the tour of the property and our kids loved feeding the animals.

We had the most lovely country getaway staying at Martinsell Cottage. The surroundings are just magical- rolling hills, pine forest, trees losing the last of their autumn leaves. The children were thrilled to get the opportunity to feed the sheep and alpacas when we arrived, and enjoyed going to say hello to them each morning. We also enjoyed a short walk over the back fence and through the field to the ruins of an old cottage and the old schoolhouse.
The cottage itself was perfect for our needs, and although somewhat dated it seems to be well maintained and was impeccably clean. The kitchen was well supplied with cooking equipment and with 2 bathrooms the cottage would be suitable for two families staying together. The fireplace is a novelty for us and we enjoyed its cosiness. There was also an outdoor fire pit we could have used had we decided to.
We only stayed 2 nights but wish we could have stayed longer!
Lovely cottage set on a large property, very chilly in the winter nights. The heating/ fire in the living area was lovely. Definitely would recommend!
A comfortable stay in a genuine, spacious farmhouse steeped in history. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
we had an amazing time meeting the farm animals and hosts. It's such a beautiful property and so quiet, couldn't recommend enough 👌
Lovely place to stay and have a look around the Barossa.

We had a lovely weekend away, it truly was home away from home.
Every time we needed something, Marijan was ALWAYS willing to help and made sure our stay was perfect.
We cannot thank these hosts enough 😊
Lovely homely farm stay- relaxing and beautiful location and hosts.

Martinsell Cottage is a wonderful and peaceful farm stay if you like some solitude feeding Alpacas and love wonderful 600 year old eucalypts which surround the property. The cottage is cold in winter but once the wood fire is cranked up its nice and toasty. The hosts Peter and Marijan both introduced each other and we found them very pleasant and both gave us our privacy and were only too happy to provide assistance if required. There is no Wifi so if required you are reliant on your service provider and as it is in the country there was 1 to 2 bars with Telstra.
The cottage is spacious and has a mixture of updated and old facilities.
Definitely worth a stay if you like some solitude and a great location to explore the Barossa and Adelaide hills - Closest decent supermarket is Gawler approx 30min drive so need to stock up with Groceries at Gawler on the way through from Adelaide.
Fantastic communication with Peter and Marijan- the property is exquisite and great value for money! If you’re a nature and history lover, you will love this! Lovely experience
Very nice cottage - homely, very peaceful and a perfect location to enjoy the wine regions and relax
Great cottage, great location, had a storm roll in one afternoon and had the fire going and it was magic,  cheers
Very comfortable stay in a beautiful part of the SA wine region.
Great spot with perfect country feel!
Great accommodation, clean, with great facilities. Lovely property and nice drive to tanunda area. Great communication with warm friendly hosts. Enjoy

We had a wonderful relaxing stay, close enough to towns to get the basics, but far enough away to let the clutter ofa busy life disappear,  the history and walking trails worth a return visit,thank you for having us.

Nice and relaxing place we enjoyed our holiday
Thanks Marijan and peter
Suga and nadeera
Peter and Marijan were great hosts Lovely cottage, we would recommend this place to others visiting the Barossa Valley.

Peter and Marijan greeted us on arrival. Check in was easy. Communication throughout the stay was responsive. The area is beautiful and peaceful. Loads of information supplied for the area in a booklet including handwritten notes about venues throughout the Barossa and their features.

Peter and Marijan’s place is on a beautiful property surrounded by sheep and the two alpacas who are super friendly. It’s about a 30min drive to where many of the wineries. We had a great time, thank you Peter & Marijan!

Amazing place to stay, its very quiet and away from city ,  peter and marijian were too good , they were so helpful , and finally i have to write about billy and sterlin , they were so lovely, if you want to spend lovely time with ur loved ones , this is the right place

We really adored waking up at the Cottage surrounded by the animals and the fantastic trees !
The Cottage is spacious and super well equipped
Special thanks to Marijan and Peter for their great welcome and advice.
Beautiful property to stay on in the Barossa and very welcoming hosts. Great location a short drive from Williamstown and other towns and places of interest. Really enjoyed our stay.

This was a very good experience living in Martinsell. The heritage building was well renovated by Marian and Peter with well equipped utility that suits family use. They gave us a home-like experience and they were so friendly to offer historical information about the mansion and nearby attractions.
The experience of living surrounding by sheep and alpaca was cool and raw. My family especially my little son loved feeding and interacting with the animals and giant ancient trees. The place was close to Barossa wineries while tranquility and country-style were preserved. It was an extraordinary experience living here and I shall come back again.

Lovely, spacious, quiet place. Two bathrooms were very handy for three adults and comfortable furniture too. A little bit of dirt road but it’s very well maintained and we had no problems with our low car. We used it as a base for exploring the Barossa Valley for a few days and it worked well. The nearest town is less than five minutes away and has 2 pubs and a general store that’s open till 8. While we didn’t really interact with the animals they did provide a nice bucolic outlook every day. 🙂
A comfortable stay at a well placed venue. Neat and tidy

Such a beautiful location and wonderful stay. Really felt like a holiday relaxing on this most special property, surrounded by ancient gums, sheep and alpacas. Simple, not overstated lodgings but still very comfortable with a very effective combustion fire. Highly recommended, will recommend to friends.
Beautiful hosts, beautiful setting, what more could you want? Would highly recommend this place to everyone. Just a magical experience.

Loved our stay at this working sheep farm high up in Pewsey Vale. Beautiful surroundings and we were warmly welcomed by Marijan and Peter. You will be a good drive from shops so remember to bring any food you may need. Kitchen facilities are good and each night we had the fire going. There is heating if needed. Beds were very comfortable and rooms spacious. There are two bathrooms and plenty of hot water. An information book is provided with all the best places to visit in the area and there is lots to see. Barossa and Clare Valleys are near buy with some great wineries to visit. You will enjoy a stay here, we did. Thank you Marijan and Peter.
a spectacular beautiful place.i felt like I was in a medieval European estate
Such an amazing place to unwind. Highly recommend

Martinsell Cottage is perfect! My husband and I wish we could’ve stayed longer than the week we had there. The cottage is beautiful. It was warm (apart from the bathrooms), very comfortable, well-appointed and had everything we needed. We loved finding basic provisions upon arrival such as bread, milk, cereal, butter and marmalade, as well as tea, coffee, sugar, olive oil, herbs and spices. Listening to the ewes and lambs “talking” to each other was very special. Loved sitting at the breakfast table, watching them in the mornings. Marijan greeted us on arrival and introduced us to the two alpacas. We agree with the all of the positive comments others have made and highly recommend Martinsell Cottage as a base to visit the Barossa as the surrounding towns are only 30 mins away.
Spacious rooms. Big TV. Wonderful wood fire.

Our stay at Martinsell’s cottage was everything we wished for. We enjoyed the beautiful and peaceful surroundings and the nearby walks were a bonus. The warm fireplace added to the cozy ambiance, and the home was equipped with everything we needed. Marijan was simply excellent. From the moment we arrived, she made us feel welcome and even provided us with some essentials upon our arrival.
The town of Williamstown had some great pubs and a bakery that we thoroughly enjoyed. It was the perfect base for exploring the Barossa Valley, and we found it to be great value for the money.
Overall, our stay was fantastic, and we were reluctant to leave. I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone seeking a peaceful getaway with all the comforts of home.

Marijan and Peter are outstanding hosts and we had a wonderful few days staying at Martinsell Cottage.
The accommodation is spacious yet cozy with a wood burner and ducted A/C to get us through the winter nights plus an outdoor firepit where we toasted marshmallows.
Marijan was very friendly when we arrived and suggested lots of family-friendly activities. She also introduced us to the lambs and alpacas which the kids loved!
Exploring the Barossa area from the cottage was easy as there is so much to see. We only skimmed the surface during our time there and will definitely be back!

Amazing grounds like a fairy tale. Peter was a great host and recommend some great places to go. He let me daughter feed the sheep which she really loved. Can’t wait to come back in Summer and spend more time outside. Thanks
Really enjoyed our family stay at the cottage. Kids loved the animals, farm and forest. Peter and Marijan were extremely helpful and friendly.

Guys, thanks for the fantastic stay and hospitality.
A stunning property, nice and remote. Somewhere you can definitely unplug from the grind.
Will see you again some time.
Lovely, calm place. The air around is healing. We had a wonderful time in this house. Thank you to Peter and Marijan!

De rust op het terrein komt je tegemoet. Wakker worden met het geblaat van de schapen is heel relaxed.  In de omgeving heerlijk gewandeld en genoten van de mooie natuur. Leuke dorpen in de directe omgeving. Tanunda was onze favoriet met Artisans winery als hoogtepunt.

The phrase, “Exceeds expectations” applies to our stay in Pewsey Vale. Everything was perfect in a unassuming way and I felt like I was at home. I would definitely stay here again. Thank you for the privilege of experiencing this amazing property.
A beautifully renovated piece of history, and lovely and friendly hosts. Thank you so much for a great stay.

A wonderful peaceful place to rest and connect with nature. Loved being so quiet and away from the city. Loved the sheep, alpacas and bird life. It is a beautiful place to stay. It is remote and tranquil area and enjoy seeing sheep. The only thing is the plumbing system making noise during the night. We cannot sleep very well especially in the further room. But in general, we are happy for our stay.

We feel privileged to be a part of South Australia’s history after staying at Martinsell Cottage. Thank you to Marijan and Peter for recommending some great spots to visit in the surrounding area and allowing us to park our car and camper trailer in the safe parking area. Thanks again.

A truly wonderful place to stay!  We really enjoyed our time at the cottage and exploring the surrounds of the Barossa. Felt instantly relaxed. Highlights were the listening to the sheep, walking the Heysen Trail and mountain bike riding. Many thanks to Peter and Marijan for sharing their unique property with us.

A perfect spot for feeling relaxed while soaking up the ambiance that Barossa Valley offers. A great location for exploring the region from this quaint 1901 clean and comfortable cottage. A step into history with all the up to date amenities. Thanks Peter and Marijan for your hospitality and sharing the property history and local information/tips with us.

Lovely place, great history. The owner Peter is very friendly and takes time to have a decent chat. He makes you feel like a relation. He is a people person. Great to hang out and relax on the farm and do a lot of nothing if that's what you like it head out and discover the area. Not too far from Adelaide and great amenities with washer and dryer in the room. I'll be back! Like Arnold said
A beautiful getaway from the business of everyday life - this cottage is absolutely lovely and peaceful! Plenty of room for families, it was fabulous.

Peter and Marijan's place is so peaceful and quiet, it's a true escape from the city. very close to local wineries, bakeries and restaurants, it was the perfect base for our long weekend. we had everything we needed at the accommodation and Peter and Marijan kindly provided bread, milk, butter and jam. thanks for a great stay!
Lovely beautiful place
Secluded, rural,picture perfect, great for the friends reunion we had.

Beautiful location, wonderful hosts, clean and tidy.

Beautiful property. Marijan and Peter were wonderful hosts. Thank you for having us.
This was a beautiful cottage. Close to the Barossa and beautiful wineries. Peter and Marijan were so helpful and friendly.

From the moment of our arrival, where we were met personally by Marijan, we felt welcome and at ease.
The cottage was large and spotless with a warming fireplace just waiting to be used.
Overall a fantastic place to relax and enjoy the Barossa Valley.
We will definitely return.
A cosy space with great facilities. The host was friendly. We enjoyed our stay here.
We really enjoyed our stay at Martinsell cottage, the place was clean and spacious on a large beautiful property with a short drive to everything the Barossa has to offer.
Very peaceful lovely property, amazing heritage buildings, spacious, comfortable, lovely Airbnb. Very private… Close to Williamstown, picturesque, and good walks available.
Lovely retreat. Had the place to myself and took my free time looking at local wild life. Would happily stay again for longer. Lovely to wake up to the birds and to have a fire at night.

wonderful hosts, peaceful, comfortable accommodation,  the ramp access was great for my mother. It was a joy having the sheep and alpacas around =)

Lovely unique accomodation on beautiful grounds, we chose the location as a spot in the South of the Barossa that was easy access to everywhere we wanted to go. Under an hour from home in Adelaide and only a short drive to all the spots we wanted to explore.

Thank you Marijan and Peter, we will book again for sure :)

It was a beautiful cottage, with lots of friendly animals and beautiful surroundings. Marijan was very friendly and provided some good recommendations for local site seeing. I highly recommend the place to stay for a few nights

Marijan's place was beautiful, it was a lovely stay for my friend and I. Marijan had great recommendations for places to check out or to eat at, and was very helpful. We enjoyed our stay very much and would definitely stay again!

A breakfast pack was welcome and the beds were really comfy.

My wife and I had a lovely stay at Marijan and Peter's place! We felt so relaxed from the moment we arrive. We cannot wait to come back and stay again soon, it's a perfect spot for a weekend away to wine, dine and relax!
It was an amazing place to stay. Super peaceful and pretty. The place was super clean and easy to use. It was great to wake up to the animals.

We were looking for a location with character and seclusion. A rural feel with a cosy place to stay.

this was my first time visiting south Australia and after our brief stay i am 100% coming back. the barossa Valley is absolutely stunning. the cottage is huge, clean and very private. Fantastic place. We loved seeing the stars at night and it is a really unique place to stay. Kate is a great host. Thanks!

We had the most wonderful stay at Kate's gorgeous tent. Every tiny detail was covered, even things we would have never expected! Kate couldn't have been more helpful or accomodating. We had the most magic time and would 100% love to come back and stay again!

One of the best Air Bnbs I have ever stayed in, complete with the cutest BnB doggo!
Clean, luxurious, private, unique and quiet - what more could you want?
Easily the BEST place I’ve ever stayed !! Absolute bliss - every detail spot on - gorgeous bed, bath, view.

We absolutely loved our stay at Kate’s and Garry’s place! Very peaceful and you have the whole place for yourself. Clean and everything had been provided for. Glamping at it’s best! The food left for us in the fridge was delicious and more than enough for breakfast. We even snacked on it in the evening. Location is great; you’re basically in the centre of Barossa. Overall, perfect for us. Can highly recommend the luxury tent.

This is an exceptional property! An outstanding location right in the middle of the bush but not very far away from Angaston. Kate and Gary were also on hand if we needed anything extra. I would highly recommend this property-I definitely want to come back!!

The luxury clamping site that Kate has created was a perfect holiday away from home. There were so many little touches that made our stay so enjoyable and relaxing. I highly recommend this place - I didn't want to leave!
Great Luxury tent accomodation with full bath and ensuite with handy outdoor kitchen. Relaxing spot.

We absolutely loved staying at such a unique place in the heart of the Eden Valley! Thanks again Kate for such a delightful stay!

We loved everything about our stay in the luxury tent! The tent itself was amazing - so comfortable, pretty, clean and warm. Perfect remote retreat with all the luxury you could wish for.

A place to recharge and take stock of life.  A lovely peaceful, well kitted out refuge from the busy-ness of todays lifestyle.  Fifteen mins drive to nearby towns to stock up and spend as much time as possible at Boongarrie, enjoying the hospitality and the fabulous countryside and night sky of the surrounds.

We loved staying here over New Years! Even though it was hot, we found things to do and the aircon was very handy! Kate gave us great restaurant recommendations which we made the most of. Would highly recommend to anyone wanting a quiet escape.

Though we have traveled extensively for over 30 years this was our first Airbnb. Since my wife and I are traveling with our 21 year old son and his friend we felt that a house would be our best option. Overall it was an excellent stay.
The location is a short walk into Lyndoch the first of several "wine towns" as one enters the Barossa Valley from Adelaide. There one finds a bakery and several restaurants (we had good coffee and breakfast at The Table Cafe), a small grocery store (for serious grocery shopping much better off in Tanunda) and a gourmet meat market (great house smoked salmon). The first several of the valley wineries are within a kilometer or so.
The four bedrooms are each quite unique and except for the one off the eating area have individual climate controls off the main system and are each decorated quite differently. The house is quite old but that is much of it's charm. There are many nice touches and features throughout such as two robes with each bedroom, a working fireplace (with plenty of wood) in the living room, dozens of movies, plenty of nice dishes and glasses, a propane barbeque (we did steaks one night). The master bath shower and jacuzzi style tub have a great view of the backyard and surrounding vineyards (though can draw the shades if needed). The backyard is pretty with the smell of citrus trees.
There was a supply of Nespresso pods with milk and a frother so good coffee was at hand!
Really nothing to complain about; overall cozy, plenty of room and a large bright kitchen when we needed to cook.
Suzie supplied us with useful tips before we arranged. We had a minor issue and were able to reach Steve the manager and had it resolved in minutes!
Highly recommended!
Beautiful cottage with gorgeous views....such a warm & relaxing space...🤗

Anne’s place had a warm, welcoming relaxing feel for our ladies get away. Pinecone exceeds every expectation. We specifically loved having the fire place, a puzzle and glass of wine to relax too. Her local tips were invaluable!

Lovely house, highly
