Great stay! Property was as described - well furnished and clean. The house is on a large property that is worth exploring, especially around sunset. Keyless entry was very convenient. Toys and boardgames a plenty to keep kids entertained.
Location is great - very central to all of Barrosa - most of what you want to visit is within an easy 10 minute drive.

We were a group of 6 (3 couples) and we booked to celebrate a special birthday.
Anne’s place was perfect in every way.
We spent every afternoon sitting outside watching the gorgeous sunsets & we’re able to use the fire pit out the back and watch the kangaroos watch us!!
Anne left lots of special touches which made our visit feel like we were staying at a friends home for the weekend.
We absolutely loved it & would highly recommend booking Anne’s place.
10/10
Thank you Anne
We had a lovely stay here, so much for the kids to play with and discover and a perfect location for exploring the area. Will definitely stay here again when we can.
Great place to stay - would definitely recommend!

This play is just fantastic - from the outside fireplace to enjoy a glass of wine to the heat pumps in every bedroom to make sure you don't go cold to the fully stocked kitchen to cook up a meal for your friends or family. This place has it all! Anne is great at communicating and has local tips as well. Cannot recommend this place enough!
We had such a lovely week in the Barossa at Pine Cone Ridge. The place is exactly as the photos and is really spacious and relaxing. I highly recommend.
Pinecone ridge was the perfect long weekend escape for my friends and I. Well stocked, clean, and easy access to the Barossa region. Lovely.
We had a great stay here. A lovely house with everything you could need. Highly recommend.
We really enjoyed our stay! Anne was so lovely and helpful and there were so many lovely little extras that made the stay special. Beautiful, clean, well stocked house
What an amazing place! We had a wonderful few days at Pinecone Ridge with our family. Very cosy, beautiful sunsets and many things to do for our family. Highly recommend.

Pinecone Ridge is an absolutely beautiful Airbnb in the Barossa Valley. The views, ambience and lovely extra touches of complementary wine, snacks and a welcome board really made our weekend one to remember. Definitely recommend for any body wanting a relaxing getaway whilst exploring Barossa’s wineries.
The perfect house for our needs! Beautiful home, gorgeous location and well stocked! We had a brilliant stay and all thought it one of the better airbnb experiences we had had.

We had a great stay at Pinecone Ridge. The property was very clean and Anne was a super helpful host, who was attentive and had some great recommendations for the Barossa Valley. We would definitely stay with Anne again if we were to visit.

We had a lovely stay at Pincone Ridge. Perfect size for 2 families staying with kids. We loved the property. The beautiful surrounds were so peaceful and tranquil. The house itself had a lovely decor and was really well set up for families. It was a perfect location to explore the Barossa. And was very easy to communicate with and helpful.

Anne and her family have created a unique place that is a hidden gem, full of charming details and a cozy, private atmosphere. The property offers a wide range of activities, including a map like a treasure-discovery for walks, beautiful sunsets, and various spots for relaxation, as well as communal areas for celebrating with family and friends. Located in the Barossa, there are magnificent wineries and distilleries, all within a 5 to 10-minute drive. The house is truly authentic, clean, and comfortable. Anne prepared a lovely welcome and provided toys and books for the children. We also received a complimentary early check-in and late checkout, which made our stay even more enjoyable—we loved it!

Pinecone lodge was our last stop on a two week trip in SA and what a great place to finish. We stayed for 4 nights with another couple and could have easily stayed 4 more. The house was so comfortable, we enjoyed the slow combustion fire on two nights and the BBQ another night. Plenty of wood and gas and the house is spotless.
Anne is an incredibly responsive host who responded to our text messages almost immediately, even finding a local mechanic to help our friends who had car trouble.
Anne also has a terrific list of local recommendations and very clear but friendly instructions on how to use everything.
I cannot finish without mentioning the beautiful views which was why we booked in the first place.
Thank you Anne and congratulations on the great job you do.

Came with my family to visit our family who live in Gawler and do some wine tours- the house is beautiful, such a private location but very accessible to everywhere we wanted to go. Anne has heaps of games (which we used), lots of DVDS (we watched Roman Holiday) and the beds were so comfortable- different pillows for different heads and a rain shower my son loved! Honestly would love to come back with less organised so we could just lounge and enjoy - thanks Anne

We had a fantastic stay at this gorgeous property. The home was spotlessly clean throughout, styled beautifully and felt so comfortable to be in. Great toys for the kids to play with, plus the property map was fantastic to go for an adventure and find the different places of interest.
Anne was fantastic to communicate with especially the information prior to arrival.
Highly recommend Pine Cone Ridge

Pinecone Ridge was a fabulous stay. Very convenient, beautiful views, great house and property for a family holiday. Kitchen was well equipped and the games available were great. We stayed over Xmas and loved it. Anne was a responsive and thoughtful host. Would definitely stay there again
Pinecone Ridge was an absolutely outstanding stay and would definitely recommend.

Anne’s place is incredible. A beautiful, peaceful spot surrounded by nature. Really close to town and lots of wineries. Great amenities, coffee, teas, board games, bbq anything you could possibly want and a welcome wine. We love this place. Highly recommend!
Great weekend away with the family and kids loved the surrounding bushland. Very comfortable house with plenty of amenities. Thanks Anne for a very nice stay.

We stayed at Pinecone Ridge for a week and loved the Barossa vineyard views and the family property being a part of our daily experience. Anne is a five star host who made us feel extremely welcome with  arrival goodies, pristine bed linen and all the comforts of home. Highly recommend and would stay again. There were lots of excellent vineyards in close driving distance and plentiful eateries between Angaston and Tanunda.
Wonderful place to stay in the Barossa

We had a fantastic stay at Anne’s. The location was so peaceful and the home was beautifully set up with everything you could ever want. The decor was quirky, in a very classy way, ant the facilities inside and out enabled relaxing dining and ‘drinking’ options that made the most of the setting. It was ideal for our 2 couples but would be extremely suitable for a family. Walks into town and easy drives to numerous nearby venues. Thank you, Anne.
This was our 2nd time staying at Anne’s property. It was beautiful stay and we felt at home. Thank you Anne. We will surely visit again.

Anne's place was one of the best AirBnB's we've stayed in. Her place was the perfect country house and felt so warm, cosy and peaceful. The house was pristine clean and had everything we required from basic amenities to toys for the kids. All areas of the house were stocked with everything we needed for our stay. We especially loved the coffee machine with good quality coffee pods and an array of tea options. Our little 2 yr old had the best time playing with all the toys provided and we appreciated the cot and highchair that was available.
We loved the property and enjoyed going for walks in the morning and watching the sunset in the evening.
One very minor issue we had, was there was a child lock on the stove, which we spent some time figuring out how to unlock. However, other than that, we loved our stay in this beautiful Angaston property and will definitely be back next time we visit Adelaide ❤️

We were 2 couples travelling together and this home was perfect! Kitchen very well equipped and stocked and beds super comfy. The fire was even stacked and ready to go on our arrival!
It was a perfect base for exploring Barossa and Clare on bicycles.
This place was a gem - from a fire ready to go through to a biggest assortment of boardgames I’ve ever seen - it was exceptional. I only wish I live close enough to visit more regularly!
Had a wonderful long weekend at Pinecone Ridge. Comfortable house with a lovely aspect. Would definitely recommended this accommodation.

This was a return trip to Pinecone Ridge.
This place is a hidden gem , great location in the beautiful Barossa valley within driving distance to anywhere

What a fantastic place to stay in the Barossa Valley! It's super private with an absolutely stunning view. I've never stayed at a place that is more well appointed than Pinecone Ridge. It's the thoughtful little touches like plenty of cutlery, crockery, wine glasses, plenty of cheeseboards, as well as a bunch of umbrellas for the unpredictable winter weather! Heaps of blankets as well! The welcome gift was lovely, as was the bucket full of pinecones and full box of firewood for us to use! The house manual was also extremely comprehensive.
Anne was a dream to liaise with, and she could not have been more helpful. A week or so prior to our stay, she reached out to let me know that we could check in early and check out late, which was unexpected but appreciated! I could not recommend this place more! It's about a 4 minute drive to the main strip in Angaston where there's cute coffee shops, bars and shops. Can't wait to do another Barossa trip and stay again!! :)
Beautiful house, very clean and in a great location. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

We had such a wonderful stay, such a fantastic location, beautiful and quiet. It is about a 5 minute drive to Angaston centre. Anne has thought of absolutely everything, including kitchen and toiletry supplies and loads of games and dvds. It was a lovely touch to arrive to a bottle of wine and some sweets. It was the perfect house for our girls Barossa trip!
Everything went very well, the fire on the cold days was very enjoyable. I will come back next year if I can!

What a special spot! Beautiful location and the house felt like a lovely home. Great selection of books and games and we all felt very comfortable and relaxed. The kids kept wanting to go back to the accomodation when we were out and about :) Thanks!

The Hutch Hilton was the perfect getaway for our family vacation in the Barossa.  John and Jan went out of their way in welcoming us and showing us around the farm.  The rooms are neat and clean each with an ensuite bathroom and shower.  The common living area is well equipped with the kitchen necessities to prepare your own meals and enjoy each others company al fresco.  The vintage cellar door is rustic and charming filled with local farm prepared jams, jellies, and chutneys, not to mention their incredible wines.  Guests are able to buy local farm products to enjoy like their incredible lamb that we enjoyed.  Our hosts went to the trouble of supplying us with wonderful farm fresh eggs, local bacon, bread and milk, which was a wonderful treat. This historic setting is a true gem and anyone visiting is fortunate enough that the Angas family shares it with the public.  We can't say enough about this wonderful property and delightful hosts.

A wonderful setting - beautiful views, wonderful trees, fresh air and unique decor. Jan and John's hospitality was outstanding - could not have asked for more. Each of the four couples had an amazing long weekend - we were sad to leave.

Honestly, we didn't know what to expect when we booked - but the location was suitable for three couples who wanted to explore the Barossa. But our serendipitous booking turned out to be so much more than that.
John and Jan were delightful hosts - warm, welcoming, highly knowledgeable and always looking to help you with advice. The working farm has been in their family for many generations, and John gave us a tour of the property (stunning by the way) before a wine tasting of what they make on-site (some of the best we tried all weekend!). We were even fortunate enough to partake in a grape pressing for the next seasons wine bottling!
The living space/kitchen is an outdoor/open plan arrangement, but really added something special to our stay. And the occasional visit of the two farm dogs was always very welcome!
Without a doubt, we will be returning here in the years to come.
Thanks for an amazing weekend Jan and John!

Hutton Vale is a wonderful Barossa experience. The farm is beautiful with views over vineyards and paddocks filled with grazing sheep. The farm is just like a setting out of Country Style ! Grape vines trailing over rough stone walls,rusty sculptures surprising visitors everywhere you look. The accommodation is very comfortable with lovely bed linen, heating, electric blankets, fresh flowers and clean adequate ensuite bathrooms. Every evening we enjoyed a roaring wood fire while relaxing in our "Glamping" kitchen/lounge shed. The sun streamed in every morning to make this area a cheery place for the breakfast gathering.
Our hosts were so hospitable and welcoming and there were many thoughtful touches around the place to make us feel special and well looked after. Our evening lamb roast came from Hutton Vale and we also enjoyed a magnificent wine tasting afternoon on the property.
If you have a group of friends that all get along and love red wine ,log fires and relaxed country living I can highly recommend Hutton Vale for a stay.
What an amazing place to stay. Host was so accommodating. Place was perfect for our little family. Thankyou

Great place for a weekend get away with friends.  Each couple had their own ensuite which was fantastic.  Even though the outdoor kitchen is not well sealed from the elements and we were there on a  very cold weekend the fire kept us warm. The lamb we purchased and cooked ourselves was amazing.

Jan's place is a home away from home!
That comfy feeling you get when you sit by an open fire, or gather around a table to share a meal are waiting for you at this fabulous place.
Beautiful views, majestic gums, a place to relax unwind, a place to share with friends or family.
Jan and John are excellent hosts, we felt special, nothing was too much trouble!
Hutton Vale Farm is a great place to connect with your surroundings, experience our beautiful country side and be part of something truly special.

our family went away for two days just to get away for the school holidays. We were blown away by the views and the wonderful hosts. our children had a great time even though there was no TV. Thank you so much to Jan and family for being great hosts. Also their wines are amazing a must try when in the Barossa Valley.

Guests are free to roam a country property, both old-style and diverse in nature. We really felt relaxed, and free to come and go as we pleased. Lazing in the rustic lounge space with the log fire and games with the kids, no devices, local produce and a bottle of Barossa wine was a wonderful taste of a life once lived. Thanks Jan and John
What a lovely spot to relax with friends or family . Highly recommend.

We were 2 families staying at Hutton Vale with 5 children.  The children had a great time running around on the farm.  It’s a beautiful property close to everything the Barossa has to offer.  We enjoyed sitting by the fire at nighttime.

The Hilton Hutch is unique & fun Hutton Vale Farm is beautiful  - watch the sheep, chickens , ducks from the hutch - the farm life comings & goings & enjoy the beautiful serenity of this amazing property.

A beautiful peaceful country stay - the hutch is so much fun - well appointed with everything needed for a lovely break from city life.
The bedrooms are light , bright & comfortable & to have an en-suite each is fantastic !!
Love the Hilton Hutch - & the Angas Family are amazing hosts.

jan and her family made us feel very much at home, a chilled approach to life around the farm. rustic living with an epic view. very comfy beds, open fire and big family dining table. our group of 8 fitted in perfectly.  would highly recomend for any group of friends or family. great place and lovely hosts.

Hutton Vale Farm was one of the most beautiful and unique experiences our group has had. The property is stunning, the rustic set up is cosy and well-equipped, and Jan and John made us feel like part of the family. Of course there is also some delicious wines to drink and lamb to eat, and a few dogs to keep us company while star-gazing, which all added to the experience. We all adored our stay and can’t wait to come back.
Beautiful location to get away from it all and stare at the stars. A true Barossa experience.  Loved it.

We had a really amazing stay with Jan and Jon. We loved the rustic kitchen and the comfy beds and the hospitality was above and beyond... The location was perfect for the many wineries! Thanks so much and hope to see you again!
Great stay!

What a special place! Our group of three couples had a fantastic time and loved the friendliness and warmth of Jan and her family. The farm was beautiful and so lovely with  a fire at night to sit by and a full kitchen to be self sufficient. Location was also excellent with a short drive into town and easy location to the wineries of the Barossa. Would absolutely stay again!

John and Jan were inspiring hosts! Their insights and knowledge of the Barossa were so interesting. We ate fresh free range eggs and lamb from the farm and walked around the beautiful property to enjoy the scenery. The location was superb and we were close to all the top wineries. We will 100% recommend Hutton Vale Farm to our friends and family.
Great place! Really fun and well set up. Incredible views to wake up to.
Highly recommend Hutch Hilton for a group. Top blend of shared and private spaces with the added bonus of a bathroom for each room. The fireplace is amazing!

An amazing place to stay - my family came here to celebrate a special birthday and it was the perfect place. Warm fireplaces, beautiful farm views, delicious lamb roast with vegetables and fresh produce from the Barossa farmers markets, friendly farm dogs, comfortable rooms and hot showers. Jan and John were perfect hosts. We will love to return again soon ;)
Fantastic experience at this magnificent property.
Great place, comfy beds, beautiful view, friendly dogs, amazing lamb/chicken, warm cozy fire - would definitely come back

What a wonderful place in the heart of the beautiful Barossa Valley. Jan and John made us feel extremely welcome and their knowledge and passion for their  farm and community are evident. Be sure to have a wine tasting with John - an experience in itself. The venue is rustic, but exactly as described, and a wonderful place for a relaxed getaway. Can’t wait for our next visit.

Just fantastic people. Really enjoyed our 2 days at this place. Jan, John & Stuart really made us feel at home and were generous to a fault. Will come back and certainly highly recommend this place to anyone. 5 stars all around.

Jan & John’s farmstay will not disappoint - rustic elegance at its absolute finest. The whole experience was exactly what we were looking for in an escape from the big city. Waking up to sheep grazing in the field outside the bedroom door and seeing kangaroos at sunset was very special. The family dogs Alfie & Mac also made us feel like part of the family. Extremely warm, friendly dogs who were always nearby and ready for a pat or play (huge bonus for dog lovers like us!). The main kitchen/dining/living area is fit with everything you could need and is perfect for dinner parties by the fire. Making time to visit the Hutton Vale cellar (located right near the accomodation) for wine tasting is a must - beautiful wines which we enjoyed during our stay. Jan & John went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. We are already planning our return.
Awesome hospitality, great place and location, highly recommended!
A special place providing so much relaxation
Great farm stay, sheep up to your front door, beautiful outlook across the paddocks, very unique experience. Well worth a visit
Lovely hosts in a beautiful spot with great wine, gorgeous pets and plenty of fun experiences. Would go again in a heartbeat

This was the most amazing and unique experience we had in the Barossa/Eden Valley. Must do's are to do a wine tasting and tour and to buy some home grown lamb for dinner.
The wine tasting and tour is intensely intimate and you get a real taste of the history and the realities of farming and growing wine grapes. As the family tells you their story you can't help but feel completely immersed in it.
It will be a challenge to find another place that delivers the same level of hospitality and warmth that we experienced.

This place provides a very unique and relaxing atmosphere!
The hosts are very responding and careful to details and communication.
And I wish I was still there by the fire!

We had the most wonderful stay. Jan and John were so warm and welcoming. We absolutely loved the indoor fire place, electric blankets, beautiful view and the delicious lamb for dinner. They also provided us with the most incredible complimentary wine tasting experience! This was a once in a life time experience that we will always remember. They also allowed us to check out later which gave us a few extra hours to enjoy this beautiful space. All the the special touches made our experience so enjoyable and we cannot wait to return. Thank you so much!

We had such a great time at Hutton Vale farm! The accommodation is so quaint and rustic. The out buildings are lovely to wander around with a wine in hand. Be sure to order a lamb roast to cook and do the wine tasting with John. He is such a great host and the tasting room was the most gorgeous old room with so much history. We all loved it!
Awesome place to stay
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Hutton Vale Farm. We travelled as a group of friends and it was a relaxing stay. Jan and John were wonderful hosts. We especially enjoyed our wine tasting.
We loved our stay at the Hutch Hilton. Such lovely people. The place is full of character and the farm is absolutely stunning. Would highly recommend.
Great Stay! Fantastic hospitality and beautiful location.

We spent 3 nights at Hutton Vale Farm with my husband and 2 kids. Caitlin was an amazing host. She made us feel so welcome and so at home!
The accomodation is very unique and perfect for a family stay. We enjoyed marshmallows on the fire and wine in the evening. Angaston is beautiful and thanks to Cait’s and Stuart’s tips we ticked off everything that was worth visiting and trying. We had an amazing wine tasting at Hutton Vale Farm with John that we absolutely loved.
We would highly recommend Hutton Vale Farm to anyone who is looking for a relaxing, warm and special stay in the Barossa. We will be back !
Ania and Co.

We had a wonderful stay at Hutton Vale. The hosts are fantastic and made you feel unbelievably welcome. The kids loved the farm and chanbe to be free in nature. The lamb and the wine are a must. Overall a great trip that we would like to repeat.
Beautiful space for a relaxing visit to the Barossa Valley!

Beautiful outdoor style home cosy for 6 people, has a wonderful time hearing the animals in the morning too.
Will definitely come back here :)

Absolutely amazing stay!
We had been longing for a farm stay and doubled with a winery we were in heaven!
Only down side is we didn’t stay long enough.
Hospitality was great and we felt part of the family.
We will be back for sure !!!

Unique accomodation in the most beautiful setting . My family LOVED this place . Comfy beds,  electric blankets, hot showers and views to die for. Cracking open fire too which we appreciated  in middle of Barossa winter . We would absolutely come back and recommend this place to anybody wanting a memorable  experience on a working farm close to all  the best food and wine in the Barossa.

We thoroughly enjoyed our family stay at Hutton Vale Farm. It was a relaxed getaway and the accomodation was quaint and rustic. There was a beautiful outlook across the paddocks with a warm indoor log fire.  Jan and John were warm and welcoming hosts who were accomodating with our early arrival and late departure. Thank you!
The best Airbnb we’ve ever stayed at! Lovely owners and a beautiful location. The place it rustic, comfortable and beautiful. Hope to be back again soon!

Our family and friends loved our stay at the Hutch Hilton. Great base to explore the Barossa and we loved being on a working farm.  Enjoyed our wine tasting , the lamb slow roast with all the accompaniments from the Angaston farmers market and  the tips on where to eat locally. Our girls loved exploring the farm and playing with our hosts.  Fabulous , relaxed stay.  Thank you !
Lovely place to stay if you are planning to spend some time in the Barossa in a bigger group. We all had a fabulous weekend!

Great rustic farm stay and a nice escape from the city life. Awesome that there’s no wifi or tv and kids have to go back to basics and run around outside, watch the sunset and beautiful landscape and just connect back with nature.

Hands down, the best Airbnb we ever seen!
Amazing experience for our Easter! Lovely people,mind-blowing landscape and cozy house!
Thanks for everything!
We will definitely come back.

The Hutch Hilton was such an unique enjoyable stay. The hosts were very gracious and really made their whole farm accessible during our stay. We thoroughly enjoyed roaming around to visit various cute farm animals, collecting fresh produce from the garden to go with our preordered Hutton Vale lamb racks/roast, looking at the art/sculptures and star gazing at night. Feels like you're far from civilization and technology (no wifi), so you can relax and enjoy nature, but the house is actually only 5minutes from the town centre and other wineries.
Caitlin took us through an amazing private wine tasting to discover the family history and direction of Hutton Vale Farm and drink generous pours of their delicious wines. Make sure you order some wine and their chutney.
The accommodation was homey and living/kitchen area large enough to entertain our group of 8. The rooms and living area were quite well insulated and stayed cozy even during cold nights. The beds and pillows were very comfortable, and electric banklets added a luxe glamping touch. Ensuite bathroom per room was great for our large group. The showers had good water pressure and enough hot water if you're reasonable with water use.
Thank you Angas family for an unforgettable stay. We look forward to visiting again, might look at the luxury stone cellar villa!

This is hands down the best Airbnb experience I’ve ever had (that’s out of at least 40 places!). If you’re staying in the barossa, this is where you need to book! You will leave feeling like you’ve had the true barossa experience - incredible hosts, delicious wine, tasty Hutton vale farm lamb roast, walking through a working farm with pigs, chickens, sheep etc etc.
You MUST do the wine tasting and allow a good amount of time, you don’t want to rush this one! More than just a tasting but the best quality chats and learning about the history of Hutton vale.
Accom
Beds were really comfortable. Shower pressure and temp great! Pics don’t do the bedrooms justice. So quiet! Perfect for 4 couples with own bathrooms.
Living
Cosy with the fire. We loved the feeling of the barn type vibe. The kitchen has everyone you’ll need. Spacious, clean and comfortable.
If you’re into 5 star hotels I would go elsewhere, however if you love disconnecting and getting back to nature but will all the perks (as mentioned above !) this is exactly the place for you.
Thank you so much again Cait, Jan, Caits husband, Charlotte, Stella. I really hope we get to come back!!! Xo

Perfect farm retreat, with an indoor fire place that made a great atmosphere for the colder weather. Plenty to do around the area, we went on a wine tour. The hosts were so lovely and greeted us, and were available on call whenever needed. The scenery is lovely, and all the rooms were very neat and tidy and comfy!!! Highly recommend for a group stay :)

Our stay at Hutton Vale farm was incredible. I stayed with my family for a weekend to celebrate my parents birthdays. Despite the incredibly wet June weekend, we had an amazing time together.
The living room provided us a cosy place to hide from the rain with the fire going and a good book in hand. The location of the accomodation is a perfect home base for a weekend of little day trips to wineries and distilleries (and other activities when the weather is better!).
On Saturday night, we were lucky to get an amazing wine tasting at the Hutton Vale cellar door. Even though we were running late from our previous stop (sorry again!), we were welcomed into the small, intimate tasting room for a wonderful tasting - of course the wine was fantastic (a highlight of the whole weekend), but the personal touch made the experience such a stand out- we didn’t feel rushed or pressured to buy, just got a feel (and taste) for how much love and passion goes into this whole farm.
Communication about the accomodation was so great - super flexible and quick at replying. Everyone loved it and we’ll be recommending both the accomodation and the wine to everyone we know! Thank you!
This is the perfection of rustic, simple providing tranquillity of the space of recharge.  Worth every dollar. 🤩

We really enjoyed the stay at your farm. The kids loved playing with the chickens, pigs and dogs and having the pot belly fire. Our host and her family clearly take care and pride in their farm and about creating a wonderful experience for people staying there. There were lots of thoughtful touches here and there through out our stay. The wine tasting and fresh homegrown lamb were delicious. The expansive fields in front of the holiday home were gorgeous. We all had a lovely time away. Thank you very much!
Incredible stay in a picturesque and homely cabin.  Pre-ordering the lamb is a must and they have all the cooking equipment you need for a roast.

Amazing property close to Wineries, Tanunda and Angaston. Relaxing and comfortable accommodation.
John was a fabulous host and interesting to listen to during wine tasting! Will definitely return!!
This was a wonderful stay and Caitlin made it all the more special with her attentiveness and generosity!

We had such a lovely relaxing time at this beautiful working farm.  The hosts were most welcoming and made us feel right at home.  The accommodation was comfortable and cosy for our group of 4 and we made good use of the lovely open fire.  Having a cellar door tasting on site was the icing on the cake.
Amazing rustic farm stay, definitely recommend it. Paddock to plate lamb order was excellent as well.
Sensational 👍

John was fabulous, very informative wine tasting. Beautiful gardens. Organised a leg of lamb from them which was delicious. With all the storms, wind and rain it was an adventure.
We all had a fabulous time. Thank you

This is a true farm stay on a working farm and vineyard. The accommodation is simple, rustic and comfortable. The pre-booked lamb roast was a hit and if you organize a cellar door tasting it is great experience. The farm is about 5 mins drive out of town so it is super quiet just farmyard sounds. Great fun and a great location.
Stay was perfect for what we wanted. Very friendly and clean.
We appreciated the rooms all having air-conditioning for a very hot weekend we had and the ensuite for each room was great for the 7 of us to get ready for a wedding.  Thanks.

This farm stay was so beautiful. I spent the weekend away with my family and everyone had a great time, the lamb on the first night was crazy good! Great farm to walk around, gorgeous garden and very comfy beds. We will definitely be coming back one day!
The Hutch Hilton is an amazing find - it’s rustic charm and cosy accommodation made for a wonderful stay. We’ll be back!

We absolutely loved our stay. Perfect getaway for a group and couples, especially with accommodation having own rooms and ensures. Amazing views of the property and we absolutely loved the fire place! Was perfect for a winter stay. The owners/contacts for the property were extremely responsive and even helped us out with a request for wine for the cellar at late notice. Would be happy to recommend the stay to friends and family.

We had been to Hutch Hilton before and were delighted when our friends arrived for the first time using words to describe there holiday as, perfect, beautiful and wow!
Communal area dotted with rustic touches and potential to enjoy great conversation, meals and stories to last a life time, that's exactly what we did.
Fabulous weekend, everyone had a relaxing and enjoyable holiday.
Thankyou Jan and John (sorry for the cliche')
The hosts with the most!!
Great hosts and amazing rustic getaway.

We were 4 couples and stayed for a total 2 nights in August. The property is set in a stunning, serene rural location - the main living areas are rustic but very functional and beautifully warmed with an internal combustion heater. The 4 bedrooms were all extremely comfortable. We got some great recommendations for local restaurants and cafes from Jan - overall a wonderful location, venue and experience - and a perfect base to experience some of the delights of the Barossa!

We had an incredible stay at Jan and John’s place. Both Jan and John were friendly, accommodating and really went above and beyond, with excellent local suggestions.
Thank you Jan and John, we loved every second of our stay.

Our group of six adults and one child had a wonderful stay at Hutch Hilton. It was exactly what we wanted: peaceful, rustic and in a great location. The views are beautiful and we enjoyed wandering around the farm meeting the animals and listening to the birds. The accommodation was comfortable and well appointed. An easy drive to wineries and to shops and restaurants in Angaston. We had no issues getting pizza delivered to us which was delicious (40s cafe). Highly recommend and would stay again in a heartbeat

We loved the farm stay , Jan and John were super helpful at all times . We played board games at night after very long time . Thank you Jan and John . We took up the offer to cook the leg of lamb and the kids loved it . Jan provided essentials need to cook a good lamb roast along with the advice on how to use the oven .

Had a great long weekend stay at the farm with a few couples. Perfect place to stay while visiting wineries in the area. Also had a tasting with John with some beautiful wines from his farm. Would definitely recommend.
Thanks again Jan & John for the stay.

The accommodation was everything we wanted! It had 4 separate bedrooms with ensuites which was great for our group of 4 girls! It was a rustic farm style, with a beautiful fire place and comfortable lounges and amazing views out of the wrap around glass windows and doors! It had everything we needed and it was a so peaceful.
