We had a great time staying here. Thank you so much!
Very cute and a perfect location. Thank you Carolyn for being a great host.

Thank you so much for your amazing hospitality Carolyn and William! We loved meeting you all (including Angus and Ruby), and had such a lovely time staying in the Barn. What a gorgeous place to stay! We had everything we needed, the styling was stunning and what a view to wake up to in the morning! We both slept so well on the huge, extremely comfortable king bed and will be recommending all of our friends to make a trip to the Barossa to stay in Angaston ASAP. Thank you for being so friendly and kind!!!! A brilliant mini vacay! Xxxx

We had a wonderful stay at Carolyn & William's farm. The Barn is a cosy and beautifully presented space with a huge comfy bed! It has everything you need for a short stay. The Barn is located near Angaston  and close to many of Barossa's  finest wineries and restaurants. Carolyn & William were excellent and accommodating hosts with great tips and recommendations.  We had a wonderful weekend and would definitely recommend the Barn to our friends and family!

Carolyn was very helpful and lovely. The room is 10/10 as is the location. If you're staying a few days make sure you come prepared with small goods like milk, fruit and snacks. The room was lovely and warm and the bed comfy. Would definately go back.

The Barn is a beautiful stay in the Barossa that offers peace & quiet and a lovely view. The driveway is lined with blossoming trees, the hosts are lovely & will do anything to make your stay special. The Barn itself is fantastic - beautifully styled, huge comfortable bed & has everything you need. The toilet/bathroom is a 15m walk away on a boardwalk, so no big deal. I loved the historical aspect of it. Sunset drinks on the back deck were everything we imagined in the Barossa. You won't be disappointed if you stay here!

'The Barn' is a well appointed room, the host Carolyn anticipating most of your needs before you even know you have them.  Most things you'll find in your room and it's only a short well lit boardwalk across to the amenities. Would definitely stay here again!

The Barn is the most amazing little place to get away for the weekend. The Barn itself and facilities were so modern, new and fresh. The location is perfect and just outside Angaston where anything we needed was a small drive. Absolutely worth every penny for an adults weekend away, drink some wine, eat some cheese, visit some wineries and sights and veg out.

Carolyn is a good helpful host and is creating a charming Barossa country feel. The room is an old stone barn well renovated with beautiful linen, comfortable bed and large fun. There is a nice private outdoor sitting area with country views.
However we were disappointed on arrival to find that the barn had no running water and the new toilet and shower were 30m away up a boardwalk in a separate building. This is rather inconvenient in the middle of a cold night! To be fair the place description did say amenities were separate but it was not clear to us that this meant no en suite and the photos did not make it clear either.This needs to be emphasised in the advert as for that price one would expect self-contained facilities. We are sure when the renovations are complete this will be a great place to stay.

Absolutely beautiful location. Carolyn is incredibly helpful and quick to respond in communication and provided lovely accommodation.  The Barn is exactly as described and pictured.  Thank you for making my experience so fuss free.
Thanks for the stay! A nice quiet place to go after seeing the Barossa. Loved the bed linen.

The Barn was truly magical and was just what we needed for a long weekend getaway. Carolyn had thought of everything in regards to amentities, from extra towels and blankets to netflix and an array of delicious teas. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and the peace and quiet of the Barn. Would highly recommend if you're looking for a romantic weekend away to enjoy some wine and soak in the peace and quiet.
Our stay was amazing! I would strongly suggest anyone going to the Barossa to stay at The Barn in Penrice. Carolyn is so accomodating and the Barn is in a beautiful setting.

The Barn is a beautifully located villa type home where everything you need is catered for. A great mix of old structures but modern facilities gives this place an edge on everywhere else. Would recommend.
Wonderful stay, great location, great view. Beautiful and comfortable. Biggest bed ever! Just perfect!

Carolyn and family very friendly and room was beautiful with fresh linen, lovely soft towels and beautiful view of countryside as well as great connection to Netflix. However take care when walking to amenities as very poor lighting on path to toilet and laundry at night causing a trip hazard and suggest much improved lighting. Solar lights provide insufficient lighting at night currently.
We had a fantastic stay! Beautiful accommodation, great hosts!! And so close to restaurants, wineries & sites! Can’t wait to come back ... definitely recommend!

Cute space with a rustic exterior and modern interior. Surrounding renovations under way at the time of writing and as mentioned in the description. Carolyn and her family were very welcoming hosts. Highly recommend.

We loved our stay in the Barn. Such a beautiful space with gorgeous views.
We had a lovely peaceful visit. Would definately visit again.
Carolyn is s fantastic host.
Great location to explore the region. The pool is a welcome relief if it is hot.
An absolutely beautiful location, room and hosts. It was perfect and I’d stay there again in a heartbeat. Thank you for making our trip to the barossa so enjoyable.
Great hospitality and a beautiful location
Beautiful space and friendly hosts. Highly recommended.

I can’t recommend Carolyn’s Air BnB enough. A welcoming host with great local knowledge that made our trip. The barn is very comfortable with a private decking to enjoy the stunning views. To top it off, Carolyn makes the best brownies! Thanks again, Tom

Highly recommended for anyone wishing to "escape" and find serenity.  A well thought out space, comfortable "large" bed and gorgeous outlook.  The toilet and shower a short stroll away from the barn wasn't a problem.  We decided to stay in each night instead of eating out as we didn't want to miss the opportunity of enjoying the sunset and relaxing in such a lovely setting.  The property is situated within an easy drive to "everywhere" in the Barossa but you still feel like you are in the middle of "nowhere"!!!
Excellent acommodation, very clean and has everything you need.
Enjoyed our stay. Bed was amazing. Best bucolic view to wake up to in the morning
Excellent and helpful host, with lots of local information for tourists. The place was spotless and serene. Sitting on that decking, watching the sun set across the hills is special.
Beautiful peaceful retreat, and there’s a pool!
Great Air B&B. We really enjoyed our stay here. Beautiful set up. Great communication from the hosts. Would recommend.
Beautiful peaceful accommodation in Barossa Hills. Close to town and wineries. Really enjoyed our stay and appreciated suggestions from host re places to go.

The perfect little retreat for a relaxing getaway! We stayed for 3 nights and didn’t want to leave. Carolyn is a very helpful & accommodating host. The king bed is super comfy & Carolyn has the place set up so well with all of the furniture & amenities. It’s hard to beat having a glass of wine on the deck watching the sunset over the fields! The lovely & spacious toilet/bathroom/shower is only 20 steps away and wasn’t an issue at all. Can’t wait to come back & stay again.
It is a lovely little getaway in the Barossa and close to all the wineries.

Was nice place & beautiful balcony & close to other towns. We didn’t have any hot water for a day so had to have a cold shower. The bathroom is away from the room and the lights walking there were very dim so was hard to see where I was walking. Also would of been good to have a sink in the room rather than have to keep walking to the bathroom area.

We had a wonderful stay and look forward to staying again in the future . Carolyn was a terrific host and made us feel very much at home . The property is ideally located a few kilometers from town and sits
beautifully in a rural setting . Highly recommended !

Carolyn is a great host, very easy and lovely to chat to. The gorgeous little barn house was way better then we expected, and had all the amenities so that my mum and I could enjoy a nice hot coffee and brekky in the mornings. Would recommend to anyone who's wanting to get away for the weekend!!
The perfect spot for a week end in the Barossa. The barn is very comfortable, the sky full of star and Carolyn and William were extremely helpful. Would definitely recommend staying there.

Carolyn’s Barn is utterly idyllic! The perfect place for a weekend away to decompress from city life. We spent the weekend wine touring so brought bits with us for breakfast and despite its secluded location were even able to order a pizza at night! The room is very cosy, heating and a great big bed. The separate bathroom didn’t really bother us, just maybe bring your slippers so you don’t need put your shoes on every time you need to go :)

What a wonderful accommodation! My partner and i loved how it was so homely and the short walk to the amenities weren't a problem at all!
Carolyn gave us a range of great suggestions for what to do in the Barossa which were perfect. We spent hours driving around the Barossa valley.
Would definitely recommend the place to anyone heading to the Barossa!

We had a midweek stay at the gorgeous Barn and it was the perfect spot to explore the beautiful Barossa . Comfortable bed and lovely extras, loved the coffee :)
Thankyou to Carolyn for the local suggestions which took us to places we would not otherwise have found .
Great location, a lot of history, easy access to the Barossa Valley wineries.

What a beautiful place to have spent a couple of nights at to give us access to the Barossa. Well appointed facility with all we needed. Sitting out on the patio with a bottle of red & some cheeses while the sun was setting was pretty special. Nice location to be able to get out to explore the region as well.

We throughly enjoyed our stay, the barn was beautifully renovated with luxurious and stylish decor. It had everything we needed and was close to excellent wineries and restaurants. I would recommend this accommodation to any couple looking to experience the Barossa Valley.

Fantastic location (close to all the wineries, food places and historical townships) just out of Angaston, the room is very private and open space with a cool layout looking out to the valley view.   The room offers everything you need and more.  If you are looking for a classy escape, this is your place with very friendly hosts.  Thank you again, Samuel & Mel.
Exceeded our expectations. We enjoyed everything about our stay. The premises, the location and the hosts were exactly what we were after. Thankyou so much.

We had a great time at the Barn. It was peaceful and beautiful and exactly what we wanted. Close to Angaston and Tanunda which had lots of good and drink options, not to mention a winery on every corner! Carolyn and William were great hosts and gave us lots of tips for the area. Would definitely recommend the Barn!

Carolyn and William were amazing hosts! The Barn was absolutely lovely and beautifully fitted out. The bed was very comfortable and the amenities were great. It was lovely to sit out on the private deck and look up at the stars. Despite the heatwave while we were staying, the Barn was very cool with AC and a fan. It was also great to have a dip in the pool. The bathroom is very close and no issue to get to. There were lots of brochures and guides in the room for guests and Carolyn kindly gave us some personal recommendations, all of which we loved! The location was great for getting around the Barossa. We were really impressed with the whole experience and will definitely be back the next time we come to the Barossa.
Outstanding hospitality, property and accomodation. Would highly recommend staying here :)
Amazing and beautiful place, very comfy and well located, had a great time! Definitely recommend to anyone staying in the Barossa region

This was hands down the most beautiful Airbnb I have ever stayed at. The barn is incredible, the views amazing and Carolyn’s hospitality and recommendations for exploring the area were amazing. I’m counting the days until I can come back!

Honestly amazing! Couldn’t recommend staying here more.
Carolyn and William have thought of everything. So beautifully styled throughout and the location is just perfect.
Carolyn also provided us with wonderful suggestions for dinner and breakfast that we are so glad to have tried. The perfect weekend in the Barossa made so by having such a wonderful place to come back to. Thanks so much again :-)
Awesome stay

My husband and I had a wonderful weekend at The Barn. The room was beautiful, with lots of thoughtful touches and a very comfy bed. We loved our stay there, especially sitting by the pool in the afternoon with a glass of rose. Highly recommend and we’ll be back!
Amazing place with a lot of character. Very comfortable and stylish room
A perfectly located and luxurious sleep with everything the Barossa has to offer at your door. Enjoy the calm view before you start a day of great food, wine and wandering.
Amazing location near angaston, views of surrounding farmland and rolling hills. Stylish space and great hosts, would stay again.

The Barn is exactly as described and a lovely place to stay. Everything was immaculately clean and stylishly decorated. The facilities were great, very modern and clean. Carolyn and her partner are lovely hosts and it was a pleasure meeting them both. The night sky is outstanding in Penrice, you can see so much detail in the Milky Way. We enjoyed the local visitors too including a kangaroo, kookaburra and watching the neighboring sheep. Thanks for a relaxing stay!
My partner and I loved our stay at Carolyn's place. It was the perfect weekend escape and we loved all of the local tips Carolyn and William provided. We will be back!

This little barn is beautifully finished with thoughtful touches. The French doors lead to a private deck that overlooks the rolling hills and perfect for your morning coffee. This barn has all the amenities that you’ll need. The host provided great local tips
We had a lovely time. The Barn was warm, great views and the bed was so comfortable.
Beautiful property and house that has everything you need included. Bathroom was lovely as well and very close to the house! Great hospitality and stay overall!
Awesome experience and stay. Nice and quiet, welcoming and amazing views at both day and night, highly recommended

Really nice to be just out of town with a proper country feel. The concept of building a small village is excellent and this building is a great part of it and really well done. Lovely little place for the middle of winter and a short cab ride from the nearest town. Perfect  central point for a Barossa stay.

We loved our stay here - very cosy. It was cold and rainy during our stay which made the trek to the separate bathroom a little bit tricky, but the room itself was so lovely that it more than made up for it. We would definitely stay here again!

The photos of the Barn did not do justice to the space (I mean that in the best way possible)! It is absolutely stunning, loved that there was coffee beans and tea, the gigantic bed with heated blanket, the cordless charging ports was a special touch, the deck and outdoor space was perfect for our brunch with food from the Farmers Market. The bathroom and kitchenette was only a short walk along the pavement/deck. We had already planned out the weekend for my partners birthday, however if your stuck for ideas Carolyn was more then happy to offer local ideas and there was plenty of magazines, brochures and a home made guide book to the local area in the barn. I would absolutely recommend this place to any couple looking to get away to the Barossa.
Great Little Spot, good value for money.

Very clean, great facilities and a beautiful room! Some really nice thoughtful touches that really does make a difference. The toilet and shower is seperate to the room however still private and not really an issue! Definitely recommend when staying in the Barossa.
The Barn was all we hoped for, the bed was enormous
A great experience :)

Fantastic place to stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and had plenty of extra little bonuses such as wireless charges for phones, Bluetooth speaker, and lots of tea/coffee options. For anyone staying who is worried about having a bathroom separate to the main building, it is a VERY short distance away and was not an issue at all. Bathroom was clean and tidy, and had a fantastic shower with a rain shower head! 5 minutes drive from the main town Angeston and 10minutes to a heap of great wineries, we had a fantastic time and highly recommend this place as somewhere to stay!
Beautiful spot to relax and forget your worries...will be back!
Lovely place would recommend
Fantastic little place for a weekend getaway!
Fantastic relaxing place to stay. Very peaceful and had everything you need to unwind. Great location and not too far from anything

This place is one of the best we’ve ever stayed at. The photos really don’t do it justice; we were in awe constantly with the beautiful property. Not to mention Carolyn’s amazing hospitality too; it was the perfect stay! Will definitely be back ☺️

Beautiful space in a lovely setting in the Barossa region. The room is so comfy and beautifully styled and has everything you need. There are terraces for sitting outside the room and a covered living room space next to it where we sat with a cup of tea in the morning looking across the garden. The bathroom really is a short little hop from the room and is beautifully done with a great shower.  Carolyn is a great host, quick to communicate and gave us good tips for the area. We only stayed one night but would definitely return next time we’re in the Barossa!
Lovely little place for a quick stop over on our way to the Flinders Rangers

Such an amazing weekend away. The most gorgeous cottage, so private. The separate bathroom is not a problem. The bed is huge and I miss it!!! Carolyn is a great host and very helpful with recommendations. STAY HERE!

A truly beautiful barn - the space was characteristic & cosy :) Not to mention, amazing views, especially from the loo ;) Carolyn was such a welcoming, easy going and helpful host!
My Mum was in awe of the assortment of tea provided & we both very much enjoyed the recommendation for our lunch outing! Oh & the attention to detail exceeded our expectations; from an umbrella by the door for when it drizzled and beautiful flowers around the place, everything had been thought of ! We definitely hope to visit again someday :)
Great location, great communication, would recommend to others visiting the Barossa region.

This is why AirBnb exists! The Barn was so comfortable and made our trip to the Barossa. The bed was huge and the heater / air con unit meant it was so cozy. It was well kitted out and beautifully designed. It was just so unique and we spent half our time eating cheese and drinking wine on the decking. We didn’t know what to expect from the outside bathroom but it only added to the experience. Getting a good look at the starry sky made it all worthwhile! Thanks to Will and Carolyn for being exceptional hosts.

Loved our two nights at ‘The Barn’, definitely worth more than a night to soak up the country amosphere. Not only is the sleeping accomodation charming and wonderfully inviting, that huge billowy bed requiring the obligatory lay in, but the cosy but spacious sitting and cooking area ‘the pug house’ is delightful to while away a comfy hour or three with a book or bottle of local wine. There are numerous dining in and take away food places open till quite late within a 10minute drive but the pug house was so inviting we shopped at the local iga and cooked a full meal both nights with the adequate facilities and soaked up the twinkling candlelit ambience. If you love to get away from it all yet have everything at your fingertips Carolyn’s is that spot. Highly recommend. Ps, the night visit to the luxury loo is a starlit wonder to behold if you don’t see the heavens often.

The Barn literally has it all!!!!not only that it is very stylish and worth every cent!!! William and Carolyn were great hosts, so helpful and offered some great tips on where to go in the Barossa.
A must stay!!!
Beautiful, comfortable and thoughtfully decorated/designed - thank you we loved it
Carolyn's place is great! Rustic with a sense of luxury and comfort. Carolyn has thought of everything to make the stay as welcoming as possible. Great place to stay when in the Barossa :)
A fantastic stay, extremely comfortable with a beautiful view. We loved it and hope to be back one day soon!

I stayed at Carols Airbnb for 2 nights & the space Carol & her husband have created is perfect for a country escape or if your looking for affordable accommodation near the Barossa.
The king size bed was super comfy, the cottage & the seperate bathroom was super clean & although the toilet & shower are seperate from the cottage it was not an issue & literally just a few steps away.
The private decking area attached to the cottage is a great peaceful space to have your coffee in the morning, a glass of wine in the evening or just to sit, relax & read a book. There was a big electrical storm one of the nights of my stay in which the power was out for a few hours & Carol was quick to make sure I was ok & to see if I needed anything. Comforting considering I was staying there on my own. Thanks so much for your great hospitality Carol 😃

The Barn far exceeded our expectations. Carolyn met us on arrival and gave us a brief tour of the space before leaving us to relax. The bed was incredibly comfortable and we spent some time enjoying the sun and drinking wine on the outdoor patio.
Carolyn and her partner were kind enough to lend us their barbecue to make dinner one evening, and always made sure we had everything we needed. Absolutely one of our favorite AirBnb locations we have ever stayed in. We couldn't recommend this enough! Thank you again Carolyn.
the barn is a lovely place to stay for peace and quiet! very earthy and pretty!

Carolyn has done a beautiful job decorating the small stone barn, the king size bed was very comfortable, the location is so quiet at night, stunning night sky to view the stars. We enjoyed having aircon, a ceiling fan, smart TV and a space to prepare simple meals. Carolyn was a great host with prompt communication.

Very luxurious and relaxing spot within easy reach of everything in the Barossa Valley. Really well appointed and tastefully decorated. You don't want for anything here except a nice bottle of local wine to enjoy on the back deck. William and Carolyn are great helpful hosts.
Quirky, quiet, comfortable and  very close to Angaston yet great 'bush' feel

Wow wow and wow!
I’m not really one to write reviews but this little gem really is something else.
We absolutely loved our two night stay in the barn. Carolyn has thought of everything.
Exactly as described and even better than the pics.
The most beautiful and comfortable big bed, seperate cooking/dining area if you wish although the beautiful little town of Angaston is only a 5 minute drive. We came for a weekend from Sydney and I just want to do it all again 💛
Very relaxing, awesome stay.  Great hosts. Highly recommended.  👍

Incredible accommodation, and the best Airbnb experience I've had. Carolyn and William have done an amazing job restoring the historic buildings, the photos dont do it justice.
You can simply arrive without having done any research or planning as they have included a fantastic guide to the wineries, food, tours and experiences you can do in the region. I had spent a lot of time looking into what to do beforehand and picking up their guide was much easier than searching through multiple websites.
Can't recommend this place enough, we'll be back for sure!

Great place to stay while experiencing the Barossa! Very comfortable stay with beautiful outdoor areas to relax in. The barn was charming, cosy and the decor had clearly received a lot of attention to detail. Still had all the modern facilities - pretty reliable wifi, smart TV, streaming services, a portable Bluetooth speaker, A/C and a massive, comfortable bed. The back deck and outdoor couch were quite private.
Toilet and shower were a short (and well lit) walk along the deck and were both modern and clean. Access to the pool was great during our summer stay. Carolyn and William were very hospitable and up for a chat, but certainly not overbearing. Definitely would recommend.

Delightful place in Penrice, barely removed from Angaston and Tanunda. Picturesque, cosy, so many thoughtful touches. Beautiful to look out onto the hills during the day and stars at night. Had we stayed longer we could have had a go at the pool and barbecue. Would highly recommend this to couples looking for a romantic getaway.
Thank you very much for the lovely stay, tips and most importantly the good humour. Could not recommend the barn more highly!

We had an excellent stay at The Barn and would highly recommend it. Every convenience has been thought of and attended to. The decor is beautiful, and there are a number of luxury touches: huge king sized bed, wireless phone chargers, chrome cast, Netflix and Stan, private deck in addition to the pool and bbq areas. It was really outstanding 🌻
Beautiful little barn - lots of lovely little touches and really close to the centre of town. It was one of the hottest weekends we've had all summer and we were super comfortable. Thankyou!
A lovely little getaway with everything you need. Beautiful location and a stylish stay. Hosts were lovely and very accommodating. Definitely recommend.
Cute and cosy. Comfortable space. Great location.
lovely barossa rural space. I wanted to show my partner a rural space and this was perfect. beautiful room, lovely pool and space outside to look at the stars!

Charming accommodation.  Definitely recommend staying if you are looking for a unique experience as the bathroom is a very short distance from your room. Great for star gazing. Everything was clean and tidy with attention to the small details. We loved the the super sized king bed which was extremely comfortable. Carolyn and William were great hosts and we enjoyed watching their playful puppy and kitten playing together much like the movie “Milo and Otis”.

Highly recommended, friendly and gracious host. You will love the effort the host have put into the decor, and the little thoughtful touches dotted around the place. The rear deck is perfect for star gazing. This place has charm by the bucket loads. Don’t forget to ask the Carolyn & Mike for dining recommendations.

I was excited to stay here because it seemed interesting and looked beautiful, but it was honestly even better than I expected. Most comfortable bed ever, and I loved sitting on the deck with a wine, watching a kookaburra hop about nearby. Carolyn was very welcoming and friendly, and gave us a great suggestion for a bushwalk when she found out that's what we wanted to do. Would love to stay again.
A perfect place to stay if you're visiting the Barossa. It is a good space in a nice location with great hosts.

We had a great stay, Carolyn and William were great hosts and the barn was perfect. Although you are not that far from their residence, the barn is super private with it’s own outdoor space as well as the pug lounge. Is close enough to the towns to not be inconvenient, but far enough out to escape the noise/light and to feel very secluded.

What a perfect weekend we spent at The Barn!!! It was the most relaxing little getaway. William our host met us on arrival and gave us a tour of our weekend property. Only a short drive to Angaston which has great food options. William told us about the Farmers Market on Saturday mornings which we picked up some amazing local produce for our weekend stay. Highly recommend staying here, we will definitely will be staying here again.
5 stars! The perfect little place to stay and relax.

We loved our stay at Carolyn + William's spot in the Barossa Valley. A cute little stone cottage with privacy and views, and a kitten and puppy to play with. A 5 min drive to the nearby town of Angaston, you can even get food delivered, which was nice after a day spent cycling around the wineries. We wished we had stayed a bit longer!
Lovely little place perfect for winery hoping. Wish we could have stayed longer.
Carolyn made us feel at home and the property included everything you need for your stay in the Barossa Valley. Check in was super smooth too, Carolyn greeted us as we drove down the driveway :)
Beautiful stay in the Barossa. This Airbnb has everything you’ll need and was the highlight of our trip. We loved the pugs 😍 and the bed was super comfy and spacious! Excellent value, thank you ❤️
A beautiful place to stay for a weekend getaway. This Airbnb has everything you’ll need and being greeted by Carolyn with pug & kitten in tow was a fantastic way to check in.
Great place for an overnight getaway! Carolyn was very accommodating and had great suggestions for nearby places to visit ☺ Would happily stay here again!
The space was so comfortable and stylish. Perfect for a quiet getaway from the city :)
Cute, clean and quaint place with everything you need. Would recommend!

The Barn is an absolutely magical getaway. Carolyn and William are incredible hosts. They have included so many thoughtful touches in the Barn and are very hospitable. We loved chilling on the deck of the Barn, it is completely private and has great sunsets. The bed is HUGE and so comfortable! Their cute kitten came down and paid us a visit which we loved. Would absolutely recommend the Barn to others! What a special place.
Quiet retreat that is wonderfully equipped  for your stay
A gorgeous and scenic stay with absolutely everything you need. Rustic luxury.

A little bit rustic and a little but lux is a great description of this place.  While the bathroom is separate from the "bedroom" it wasn't much of a problem for us.  We had a full moon and it wasn't too chilly.  There are great spaces here to chill out and cook and mediate at sunrise and have a romantic dinner at home.  Just lovely.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in the beautiful Pug cottage! It’s got so much character! Loved the little touches, all the details are really thought trough. The place is absolutely spotless. Conveniently located for access to the Barossa valley wineries. Carolyn was very friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend her place!
Fabulous little spot! Great view. Very comfy
Beautiful barn and amazing location. We had a short stay but would have gladly stayed longer. It had everything we needed and a perfect location for all the wineries and sights.

The barn is in the perfect location to explore the Barossa. The little town near by angaston is so cute and all the wineries are within 15-20 mins. Beautiful sunrises out on the property. Nice casual pug lounge to hang out in and like a glamping experience with shower and
Toilet seperate to the barn. Would recommend bringing some food for the bbq if you want to make a meal there.

A really nice place to stay in a rural setting that is close to town and accessible to all the Barossa has to offer. The Barn is very well appointed with all the amenities you need. Carolyn met us on arrival and showed us around before leaving us to have our private getaway.
Recommend it to anyone wanting a nice and quiet break.
This place was super cute and with a modern touch! Very great space and ameneties. Perfect spot for exploring the Barossa and enjoying the cold. Thanks for the great stay!
Such a great place to stay for our trip to the Barossa!
Carolyn and William had a great place located centrally in the Barossa. A good base to travel around various different wineries in the region

Lovely cosy accommodation - presented beautifully and exactly as described. The hosts met as we arrived and as we left, and otherwise we felt like we had our own space. Fabulous location with a beautiful outlook. Lots of cosy and private places to enjoy the outdoors. Definitely recommend.
Thank you for having us at this charming cottage in a farm setting. All of the decor and provisions were of a high standard, and we enjoyed the view from the decking across to the fields.
Beautiful renovated barn with amazing views. Only a short drive to wineries and restaurants. Loved it, thank you!
Lovely location!

A gorgeous little cabin tucked away amongst farmland.  The outdoor lounge area was a great spot for BBQ meals and to catch the sunshine during the day.  The seperate toilet wasn't an issue, even on late night dashes.  My favourite spot was sitting outside watch the stars at night with a wine from the nearby vineyards!

The barn was a lovely, different place to stay. The bed was amazing and the heating was good considering we chose a couple of cold wet days to be away. The bathroom was lovely but, as stated, you have to be ok with a short walk. Even though we were there when it was cold and wet it didn’t take long to forget about the cold bathroom floor once you were under the lovely rainfall shower. I would like to stay again when the weather is warmer so we could enjoy the deck and the pug lounge as it has great ambiance.

Carolyn is a wonderful host. Excellent communication. We loved the deck, outdoor pug Lounge to hang out and the king bed was very comfortable. Excellent streaming services too. The place is very unique and relaxing. Would definitely recommend.
Super lovely location, really welcoming and helpful :)

Great, relaxing and quiet location. Quaint and cosy.
Fantastic location for touring.
Very much appreciated pet friendliness.
Thank you for the break away to rest.
Carolyn was a wonderful host. The place was clean and safe.

Lovely rural setting that is comfortable and cozy even on the coldest nights of the year! Very convenient location while still feeling like we were away from the rest of the world.  Carolyn and William were very welcoming and had some great recommendations of where to visit.

The view from Carolyn's Airbnb is gorgeous. We were lucky enough to enjoy the view in the company of Carolyn's adorable pug, Tanzanite.
The Airbnb and facilities were clean and felt homey. If you plan on bringing your own food, I would recommend checking that the bar fridge is on. We unfortunately didn't notice that it was not on until it was too late and our food had to be thrown out.
Although Carolyn lives on the property, she respects privacy.

The Dairymans Cottage is the ideal weekend getaway in the Barossa. Situated  a short drive from local wineries and restaurants its country charm is a refreshing break. The local produce provided is straight from paddock to plate, offering a great opportunity to enjoy the most delicious food in the area. The cottage itself is neat, tidy and tucked away to provide a relaxing connection to the country, with all the amenities expected in a fancy hotel. We were greeted by the most loving ‘red dog’ who visited us every so often just to check in on our stay. We will definitely be back in the future!

We loved our four day stay over Easter 2021. The accommodation is lovely and the whole experience of staying on a farm was very special. We also loved using the barbecue to cook fresh sausages and enjoy sunset over the paddocks.
Thanks Michael for a delightful stay! Highly recommended to prospective guests!
Amazing hospitality and stay! Sad we didn’t stay longer. Thank you Michael and your farm family!

A beautiful Airbnb and a wonderful experience!

Absolutely fantastic place to stay, we really enjoyed being on the working farm! We fed the pigs, helped bring in the cows for milking, saw the arrival of a baby calf on the property! Could not recommend more highly and hope one day I can return.

Such a wonderful farm stay at The Dairyman Barossa. The Market is only open Saturday mornings 7.30am to 11.30am. We bought lots of cheeses, preserves, dried fruit - great gifts to take home.
It was our first farm stay and we had a great experience. We watched Charly milk the cows, Michael feed the pigs- free range heritage pigs - were fed milk and oats. 3 of the chickens would roost near our cottage and Charly would find eggs around the milking shed. Wonderful hospitality
Amazing! Loved the pigs and cows. Michael was awesome.

A weekend Sydney getaway that will leave you feeling refreshed yet still relaxed. Treat yourself and book into the Dairyman’s Cottage.
If we could, we'd give Michael a 6/5 for hospitality! He's an amazing person, and his farm is a welcome change from the hustle and bustle of city life.

We will definitely be back.
We searched high and low for a working farm stay, i would highly recommend this farm.

My husband and our two daughters (4 and 1 years of age) stayed at Michael’s Airbnb. We had a fabulous time exploring the farm and also, the neighbouring Barossa Valley. The Airbnb itself had everything we needed and much more. Michael was warm and welcoming and we really appreciated his hospitality.

Michael was a very busy on the weekend we stayed, however he took time out to show my hubbie around the farm. The cows where great, and Ruby was very welcoming even calling by to say hi on Sunday morning. Michaels, butter, ham and bacon were delish, YUM. Would recommend a stay.  It was just what we needed.

This was the best Airbnb we have ever stayed at. Michael was so welcoming and took time to show us the animals including a brand new calf that was born while we were there! The provisions included were incredible. Our 1yo and 4yo daughters had the best time and didn’t want to leave. Beautiful location and perfectly equipped cottage we loved our stay so much.
Michael was lovely in taking us around the farm and catering to our needs. Would definitely recommend

We had a wonderful stay at Michael’s picturesque property. It was delightful to be around the farm animals. Michael was such a welcoming host. We highly recommend this stay and would definitely return.

Had a wonderful trip to Michael’s over the NY period with friends and our x2 18 month olds. Michael was incredibly hospitable, the cottage was immaculate and the outdoor area plus the farm were amazing. We all had a lovely time and can’t wait to go back.
The fresh farm produce and visits from beautiful Ruby put the icing on the cake.

We enjoyed a wonderful weekend at the Dairyfarm with our 3 children. Thank you Michael for your hospitality and generosity and for making our stay truly special! The children absolutely loved seeing the farm animals, especially the pigs being fed and the cows being milked. The cottage was just beautiful and we loved cooking up your delicious produce!! It was a fantastic family holiday and we hope to come back again soon!
Loved this place will go again!
This was our second stay and it was fantastic once again. Michael is so generous with his amazing produce. The cottage is so comfortable and homely we didn’t want to leave.

Thank you Michael for such a welcoming stay. Seeing how the farm operates and tasting your delicious produce. We would love to come visit again, it was the highlight of our trip. The cottage was spacious and had a lovely garden.
Super friendly bloke, couldn’t have asked for a better get away with my partner, we had an amazing stay

We absolutely loved staying at Michael’s place. He is so generous with his fresh produce, when we arrived we had his eggs, bacon, ham, butter and milk - all from his farm - in the accomodation waiting for us.
We were invited to watch the cows being milked and pigs being fed, and we really had the ‘farm’ experience. Michael was so lovely and we were definitely glad we stayed there. It’s about 20-25 minutes away from the main wineries, and taxis weren’t very reliable, so make sure you’ve pre-organised that or have a car.
Perfect location! Michael was very generous with the fresh produce from his farm.

Michael was such a lovely host. He was very helpful and was wonderful with the kids. He explained the animals to the kids, was very friendly and gave wonderful recommendations. If we needed anything he was such to help straight away.
The accommodation was perfect, offered everything you would need to a relaxing and peaceful stay.
We loved our stay, will definitely be back on our next trip through SA.

Thankyou for the lovely getaway Michael.
The cottage has everything you need for a comfortable stay
We loved watching the pigs being fed & cows being milked
Staff on farm very kind and helpful
Brekky provisions were very generous and 5 star quality- we loved the farm produce so much that we had to stock up at the Farmers Market for the way home.
Thanks again, ❤️ Fellow dairy farmers
Steph, Mat & Everleigh.
Awesome experience.  Cosy accommodation. Delicious local produce provided by Michael.

This is so much more than just a place to stay! The kids loved the farm animals… milking the cows and Muchael being so patient and enthusiastic!!! Gorgeous nature surrounding… felt lovely and peaceful! Highly recommend ♥️

We had a fantastic stay at Michael’s place! He was a wonderful host - very welcoming and thoughtful. The space was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped, making us feel right at home. A special touch was the generous provisions he left us to make breakfast in the morning which was truly appreciated. His hospitality made our trip even more enjoyable. Highly recommend staying here if you’re looking for a great Airbnb experience!

We loved our stay! The food provided was incredible. Michael was a great host. We loved the farm. We had our 8 month old son with us and he loved seeing all the animals in real life. The house was also very suitable for him.

Fantastic place, beautiful surroundings,  the premesis was stunning and cosy, Michael was a great host and we were given some fresh produce (you can't beat that). great place for a getaway to relax and unwind.

Nelly’s place is amazing everything and more is there everything is brand new.
Highly recommend would defiantly stay again.
And Nelly’s hospitality is also excellent.
Fantastic experience
An outstanding place to stay, highly recommend as truely beautiful location with Nelly as the perfect host. We are definitely staying here again.

Nelly was a lovely host and responded straight away. When we arrived the instructions were super easy and we located the place with ease.
The villa itself was beautiful, with lovely linen and a stunning bathroom with an excellent spa bath.
The view was spectacular and sitting out on the little deck with the local wine and cheese we collected during the day was a perfect end to the day.
Amazing photo opportunities and it is so private.
If you need help Nelly is happy to help but on the other hand if you like your privacy he is more than respectful of this.
Would definitely recommend staying here. Perfect for a romantic couples get away and some quiet time.

Nelly and Guido, thank you so much for the amazing opportunity to stay in your spectacular accommodation.
Your stays were exactly what we need when visiting the Barossa for our friends wedding.
Conveniently located at the start of the Barossa Valley trail, close to everything and the overall easy of getting to and from your place was so great.
The amenities and presentation of the accommodation was perfect, my partner and I can’t complain about a thing, you have certainly thought of everything; from superb linen to dual shower and a spa all overlooking the gorgeous vineyard.
Ultimately congratulations on such an amazing stay. We will be highly recommending your stay to friends and family when they visit.

We were on our honeymoon and had an Absolutely gorgeous stay.  Great amenities, friendly hosts.  Highly recommend grabbing a bottle and enjoying the sunset Vista from the gazebo.  Would absolutely stay again.
Great stay in the middle of a vineyard. Quiet location with great amenities, had a great stay and would definitely recommend this property.
Amazing house and views! Super clean and stylish and the owner was super nice. Really enjoyed my stay 😊
Nelly’s place was just stunning. Super clean, fantastic amenities and beautiful extra touches, luxurious towels, bath salts etc. would highly recommended and would definitely stay again.
Way beyond what we expected! So clean and amazing ammenities. Will be staying again!

Perfekt ausgestattete Villa mitten im Weingut. Auf der eigenen Terrasse, umgeben von Rebstöcken, lässt sich am Abend wunderbar ein Glas Wein geniessen. Die insgesamt drei Villen sind sehr ruhig, abseits der Strasse gelegen. Sehr zu empfehlen.
BEAUTIFUL PLACE, very organised, clean and friendly
The place was gorgeous with amazing views! Nelly and Guido are lovely hosts.

Great place and location. Lots of really nice touches. Sitting on the porch with a wine overlooking the vineyard at sunset - magical. Spectacular sunrises too with native wildlife incl kangaroos outside you door. Hosts are great and very communicative. Everything was perfect on our extended weekend stay. Highly recommend.

Wonderful stay at 1837. Pictures don’t do the bnb or vineyards justice, spacious enough for 2 and great amenities. Lovely staff who helped us when we locked our keys inside. 10-20 minute drive to all wineries we wanted to visit.
Nelly was a fabulous host that greeted us with a big smile and bottle of wine then left us to our fabulous and relaxing stay! The accommodation was gorgeous and had everything you could need!
This place is beyond stunning! Everything about our stay was absolutely perfect. It was the highlight of our trip to Barossa Valley. Nelly is a fabulous host and super accomodating. Highly recommend!

A very clean and well maintained space, with great access to the Barossa wineries. The space has everything you need but lacks warmth or the ‘cozy’ factor, which was disappointing in the depths of winter. The fireplace is purely decorative, you’ll need to crank the AC to stay warm. The AC unit is right outside the bedroom, so pack earplugs if you’re a light sleeper. Nelly was a very accommodating host, especially when we had to change plans due to COVID. She was on hand if we needed anything but gave us our privacy for the whole stay.
Absolutely loved the stay! Beautiful places to stay for a weekend getaway

Nelly was a fantastic host, made our trip very memorable. My partner and I would happily stay here again and recommend others to stay here as well. The hospitality and the service Nelly and the 1837 team is second to none.

We stayed for a month and we were truly sad to leave. Nelly makes the place a wonderful and tranquil oasis with majestic views of Barossa Valley. The on-site restaurant is top notch and their wines are wonderful. The cottage itself has everything you need to relax, drink some wine and cook a meal.
Again Nelly and Guido are perfect hosts and we will be back.

My husband and I stayed at Karina’s for a weekend getaway. It was lovely, close to the centre of Tanunda and easily accessible to all the highlights of the Barossa Valley. The extra touches of fresh milk, the very generous continental breakfast and the cheese and wine were really appreciated.  The enclosed private garden is a gorgeous place to sit in the morning or afternoon with the established garden. While the studio apartment is located on the same ground as the owners residential property it still felt private. Thanks Karina!

We stayed the weekend on a Birthday trip to explore the Barossa Valley vineyards. We were able to check in early and start exploring which was amazing. The house was beautifully presented, immaculately clean and a lovely welcome note with beautiful platter, wine (which you could also buy more of), dried meats and cheese ready for us on arrival. Lovely breakfast and room amenities were all top notch. Very comfortable bed to top it all off. We will be back!
Cute little place with a few extra thoughtful touches.
Clean, Tidy, great hospitality, loved every minute of it Thankyou
Great studio space in an excellent location. Very comfortable and quiet. Wine and snacks on arrival was a nice touch! Clear communication from Karina and everything was as described. Thanks Karina!
Lovely green outdoors, all the thoughtful touches
Great host very clean property. Cute little bed and breakfast.
A tremendous location to access the Barossa. The space was perfect and the welcome cheese board and bottle of wine just top it off. Will 100% stay again.

The unit was clean and cosy. There were lots of thoughtful touches such as a lovely cheese board, wine and breakfast fixings. The private courtyard was the perfect place to sit and enjoy the stars with a glass of wine. Thank you so much for a wonderful mini stay.

A great little place to spend a few days exploring the Barossa region. The bottle of wine and local produce platter on arrival were a great treat. It’s a little bit further from the centre of town, but it’s in a quiet and private location.
Great location. Central to all wineries. Great hosts. Very clean and private. Had a great stay.
Lovely studio unit in a handy location, well equipped and  comfortable. Our very thoughtful hosts, provided a complementary bottle of wine and many other local treats. Very happy to recommend.

My stay at Fechner Place was just perfect!  The guest house was big and relaxing, the bed comfortable and the courtyard was so pretty...a perfect place to enjoy the complimentary bottle of wine and cheese platter which was my favourite part!  The continental breakfast was delicious and I enjoyed every part of my stay.  I also got to meet the hosts by chance when I was checking out and they were friendly, kind and thoughtful.  Would definitely recommend and I would stay here again.  The accommodation is walking distance to the Main Street and to some of the wineries.
Awesome place. Very private. Great location.
Lovely hosts, convenient location

We absolutely adored this beautiful bnb, it had everything you could possibly ask for. It was immaculately clean, in the perfect location and was very stylish. We were treated to a beautiful platter on arrival with delicious cheeses, meats etc as well as a lovely bottle of wine. Check in was a breeze and Karina was very speedy in replying to messages, giving recommendations when we asked where we should have lunch. The bnb had its own private courtyard and while it was a little chilly for us to enjoy it, it would be lovely to enjoy once the weather warms up. We were pleasantly surprised by the selection of breakfast items that were available for us to enjoy, as well as fresh fruit and bread and homemade biscuits and jam. We would highly recommend this to anyone looking to get away for a couple of days, next time we would love to stay for even longer! Thank you for providing the perfect air bnb service, we would love to visit again someday soon.
Great place to stay, very clean and everything we needed was there. Very modern and stylish accommodation in a quiet location.

It was a bitterly cold day when we arrived and were pleasantly surprised to find they had turned the heater on for our arrival. The place was small and cosy but had ample room and storage for clothes.
The location was prefect, a little off the beaten track but still close enough to walk to local restaurants and wineries. Must add a little shout out to Langmeil Winery both staff and wines were amazing and only a 10 minute walk. If you decide to drive try

A lovely quiet studio apartment in the outskirts of Tanunda with good sized bathroom and all you need for a night or two away from home. Clean, warm and comfortable for our wet and wintery stay. The platter and wine were a nice added extra.

We absolutely loved our weekend away. Sparking clean and everything we had hoped for. The wine and cheese upon arrival was above and beyond. Very nice personal touches. Just a short walk from wineries and the town centre. We would happily stay again!

What a lovely Airbnb! Private, comfortable and lots of beautiful extra touches that made us feel special. Sat enjoying the delicious cheese board with a glass of wine in the private courtyard . Many thanks

A great bnb - beautifully decorated, clean and comfortable. The supplies were very generous and the bottle of wine was a lovely touch. Already booking our next visit
- Excellent hosts!
A very charming, value for money, studio. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and the thoughtful and personable touches that were made for us as guests. Thank you-we will be back.

Ann and Chris were wonderful hosts. We really appreciated all the local information and flyers available to us and I loved the flowers in the bathroom - a beautiful personal touch.  The space was cosy and comfortable. Everything was spotless and very welcoming and the courtyard garden was a mini paradise.  The birdlife in the mornings made my heart sing.  It didn't bother us that we weren't super close to the main road - the Barossa needs to be seen by car anyway so wasn't a problem at all. Would highly recommend this lovely studio.
Great place very clean and a lot of thought went into making it comfortable for guests.
Very cute! Perfect for a quick overnight stay and great value for money. Recommend
Lovely place to stay
This is our second stay in this lovely home. Very cosy and stylish with everything you could need. Can't wait to come back!
Beautiful accommodation - clean, quiet, with very comfortable bed and wonderful patio. Generous provisions. Very relaxing stay, and would readily return.

We were so fortunate to choose Fechner Place in the Barossa Valley to stay whilst exploring the area for my birthday 🎉 Everything was exactly as shown on the website but the experience was way more!!! Little touches like the grazing platter as you arrive and your choice of a delicious bottle of red or white wine from the region made all the difference. The little bunch of flowers 🌸 in the bathroom also made us smile 😊 The studio was beautifully clean with a lovely outdoor garden area to sit and enjoy the wine and food platter 🍷🍷🍷 As for the location, that was perfect too, as we were close to amazing restaurants as well as just a short drive to all the surrounding vineyards and local attractions like Maggie Beer’s Farm Shop. Thanks again for being our wonderful hosts 🙏
Great private space that is a generous size and short walking distance from town
Absolutely gorgeous place with all you need for a weekend getaway, lovely little courtyard to relax in, great location to explore, very close to restaurants and wineries.

My wife and I stayed here for a few nights and it was absolutely fantastic. Short walk to restaurants and cafes, short walk to amazing wineries. It was perfect.
The room was quiet, comfortable and spacious. The hosts went above and beyond to look after us, we will definitely stay again when we’re back in the Barossa.
Karina's place is exceptionally clean and within a 20 min walk into Tanunda.  The thoughtful touches of wine, a platter of nibbles and biscuits were a lovely surprise.  A fantastic place to stay.
Lovely stay! Close to some fantastic wineries too

Karinas place was the perfect place to stay while touring the Barossa. The little thoughtful touches such as a personalised card to welcome us, a complimentary wine and a platter to enjoy made it that little bit more enjoyable. Would definitely stay here again.
A lovely, clean and cozy studio in the perfect location for exploring the Barossa. Highly recommend.

Such a stylish well thought-out studio. Best sleep I’ve had in ages, great linen and many special touches including flowers. The welcome platter with local products and chilled bottle of white were greatly appreciated and enjoyed. Communication from the host was outstanding and the welcome note and guest booklet to the point and an easy go to reference. Breakfast provisions were generous and yummy and morning coffee in the private courtyard/garden stunning - added enormously to the scope of the space. Ice in the freezer was a big plus.  Will be highly recommending to friends and family. Already planning my return visit.
Beautiful guest house, we loved the complimentary cheese platter and wine we enjoyed in the courtyard. Very close to wineries and restaurants. Will definitely book next time we come back
We had a wonderful stay here. Bottle of wine and cheese board on arrival was lovely. Would happily stay again 🙂

Great location, comfy, clean and well appointed. We really enjoyed the quiet location with the private courtyard. A bottle of lovely wine and a platter made us welcome and relaxed. Very thoughtful, everything provided, couldn’t ask for more. Definitely will stay again.

Simply can't recommend this place more highly!!
We had a wonderful time here. Walking distance to the main restaurant/bar/cafe area in Tanunda, beautiful space to return to after a day of visiting wineries.
Arriving to nibbles and wine was just such a lovely touch after a long drive and the bed feels like you're sleeping in a cloud. Can't wait to return soon!

Thankyou so much for a great stay. A beautiful studio with everything that you will ever need.
Not only was the accommodation spotless and comfortable but all the little touches such as continental breakfast, cheese platter and wine were a lovely surprise.
If you are looking for a perfect little spot for your Barossa base then don't miss this gem.

Great stay at Karina’s place in Tanunda, after tossing up the Novatel or a B & B we made the right decision.  Spotless and comfortable, amazing surprises on arrival that I won’t spoil, a short stroll to Langmeil, Peter Lehmann’s and the best bakery around, a little further into the town centre and a great selection of restaurants, parked our car for the whole stay.  We will be back 3 nights was not enough Thankyou for your hospitality Karina, Chris & Ann be sure to stay with these local legends 👍

thank you for having us. we had an amazing time. value for money was fantastic. Chris and Ann are so accommodating. Chris went out of his way to help us get our wine posted from SA to NSW. we will definitely be back and recommending to others!! cannot recommend enough
Nice, relaxing and super clean getaway
Can't fault anything at all. Super clean, lovely linen and fluffy towels, welcome cheese platter and wine, good shower, amazing communication. 12/10 would stay again
We had a fabulous time at karinas place! All of the breakfast food, cheese platter and wine they left us was such a beautiful touch that made our stay in the Barossa that much better! Thank you
Great stay!! Cute cosy studio, thoughtful touches, everything you might need is provided 😊

A great spacious studio apartment with a lovely garden and generous hosts who provided a bottle of wine and a delicious  breakfast. Within walking distance of the main Street of Tanunda and some wineries (David Franz etc). Good location to use as a base to explore the Barossa. Really enjoyed our time here.

It was a lovely stay. Easy parking and cozy space with all the essentials & more provided. We also greatly appreciated the personal touches such as our names on the welcome card, complimentary wine produced by the hosts themselves, and a cheeseboard. Thank you for the Barossan Hospitality!

A great place to stay while in the Barossa. The studio has everything you need and was spotlessly clean. Extra touches of wine and platter of local produce made it so welcoming and there is a lovely little courtyard to sit out in and enjoy your morning coffee. It’s close to great wineries and restaurants, we’ll definitely be back and highly recommend for a weekend getaway.
Great little base for wine touring in the Barossa, everything we needed and city place to rest after a few long days out. Only improvement would be wifi but we did fine without!
We had a great stay. We loved the comfy bed and soft towels. The antipasto platter was perfect after a day of travelling.
Very comfortable and pleasant stay
an amazing stay was had.     this would have to be one of the very best airbnb's we have stayed in and we have stayed in many.

We had a great stay at Anne and Chris' place (hosted by Karina) it was a comfy space, well laid out and thought out and had everything we needed for a great stay. We really appreciated the little thoughtful touches, extra towels, sweet treats and the room being warm for us on a super cool day when we arrived. Thank you :-)

A gorgeous place to stay, the wine and generous platter of local produce was wonderful to arrive to! Beautifully decorated and cosy, great check-in process and very private. Well located as well to visit local wineries and restaurants. Highly recommend it to couples looking for a Barossa getaway!

Such a beautiful, cozy and clean place to stay in the Barossa. Karina, Chris and Ann were so accommodating ensuring our stay was the most comfortable. From the complementary wine and cheeseboard to the the beautiful courtyard, it’s a must stay. We will be back !

Exceptional bed & breakfast, beautiful location quality soft furnishings and a high level of cleanliness. Loved the wine & cheese platter being included.
Excellent communication with host.

Beautiful little spot, in a great location. Place was clean and comfortable. Was great to receive some nibbles and wine on arrival. The bed was amazing and we had a great nights sleep. Took 10 minutes to walk to the Main Street of Tanunda. Thanks for a great stay
Fantastic location and great hospitality from the hosts

Great location on edge of town meant it was quiet but we walked into town for dinner.  Very clean and well provisioned for breakfast.  The courtyard would be lovely in summer but was a bit chilly to sit out when we visited!   Excellent communication from host
Beautifully presented accommodation with with some lovely treats.
Great little place. Perfect location for exploring the Barossa. Set on the edge of Tanunda it was super accessible to wineries.

This unit was absolutely fantastic, comprising large entrance, spacious bathroom and bedroom living area. Immaculately clean, very quiet and in a great location within easy access to everything we had planned to do in Tanunda and the surrounding area. The bedroom / living area overlooks a beautifully planted private courtyard. We enjoyed the snacks that were provided and would love to return.
lovely location, clean rooms and beautiful little garden that was perfect for a coffee in the morning and a wine in the afternoon, beautiful birds flying and singing in and out too.
Peaceful well appointed studio. Close location to the town, 20 min walking
Such a perfect little studio in a great location. So many thoughtful touches and inclusions. Would highly recommend to any couple visiting the region.
Lovely stay, beautiful clean home. Lovely outdoor area. Beautiful breakfast supplies, wine and nibbles on arrival
Beautiful property with attention to detail extremely clean with everything you need for a short stay. The wine and platter on arrival was a lovey touch, we absolutely loved it.

Such a beautifully presented studio - we were very happy to come back and relax after a day exploring the region. The lovely, fresh breakfast provisions and complimentary wine were a great touch and the courtyard provided a perfect spot to relax with a coffee or book. The hosts were also incredibly helpful and accommodating when our travel plans had to change slightly last minute.
Will definitely stay again.

Really enjoy this place ……. wonderful quiet location, close to the heart of Tanunda.
So many small touches including generous snacks, breakfasts and a lovely platter and wine to welcome us.
It’s a definite recommend from me.
Amazing place to stay. Only regret is that I didn't stay longer.
Beautiful little bnb, great location within walking distance to town and a few wineries. The foods and wine was a lovely touch. Would highly recommend to anyone.
Absolutely gorgeous accommodation & very clean, such a quiet peaceful place to come back to at the end of the day.
Everything was perfect! The place was spotless, so close to restaurants and wineries. We had our newborn with us, it was easy for us to go around. Will stay again❤️
Great place, location and hosts. Highly recommend.
Highly recommend staying here - a lovely place, centrally located. Very much appreciated the generous supplies. Would definitely return.

We loved our stay at this beautiful studio! It was so cosy and warm. We loved returning to the peace and quiet after a full day out at wineries. I loved reading my book and enjoying an afternoon tea to the sound of the birds in the courtyard. Walking distance to some wineries and to town. A great selection of delicious goodies that lasted us the 3 days! Would definitely recommend.
Perfect for a short getaway with my husband, highly recommend

A beautifully appointed studio for a couple visiting the Barossa. The hosts have thought of everything. It’s a quiet and extremely comfortable place, easy to get to and within walking distance of the shops and restaurants. A few wineries close by too. The welcome goodies were a lovely touch with all the comforts of home. Bright and modern, lovely private courtyard we couldn’t use because of the wet weather so we will just have to visit again!

This is a truly beautiful, quaint little place to stay. It has everything you need, with the centre of town only a stones throw away (some cellar doors even closer!). The communication is excellent and the breakfast topped off an wonderful couple of nights. Would highly recommend staying here!

The only bad thing about staying at Karinas place was I didn’t get to meet the lovely lady.. Everything was perfect and felt like a part of the extended family if we ever needed anything.. Very Welcoming place with a very cute courtyard would definitely stay again!

We had a wonderful weekend.  The accomodation was perfect and the little extras were a wonderful added touch.  Would definitely recommend staying here.  The hosts were very helpful and responsive.  Thankyou ☺️
Lovely and clean, enjoyed our stay

Beautiful place in a nice quiet secluded street.
Close to lots of restaurants and amazing wineries
Lovely clean and small studio to stay. Hosts were good with communication and food extras were appreciated.
Exactly as described- a classy, well decorated studio with everything you need for a romantic getaway. Hosts were warm and inviting, and we’ll definitely be back when we visit the Barossa next.

Such a lovely space for a short getaway in the Barossa. The complimentary bottle of wine and continental breakfast were a lovely Suprise. Easy walk to the Main Street of Tanunda and an easy walk to a number of lovely cellar doors. Excellent local recommendations. Quiet and private courtyard was lovely for an evening drink as the sunset.
A great weekend getaway spot.
Really nicely appointed studio with some lovely extra touches!
It is a lovely quiet spot in a great location. The light brekkie and cheese platter were very yummy. Thank you.

We had originally booked a 3 night stay at Fechner place but unfortunately due to an urgent family situation we could only stay for 1 night.
It’s a beautiful place, with one of the best welcome packs we have experienced at airbnbs. Spotlessly clean and very comfortable. We will return to fully appreciate the area and the accommodation.

The studio had such a welcoming vibe when we arrived - heating and lamps on to make it cosy, complimentary wine and delicious cheese and nibbles waiting for us. The bed is super comfy, and there is a gorgeous courtyard to enjoy a glass of wine or morning coffee. Lots of lovely little touches too - a hair straightener as well as hair dryer, pod coffee machine - everything needed for a home away from home. Ann was lovely to deal with. It was a quick visit and just a taste of the beautiful Barossa Valley. We will definitely be back and would happily stay here again
Thank you for an extremely comfortable stay. Lovely treats upon arrival. Will definitely stay again.

We had a wonderful stay in this studio apartment in the Barossa Valley.  Communication was excellent and the accommodation exceeded our expectations.  We really appreciated all the extras that were included and it made our stay extra special. Thank you for providing such wonderful accommodation. We look forward to returning.

This was such a great place to stay. We were in Tanunda for a wedding and were so lucky we snagged this spot. It was clean, beautiful, and quiet, and the hosts put in all this little touches that made our stay all the more wonderful. There was even a hairdryer and hair straightener that made getting ready for the wedding so much more convenient!

The studio was well presented and well equipped. Karina and Ann provided a lot of information about the local area and their communication was always prompt. We appreciated the attention to detail and little touches such as the welcome platter and continental breakfast and the later than typical checkout was an added bonus! The studio was well laid out and exactly what we needed for a couple of nights away!

The best AirBnB we've ever been to, and it's a real BnB too. It's really well featured and very clean & tidy. The bottle of wine, the small platter, and light breakfast was just right, and really appreciated. The little courtyard is absolutely beautiful. We wish we had another night to enjoy it properly. By the way, the photos don't do the little courtyard justice.
We're from Queensland, and if we've ever back in the Barossa, we would definitely stay at Fechner place again.
Thank you.

We really enjoyed our stay at Karina's place.  It more than adequately suited our needs while in the Barossa for a wedding and needing a comfortable and convenient place to come and go from.  The wine and cheese plate and little extras were much appreciated.
Just lovely everything was terrific

Absolutely beautiful place to stay for a few days. Great location for Tanunda and exploring Barossa Valley. Spotlessly clean, and lovely touches with snacks and bottle of wine to enjoy. Host was super friendly and very responsive. Will definitely stay here again next time we visit Barossa and will recommend without any hestitation to anyone wanting a lovely & quaint accomodation for your stay in Barossa.

What an amazing place! 
So welcoming hosts and the studio was lovely decorated, lots of reading material, the bed was soft with loads of pillows - I could go on and on.
Entering the studio there was a lovely spread of fresh bread, wine and snacks, with even more waiting in the fridge.
I was traveling alone over Christmas, and Karina and Chris was very warm and caring, even leaving a Christmas card and a box of chocolates on my doorstep. Would definitely go back and even stay longer. 
If anything, if there was a bike available it would make getting around easier without a car (Tbf, I didn't ask for this, so they might already have one)
Lovely studio, well organised, clean etc. Supplies provided (coffee, milk, juice, cereal etc) were greatly appreciated.  Bed was comfortable, little outdoor space was lovely too.  Highly recommended!

This place delivers on everything it promises: privacy, comfort, cleanliness, excellent location (best spot to stay if you’re exploring the Barossa) and a very responsive & attentive host! The Brekky options including the Nespresso coffee machine supplied meant we could have a good feed before hitting the road for a full day of wine tasting! Thank you Karina, we will certainly be back again.

Great location, exceptionally clean and beautiful courtyard.
On arrival we were welcomed with a cheese plate which was a great way to start the weekend.
Thank you for having us
Very quiet and peaceful. Close enough to everything we needed as well.

Our visit was enjoyable. The property had a nice ambience, was very comfortable and clean. It was in quiet place but not far from town.  Snacks,  wine and breakfast were a valued addition. Quick help was provided when needed.
Great spot, flexible host and beautiful, perfectly clean studio
Ann & Chris were excellent hosts going beyond & above with their hospitality. A lively stay, would highly recommend in a beautiful setting & environment. I’ll be back.
