Such a beautiful stay at the cottage , it was very warm and cosy. You won't find a better view in the Barossa !
Great place in a rural setting, just what we wanted.
The house is clean, various breakfast items for us to enjoy.  We enjoyed our stay.

Petra's House, was quaint and the photo's were exactly what we expected. Great position close to all the winery's. The house was situated in lovely quiet street, among the vineyards. Heating was great.
Scenic, quiet location.
Great little cottage in a great location!
Loved the breakfast
Beautiful stay, very clean, great peaceful location. Lots of character in an old cottage. Amazing location and a perfect retreat for a weekend with family! Will be back!
great stay for our first trip in Borossa!

Local historic house
Close to wineries

We loved our stay and the location of this Airbnb!
The property was very clean and there were lovely thoughtful things like German cookies, milk, breakfast available. Really helpful to also have the option for a later checkout.
A lovely cottage in the heart of the Barossa. Close to great restaurants and fabulous wineries we will be definitely booking again for our next trip to this wonderful part of South Australia

Thanks for a lovely stay at Petras House. We loved this historic cottage in vinyard surroundings.  Petras House has a very homelike feel and is well set up with everything you need for a pleasant stay.  The house has many original features. Beds were comfortable. We were only there for one night but wish we could have stayed longer! Sibylle was very helpful, responded quickly to queries, and we particularly appreciated the special arrangements for early check-in so we could get to our concert. We certainly hope to return for a longer stay one day.

Wonderful old house, lovingly decorated to suit the style of the building. Contained everything for an enjoyable stay and the bed was the most comfortable we’ve found in any accommodation we’ve ever stayed at. Perfect location to explore the Barossa . Looking forward to returning for a longer stay.

Great old house with period furniture in between the grape vines. Close to Nuriootpa and the wineries. Would recommend to people wanting this type of accomodation. I would stay there again if up in the Barossa.
Absolutely loved this well presented home! Highly recommend!
Nice cozy space. Traditional Australian house built in early 1900s. Beautiful stars at night, but quick drive to the shops and restaurants. Would recommend.

Wonderful place to stay in the Barossa, a short drive to all the little towns scattered across the Barossa Valley. Sibylle was very welcoming & proactive. Our stay was all we had hoped for. We loved the serenity & peacefulness of staying in a 1910 cottage on the edge of a vineyard on a quiet road. The sunsets were magnificent & the stars were amazing. If we are ever back in the Barossa we know where we want to stay - Petra’s House.
Conveniently located near some wonderful Barossa wineries. Only stayed the one night, which suited our needs. Food provisions were left for us, which was appreciated.

This historical house is in a lovely peaceful location amongst the vineyards. It is only 15mins drive to Tanunda. To me it felt like I was staying at my Grandma’s house- it is homely and welcoming with old style furniture and original fittings. The host generously supplies ample ingredients for a simple breakfast. The beds are comfortable and the shower water was hot.
A delightful old house with beautiful old world decor but all essential amenities and a wonderful setting.

We enjoyed a an absolutely lovely two night stay at Sibylle's wonderful 'Petra's House'. Communication with Sibylle was easy and helpful, and we could not find fault in the homeliness of Petra's House. The air-conditioner was easy to keep the house warm as the temperature dipped in the evening, and the kitchen had all the equipment and amenities we needed for our short stay. The garden and surrounds are absolutely beautiful, and we enjoyed sitting amongst it with a cup of tea as the sun set. We would not hesitate to rebook when next in the area. Thank you, Sibylle!
Great place to stay, with excellent breakfast provisions.
This place has stood the test of time & is a charming place to stay if you like a slower pace. Close to good restaurants while staying in county peace & quiet
The house was quiet clean and comfortable, sybelle went out of her way to provide bread and other which was much appreciated
if you're looking for a reasonably priced 1910's house near Nuriootpa then this is the one. Sybrill is an excellent commutator who went out of her way to assist. Would happily stay here again.

Lovely old cottage. Central heating was great and really necessary. It doesn’t flow through to the toilet and bathroom though so it was a little chilly going to the loo. Kitchen had everything we needed, milk, cereal, bread, boiled rain water in the fridge. Bed was really comfortable and the location very central to all things Barossa. Sibylle also left us a bottle of wine from the property for our anniversary which was a nice touch.

The cottage was very quaint and as described. The central heating was much appreciated as it would’ve been quite chilly without!
A nice place to stay for the night.
Comfortable beds, good central heating, older style kitchen and bathroom. Quiet location.
A warm staycay in the Barossa, felt very homely, calm and a warm cosy bed!easy to find, amazing host and so many things to do and see around! we will be back!
Everything you need you will find here. Was lovely and warm.
Lovely old cottage only a  few minutes drive from Nuriootpa and Angaston. Generous breakfast supplies and even got a bag of lemons to take home!
Great character with information about the house's history. Quaint and very warm during a cold winter weekend.
Very cute house in a beautiful location! Lovely host who looked after us very well. Thank you Sybille!
only had an overnight stay in cold weather,  a week in summer would be ideal.

We had a really good overnight stay at Petra's House.  Sibylle had left all we needed for a great breakfast - which immediately makes you feel very welcome.  The bed in the room we used was very comfortable and the central heading took the edge of a cold Barossa night and morning.  Petra's House is on the northern end of the Barossa, but no where is far from anywhere in that gorgeous part of the world and from there, we enjoyed Angaston markets, great coffee, good wine and Barossa foody products.  Can recommend.
Charming old cottage in a great location. No issues experienced! Cozy.

We really enjoyed our stay at Petra’s house. The location is perfect for exploring the Barossa vineyards and is really quiet. The house has been beautifully preserved and we loved the history notes Sibylle left for us. Sibylle was flexible with our check in and left everything we needed for breakfast each day, even dropping off fresh bread for us half way through. She left us some other thoughtful goodies and let us check out late. We would recommend Petra’s house to anyone needing a reasonably priced base in the Barossa. We will return!
Lovely spot to stay with plenty of space. Sibylle was easy to talk with and flexible.

Perfect spot to experience the peace and beauty of the Barossa countryside while close enough to town for dinner, grocery shopping etc. All the basics for breakfast were provided, plus a delicious apple cake which made us feel so welcome.

Excellent place to stay in the Barossa Valley. Beautiful home which has been maintained to original condition. Very comfortable and warm. Loved the cereals, condiments, sourdough bread left for us. Close to Stockwell Hotel which was great for dinner.
Would come back again!
Apart from a couple of small things the place was excellent.

We had a great stay, the property is a beautiful cottage built in 1910, and has a great country feel, as well as being surrounded by vineyards. Provisions were left for breakfast, and everything was as described.
Just like grandma used to make! A very good example of what it was like to grow up in this era. The place was quaint but clean tidy and cozy.

Charming country property furnished in the style of a traditional farmhouse of the Barossa but with modern trimmings like air conditioning and inside toilet and bathroom! Set among vineyards, and with outdoor seating on two different verandas, we were spoilt for choice at happy hour..
had a great stay, the house was very cute & comfortable. Close to some great wineries & the Barossa markets. very enjoyable stay.

Cute old cottage from the 1910’s. Close to heaps of wineries to drive through during the day and walking distance to the willows winery in the afternoon. Beautiful sitting outside amongst the vineyards. Excellent range of included breakfast options also.
A lovely house in a lovely setting, we were very pleased with Sybille’s communication.
A beautiful area and lovely clean cottage.

We just loved our stay at Petras Place. A beautiful old cottage with so many lovely original touches. We found the place easily with Sibylles instructions and easy to access. The bed was super comfy and the ducted air conditioning was very effective. Would definitely recommend.
This quaint cottage was a delight to stay in - pictures look exactly like it was in person.. Sibylle was easy to communicate with as well.

We enjoyed our weekend at this classic Barossa cottage. Very comfortable, spacious and a generous array of provisions provided…even some freshly picked apples.
Great communication with Sibylle at every stage. Thank you.

It is a Typical early Australian home with high ceilings, two large bedrooms, a modest-sized lounge room, and a period kitchen with modern touches and period furniture and decor.  Quiet surrounds with very little traffic and a 6-minute drive into town. Would happily choose this place again.
A lovely peaceful and comfortable home.   We loved that the decor was of the time it was built. Thank you Sybille for all those little extras! What a great Easter!

Sibylle was very helpful & friendly from the start. The house is old but very well maintained and everything you may need available. Beautiful scenery of the vineyards when sitting out on the porch. The breakfast included was very much appreciated. Thank you for having us :)

We really enjoyed our stay in Petra’s house at Light Pass. The property has been kept in the original style and charm and maintained well. Sibylle was very proactive and easy to communicate with throughout our stay.
Quiet location but close to town for supplies. Like a step back in time, sympathetically decorated to keep the antique vibe. Plenty of provisions supplied.
A beautiful place to stay with a wonderful host. Sibylle advised what to do and where to go. The house was lovely and we lived sitting outside watching the birds in the morning sun. Fantastic.
Very homey and clean! Such a beautiful place to stay
Gorgeous stay in the Barossa. Quaint cottage with peaceful surrounds. Close to great wineries and local town centres. Sibylle was a good communicator. Would recommend to others.

Such a nice place to stay, beautiful vineyard views.
Heating worked very well which was great as it was a bit cold when we visited.
Thanks Sibylle.
Old country house in the middle of the vinyards. Quiet and relaxed. Not modern but very comfortable, warm and had all the basics needed for a night in the Barossa.
Absolutely loved it! Magical house in a perfect location!
Great location and quaint stay, thanks Sibylle!

Had a great few days holiday at 'Petra's' the location is fantastic and close to all towns , you will need car but the next town is only 5 mins away. The house itself is just wonderful, full of heritage and so quaint.
Sibylle was great to deal with , and the check in/out process was easy.
We stayed in a cold snap and the heating worked great, but pack socks to dash to the loo. Had the hottest shower of my life too .
10/10
Neat and tidy old homestead.  Comfy beds. We felt it was a bit overpriced for the one night.

Petra’s House has the feel of a country farm cottage.

We had a wonderful stay and can’t wait to return! 11/10

charming place, beautiful location. heating very good, comfortable lounge.

the pictures stuck to the walls are not a great look
. the notes stuck to the walls would be better if typed up in a folder with lots of other local info, taxis etc.
Great little spot and walking distance to two great little wineries! Really enjoyed our time at the Willows sitting on the balcony and sampling the fine drops.

An enchanting early 20th Century house with period furnishings. We had plenty of space to relax and the house is well located for accessing the Barossa attractions. We felt at home in the house. Highly recommended.

Great location for anyone visiting the Barossa Valley; very private place. Sibylle was easy to communicate with.
Whilst mindful that we were in a 1910s house in the country, we had to deal with a few unexpected insect issues. This somewhat took away from the experience.

No disrespect to the host, the stay is in a great location and we appreciated the charm of the house. Thank you Sibylle for having us!
Staying at Sibylle’s house was easy and quaint. Good location just slightly out of Nuri, surrounded by vines. Sibylle was easy to communicate with and gave clear instructions. Would highly recommend!
Cute cottage stay in Barossa. Thanks for having us!

Petra's Cottage was a quaint step back in time.
From querky hand written notes that added to an adventure of discovery.
Beds were comfy, but top sheets would be nice and perhaps suggest quilts that fit the size of mattress as if two people were sharing the bed it would be a struggle.
Spacious and quiet cottage located next to a vineyard and easy access to everything in the Barossa Valley.
Good location, old building charm. Bathroom older style. Living room feels a bit closed and musty

A beautiful, quaint cottage in the heart of the Barossa. We loved Petra’s Place - we felt right at home and our host, Sibylle, kindly left plentiful breakfast provisions for us. The kitchen was well-equipped and the lounge room was comfortable - and decorated for Christmas, which was a lovely touch!
We would love to come back for our next Barossa holiday.

We enjoyed the location and how comfortable we felt as soon as we walked in, beautiful scenery, loved the decor, felt as if I was walking Into my grandma's house. Great place for a peaceful get away in the Barossa
Historic home. Comfortable and charming. Great value

Quirky cottage, takes me back to staying at grandma’s house when I was a kid. It is an old house but everything works and we had a lovely comfortable stay. There were generous breakfast supplies which were very much appreciated. The location was perfect for our needs, very central and an easy drive to all parts of the Barossa Valley.
Sibylle was easy to communicate with and was very helpful and understanding when we asked if we could check in outside of the stated times.
We had a very enjoyable stay.

A little piece of yesteryear.
Nice quiet location but close to the main Barossa towns.
Comfortable beds. Good hot water. The weather was hot while we were there but the house cooled nicely.
If you're looking for a base in the Barossa this would be a good place to stay.

What an absolute gem! If you are looking for shiny stainless steel and state of the art forget it, this is not for you. But… If you want that old world charm beautiful antique furniture really comfortable surroundings, this place has everything you need. So quiet nestled in amongst the grapevines. Just a wonderful place to get away.

A charming cottage! Peaceful location, but very driveable to everything. Excellent and thorough communication, generous breakfast provisions. A really traditional cottage filled with character... very special. Highly recommend.

We really enjoyed our stay at Sibylle’s lovely house. It was full of character and history, and adjacent to lovely vineyards. She provides all the ingredients for a good breakfast, and most importantly, when we inadvertently left something behind, Sibylle went out of her way to return it to us, meeting us at a rendezvous and refusing any reimbursement for her trouble! What a kind host and a comfortable stay.
Highly recommended, would love to go back
Gorgeous little original cottage in Barossa.
Great communication. Neat and tidy cute house. Recommended stay
Sibylle’s place is a true historical gem in the Barossa. The beautiful veranda overlooking the vineyards and the well-equipped kitchen were our favourite features. We’ll definitely stay there again.
The ambiance of this place is amazing. I slept like a log.
So many thoughtful touches in this place and wonderfully quiet. A place to really get away from things.
Had a lovely stay for our anniversary, very clean and and spacious for two, great breakfast and warm hospitality from Evelyn

We had a brilliant one night getaway at Evelyns place. The unit is exceptionally clean, well furnished and comfortable. We stayed on a mid-30s day and the aircon was nice and cool. Views and surroundings are fantastic.
Nice quiet and relaxing get away with great amenities
Such a lovely spot, with special luxury touches. A perfect spot to stay to explore the Barossa. Would 100% stay again. Thank you, Evelyn.

Evelyn’s guest suite ticks all of th boxes! She has created a beautiful guest quarters in her new home that is stylish and spacious, comfortable,  and convenient to the many wineries and nearby small towns. Located in the countryside, there is peace and birdsong. She provided a wide selection of breakfast items, including eggs and bacon, honey from her hives, and other homemade items to round out a lovely breakfast. After two months traveling, her place ranked in the top three of our many Airbnbs. We highly recommend if you are thinking of visiting the Eden and Barossa Valleys!

Homely, clean and comfortable and Evelyn is very friendly and welcoming.
Thoroughly recommended!

The thought and care put into little touches around the place, like fresh flowers and produce, for example, make this space feel loving and cosy while being super clean, fresh and modern at the same time.
Evelyn asked ahead of time of any dietary requirements so I could happily get stuck in to all the treats provided, knowing my allergy had been considered.
I highly recommend this spot to any couples or singles in need of an escape to take a breath, Meander is perfect.

The place was beautiful! Nice and cosy winter nights with a hot tea was bliss 🥰. Beautiful scenery with lots of animals around. Evelyn had out done herself with the homemade products. Nothing better! Loved how she used the space with wooden furniture with touches or green and blue around.

This is the perfect place to relax and enjoy a warm welcome. We used Meander Retreat as a base for walking the Lavender Federation Trail. Perfect retreat after a day's hiking! Evelyn is a fabulous host.

We could not have imagined a better Winter stay - stunning accommodation, great breakfast, and the most lovely host. Evelyn made sure we had what we needed to fully relax and culminated with a bonfire and a bowl of yummy chocolate pudding. We were spoilt and will come back very soon! Thank you - best experience we’ve had in a long time.
This is a beautiful property and a very stylish studio. It’s the perfect location to explore the Barossa/Hills and get some country air. We highly recommend this stay.

Lovely spot on the edge of the Barossa. Evelyn is a great host, unobtrusive but attentive. Super clean, nice Asian decor touches, really warm in the winter, high ceilings and roomy. Chooks, veges, fruit in season and modern kitchen for own cooking. Lost an hour in the big bath after canoeing and walking around Warren Reservoir.
We have really enjoyed our stay. We will definitely recommend this place and will be back one day ourselves.

We had a great time staying at Meander. We love the house and the location. Evelyn is a very thoughtful and generous host. This was our second stay at Meander. We really enjoyed the extra trouble Evelyn went to - bonfire, after dinner drinks, the wood oven pizza. The location is perfect for exploring the Barossa wineries and walking the Lavender Trail. We look forward to another visit in the future.
Thanks Evelyn for a wonderful stay at your sparking cleaning retreat.  We enjoyed our stay in the quite Springton fields with the rolling hills and with the Barossa just down the road.   Peter & Prue

Evelyn's place is just perfect. Lofty ceilings, beautiful views, quality finishes, lovely host. We felt relaxed and pampered there. It was the perfect country getaway. Evelyn has thought of everything to make guests feel welcome and at home. We only wish we could have stayed longer! Thank you Evelyn.
This was our 3rd visit to Meander; we love staying here. Evelyn is a fabulous host!

We have really enjoyed our stay at Evelyn's place.  We love her place;  it's beautiful, well-equipped, comfortable and serene with a country feel.  It is great for a retreat!  She pays attention to details and we felt really well taken care of.  We highly recommend Evelyn's place and plan on returning.

Evelyn was such a lovely and accommodating host! We loved our farm stay and couldn’t recommend highly enough.
We loved the wine and chat, homemade jam, musli and farm eggs!
Thanks again Evelyn for a wonderful stay x

What a peaceful and relaxing spot! We loved every part of our stay from adventuring around the property, being greeted by doggo and chickens, relaxing with a wine under the gums and the amazing facilities. Evelyn is a lovely host who will make sure you’re well looked after but have your own space. She puts so many lovely touches into the property and we really enjoyed making our breakfast with local produce! Easy adventuring into the Barossa by car. Thank you again!

We loved our stay here over Easter. Evelyn is a lovely host and made us feel very welcome. the homemade bread and breakfast supplies were very much appreciated. I loved spending some time in the hammock with a local wine, under the gums, watching the orange butterflies against the blue sky in the breeze.  I can wholeheartedly recommend staying here!
Definitely you won’t regret to stay in this lovely place! The place is amazing! The host thinks about the smallest details that make the stay even more special! We loved so much everything!

Evelyn's property is absolutely heavenly! The location is superb and the love and care she puts into running her business is revealed in every detail of her spotless place. It was amazing to be able to enjoy a glimpse of the country life, especially the delights she offers such as the honey, the jam and the fresh eggs all produced locally in her property. I highly recommend her place and I would easily go back for another restorative stay.

Our stay at Evelyn’s was fantastic. She was so welcoming and her place feels so homely and secluded, we didn’t want to leave! From the little touches around the supplied baked bread and eggs from her chickens to her warm welcoming and hospitality I couldn’t recommend this getaway highly enough.

It was exactly what we wanted. Peace and quiet, away from our busy lives. Clean and spacious. My personal favourite part was he bath, I spent hours soaking in it. Meander cottage was super easy to find and check in was a breeze!

A fantastic and stylish stay in Springton! Evelyn is such a lovely host and her property is lovely. Her garden is beautiful and if you are keen on fully using the kitchen the vegetables and herbs that Evelyn offers add a wonderful touch to any meal.

Lovely clean, new space in a gorgeous part of SA. We really enjoyed the king bed, soft sheets, deep bath, modern shower, fresh produce & 11am checkout!
Just a heads up for the nudists out there & those going away for a 'romantic' occasion - the suite is attached to the main residence & there is an internal door between the two rooms, which is locked but we found a little unsettling 😉
Thanks for a lovely stay Evelyn.

A cute and comfortable little place to stay in the Barossa. Super quiet if you wanted to chill for the day like we did. Lovely orchard full of different fruit trees and veggies growing, sweet little doggy that liked to be in your company and a great big bath if you fancy a treat! We loved our stay, it was just what we needed
Thank you Evelyn.
We had a lovely quiet weekend away, peaceful little part of Eden Valley. Great bath, comfy bed and the breakfast was delicious. Would stay again 🙂
This is a fabulous place to stay. Evelyn is a wonderful host!!! We love staying here!!

Meander was a lovely place that was peaceful, very comfortable and welcoming. It is a place to unwind and rest.
Evelyn was extremely welcoming and kind and provided thoughtful touches throughout the suite.
I found it hard to leave and would love to stay again.
Lovely view to wake up to in the morning.  Home baked bread and jam with honey made by the hard working bees on Evelyn’s property all made our stay decadent.  Thank you!

Meander Retreat is a little GEM. Nestled in the Barossa Valley, Springton, away from the hustle and bustle, you'll see the stars and hear the birds and buzzing bees in Evelyn's beautiful gardens. The Green Room was beautiful and well appointed with many thoughtful touches including fresh flowers. A luxurious bathroom with rainfall shower head in shower and waterfall spout for the bath. King sized bed, well appointed, quality filled kitchen and we were given freshly baked bread for the next day's breakfast. If all these many touches weren't enough Evelyn offered to make us a pouch of bath salts, fresh lavender, rosemary and other delicious smelling herbs to add to our bath that night. The whole place is delightful and extremely well cared for. Well worth the visit.
A well thought out, clean tidy, light and airy private studio with space to cook, eat and sit as well as a comfortable bed. A good base from which to explore the Eden and Barossa Valley.
Another wonderful stay at Meander hosted by Evelyn. It was a pleasure as always, and we hope to be back soon!

Loved staying at Evelyns accommodation. We really relaxed, enjoyed the property, made our motorbike riding week all the better, being able to pull bikes out of van and wash them down too.
Loved the little goodies Evelyn made for us to enjoy too. Thank you.
It is a fantastic and peaceful place to stay. i would highly recommend it.

Exceptional host. Great place and a fantastic time.
Thank you so much! Best accommodation we have been to.

Evelyn’s place is a true hidden gem. I wish we had stayed longer than one night. The room was comfortable and made you feel right at home. Beautiful furnishings and the bathtub was truly gorgeous (Evelyn even left some salts to enjoy). The gardens are lovely. The provisions for breakfast were a generous provision. We will be back. 🙂

Evelyn was lovely lady, who responded promptly to any questions I had.
The room was really good & exactly what we needed, great modern bathroom.
Fantastic breakfast including muesli, fresh milk, the homemade bread, jams & honey made by Evelyn herself were delicious and made our stay just that little more special.
We would definitely stay there again
Thanks Evelyn

This place is so peacefully quiet and the bed so comfortable that we slept like babies through the night. It was cold outside at night, but the room stayed so comfortable warm with no heating running at all. The bath was large enough to fit my over-6 foot husband comfortably.
There was a large Moon but even so the stars are incredible out here.
Evelyn supplied us with freshly baked bread on the afternoon of our arrival, and combined with the jam, honey and muesli more than covered our breakfast needs. We found a firepit but be aware you will need to bring your own firewood for this. The room is very neat, comfortable and has everything you need for a short or long stay.
Thankyou Evelyn for letting us share your little piece of Paradise.
A peaceful and cosy stay! Even for one night, we felt right at home and rested. Evelyn is thoughtful, warm and responsive.

If I could give 6 stars I would! The most perfect stay! Bed was so comfortable, the room was so cosy and spacious and the bathroom was amazing! Homemade bread was such a special touch (and super delicious)
Thank you for having us Evelyn, we hope to be back soon!
am really pleased with Evelyn's cosy place, it has everything, it is clean, comfortable, slept very well, it is peaceful, would love to be back here the next time
Perfect space to relax and stay cool. Immaculate accomodation and Evelyn was absolutely wonderful.  Her sourdough bread was incredible.  We will definitely be back!
nice and peaceful. not near amenities so bring what you need with you. lovely  breakfast items including milk and fresh bread were provided.
Fantastic location and clean space
We had a great night in Springton. The house was clean, comfortable and cosy. There were clear instructions for check-in and use of amenities. Thank you Evelyn for the lovely stay :)
My partner and I had the most wonderful stay at Evelyn's place. Could not have asked for a more welcoming and accommodating host. We will definitely be coming back on our next Barossa adventure!

Meander Retreat is a wonderful place to visit and we will definitely be going back. The accommodation is perfect and accurately described. We booked both the Green Room and the Garden Studio for the 3 of us plus our whippet. There was a freshly baked loaf of bread there in each room on arrival with everything we needed for breakfast the following morning. Our dog enjoyed it too as she was able to safely explore the adjoining orchard which is fully enclosed. Evelyn was a delightful host. Thoroughly recommend this to all.
A beautiful cosy stylish retreat for 2. Enjoyed spa and outdoor  area. Great hosts.

57 studio was very clean and new, nicely designed and had a great space.
The location was central to Barossa Valley but not walking distance to Tanunda town centre.
We were abit disappointed that we didn’t meet Annemarie during our stay.

Lindsay and Anne Marie were very friendly hosts. A great little
Place to stay for a weekend in the Barossa. Clean, comfortable and the spa was an added bonus. Look forward to a beer with Lindsay when we are next in the region.
Beautiful little studio.
Great stay, hosts were very welcoming, would recommend to other guests.

We loved staying at Lindsay's apartment. It was beautifully decorated with lots of thoughtful touches. The shower, outdoor spa and kitchen were highlights, as well as the lovely bottle of wine on arrival. The location is perfect for exploring the Barossa too.
Highly recommended!
You'll enjoy a nice stay in the Barossa Valley. Nice and comfortable place, good location, friendly owners.
Nice little studio apartment in good location. Lots of pretty decorations and furnishings. Plenty of room for two people with a nice outdoor sitting area too.
lovely, stylish and cosy with nice extra touches, would stay again!
Most enjoyable place to stay, very clean & comfortable. Very friendly & accomodating hosts.  Would gladly stay again.
This place is as it is listed. Loved the place. Loved the Barossa

Studio 57 is a beautiful spot to stay and explore the Barossa. The location was perfect and the hosts were very helpful. The studio contains absolutely everything you need and is very comfortable. We didn’t want to leave!
clean, everything a couple would need, great hosts, very friendly.
Sparkling clean and beautiful. Better described as an up-market granny flat though, they've made every effort to make it private and have done very well. Just something for people to be aware of :)
Beautiful hosts and accommodation with everything you need. Spa was a special treat. Easy walk to main street of Tanunda. Also several wineries withing walking distance. Highly recommended!
Fantastic! So much more stylish than the photos could portray!

What a beautiful stay! The host is such a warm gentleman and very helpful!
We got a beautiful bottle of wine too!!!
We will definitely recommend this place and will definitely be back! X

Murnane's Studio 57 is very well equipped for a weekend away in the Barossa, either using it as a bedtime base or having some quiet time at the Studio. It is warm and cozy, very well set up, and aesthetically very lovely too.

The studio was spotlessly clean, well provisioned, modern and with everything working. It was perfect for our needs as a base from which to ride the Barossa Cycling trail. It's tastefully furnished,  comfortable and relaxing, in a quiet location. The wine and chocolate were most appreciated. Thank you, we recommend it very highly and would stay again!

For us this was just a stunning studio in a perfect spot for visiting some local wineries. From the moment we checked in we were greeted and given some tips on local places to eat and drink, the amenities and extra touches exceeded any expectations I could have had, and the studio itself was clean and modern and just perfect for a few nights away. I can't think of anything that could be done better at this spot and I would definitely stay again on another trip to the barossa.
This is a great place to stay if you want to explore the wineries of the area. The place was clean and comfortable. We really enjoyed our short break here.

Had the a fantastic 2 days away in this perfect little apartment. Had full ambition to go out and enjoy culinary delights of local restaurants and bars for days but felt much more comfortable staying in and in joying the unique atmosphere this little place had to offer !
Sparkling clean studio bedroom with all the amenities of a hotel and lots of little thoughtful touches such as local wine, chocolate, milk. Would definitely stay again.
Very comfortable and clean with amazing hospitality. Excellent value for money in ideal location

This air bnb was amazing! So much better than expected, the room is so  big - it’s like a self contained unit! So warm and comfortable. 我们非常失望，因为房源与平台上展示的图片和描述严重不符。房子的实际状况让人感到极度不安，尽管我们从墨尔本开了10个小时的车到达房源，在我们真的非常需要休息的情况下，我们甚至都不想考虑能否退款，只想着立刻离开。
1. 房源整体光线严重不足。这间房子里的灯基本都起不到照明的作用。我们在下午到达房源，房子里阴森极了，阳光没法进入，开了灯跟没开灯一样暗。尤其是走廊的灯无法使用（房东说会在我们退房的那天来修），晚上如厕需摸黑穿过长长的走廊，简直就是恐怖片。我们完全无法想象在这种环境下度过夜晚。
2. 房源需与另一栋房子共用车道，这让我们感到缺乏安全与隐私。后面那栋房子的陌生人需要从房源的两间卧室窗户还有卫生间旁边经过。明明有可以避开后面那栋房子出入的正门可以使用，但是却要求我们在后面那栋房子的注视下使用后门出入房源，我们只感到被监视，让人极不舒服。
3. 卫生间的真实状态与宣传照片明显不符。平台照片干净整洁、布置温馨，实地却显得异常昏暗陈旧，洗漱台水压异常，热水龙头无法正常出水，陈设也与宣传图不一致。更别说没有在宣传图中的厕所，更是异常黑暗、老旧。
4. 房内布置令人不安。次卧柜门无法关闭，卫生间旁的旧柜子令人惊吓，走廊上的挂画在昏暗灯光下更是令人不适。
5.房东宣传可以在黄昏时坐在花园阳台上品酒欣赏落日，但实际上阳台桌椅布满灰尘，已太久未被打扫，根本无法使用。
我们仅向房东反映了照明和我们真实体验到的问题，并建议她更新照片、改善照明、提升居住体验，但她的回应极具冒犯性，不仅否认问题，还攻击我们不会阅读、讽刺我们，这种态度让人非常难过。事实上，我们选择这间房源并不是因为价格，而是因为这是当时附近唯一看起来整洁、风格温馨的选项。价格从来不是我们最在意的因素，我们唯一的期望就是图片与实物相符，符合宣传。遗憾的是，房东在我们表达合理建议后却指责我们，这让我们感到被冒犯，也完全不符合Airbnb社区应有的尊重与理解。
虽然房源的地理位置不错，也能看出房东曾有意营造温馨氛围，但现实体验却令人彻底失望。建议未来住客慎重选择，也建议房东重新评估房源状况与描述的一致性。

This is an amzing property with breathtaking views of the vineyards. So close to the main street of Tanunda. The pool is heated to Spa temps and is enjoyable even on a chilly day. Make sure you check out both cellars. Truly a great stay.

Such an awesome little cottage.
Everything there that you need and only a short stroll into lovely Tanunda.

The cottage, location and view was stunning and hospitality beyond our expectations…The cellar was amazing and we tasted some fabulous wines made from the grapes off their own vineyard…It will certainly be somewhere we visit again and would recommend staying here to anyone…Can not speak highly enough of the cottage and hosts…
Thank you so much Scott, Craig & Jan, our stay at the cottage will be one we remember and have wonderful memories of…

We had a wonderful stay in the Barossa Valley at Rogasch cottage. The views over the vineyard were fantastic and we enjoyed the wildlife while relaxing on the deck.
The cottage had everything one needs for a very relaxing stay, plus the fireplace and plunge pool were a amazing treat.
We received a very warm welcome from Scott and Craig. They told us about the vineyard plus arranged a private tasting for us of the wines from the property. What a treat going into the underground cellar. We can highly recommend a stay at Rogasch Cottage.

Lovely. From the moment we arrived we felt welcomed and free to explore the beautiful little farm. The little cottage was clean and cosy and well stocked! The plunge pool was warm with a stunning outlook. We really enjoyed the stay. The personal and unique wine tasting experience topped it off. Definitely recommend staying and will definitely be back! Cheers

Stunning place to stay in a perfect location. I can’t say enough good things. The view over the vineyards over to the other hill as we sat in the pool watching sunset was simply magic. Really comfy beds and easy walk into town.
Made catching up with friends into a really special weekend. Thank you.oh and the forage supply co wine is really really good!
This is the one, just do it

Literally couldnt ask for anything more in a holiday!! The cottage outdid our expectations (and we'd been trying to get there for 2 years!)! Scott was an awesome host and was easy to contact the whole way through. The history of the cottage, the absolutely stunning view, the HOT TUB....cant rave about it enough. Love the philosophy of Forage co. And happy to drink ALL the wine for a good cause! Special shout out to Paws....our favourite wine-dog! Thankyou for giving us the best girls weekend!!
We had an amazing stay at Rogasch Cottage. Perfect location and the cottage is absolutely fantastic. Cannot fault this place!

What can I say this place is Absolutely amazing. It’s cozy and comfortable , it has the ammenities, it’s private and the view is absolutely amazing.
The wine cellar is really cool with plenty of wine and a night caps.
The only thing that let this place down was the floors were dirty, unwashed dishes when we arrived and full bins but other then that this place is amazing and well worth the money
Great place to stay with a fantastic view. The kids loved the pool and it was really warm and inviting.

Scott’s place was great, the back deck was absolutely beautiful. The property itself had some personal touches including some tasters of local gin and wine which was a nice bonus! In terms of location, it’s very walkable to the local town which is handy. Thanks for the great stay Scott!

Such a great place and only a stones throw to the Main Street of Tanunda.
Plunge pool overlooking the vines was amazing. Beautiful setting.
Comfy and massive beds too.
We had the most amazing stay ! Cannot recommend this enough!  Such a beautiful location and place to be away from home ! Thanks so much
Great location and very peaceful. Property in need of some repairs and could have been presented a little cleaner, otherwise a very enjoyable stay.
Thank you Scott for such an awesome stay. We loved everything about the cottage and will definitely come back next year!

My husband and I stayed here for our mini honeymoon from Perth. It was absolutely perfect, the pool is so warm and an incredible view over the vines. It’s a short walk into the main strip for dinner or drinks, or a food shop. Close to our favourite Barossa Wineries! Could not fault a single thing. It was bliss!

This beautiful property is exactly what you expect an amazing AirBnb to be. The beautiful warm plunge pool overlooking the vineyard is an obvious highlight. The kids absolutely loved it, as did us parents. The cottage is clean and comfortable, with lots of nice little touches throughout. The open fireplace with well-stoked wood, sorted by size was great. Complimentary wine, gin, port in the cellar were all just some of the touches. We were lucky enough to do a private wine tasting and vineyard tour with Scott and on top of the pool, it was an absolute highlight of our stay. His wines are amazing too. Would absolutely recommend to anyone. Worth every dollar.
Scott was an exceptional host, he went above and beyond to make sure our stay was perfect. The cottage is absolutely breathtaking and a truly special place to stay. We will be back!!

I cannot recommend Rogasch cottage enough! We spent 3 nights there with my parents who were visiting from overseas.
For starters the property is in town in Tanunda making it easy to walk to shops/restaurants but the privacy of the outlook onto the vineyard makes you feel a million miles away from anyone else and there is no noise at all. A truely unique combination of convenience and privacy.
The cottage had a fully equipped kitchen with sizeable fridge, cooker and hob and made self catering really easy for the slower mornings.
As many have mentioned the on site tour of the vineyards with a tasting is an absolute must! We were shown around by Craig and my parents are deadset this was the highlight of their 5 week trip to Australia! It’s great to do tastings at other wineries in the Barossa but nothing compared to this. The family is an absolute delight to spend time with (paws the dog included!) and they have a spark of showmanship that makes for a truely unique experience!

We absolutely loved our stay - couldn't recommend this accommodation highly enough. Scott's tour of the micro vineyard and wine tasting around the property was the highlight of our 5 day trip to the Barossa. The plunge pool is to die for and we adored spending afternoons and evenings watching the sunset over the vineyards. Best Airbnb ever! The hosts went above and beyond for us - we can't thank them enough for a very memorable stay with our family visiting from the UK. we were all blown away. Can't wait to come back!

This is the second time we’ve visited Tanunda in the Barossa and again it didn’t disappoint. Ragasch Cottage is a beautiful place on the most peaceful and accessible location.
The hosts are wonderful and I highly recommend a tasting of their beautiful wines. They have an extensive range of wines for a small vineyard and also the story of their wine, how it all started and how it supports a wonderful charity makes it extremely special. We thoroughly enjoyed hearing Craig speak about the property and cannot speak more highly about the wines we tasted, it was a real surprise!
The cottage is gorgeous and has a beautiful history, it’s well kept with lots of character. You will also love the plunge pool overlooking the vines, and enjoying magical sunsets. I highly
recommend Ragasch cottage for your Barossa stay.

This cottage is a fabulous place to stay in Tanunda. It is absolutely as beautiful as it looks in the photos - the view is just gorgeous! We loved sitting in the plunge pool watching the sunset over the vines. The main street of Tanunda is a very short walk away (about two minutes) but the property is very peaceful and private. There were lots of little extra touches to make us feel welcome and we LOVED the private cellar. What a unique experience! The beds are very comfortable in beautiful big, very quiet bedrooms. Just book it!! We would highly recommend Scott's place and would love to return one day.

We could not say better things about our experience at Scott's place! It was incredible.
The location was right off the main street, which made it easy to walk and access cafes in the morning. We were also in close proximty to many wineries which were only a short drive away (less than 5 minutes!).
We were greeted on arrival and felt right at home straight away. The house is even more beautiful than photos and as we had our 1 year old daughter with us, they brought two boxes of toys for her to play with, which was so lovely!
For parents who can't leave at night while our baby slept, the cellar was a fun activity and nice touch, the pool was great and they had a BBQ which we used to cook a meal at home instead of going out - it was great! I felt like I was staying in a resort and they had thought of everything that we could need (full length mirror in bedroom, wine glasses, decanter, local guides - the attention to detail was great).
Will definitely be back! Thank you.

It is rare to find accommodation that provides 5 star luxury with friendly, down-to-earth hosts. Scott, Craig, Jan and Paws have created a truely beautiful place to stay that has not only stayed true to the history of the property but is also a part of a business with sound social and environmental principles. Stunning views, beautiful cottage and great wines. Well done guys. We will be back.

We loved our stay at the cottage. it was immaculate and modern in an 1800 year old cottage with amazing views. This was our favourite AirBnB stay yet as not only was the cottage gorgeous in a fantastic secluded location while still being magically close to everything Scott, Craig and Jan were brilliant, warm hearted hosts who went above and beyond with Craig's tastings of the family wines the highlight of our entire trip. We would return again without hesitation.
Great location, beautiful site and nice an peaceful weekend
Fantastic location for a Barossa getaway. The accommodation is as described and pictured. Cot so conveniently provided for our little one and perfect for our stay!
We had a lovely stay nestled amongst the vines and close to tanunda Main Street. we would be happy to recommend and stay again

This was the perfect spot towards the end of our trip, beautiful and quite set within a vineyard! Scott was an amazing host, treated us to amazing wine tasting of the wines he produces, all espectacular!!
Tanunda it self is a nice small town with a lot of the wine making charm.
Highly recommend. Great host, excellent location, beautiful property. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay & would love to come back.
Fantastic place. Would recommend 100%

My husband and I loved Rogasch Cottage, it was amazing. The accommodation so comfy, great furnishings,  all you need in the kitchen,  modern bathroom and my favourite....the plunge pool overlooking the vineyard.  We had breakfast at Vino Lokal , lunch at Harvest Kitchen and a cheese platter at Maggie Beers.  Wonderful!

What a stunning perfect location!
The hilight is definitely the pool looking across the beautiful vineyards! So relaxing and tranquil and the location is close to everything you could want in the Barossa.
Would have been great to relax outside on some comfy table and chairs, so perhaps one small area of improvement to make the stay first class. 😉

Beautiful place really tastefully renovated to feel luxury and charming. The location itself is wonderful, you'd never know that you're in the centre of Tanunda within walking distance of amenities and restaurants. The pool is so warm so even on chilly days or evenings you don't miss out! We loved our stay and can't wait to go back.

Scott, Jan and Craig were such incredible hosts. The cottage is so convenient to wineries and walking distance to shops and restaurants. But the best part is the cottage - so beautiful, sitting in the heated pool, overlooking the vineyards. Just magic. Quiet, peaceful, comfortable bed, lovely shower, bath and a couple of supplies like wine, milk, coffee. We were so lucky to stay during the grape picking season. The Rogasch’s were so generous with their time showing us the process, a wonderful wine tasting and spent hours chatting with them. Generous and kind people hosting an unforgettable cottage destination! We will be back.

Awesome stay in a unique location. Loved the golf off the tee into the vineyard and the hot tub. The essentials - bed, shower, linen, kitchen - were all great. The extras on top such as the chocolate and gin were delightful too. Amazing location only steps from the town’s Main Street, kangaroos in the vines - seriously hard to fault. Worth the money and would highly recommend.
We call this place our “Happy Place”.  We design our trips around being able to stay here.  Enough said! :)
Incredible view and location, easy to walk to the main street - we had a wonderful weekend away. Thank you Scott

This cottage was absolutely fantastic.  Beautiful 2 bedroom, great kitchen and able to walk around the gorgeous vineyards. Just beautiful details in the place and very upscale.  Great views of the outdoors and very comfortable seating in the house to read and relax.  Within walking distance to the town and restaurants and shops.  Hosts were just so friendly and gracious.  We will definitely be back here.
Thank you so much for having us! What a beautiful place with so many nice touches. A beautiful stay, could not have asked for more thoughtful hosts! We will be back.

perfect place for a breather. All necessities were provided plus extras. View of the vineyard was stunning! soaking in the heated pool while watching the sunset was breathtaking. We enjoyed the golf as well. Our family had a fantastic time!

Hands down the best Airbnb we have ever stayed in. Travelled with my wife and young daughter, and it's hard to put into words how special this place is. It's a sanctuary where you are on a farm, but can walk into town in 5 minutes. The house has so much history, the beautiful architecture, the hidden cellars, the bath temp pool over looking the winery. Multiple fire pits, and ultimate relaxation. To top it off, Scott and his family treat you like royalty with their down to earth warmth and generosity. This place is magic and even better we now have extended family in the best wine region in Aus! We will be back as soon as possible.
Thanks again Scotty
Chris, Nicole and Frankie

Can’t quite find the right words to describe just how special this place is! We were greeted warmly by Scott, his dad and Paws the dog. Lucky for us our stay coincided with a Tasting Australia event at the property, which we were welcomed to and our two young kids accommodated for beautifully. It’s hard to believe this beautiful oasis is just a 5 minute walk from the centre of town. The pool was idyllic, the cottage luxurious and cosy, and Scott’s hospitality was second to none. My daughter and I loved our tractor ride through the vineyard with Scott and Paws :) And thrilled to have been introduced to Scott’s incredible Forage Supply Co sustainable wines and to learn about how this business supports community. Really inspiring stuff! We definitely hope to become regular visitors!

Amazing place to stay and excellent host, had opportunity to have a private wine tasting where we were staying which was amazing and one of the highlights of our trip so far also can’t forget paws she was an amazing host as well.
Thanks again for such an amazing experience

The heated plunge pool was what first attracted us to stay here, and it certainly didn’t disappoint. Fantastic views and peaceful surroundings meant that we spent a lot of time at the property rather than heading out. When we did decide to leave, the short walk into Tanunda was very convenient. The complimentary wine from the cellar was also a very nice touch. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and can’t wait to book again and come back.
Would definitely stay again!  Scott was very fast and helpful with recommendations. Place exceeded our expectations!  Thank you very much for sharing your beautiful home!
Beautiful place to stay, location was amazing
Great place to stay. Extremely clean and homely. The fireplace is fantastic!
Thanks Scott and team … wonderful stay.

Rare and unique opportunity to enjoy a rural setting within a short walking distance to Tanunda's main street, including nearby restaurants, cafes and food options. Also ideally located in terms of Barossa wineries, local tourist office and places to just relax and enjoy. Scott, Craig and Jan have thoughtfully restored the cottage to create the best of both worlds, maintaining the character of the original 1800's cottage, with modern kitchen, bathroom and various hidden surprises for guests to enjoy, including the internal cellar with Forage and friends wines.
Take the opportunity to find out more about Forage Supply Co wines and valuable work it does in helping others!
Great set up in a beautiful location! Perfect for a couples getaway

Wow, what can I say, this place blew our minds. Not only was the setting and location amazing it was the nice little touches that we weren't expecting that really made our stay so incredible. We will be back for sure, there is no place like it in the Barossa.

The place is perfectly placed amongst the vines. Unfortunately we had some bad weather but there was nothing better than sitting by the open fire place enjoying a glass of red from the cellar. Perfect place to stay and enjoy the wonderful things the Barossa has to offer.

What a place to stay! Not only is the accommodation and location fantastic, its the thoughtful touches and warm reception you arrive to from Scott, Craig or Jan that just make staying here wonderful.
I could not recommend Rogasch Cottage enough to anyone looking to stay in the Barossa Valley.
Honestly can't wait to go back!

Incredible stay! Impeccable location so close to town but you felt like you had your own private vineyard!
Beautiful amenities and a lovely touch with complimentary wine, gin and port!
We had dinner in the underground cellar one night and it was a once in a lifetime moment.
Sunset in the spa was another unforgettable experience.
Hosts were so lovely and helpful!
Already talking about when we will come back!

Stayed at Rogasch Cottage for a weekend girls trip to the Barossa. The cottage and the view was gorgeous, even better than the photos. Weather wasn’t great during the trip but the fireplace and the heated pool kept us cosy! Loved all the extra touches, we felt so treated the whole time. The wine tasting with Craig was the highlight of our stay! Amazing wines and great chat.
10/10 would recommend and hopefully get to stay again one day!
Big thanks to Craig, Jan and Scott.

Beautiful spot and amenities. Scott was highly responsive to questions and went above and beyond to meet our needs. Scott was extremely accommodating & flexible when organising a wine tasting for us around our 9-month-old baby's sleep schedule. Even though we travelled with a baby, we still felt like we could fully relax and enjoy ourselves. You don't realise how clean the place is until your baby commando crawls all over the floor - the place was extremely clean. I also loved the attention to detail with regard to the bathroom window. I loved bathing and looking out to the bush/vineyards or you could also tint the window for more privacy - genius. Beautiful spot and delicious wine, would highly recommend!

Wow, what can we say, truly one of the best places we’ve ever stayed!
The cottage and property are more stunning than the pictures show with the highlights being the amazing plunge pool, cozy fire and quirky private cellar.
Scott and Craig graciously organised a tasting of their wines and took us on a journey through the property and talked us through some of the amazing work that Forage Supply Co is doing both inside and outside the wine industry. This was by far the best wine experience of our Barossa trip and a serious must do.
Additionally Scott organised for a personal item that was accidentally left in the property to be shipped interstate, what a legend.
We would not stay anywhere else on future trips to the area and can’t wait to go back to visit!

We ended our honeymoon here, and we couldn’t have asked for a better conclusion to our trip. Scott was super responsive, and allowed us to check-in early having arrived earlier than expected. The place was neat and tidy with the view being as depicted in the photos - if not better! The hot tub was perfection, and created a beautiful space to watch the sunset (and the kangaroos that would stop by as well). The fireplace made the space feel extra cozy as well. We couldn’t speak more highly of the place and will definitely be back!

A fantastic venue. We wanted solitude and a walk to great restaurants. Beautiful cottage steeped in history and brilliantly renovated adding modern conveniences. A fantastic mix of old and new. And the heated plunge pool overlooking the vines was amazing even in winter!
The bed was extremely comfy. We have a ten week old baby and even she slept well in the cot provided.
Highly recommend.
The cottage will exceed your expectations. Not only does it look like all the pictures, there are many details throughout that make it a truly luxurious yet cozy experience. Location is unbeatable.

We have enjoyed our stay very much. The cottage keeps all promises made. The location is perfect, stunning views, privacy, and the heated plunge pool is lovely even on colder days like we had in August.
Inside the cottage was very clean and offers everything you need. The combination of old charm and modern interior makes the place very special. The fireplace makes it even more cosy and the wine cellar including the offer to taste the Port Wine is very special. Also thanks for the complementary bottle of wine per night!
The Barossa is always a great place to visit! Thank you for letting us staying in your beautiful cottage. We could not ask for a better weekend get away. We highly recommend the place and will hopefully back one day.
All the best from Ralf, Sabine and Dominik

We had the most amazing stay. Scott was so welcoming and hospitable, it’s hard to put into words. From the moment we arrived we were treated like family. We enjoyed a beautiful wine tasting down near the creek & fire pit with “Paws” at our side. Our wine tasting finished off in the amazing cellar🍷which has to be seen to be believed.
Scott’s wines were delicious and we highly recommend becoming a member to his wine club. All in all we had a very special stay.
We can’t wait to go back 🥰

An above and beyond experience. Amazing balance of convenience, accessibility, and serene surroundings.
We have 2 young children and they were both at home here. Plenty of outdoor space and comfort inside the cottage.
Cottage is a short walk from the cafes and restaurants nearby.
Fireplace and hot tub helped us wind down our evenings after putting our kids down for the night.
Lastly the hosts Craig, Scott and Jan were the most welcoming and accommodating hosts we have ever had.
We hope to come back again soon!
Was very nice place to stay for a getaway trip, the best hot tub with a view. could see some kangaroos in the vineyard 😁
Fabulous cottage for two young couples enjoying the Barossa! Scott was a fabulous host and very generous. Loved the visit from paws as well.
This place was stunning! The hot tub is an awesome addition, and shows off the gorgeous views! Great location!

We had the most glorious stay at the cottage. We’re treated to an amazingly kind welcome and felt right at home. We will absolutely be back. Wine from forage supple co was epic also, will be ordering a lot of it!!!

Stop looking and book this right away! Incredible experience, cannot recommend highly enough. Scott, Jan and Craig are such wonderful, gracious hosts. So helpful and went above and beyond the ensure our stay was a special one. We did the best tasting of our trip with Scott, including wines by the creek and in the cellar - we’re all joining the wine club! Walkable to town, yet so peaceful and beautiful. Pizzas in the pizza oven (which they lit for us while we were out on a wine tour!), hot tub sunset, and even a swing of golf. This is an absolute gem, you won’t regret booking it!
Stunning location, cottage and hosts. Will be back!

Rogash Cottage is so good I want to keep it a secret! You wouldn't believe how close you are to Tanunda - walking distance to restaurants, bars and wineries - but once you enter the driveway, feel like you're on your own private acreage out in the country. The house itself was spotless, with everything you needed, even your own private wine cellar! Highlights were sitting out by the fire, jumping in the heated pool and hitting golf balls from the driving tee into the vineyards. Thanks Scott for a great stay, we hope to come again in future!

One of the best places we have ever stayed. It is so peaceful with the most beautiful views and amenities - the plunge pool overlooking the vines, the bath, fireplace, cellars and fire pit all added the cosiest and most luxurious feels. The added touches such as complementary wine, gin, port, chocolate and even a mini golf made it stand out even more so. Jan and Craig are also so lovely and obviously take pride in their property and providing an unforgettable experience. Do yourself a favour and stay here!

Loved our stay here.
Beautiful cottage.
Great comms from Scott on places to eat.
We had some terrible weather but was so cozy with the fireplace, hot tub and the red wine.

We really enjoyed our stay, the cottage was the perfect balance of feeling secluded yet within walking distance to the restaurants in town. Admittedly we only checked in for a short ‘reset weekend’ to enjoy a weekend together but upon arrival wished we had opted for a longer stay. We will be back again.
Beautiful place to stay highly recommend!
An amazing place to stay which only enhanced our visit to Barossa! The photos don’t do it justice!!!
Our weekend getaway to Barossa was made even more amazing by this beautiful place. It was so relaxing and just overall a great experience. We will definitely be back.

Fantastic location with a beautiful outlook which makes it almost a challenge to enjoy the rest of the Barossa when you'd rather be in the warm plunge with a glass of wine! Very pleasantly surprised to find how close to the centre of town the cottage is, which made walking to meals and coffee a breeze. Large, comfortable beds with very good curtains made getting sleep after a full day of tasting a breeze! Only trouble is that three days wasn't enough!
Brilliant spot and just like the photos. The view was amazing. It was unbelievable and you simply have to go…

Lovely home and plunge pool! Location was amazing and views were amazing!
Hosts friendly and welcoming. Very easy to communicate with.
Only advice would be for the price, although 2 bottles of wine are offered to choose from that perhaps provisions for breakfast would also be good & would also complete the stay perfectly. Otherwise thoroughly enjoyed our stay and the beds we’re comfortable, which is often hard to find!
Amazing view and peaceful house , heated pool with vineyard view, comfortable rooms with clean beds too

My husband and our 3 young kids (6m old, 2 year old and 5 year old) had an amazing time at the cottage. Everything thing was incredible! Highlights included walking down the private cellar for a glass of Port before bed, swimming in the plunge pool daily, the big free-standing bath with a view over the vineyard, and last but not least Scott gave us a private wine tasting at his house on the property, which then led to a tractor ride for the kids through the vineyard to the river. We have never been so impressed in our lives at the level of service. Highly recommended! Walking distance to the main street.

Very close to the centre of town and beautifully private at the same time. Lots of homely gifts of wine, chocolates and gin to make you feel welcome and at home. Great spot to relax and wind down, loved having a hit off the private driving range! Celebrating a special occasion, my wife loved the surprise. Would recommend.

Thanks Craig, Jan and Scott for having us for the weekend. Very friendly and hospitable hosts.
We stayed at the cottage with another couple and throughly enjoyed our stay. The cottage is nice and there was enough room for the 4 of us, and very easy to get around town and the hot tub is great!
The highlight was the wine tasting we did with Craig on Friday afternoon. We went through each of their wines, explored the property with the beautiful creek running through it and shared stories and had a laugh ending the tasting in the cellar with a selection of reds. Craig went over and above and took us through not only their wines but the local history of the property and enjoyed a wine with us.
Will definitely be back! Thank you again.
this was our 2nd stay, and it did not disappoint

Amazing location! We drove, and there was lots to explore around the area. Close to the main street, and great food options within a few minutes drive (many places also to takeaway). The plunge pool was sensational, and it was so great to have a fireplace. We will book this again when we make it back to Barossa.
Beautiful view, generous amenities, close to everything, relaxed, clean and welcoming

Would definitely recommend Scott’s wine tour, all the wines were delicious. Cottage is stunning, right in the centre of town but still felt private with amazing views. Hot tub and cellar are a real highlight of the property. Would 100% go back !

Great base for exploring the Barossa. Walkable to Tanunda cafes and restaurants. Lovely view out to the vineyard and we experienced gorgeous sunsets. Best place to be at sunset is in the plunge pool (nice and warm too). Cottage is very comfortable. We didn’t self cater - we ate a fermentAsia (walkable), Artisans of Barossa and Vitners Bar and Grill.

This by far is one of my favourite airbnb experiences that I have had, could not fault a single thing and the care that Scott and his parents have about their cottage, their property and providing incredible experiences is something that is very unique and special. Cannot wait to stay again !
The big cellar in the pictures isn’t in the cottage and the driveway isn’t real friendly for lowered cars, other than that loved the place

Beautifully appointed place and generous supply of wine, milk, chocolate and gin tasters. The location is so close to Tanunda township but feels like you’re a world away with a beautiful outlook over the vineyards. The rooms are beautifully furnished and the bathroom is clean and modern. The deck and pool are divine. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

This is one of the best Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in! Truly beautiful location & a lovely, clean cottage with lots of special extras that made the stay a real stand out. The view from the heated pool over the vineyard is stunning, and you are only a short walk from the Main Street of Tanunda which has lots of delish restaurants and cellar doors. Would highly recommend to others.
We had a lovely stay. We spend so much time in the pool and took in the amazing view.

Scott’s cottage was like a small piece of heaven hidden away among the wine yards. Sitting in the pool overlooking the winery and looking at kangaroos jumping about was just like a perfect Aussie experience.
Kitchen and rooms were great and there were so many details that just made it an experience in itself.
Located just a 5 min walk from the Main Street in Tanunda. Perfect.

This has to be one of the best Airbnb spots I have ever stayed in. It was the perfect spot to get away, relax and enjoy excellent food and wine. The cottage was so unique, welcoming and cozy. The hosts made us feel very welcome and taught us lots of history about both the property and the area. Thank you so much, Scott, Craig and Jan for sharing your little slice of heaven with us!

We had the most wonderful weekend celebrating our 20th Wedding Anniversary. Enjoyed the pool with an amazing view, walked to lunch at 1918, relaxed and recharged. Accommodation was clean and inviting, thank you so much :)
Amazing view. Great pool, wine and chocolate, coffee pods  included In the stay. Very good for a romantic weekend away. We had a great time

A wonderful stay! Absolutely loved the cottage, the heated pool and deck area were a highlight. Scott and Craig were friendly, and Scott took time out of his day to show us how the vineyard worked. On top of that we did a wine tasting in their “big cellar” which was exceptional and one of the best tasting experiences we’ve ever had. Not only was Scott very generous with his time and explanations, he took us on the gator through the vineyard and the best part was the wine is phenomenal. Right up our alley and we can’t wait to receive our order at home!! Thank you, 10/10. X Emma & Justin
Amazing stay, beautiful setting and location, we loved everything about it!

Absolute beautiful place to stay. From hitting golf balls into the vineyard to wine tasting in the cellar was an amazing experience. Our 2 year old had a great time also, Felt like home.
Thank you Scott for the accomodation, we will see you again next the near future.
Cheers Sam
Fantastic hosts, clear communication and more than happy to help.

This was our second stay here, and it was just as good as the first.  This is one of our favourite spots.  From the view, to the hot tub, to the cellar, for a wine lover this is a must stay.   Not to mention the delicious Forage Supply Co wines. Thanks Scott, we will be back!

Scotts cottage is a delight in a perfect location walking distance to everything but private, peaceful and spacious with a fantastic view over the vineyards. The heated plunge pool is a luxury extra that was a joy and the friendly, helpful and relaxed family made our stay memorable- we definitely recommend and will be back!

Amazing stay. A hot tub in the vines is nothing short of genius and made the stay unique and special. The place had everything you could possibly need and some. The micro vineyard tour was exceptional and were so grateful to Scott for taking time out to do it. Highly recommend!

Amazing stay with Scott - beautiful cottage with an amazing view overlooking the vines in the perfect sunset trap. Plunge pool was absolutely phenomenal, and a great selection of garden games. Generous wine selection and espresso machine. The highlight though was the wine tasting and tour of the property - unforgettable experience. Thanks so much! When we come back to Tanunda we will stay with Scott again without hesitation.

We had a great stay at Scott's cottage. The location is excellent as Tanunda has a great range of eating places.
Good amenities, comfy beds & such an interesting view looking down on the Vineyard.
We really enjoyed the Barossa Valley, so much to see & do.
Lovely place to stay and great host

Simply outstanding..... perfect place to relax overlooking the vineyard. Great hosts, don't miss the opportunity of a wine tasting and going in the old cellars beneath the cottage.
Easily walkable to Tanunda with restaurants and shops. Would love to revisit if in the area.

Thank you Scott.

Pros: 
-Very spacious house, can easily accommodate up to 8 people. 
-beautiful views 
-Warm 
Cons:
Where do I start?
-Upon arriving, there was machinery and landscapers working at the house. The owner didn't inform me of this. One of the workers told us they were returning the next morning at 7am. Thankfully when I told the owner, he told the workers to stop. But I Don't know why he would organise landscapers knowing that there would be guests staying at the house. 
-When we walked into the house, it appeared a little grubby, there were scuff marks on the walls, and there was a strong foul smell coming from the drain. Although the owner assured me it had a total clean to qualify standards, it sure didn't appear so. 
-When we moved a couch into the lounge area, we found rat droppings underneath. Then more on the couch. Then more droppings in the drawers. And on the bedside table. When I informed the owner, he didn't try to rectify the issue at all.

-The road leading to the house is unsealed and very rough for about 2kms, and if it rains it gets quite muddy and slippery, and at one point you need to drive through a puddle of water. 
-The TV was Outdated.
