We couldn’t thank you enough for such a great stay and we hope to be back when time permits!

Cosy and beautiful cottage that you can easily relax into straight away. Everything was spotless and the kitchen was well equipped to make simple food for a weekend away. Veronica was friendly and super easy when it came to organising everything which made the weekend stress free which we greatly appreciated. It is the perfect little hide away to just relax in.
Veronica and Phil were great hosts. They left lovely sweets/treats for us upon check in, they were great to talk to and had plenty of recommendations! thank you for hosting us! :)
Beautiful cottage, Veronica and Phil made us feel at home. They left us few little treats for us to enjoy. The courage is very near lots of great wineries. Highly recommend this spot.

Our stay was a relaxing and peaceful visit thanks to Veronica and Phil. The cottage is crafted so beautifully and all the small touches don't go unnoticed. We felt instantly at home. Will definitely be back for another visit.
The cottage was very cozy and interesting, and Veronica and Phil were both extremely friendly. The dogs were extremely friendly and provided extra entertainment too!

What a beautiful cottage with amazing hosts. From the moment we walked in we felt relaxed and there was everything we needed to have a comfortable stay. The complimentary cheese, bread and snacks were a lovely touch. Would definitely return for a relaxing getaway again
H

Phil and Veronica were absolutely amazing hosts, it's truly a home away from home. The entire place is warm, cosy and incredibly inviting. Everything you could possibly need was readily available and all the recommendations we're close by.
The spa was fantastic to laze in after a long day of exploring and walking. And best of all being greeted by the sweetest dogs each morning. We can't wait to come back!!

We felt right at home! Phil and Veronica were the most amazing hosts, we felt very spoilt.
The cottage is so cozy and I finally felt relaxed and relieved of any stresses. Amazing communication and hospitality.
I cannot wait to visit again in the future 🫶

A place very close to Gawler and Adelaide, but completely quiet and private and with a strong country feel. It has a an unusual German history which Veronica and Phil have been keen to research, and there are many examples collected in the cottage itself. On top of that, they bent over backwards to supply extras to make our time there comfortable. As fairly regular AirBnb-ers, I don’t recall receiving such complete hospitality before. Highly recommended.

My partner and I stayed for two nights, we were welcomed with a platter of Veronica’s homemade olives, jam and spicy pickles. These were amazing, she went above and beyond to make sure our stay was amazing. My partner and I agree that the olives were some of the best we’ve ever had.
She made our stay so welcoming and inviting, the cottage is absolutely amazing. The fine little details everywhere helps to tie everything in and helps to bring that homie feeling.
Thank you so much again Veronica 🔥🙏🏼. 100% would stay again.

We've had an absolutely amazing getaway. The place has such a unique vibe and very peaceful. Veronica and Phil are great hosts who clearly work very hard to keep the place to the highest standard. They're very proactive in making sure their guests are satisfied with the experience and very approacheable and responsive. Would give more than 5 stars if we could!

Had a lovely stay at cosy Schmoburgk Cottage. Hosts were very responsive and thoughtful with leaving welcome treats that suited my dietary requirements. Place had everything we needed. Loved the heated outdoor spa. Thank you Veronica and Paul. Would definitely stay again.

We absolutely loved our stay here. Every detail was thought out and we weren't left wanting for anything more. Cosy attic room and comfy bed, lovely views, loved the jacuzzi, frogs and birds galore, peace and privacy. We enjoyed our evenings by the fire and cooking in the well-stocked kitchen. We'd definitely stay here again and recommend to others.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay! Our dog loved the adventure and it was so great being able to bring her with us. The indoor wood fire was so cosy on the cold winter evenings. Veronica went above and beyond with provision of snacks and thoughtful decorations! Can’t recommend this place enough!

Shromburgk Cottage is absolutely beautiful! Veronica is so lovely with great communication. Clear instructions and even left us a sweet note welcoming us for our anniversary. Wine, platter and snacks for us too. Robes to use after a wonderful dip in the hot tub under the stars. The view from the loft bedroom window as amazing! It feels very homey with artifacts and books everywhere as well as many places to sit and relax together. The perfect place for a couples getaway. Close to the expressway but you wouldn't know it with how peaceful it is. The dogs are sweet and loved having sticks thrown for them. We cannot speak highly enough of this place. Highly recommend!!! We will definitely be return guests. Thank you for a wonderful stay 🥰
Loved our stay! Such a beautiful cottage set on open acreage, lovely for a morning walk. Topped off with a spa bath under the stars!

I can’t believe how amazing this place is! Me and my partner stayed for 2 nights and it was incredible. The house is decorated so cosy and homely, it was super clean and had all the amenities you could need. Veronica clearly puts a lot of time and effort into making the place perfect for her guests.
The welcome pack included wine, fresh bread, butter, Brie, olives and pickles (not personally my cup of tea but a lovely touch nevertheless), and a brilliant selection of yummy snacks.
The spa was definitely my favourite part, and being able to warm up by the fire afterwards was so nice.
The bed was comfy, and the heater in the bedroom ensured that it didn’t get too cold through the night. All in all, a fantastic place and we can’t wait to visit again.
Bonus points for the furry friends 😁 We would absolutely rate more than 5 stars if it was possible.
Thanks again to Veronica and Phil

Wow! We could not be more thankful for the breathtaking experience that we shared at this magnificent cottage.
Who needs to go anywhere when it feels like many different adventures within the one place!
From starting the trip off with listening to the history of the land, to many games of fetch with the dogs, enjoying yummy snacks, cheese and wine (can’t forget the Port), picnics in the orchard, bacon and eggs in the greenhouse, spending each night in the spa, and dancing to abba on the record player.
We appreciate every amazing detail and hard work you both have put into Schomburgk Cottage.
We can’t wait to come back and make this an annual staycation.
Really cosy, peaceful and relaxing at Veronica and Phil’s. They made it very welcoming and homely. We will definitely be back!

everything about this place was perfect !
every item in the house was placed thoughtfully and it was all so incredibly cozy. this home was what made our trip so special, thank you !

We had a very enjoyable stay at the Schomburgk Cottage. Veronica was very helpful and friendly, making sure we had everything we needed.
We were greeted with some thoughtful arrival gifts including wine, cheese and homemade cookies.
The bedroom upstairs is definitely a low roof but if you’re able to get around okay, it’s beautiful and actually quite quirky.
Stand out features were the two beautiful dogs that come visit every not and then and the hot tub to take the chill off the cool afternoon.

Thanks Veronica for having us. The stay was awesome, everything we needed, heaters in the bedroom, spa outside, the location was quiet and peaceful. Whiskey and Sierra (the dogs) were great to have around.
What an amazing place and incredible hosts!! Great location and such a friendly and welcoming place. Can’t recommend it highly enough.
Outstanding place
A beautiful home with lovely homely touches. Was so nice to have breaky in the fridge waiting to be cooked!
If you like antique charm you will love this place.   Very spacious and thoughtfully styled.  A very nice place to stay
Good for a group of travellers/family.  Cool building, classic furniture, in a lovely town close to the action
Fantastic location and comfortable. Could easily have stayed much longer.
This is a great venue to tour the Barossa, a fun piece of local history filled with everything that you need to enjoy your stay.
Ideal place to stay at the barrossa valley. Clean and tidy had a great time

We absolutely loved our stay. The house was sparkling clean, the interior decoration could be out of a magazine, it's perfectly stunning!
The house doesn't just offer free Wifi, but also Netflix, Stan snd other on demand channels as well as a DVD player.
The kitchen is fully equipped.
We could not gave hoped for a better place.
We loved meeting Heather at the property to hear a bit if the history of the property.
I coukd go on and on about just how good this place is.

Heather is a wonderful host, the inn is a lovely space to relax, the beds are extremely comfy and the amenities were great, including very thoughtfully bread, juice and milk for our arrival. Would definitely recommend it for anyone wanting a couple of nights in the Barossa
Thanks again
Great hosts and a gorgeous building with interesting history. Just what a Barossa bnb should be!
Just a beautiful bnb - sparkling clean, snuggly blankets to wrap in on cold nights, so convenient and Heather is so lovely.
very Intresteing , Heather was very helpful, responsive.

This is a home away from home! We loved our stay here. The house had all the essentials you could ever need and the special welcome by Heather on check-in giving us the history of the house, was a lovely touch. We spent a few nights in and using the BBQ and cooking some lovely dinners was beyond easy in the very well equipped and spacious kitchen.
Overall super clean, very comfy beds with a selection of pillows, fast internet, a huge TV, comfy sofas with blankets and a cosy fire place. Easy to park right outside and only a walk down the road to the local super market and pub. Very good location and quiet at night time.
We will be back!! Thank you so much for a great stay!

We enjoyed a fantastic few days at Heather and Gordon’s place. Set within close proximity to the Barossa and Eden Valley wine districts their bnb had everything we needed and more. A beautiful old house tastefully decorated with quality furnishings and all the facilities we needed. This is a really comfortable home and a true country getaway. We also enjoyed the historic nature of the house and Heather’s tour of their original Scotch Oven at the rear of the house was a great treat. We’d definitely like to stay here again when we next visit the Barossa Valley,

What a lovely place! So full of history and very stylish and many thoughtful touches.
The beds are very warm and comfortable.
Ask to see the original old oven out the back, it’s awesome!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
Lovely heritage building, well positioned and well equipped with thoughtful touches.
Great location and space. Heather and Gordon are very helpful hosts.
What a beautiful cottage. Well appointed, great history, well located. No downsides I can think of - thanks for a wonderful stay, will be back!

Heather & Gordon Thank you for welcoming us and for sharing your wonderful home. We enjoyed the home very much and appreciated the history of the home and it’s many fine furnishings.
There is so much to appreciate and so little to suggest.
Thanks again for allowing us stay in your comfortable and well appointed home. Many thanks Peter & Evy.
Fantastic place to stay. Accurate photos and description. Very clean. Helpful host.

Such a well appointed, charming cottage with everything a traveler would need while visiting  the area. Heather and Gordon were fabulous hosts and really went out of their way to make us feel welcomed and at home.

Heather’s place is absolutely lovely. 3 beautiful bedrooms, a kitchen with everything you could need and a great lounge room to relax and enjoy with family or friends. Heather met us on arrival and was really welcoming. She always communicated really quickly too. Pity we couldn’t stay longer.

This lovely property was perfect for a quiet weekend getaway in the Barossa. Heather was a fabulous host and very helpful in settling us in for our stay. Highly recommend to others who are looking for a quick getaway to the Barossa.

We had a wonderful stay at Heather's place.
It was so comfortable and clean.
The kitchen was fantastic and the apartment was very spacious with two large living areas.
The fire was lovely and the apartment had everything you need for a lovely stay.
We would definitely love to stay again.

Heather and Gordon's place is a little piece of heaven in Lyndoch. From the incredibly comfortable beds to the fully-stocked and Immaculate kitchen, they didn't miss a single detail. If a home-away-from-home bnb experience in an historic nineteenth century property in the heart of wine country sounds like your thing, we couldn't recommend this place more. We'll definitely be back!
Lovely home, that’s really well located. Sparkling clean and  Heather is great to communicate with. Comfy beds and love the fireplace to gather around. Thanks again Heather!

We had a very relaxing two nights in Lyndoch at Heather’s place. It was clean and well-appointed with many thoughtful extras (herbal teas, condiments, sofa-rugs, etc). It was easy to explore the Barossa from there but also comfy to spend some good family time around the table with some board games. Thanks Heather!

The Inn and Bakery are beautifully maintained, keeping a good feel of the history of the place along with well appointed mod cons. Highly recommended as a cosy place from which to explore the Barossa or simply to relax at and enjoy. Jeff & Petra

What a wonderful place to stay in. House is very clean with ample of space.
A complete kitchen which will make your feel like home. House is full of character.
Our host heather was lovely and we we enjoyed our stay. Definitely recommended to check this place out if you are visiting Barossa. Value for money , double thumbs up!

Wonderful house and location in the beautiful village of Lyndoch.  Beautiful beds and furniture in accord with the history of the building.  The kitchen is spacious and well equipped with a coffee pod machine, electric milk frother, Kenwood chef mixer, food processor - everything you could possibly need.  The wonderful selection of teas was very impressive.  A great selection of breakfast items are provided as well - bread, milk, eggs, cereals, jams, honey, vegemite.  The very organised instruction folder for all the equipment in the house was much appreciated as well as the information booklet with recommendations for places to go and things to do.   We had an amazing meal (tasting menu) at Ferment Asia in Tanunda.  We loved sitting around the large fire place, there was plenty of wood provided and the fireplace was ready for us to light when we arrived.    Lyndoch is a very pretty village with numerous wineries within a short distance.  The countryside is delightful especially in spring with all the leaves on the vines.  This is an amazing air bnb, highly recommended.
Expect a wonderful stay with all the creature comforts. Beautiful home!
Lovely home and lovely hosts. The kitchen was so well equipped, our group of two families staying there were very comfortable and wanted for nothing. Also the beds are super comfortable!

This is the most gorgeous bed and breakfast, we had such a wonderful stay! All the facilities you could possibly want with fantastic location to some of the Barossa’s best wineries. Heather & Gordon fantastic hosts!
A friendly reception, a lovely home and a great stay. This B&B has everthing you need to have a brilliant time in the Barossa.

We loved our stay here. The location was perfect, within walking distance to the local cafes, brewery and wineries.
The place itself was very comfortable and full of character (used to be the old inn in the town). Heather was great with her communication throughout as well, would really recommend this place.
There are so many positives - Cleanliness, everything we needed for a comfortable stay, Space, History & we can’t wait to book another stay.

Amazing place. Had a wonderful time with my friends here. Everything was beyond our expectations and kudos to preserving the rich culture and history of the location.
wonderfully located, close to some amazing vineyards!
Comfy and relaxing

Beautiful property located at the southern end of the Barossa. Big comfortable beds and excellent kitchen facilities. There were so many thoughful touches to ensure a comfortable stay. Thank you Heather, we will hopefully be back one day!

Accommodation is really nice with lovely furniture and amenities Great Location and Heather is a wonderful host , very helpful.
Perfect place to stay especially if its for more than a night and it has all the facilities needed for a long term stay.

A truely beautiful house that is very special. This historic house is so beautifully furnished we spent so much time just looking at all the lovely things. Heather was very prompt with communication, check in very straight forward. Lots of information left for visitors both about aspects of the house and recommendations for places to visit. Lyndoch is a lovely little village with a couple of nice restaurants, a great bakery, a couple of nice shops and a pub and very short drive to all the Barossa has to offer. The bakery inn is just gorgeous and we loved it. Many thanks for all the little touches and special things provided. If we are back in the Barossa this will be where we will stay every time!

Great stay at the Barossa Inn. Very clean and spacious house, well-kitted out kitchen / dining area for cooking.
Communication with Heather was a breeze, with very clear instructions.
Very reasonably priced given the large space and proximity to Barossa Valley wineries.

A fantastic piece of historic Lyndoch to base ourselves in during our Barossa holiday. Heather was prompt and efficient with her responses, and gave us a guided tour once we arrived, which we all appreciated. The accommodation itself was spacious and comfortable, with all of the conveniences you want while on holiday (fully functional kitchen, laundry, multiple TVs and fast internet), while still retaining the historic charm of the inn and bakery. It was a fantastic location for our family's holiday!
Very beautiful house, comfortable, Prime location, the host is very friendly and generous. Loved about the house that it’s very well equipped and stylish .

What a lovely place to stay for a visit to the Barossa! Heather and Gordon's house was charming, immaculate, very well appointed and in an ideally location. The house had every amenity you could need - and then some! - and all the little touches made us feel at home the moment we walked through the door. Communication was perfect, and the house was better than the photos indicate. We could tell there was a lot of thought and effort put into the house. Gordon's welcome tour was a great touch as well, as it was nice to know a bit of the history of the house.
Thank you so much Heather and Gordon! Would defintely stay again next time we visit the Barossa.

Such a gorgeous place to stay for a getaway in the Barossa! Heather and Gordon's historic house is beautifully furnished has all the amenities you need or could want and more. The lovely little extra touches made us feel comfortable and at home. The house was immaculate, homely and very well equipped in an convenient location. The fire place was a treat. Communication was fantastic and prompt, the house is so much better than the in photos. We could tell there was a lot of thought and love put into the house. Gordon's welcome tour was great as it was nice to hear about the history of the house.
Thank you so much Heather and Gordon for a wonderful stay and all the lovely little extra touches that made our stay so special. Would defintely stay again.

Large house, once an Inn and bakery, lots of room for a family of four, fully stocked kitchen, large comfortable beds, fireplace was great. Lyndoch is one of the smaller Barossa towns, but has 2 pubs, a cafe and bakery for eating out plus several lovely wineries to visit.

We loved Heather’s place! Has all the amenities you need & is very homely. Our son got sick during our stay so we had to hang out at the house for a day &  it had everything we needed to feel comfortable & relaxed, just like at home😀 loved all the beautiful old world furniture & so much history in the building! Excellent location, easy to access Lyndoch & all the surrounding towns & wineries 🍷 I highly recommend this place & we would love to stay again next time 😀
Great stay in a place steeped in Lyndoch history
Fantastic stay, the accommodation has a ton of historical significance for the area, and it was a peaceful place to relax after adventuring for the day, will be returning. Thank you!
What a wonderful place. A beautiful house with lots of charm and history. It really felt like home with little touches to make your stay nice and comfortable. Would definitely stay there again!
Great stay. All guests really enjoyed it!

Our group of 4 had a great couple of days at Heather's place in Lyndoch.  The house was obviously well loved and perfect for our needs for the weekend.  The property was well presented and clean throughout.  The fresh orange juice was a welcome surprise and make for some great pre-lunch mimosas.

Thank you to Heather and Gordon for allowing us to stay in your lovey home. A refurbed heritage building with comfortable beds, top-notch appliances, and friendly hosts. The house is of course in the middle of the Barossa Valley, with great wineries only a two minute drive away.

We had a wonderful stay at Heather's place.  It's a great location and the house has everything you need and more.  Superbly furnished and a real home-like feel.  We couldn't have asked for anything more.  Thanks so much for making our stay in the Barossa a memorable one.

The 'Bakery Inn' was a beautiful piece of history that Heather and Gordon have obviously put a lot of time and effort into restoring. Thank you for sharing the beautiful home. Heather is a very responsive and welcoming host. We had a wonderful stay.

Loved heathers place. Felt very homely and cosy. Have already started recommending this place.
Will definitely be back!

5 of us stayed at Heather’s place over a weekend. Was great value and very comfortable for 5 people. Pictures are very accurate, nice and very well equipped kitchen. Heather was excellent to communicate with as well as flexible throughout the whole process. Very clean, highly recommend staying for a weekend 👍
Lovely accommodation and piece of history in Lyndoch.  Heather was very responsive and friendly.  We enjoyed our stay.

The owners have gone above and beyond in restoring this beautiful building with heritage significance. Everything provided is high quality - from the linen to the kitchen appliances!  They have thought of everything, which makes it an extremely comforable and relaxing stay. We loved going for walks in the morning and throughout the day we could take a stroll to wineries and a fantastic local brewery. What more could you ask for in a weekend away!
Our greater family had a wonderful stay at this amazing home.
Everything was excellent. We’d love to come back.

Really special place!. House is huge. Beds really comfortable. Bathroom luxurious. And fascinating history.
Couldn't ask for a better place, and Heather and Gordon were perfect hosts.
Recommended!
Great place and super great hosts! Will definitely stay again when required. Great hospitality.

This was our second stay at Heather and Gordon's place, but it certainly won't be the last! No detail is left undone, from stocked kitchen to the 'in case you forgot' stash in the bathroom. The beds are ridiculously comfy, the heating/cooling options are comprehensive and the whole house has a mountain of historical charm. Love the addition of the incredible antique bar in the old pub room!
Thanks so much - hope to see you again next year!
Beautifully appointed and furnished. Very comfortable beds, and generously provisioned. Thank you for a wonderful stay.
Heather's place provided us with everything we needed for a very comfortable stay, as well as lots of extra things such as a well stocked pantry and a first aid kit.

A lovely place in peaceful Lyndoch. A couple of nice restaurants in town but mostly just enjoyed being close to the Barossa vineyards without the bustle of Gawler or Tanunda. Lots of space and character with big beds and an awesome lounge/bar area. Lovely place to spend the weekend.
We had a great stay. The house was very comfortable and quiet. Loved the history of the house. Will be back and recommending the house to friends. Thx Heather 😀
Very unique themed Airbnb. Loved the old school bar and history of the building. Very nice set up and furniture. Highly recommend

Well maintained heritage building with lots of wonderful details. We enjoyed every bit of our stay in here.

The Barossa Inn was a fabulous place to stay. Heather and Gordon were fabulous hosts. The bnb was perfect for us, it had absolutely everything and then some. Immaculately clean and beautifully presented. I highly recommend this beautiful property as it had everything and was a great base for out Barossa adventures.

We come back every year, and there’s a reason for that - the Barossa Inn is our favourite place! We love it so much and will absolutely be back next year. Thank you, Heather! ❤️
We had a great experience staying at this fantastic accommodation. Placed well to explore the Barossa region.

The Old Barossa Inn was pure delight to stay in. The delightful hosts had thought of everything to ensure a comfortable stay. We loved the wood fire as it was so cold when we stayed. Walking distance to a bustling cafe, excellent restaurant, and even a vineyard. Short driving distances to other towns, lavender farm and plenty of wineries.
Thanks for making us feel so welcome and comfortable in your beautiful home.

This was our second time staying at Heather and Gordon's place. The property is in a great location within walking distance to shops, pubs, cafes and wineries. The house is extremely well appointed with everything you could possibly need, really comfortable beds, heating and cooling and a great outdoor area. The hosts were friendly and responsive and we would highly recommend staying at this property.

This was such a delightful house to stay in. A piece of history and full of exquisite antiques. Heather and Gordon have thought of everything you could need, such attention to detail. Absolutely enjoyed our stay.
Thanks Heather for a lovely stay! Great piece of history conveniently located in Lyndoch :)

We had a splendid, peaceful time at Heather and Gordon’s historic place. Within walking distance to the local pub and IGA supermarket, and a couple minutes’ drive to local Barossa wineries, we felt immersed in the history of the place which was previously an old bakery. The house was extremely well appointed and the breakfast kit (eggs, milk, bread, butter, condiments, etc, etc) was a generous touch. The place is quiet and extremely clean. Highly recommended!
My sisters and I had a lovely stay, very clean and tidy home, a lot of old charm and history in the place. Very friendly host that greeted us on arrival.

We had a wonderful time in Lyndoch at Heather's place. Incredible amenities and a historic charming vibe. A lovely house to enjoy with friends or family. Big living spaces and outdoor BBQ. We would highly recommend. Thank you.
We had a great few days at the property. It had everything we wanted and the beds were soooo comfy. We’ve booked again for later in the year!
Spacious house with loads of inclusions, beautiful fireplace and very quiet area, would highly recommend.

Peter and Jane were wonderful and generous hosts. We opened the door to a beautiful and cosy home, fire running and bacon in the fridge. It was so perfect having the wood fire pizza restaurant next door, meeting the locals and enjoying delicious local wine. Thanks for having us, we'd love to come back!
Lovely location, fantastic food and wine, beautiful accommodation.

Peter, the owner and winemaker, is a great host and makes amazing pizzas. The facilities in the Loft were great with a well equipped kitchen and a large lounge with plenty of movies and games. If your lucky you'll get a tour of the estate.

Jane and Peter and their staff made us feel very welcome from the second we arrived.  This bnb is special in that the accommodation is just metres from a wood fired pizza restaurant where you can also taste locally produced fine wine.  The grounds are beautiful. A perfect place to relax or to engage with your hosts.
A spacious and very comfortable house with all that we needed.  Hosts were very welcoming and accommodating.  PIzzas are excellent if you are staying on a night the pizza oven is lit.
amazing spot, beautiful indoors and out, amazing hosts
Only stayed one night, awesome clean place, would definitely stay again.

Great characterful accommodation under the same roof as a cellar door and pizza restaurant.
Highly recommended
Wonderful loft with plenty of room, perfect for a family getaway or romantic weekend.
Amazing place and amazing host! Will definitely be back - thank you for your hospitality!
This is a wonderful location, it has great facilities and a fabulous host. Can’t recommend highly enough.
Thanks so much Jane and Peter! Excellent service provided throughout (including a complimentary and delicious loaf of bread) - my brother and I thoroughly enjoyed the weekend trip 😊
Amazing hosts, stunning location and cannot wait to go back for another visit

A great peaceful place to stay! Amazing views and up close encounters with wildlife. The wood oven pizza is fantastic along with a glass of wine. If you're looking for a rustic relaxing stay, this is the place for you!

We were stoked with the property on arrival. It’s a beautiful estate, with it’s charms and birds surrounding it. The house were nice with fireplace and clean. Jane and Peter were very helpful and friendly (and the two labradors)
Nice wood-fire pizza restaurant next door. We would highly recommend this place.

This is a great place to stay in a rural area of the Barossa. It is not in town but on a working farm. There is a weekly market in the next town with "the best breakfast in the area" which is fantastic.  It is within 30 minutes drive from the major wineries of the 100 or so in the Valley. Everything is exactly as shown on the website and Jane & Peter are wonderful hosts.
Gorgeous estate, and pizza was soooo good!!!, enjoyed every minute of the stay!! Can’t complain
A great place to stay and delicious pizzas!

Lovely, large, cozy place. Hospitable hosts, some lovely puppies running around and we enjoyed the Springton pub! Huge DVD selection, great after a big day of tasting wines. Would 100% recommend and will likely be back. Thanks!!!

Beautiful accommodation equipped with country views and a roaring wood fire heater, perfect for a winter getaway.
Jane & Peter are very accommodating and went out of their way to make our long weekend memorable. Peter served up some delicious wood fire pizza in the restaurant, right next door. The kids loved exploring this picturesque estate and eating toasted marshmallows from the pizza oven... The Shiraz is also great! Will definitely recommend
Great location. Loved the pizza and wine. Perfect place to unwind and recharge.

Great venue, the pictures don’t do the place justice. It’s bigger than it looks and very cosy. The hosts were fantastic, made everything super easy. The wood fired pizzas next door were quality and would highly recommend. Only regret was we couldn’t stay longer.

Beautiful, cosy space in peaceful, scenic surrounds. Yummy breakfast supplies, plenty of wood provided for the fire, and delicious wood-oven pizza and wine available from the adjoining restaurant. Lovely base for a weekend away in the Barossa.

Jane was such an amazing host, really communicative, considerate and thoughtful. The photos do not do this place justice, it completely exceeded my expectations. It’s extremely clean, The large gardens are gorgeous to walk through, the house is so warm and spacious and the bedrooms are very cosy. The house is full of little surprises as you walk around and watching the birds outside the window every morning was beautiful. Jane made the effort to have the fireplace on for us as we arrived and made us fresh pizza from their restaurant. I can not recommend Jane and this property enough! Thanks again Jane, you were a wonderful host!
Amazing hosts, Magical location 😃

We had a lovely relaxing stay.
From keeping the fire going to watching the chattering birds on the feeders; we felt really content on the farm. Receiving a visit from grandpa (the dog) was a treat and he was glad to take care of any leftovers. The pizza’s were excellent, as was the wine, port and everything else the farm offered. The weekend was very relaxed and just what we wanted.
This is a beautiful place to stay with amazing food and great scenery! This is the perfect getaway for anyone needing a change of scenery and wanting a place to relax. Highly recommend!
Beautiful peaceful setting.  Self contained, with all the comforts of home.  Friendly and helpful hosts.  A lovely place to unwind.
Jayne and Peter are wonderful hosts and that property is amazing. We really enjoyed our night there and the pizzas were just as good as the conversation. Absolutely would love to come again
An exquisitely beautiful location coupled with warm hospitality. Well provisioned and a yummy wood oven pizza.  Thank you Jane and Peter.

Great BnB, great wines, great pizzas, and great hosts. Oh, and great lab/retrievers too!
A great night all round.
Great, spacious and comfortable accommodation, in a superb location with great hosts.

Such an amazing loft/accommodation and experince.
The pizza is fantastic.
Such a beautiful place. You will have no regrets. Thank you both.

This is the perfect Airbnb! Jane is a truly wonderful host, and the house is impeccable! We stayed for the wine tasting and had some delicious woodfire oven pizza!! The location is scenic and picturesque and the stay was beautiful! highly recommend :)
Cute Location would be great for a weekend away
