The house was a 5 minute walk from a pub with lovely food for lunch / dinner, and also a cafe with delicious breakfasts. From the house, we also walked to Kellermeister winery which is beyond gorgeous on a sunny day, and to Ministry of Beer, which we would also highly recommend.
Overall, we had a fantastic holiday, and would definitely recommend Darren's house.

The house was lovely with stunning heritage fixtures and fittings that were in keeping with the area and building. Darren, the host was extremely friendly and proactive, flexible with our check-in, and attentive whilst we got settled. The house will easily sleep 3 families or a business retreat which is what we were using it for. Perfectly central for everything within the Barossa and private enough for a great retreat.

Fantastic host and a beautifully renovated historic home with all the amenities of a new house, fantastic for a large group like ours. Darren was a great host, very responsive and very helpful. Definitely will be back.

We were a group of 9 women and this was the perfect house for us. The beds were comfortable with beautiful linen, and we loved the long dining table. It was a cold weekend and the house was cosy and warm. We walked to wineries and enjoyed dinner at the Lord Lyndoch. I highly recommend Darren’s beautiful, historic house. I think it would be lovely in summer too, with the beautiful garden and barbecue area.

Darren's place was beautiful! Robyn met us at check-in and she was very welcoming and informative. She talked about the history of the place, and told us about the very tasteful renovations. The beautiful platter was a lovely thought.
Robyn was very easy to contact and responded very quickly.
I would certainly recommend this lovely old Coffee Palace to anyone looking for group accommodation in a lovely area.

Absolutely stunning. If I could give more than 5 stars I would. We had a brilliant stay at Darren’s place. It was remarkably clean, incredibly quiet, and suited our needs perfectly. Darren was extremely friendly and responsive, even giving us a tour of the house, and some very interesting history. There was also a very generous platter of goodies in the fridge, which was thoroughly enjoyed by all. We could tell that Darren takes great pride in this house.

Lyndoch Grand Villa is a special and unique place to stay where all your needs are met, it is great value for a large group.
The hosts were generous with their time and services provided including personal welcome, history tour, local recommendations plus generous platter in fridge!
Thanks for having us, we’ll be back!
A lovely place for our small company to be accomodated as we attended a conference at the Novotel. Charming, quiet with excellent facilities. Darren was a helpful host and very proud of the place.
Great place for a group. We are 7 old school friends and were extremely comfortable. Short walk to the village and right amongst wineries. Would definitely stay again.
Wonderful accommodation fantastic place to stay with a large group
Darren was a lovely host and the house is beautiful and delightfully presented. Can’t recommend this place more highly.

Lyndoch Grand in de Barossa Valley is een zeer aan te bevelen locatie om te verblijven!!
Wij verbleven met 6 personen 4 weken in dit prettige huis.
Darren en zijn vrouw zijn erg vriendelijk en gastvrij, ze verwelkomden ons met een heerlijke BBQ!
De pooltafel in de grote kamer boven was fantastisch!
Groeten Dirk Antonis
Great pad, great place, loved it!!

Darren met us on arrival and gave us the grand tour and lots of local history. My friends and family immediately felt right at home. We were there to celebrate an 80th birthday wine touring and tasting what the Barossa had to offer, the location is perfect for this. We would definitely recommend and return but not too soon as we all had too much wine. Thank you to Darren and his wife.
Great stay

Thanks so much. Had a great time with a multi generational birthday weekend.
Lovely venue.

We are a group of six girls visiting SA on a girls trip from Perth and our stay was absolutely perfect with everything exceeding our expectations. The beds were comfortable and cozy. The house was beautifully styled and equipped with every detail to make our stay comfortable. We couldn’t ask for a better experience and Darren was a great host. We will definitely be back and would highly recommend.
A lovely place to stay and superb value

As well as being a beautifully renovated period properly, it was so comfortable and perfect for our group of 4. Two full bathrooms are hard to find in an affordable price range so that was a bonus. Communication from Peter was amazing and so accomodating for any requests. Love the quality toiletries and fresh produce provided for a full breakfast - plus the bottle of red didn’t last long! Highly recommend.

The perfect location for our little family gathering, White Rocks is a beautiful home with those little touches that made our stay very special.
Provisions for breakfast and a great array of jams, teas, coffees - in fact everything was there for us. We had a meal in one evening and the kitchen was really well appointed for the cooks.
The garden is absolutely divine with a great array of flowers and herbs.
There are plenty of spaces to read a book or just relax over a wine.
We would definitely head back there - White Rocks makes a perfect base for exploring the Barossa.

Fabulous location near the restaurants of Tanunda and all the wineries and other attractions of the Barossa.  Really comfortable and cosy house and we highly recommend staying in this lovely house.  Lots of added extras which added to a very comfortable stay for our group of four. Definitely a return visit when we are next in the region.

6 Star rated amazing stay!
We've stayed in a number of Airbnb's and this is well above all the others (sorry to the others, you were all good 5 stars, but Whiterocks is truly next level). This is a really stylishly renovated period home spotlessly clean and fresh with beautiful furniture, art and luxury everything; The kitchen has an induction cooktop, full oven, quality wine glasses and cutlery, coffee machine and pods. The lounge has a leather suite, large screen tv, Netflix and high-speed internet. The bedrooms have beautiful crisp sheets, super soft pillows and electric blankets. The main bathroom has heated flooring and twin shower heads. There is ducted air-conditioning, a full laundry with dryer, an outdoor undercover deck and a BBQ.
Our hosts were amazing and the personal touches such as the lovely provisions they supplied made the stay really special. We highly recommend staying at Whiterocks; Thank you to Peter and Jan!

Great location in the heart of Tanunda. An amazing array of goodies provided in the kitchen including TIM TAMS!! (agree with previous review, next level compared to other Airbnb's have stayed at) Attention to detail was fantastic. Place was clean and comfortable, kitchen well provided for, plenty of firewood to get cosy by the fire. The host had great communication and was lovely to deal with. Highly recommend!
Fantastic house, great central location, immaculate presentation and loved the thoughtful touches to help make our stay as comfortable and easy as it could have been!

Peter’s House in Tanunda was perfection for us and the kids. Brilliantly located close to restaurants, cafes and wine bars - warm and spotlessly clean with generous extras like eggs, bacon, bread and wine. We loved our stay and will definitely be back. Thank you Peter.😊

Lovely home with great amenities and location.  Walk easily to restaurants and amenities.  Many little extras that make for a wonderful stay.  Peter had great communication and would recommend the stay for anyone coming to the Barossa that wants a very comfortable stay.

Peter and Jan were fantastic hosts. Always approachable and friendly. Thank you so much for the wonderful stay. Excellent kitchen layout and supply. Nice touch with the fresh bread and tasty wine. The garden was a nice surprise with fresh herbs for cooking like Parsley, Rosemary and Thyme.
Located very central to the township for a freshly made barista coffee in the morning ☕️ and a variety of pubs, bars and restaurants for the afternoon come evenings.
Hope to stay again.
🍻 Jason, Scott and Crew.

Peter & Jan. Thank you so much for a wonderful stay at Whiterocks.
Your communication and check in process made our arrival so easy and efficient.
The level of detail and the little touches to make us feel welcome were amazing - from the breakfast supplies to the beautiful bottle of red to welcome us. Theheated floors and fireplace made us queenslanders feel so warm and welcome.
We raved to anyone and everyone during our weekend. You are wonderful hosts and we will be back.
Thank you for everything.

Whiterocks is just as beautiful as the pictures. Everything you could think of has been included (even phone chargers for multiple phones by the beds!) The bedrooms are generous and the two bathrooms with heated flooring was a luxury.
Peter was great with communication, the place was immaculate and very close to bakery, cafes and restaurants. Plenty of wood to enjoy the lounge room fireplace which was lovely to relax in front of while watching a movie after a day wine tasting on our girls weekend away. Thank you for a lovely stay!

Peter and Jan’s place was absolutely amazing! The house is in the perfect spot to explore the Barossa. The house is stunning with beautiful interiors and gardens. We especially loved the little added touches that made it a perfect  getaway. Highly recommend and we would stay there again in a heartbeat!!
A beautifully appointed home in an amazing location.  Walking distance to all things of convenience.  Incredible hosts who could not do enough for us.  Highly recommended.
Great location and beautifully presented home. Will definitely stay again, Thankyou Peter and Jan

Lovely home well located close to main shops and great restaurants could not ask for anything else everything you need and more cannot will definitely come back again not long enough stay
Ken and Karen

Our stay at Whiterocks was absolutely perfect, it is spotlessly clean, very spacious it had everything there that you would need for   Your stay, walking distance to restaurants, bars and shops , it is the perfect get away.. we would highly recommend Whiterocks, Peter is the perfect host… made us all very welcome and the bottle of wine and breakfast goodies was the perfect welcome gift, Big thank you 👍👍

My husband, 2 young kids and I had a lovely holiday at White Rocks. Not only is the property beautiful, but Peter goes the extra mile to ensure his home has everything that you’d need for a comfortable stay. I highly recommend this property if you are visiting the Barossa Valley.
Peter is also a wonderful host, always responsive, happy to help and answer our questions.
Overall, we had a wonderful stay at this gorgeous property :)

The perfect home for exploring the Barossa. The home was absolutely stunning with every creature comfort and attention to detail to make our stay so warm and welcoming. Peter and Jan were fabulous hosts and responded quickly and were so generous with their welcoming goodies.
It is in a great location, quiet yet a very short walk to the cafes, wine bars, shops and restaurants of Tanunda.
We were a group of 7 and the house was perfect for us all.
Cannot recommend highly enough.

From the moment we arrived at whiterocks we were welcomed by ambient music and a modernised period interior that felt warm and homely. We were pleasantly surprised to find fresh produce and a lovely bottle of Shiraz awaiting us in the kitchen. The home was equipped and stocked with all our needs, from fresh linen, to coffee pods and olive oil! There was ample space for two families (7 members) and it was lovely sitting by the fireplace where we watched Forest Gump and played board games. The location couldn't have been better as it was basically situated at the heart of the Barossa with easy access to various wineries, and was a short walk to cafes, restaurants and supermarket. The garden was also beautiful and full of fresh herbs, lime and lavender!!  Peter was organised and provided easy instructions and always prompt in his response! He was easy to engage and personable. I could not fault a thing! We were all so impressed and agreed we will be back! Thank you for having us!
Great location, great place, and amazing selection of breakfast goodies and even a bottle of wine!
The house is absolutely stunning, well stocked, amazing beds and close to everything you need! Keen to come back.

Absolutely gorgeous home in the centre of Tanunda.  Easy walk to restaurants, cafes and bars. The house has everything you need for a long weekend away. We loved the special touches …. the surprise breakfast, Vasse Virgin toiletries  and so much more. Hope to be back soon

White Rocks certainly lived up to the promising listing. We loved the old mixed with new and very modern kitchen with a full suite of amenities. Peter and Jan were an excellent hosts and provided us with some delicious bacon and eggs, as well as some delicious Barossa milk, cheese and juice. We were also staying with an infant and Peter was kind enough to provide a crib with sheets, as well as baby bath and seat.
Thanks again Peter and we hope to stay at White Rocks again!

We have stayed at Whiterocks twice it is in the perfect location for restaurants, cafes shops all in walking distance , whiterocks is always spotless it is home from home , has all amenities that you need and Peter is the perfect host always available to give you all the local information that you need, we wouldn’t hesitate to stay at Whiterocks again

This stay was booked on behalf of my colleagues for a work event.  They gave Peter and Jan a 5 star review.   The house is wonderful. Everything was fantastic.  Spotless house, close to amenities, quiet location.  Full marks!
Great spot and the best central location
Stunning, clean and very inviting. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay

Very clean and everything you need. The place is beautiful and well maintained. Really close walk to all the shops and restaurants in town.
Would definitely recommend it for a stay.

Best practice air bnb accom. Thoughtful and responsive owner. The house so well provisioned - from welcome large breakfast in fridge to coffee, tea condiments etc. every kitchen utensil you need. Clean as a whistle. Beds and linen super comfortable. Open fire was fantastic. The best air bnb experience so far!

My friends and I had a great time. Louise was a lovely host who replied quickly to any of our messages and was very welcoming. We loved the little touches (and the delicious eggs from their farm). The cottage was gorgeous and it was amazing to wander around and see all the farm animals. We especially enjoyed our surprise visit from one of the farm dogs, Rocket. Would recommend for anyone wanting a peaceful and relaxing time in the country.

We chose the Cottage at Riverside Farm for many reasons. Chiefly we were attending an 80th Birthday in Craigmore and Lyndoch is only about 30 minutes drive.
We wanted a place with privacy and comfort, the Cottage certainly gave us that.
It was such a pleasure to drink a glass of bubbles watching the stunning sunset across the hills, having breakfast under the magnificent peppercorn tree was so relaxing and we enjoyed watching the birds playing in the lovely garden.
The bedrooms were great with deliciously clean crisp sheets. And the kitchen had everything we needed.
Hot days, we had aircon and cooler nights, electric blankets.
We were close to many of the Barossa attractions - Hahndorf, Seppeltsfield & Tanunda but we were so enjoying the relaxed atmosphere of the Cottage we probably didn’t do as much as we could have.
In any case, we would certainly come back and do it all again.
For us, The Cottage at Riverside Farm was perfect & we highly recommend it. 5 Stars from us. Thank you.
lovely little place in a great location.

Very cosy place, sparkling clean, got everything you need (even have soy sauce, sesame oil and all sorts of herbs in the kitchen which surprised me) and walking distance to town centre. We will definitely recommend this place to friends and come back again.
A great little get away with a bunch of friends - a beautiful indoor fire that was used all weekend, with modernised amenities throughout!
Quaint, cosy and comfortable. In a handy position and Adele’s communication and service was outstanding
Great location and modernised cottage made it an extra special trip to barossa

We found Adel to be an extremely responsive and helpful host. The interior of the cottage has been nicely renovated. The kitchen was very well equipped.
Angaston is a beautiful village and the cottage is is conveniently located a short walk to the main street.

Lovely cottage with everything you need in a great location.
Adele was also very easy to communicate with.

Great stay up in the Barossa at Adele’s home. Looks like  suburban home but feels like a cosy cabin when inside. Fireplace really made our stay memorable, having that going for both nights and cooking in the kitchen was a breeze. Great location for Barossa wineries and walking distance to the town to get groceries and see the cute little town shops. Adele and Cameron were a pleasure to communicate with and made it effortless to check in.
Cute cottage in walking distance to the Main Street of Angaston and easy drive to all the Barossa has to offer
Beautiful and cozy place!

Enjoyed our stay! Nice deck with table and chairs to look out to the garden and enjoy the afternoon sun. House is cozy and quirky. Short walk into Angaston and the supermarket. Good base for visiting the Farmers Market and local wineries.

Adele’s place was an excellent stay that was perfect for the group of us. The house was clean and had all amenities we needed for cooking and a comfortable stay. All I would say is that the third bedroom is slightly smaller than what it seems to be in photos and doesn’t have air conditioning. However, we had a great stay and would recommend to anyone looking to explore the Barossa region!

Quaint yet modernised cottage, loved the fireplace and the cosy atmosphere!
Great location- handy walking distance from the main street (supermarket, restaurants) and a great base for visiting the wineries. Adele had helpful recommendations for things to do in the local area
We enjoyed our stay, beautiful outlook from the deck and walking distance to town which was handy!
The place was nice and local and we enjoyed our time in beautiful Angaston. We arrived early and Adele was very kind and flexible with our early checkin.
We had a lovely stay and it was nice to be able to walk to dinner / coffee.
Great location & beautifully restored inside! Kitchen amenities & also an easy walk to Foodland & cafes & restaurants on the Main Street.

Cute house close to town
Loved being able to stay in a pet friendly house- a dog flap would assisted with leaves bot blowing into the house.

Thanks for a lovely stay. On trend furnishings, functional kitchen and thoughtful extras eg hair dryer and welcome bottle of red!
Would definitely stay again.

It was the perfect spot for our girls weekend away. What a delightful place, filled with warmth and cosiness. The kitchen had everything we needed and more, and the welcome bottle of wine was a lovely gesture! Thank you for a beautiful stay!!
Thanks for having us

We enjoyed the cosy cottage vibe with the wood-burning stove. Kitchen was well stocked with basics for a family stay.  Supermarket, restaurants and cafes of Angaston an easy 5-10 min stroll. A great weekend away!

Lambert's Little Paradise is very nice, quiet, somewhat secluded studio accommodation, with a lovely outlook to the pool and garden. The unit is very well appointed, spacious and immaculately clean and tidy.  Stephen left no stone unturned so that our stay was perfectly relaxing. Great to have accommodation that is well away from the main roads but within only a few minutes drive from Lyndoch.
Peaceful area and lovely little guest house.
Good place.

We enjoyed our 2 nights at Lambert’s Little Paradise. The place was easy to find with welcoming signs. Clean and tidy little guest house with great selection of board games and puzzles. We really appreciated the swimming pool on the 30 degree day which had good shade and a small drinks fridge as well as plenty of chairs and tables. Our friends who are locals to the Barossa popped by for a dip and kids enjoyed the water slide. The kitchen had everything we needed to make our meals (microwave, kettle, toaster, air flyer) and there were two BBQ options available. Fairy blue wrens are jumping around outside and they were a delight to watch. Stephen gave clear instructions and was helpful and responsive. Hope to stay again.
Check in was easy and heating worked well on a cold night. Overall we enjoyed our stay.
Really nice to stay - clean and simple
We had a lovely stay. The place was nice and cosy and felt homely. The beds were comfortable and it had everything we needed. It was close to everything that we wanted to do.
Very neat and clean, had everything we needed.
Quiet peaceful stay. Wish we had more time!

Stephen was an amazing host! He was very responsive to messages and accommodated all of our requests. The airbnb was spotless on arrival and he was there to welcome us. We had friends who stayed in a caravan alongside and it was just the perfect spot to host our 2 groups. The pool is fantastic and the area surrounding is so well set up with speakers, tables and lounges.

Stephens place is well located and well provided. He was quick to respond and very communicative. Our only concerns are with cleanliness (rodent droppings on top of fridge and in basket above the fridge) plus very poor internet. The internet was often offline and when available the service wasn't really usable. Hopefully he is able to soon rectify the internet issues so that his future guests can maintain connection with distant friends and family

Stephen was very friendly and also accomodating to my families needs. A very relaxing place to stay, with a well equipped kitchen to make meals.
Thank you for a lovely stay and we will be back.
Stephen has a great set up with secure pool area. We now have some lovely memories with our kids and friends :)
clean and tidy, had everything we needed for a family, pool and pool area was excellent, common areas shared by other friendly campers & their pets who were quiet and respectful.

Thanks, it was a lovely place, that suited what we needed it for.
The pool was great to have for after the sport filled day.
Thanks again.
great place we loved it!
A great stay with kids. Pool with bbq area is lovely!

clean and comfortable accommodation. The pool area was fantastic. Great communication and lovely chocolates on arrival. Just a little maintenance required with the dishwasher, air con, and water temp controller but nothing that stopped us from having a great stay.

Lots of space, nice pool area, good beds, bathroom is wheelchair friendly.
Wish the bedrooms had windows so they could be better aired out.
Overall a very nice experience

Stephen’s place is as described and is overall good value for money. All fairly basic amenities but all you really need is available.
Friendly and apologetic hosts after they had a mix up with booking dates and cleaning/pre-organised transport, but all seemed like it was an honest mistake.
Location is a little out of the way but no real issue if you have your own transport. If not, taxis can be an issue to secure (and expensive), especially when local events are on as we experienced.
Steve's place is a perfect spot for an escape to the Barossa. Central, and great value. We also had great sleeps in the pitch black bedroom, a plus!
Stephen provided a great place to stay. Will definately stay again.
Great location, very quiet and comfortable.  Was warm and inviting and we all slept well in the comfortable beds.

We really enjoyed staying at Stephen's place. It was a different location to where we would usually stay in the Barossa, which was refreshing. The accommodation was clean and comfortable. We used the outdoor area for a BBQ, which was perfect.
As described.   Quick and friendly response.
Quiet, relaxing,  well placed BnB in the Barossa region. Steve communicates well.
Nice place to stay. Stephen was very communicative and helpful.

Location is quiet and away from other people,  yet only a short drive to anywhere in the Barossa or a short walk to a couple of cellar doors. Facilities are as described.  Outdoor setting is very relaxing. We loved it.
All good, as described.

Stephen's communication was friendly and he was quick to respond. We had a quiet stay and the beds were comfortable with quality linen.
Our only issues were, we wanted to open the only window/doors for fresh air, but couldn't as there were no flyscreens to keep bugs out. Also kids found the small bunkroom too warm, as it has no window.
Good place for a couple of days in the Barossa...and the kids loved the pool, making for a enjoyable stay.

Lambert’s Little Paradise was a great choice for our family of 4. The accommodation had everything we needed and the beds were comfy. The property is a good distance from any traffic and is well landscaped around the pool, it was quite peaceful sitting out on the front porch.
Stephen’s communication was excellent, and he responded quickly when we asked questions.
Great place to stay, we’d love to return at some point!
We had a great time at Lamberts little paradise. Perfect for our family of 4, close to everything in the Barossa, and the pool are was great. Will definitely stay again.
Absolutely loved our stay, kids had a ball in the pool, fantastic place. Will definitely be back!

We had a very peaceful and relaxing stay here. The accommodation was spotlessly clean inside. The pool was a fabulous bonus and we had it all to ourselves which was nice. The outside area was a little tired around the edges but overall it didn’t matter as the location was so peaceful and relaxing. It was also really lovely to meet Steve too, who was a kind and friendly man.
Excellent place to stay and surrounded by lots of places to visit. We wished we used the pools more but there was lots to do in the surrounding areas.

Tolle Poolanlage mit Rutschbahn, die Kinder hatten Spass.
Leider war die gesamte Unterkunft etwas staubig, die Badetücher rochen nach Zigarettenrauch, Waschmittel und Waschmaschinentabs waren praktisch leer, wenig Besteck, die Cornflakes und Brotaufstriche waren alle abgelaufen und trugen teilweise das Haltbarkeits-/Verfalldatum von Dezember 2023. (nach Kontaktaufnahme wurden Badetücher und Waschmittel ausgetauscht)
Das beschriebene Paradies scheint etwas in die Jahre gekommen zu sein und hat seinen Glanz verloren. Ein Grossputz, Aktualisierung der Einrichtung und einzelne liebevolle Details würden es wieder stark aufwerten.
Die Umgebung ist fantastisch und bietet viele Aktivitäten!!
cannot wait to stay again with friends
Tidy and quiet place. Use of a swimming pool was a bonus.  Everything worked.
Good place for a relaxing stay with bbq and pool.
This was a great place to stay if you want to visit the Barossa Valley. Comfortable and with everything you need, lovely pool and surrounds. Appreciated the breakfast selection.

Lovingly and beautifully restored old Kapunda train station. The photos don’t do it justice! This property is huge with massive bedrooms all very stylishly decorated. Great communication with the host and lots of nice little touches including continental breakfast being provided. Would highly recommend.

All aboard! We LOVED our recent stay at The Station.
Our group of seven (5 adults & 2 children) enjoyed a 2 night stay in May, and we wish our stay was longer!
From the start, our communication with Bridget (host) was great, and her warm welcome was informative and helpful. Bridget had thought of everything for our stay. From marshmallows to toast on the fire-pit, to delicious local essentials for breakfast.
The old Kapunda railway station is huge and has been lovingly and stylishly restored. There were plenty of living spaces, both indoor and outdoor, and we almost lost count of the bedrooms. Although the property is large, it is very cosy and was perfect for our weekend away. The bedrooms were toasty warm and are decorated in a stylish, minimalist manner. There were thoughtful touches like complimentary eyemasks and an ‘Alexa’ in each room. The games room was fun and the kids also enjoyed the wooden train set that was supplied. Other little touches like plenty of throw rugs, spare toiletries and a big bowl of fresh fruit made us just want to stay in all weekend! At the host’s recommendation, we also ordered a brunch box and a DIY pizza pack which was delivered to the door by local providore, Coopers Fresh.
When we did get out and about, we enjoyed walks around the town, some retail therapy in the local shops and a visit to the nearby playground. Pubs and the supermarket are also within walking distance.
We’d highly recommend The Station for a few days away. It’s great for families and groups and we’re already thinking about another visit! Toot Toot!

The Station is great place to bring people together for a wonderful holiday
It is full of generous and luxurious inclusions that make you feel welcome and relaxed.
We loved staying here and Bridget is an excellent host
Highlights
The cosy and comfortable beds
The outside fire pit and marshmallows
The hilariously competitive table tennis competitions
Place was a great with lots of thoughtful touches. Recommend it for 10+ guests

Fantastic place that offers something else - the atmosphere of being in an old railway station is special. The place has a nice design and special touches that makes it warm and welcoming. We had tree lovely nights, among others enjoying a big bonfire in the courtyard while looking at the stars. The kids had a blast exploring both inside and outside - it is not everyday you say yes to them playing on railway tracks.
Wonderful history in this old station. Has been tastefully decorated and is very comfortable. A must stay if your in the area.

Everything about this place will exceed your expectations.
From the get go Bridget was so helpful & accommodating.
Check in was a breeze with a guided tour and lay of the land.
From the furniture & super comfortable bedding to the custom room sprays & candles. This place has it all. Everything has been thought of & executed amazingly.
Highly recommended for anyone wanting a perfectly styled & exclusive stay with all the trimmings.
Would stay there again in a heartbeat.
Such an amazing stay! Bridget really did perfect everything - from the complimentary breakfast to the gifts you could purchase! This place has so much character and is so great for a big group.
Thank you do much for the beautiful stay!

Absolutely 10/10! The station is a stay unlike anywhere else. To be in such a historic and beautiful building, coupled with Bridget’s incredible restoration and styling. This place is a must with a group of friends or families! 2 nights certainly didn’t feel long enough. Bridget’s attention to detail was impeccable, not a single thing wasn’t considered.

This is such a special place to stay. I can see the host put lots of effects on decoration and make the house feel comfortable and stylish. We are group of two families had a wonderful two days stay in The Station.  Definitely recommend to everyone.

What a fantastic venue for a large group!
Can't recommend this highly enough. We had a wonderful stay and enjoyed all of the thoughtful touches & inclusions. :)

The Station would have to be one of the gorgeous, thoughtfully planned and executed airbnbs I have ever stayed at.
Cannot thank them enough for the amazing experience and beautiful space.
Can’t wait to come back!
Bridget was a wonderful host, quick with communication and responsive to all our requests. It was a unique stay, fully equipped with all the comforts of home. Can’t wait to return.

This is a truly spectacular building in a very pleasant town.
Beds were very comfortable and the duvets were both light weight and very effective for cold evenings.
The fire pit was a huge hit with our group,and the pizza oven for a bunch of novices produced stunning pizzas.
The kitchen was extremely well equiped and it was very special sourcing herbs and tomatoes from the adjacent garden.
If you are looking for an architecturally interesting property to stay in then The Station is perfect - a very big and beautiful building .
Just be aware of the floor plan as the two smallest bedrooms are attached to other bigger bedrooms and therefore access to a bathroom requires walking through another bedroom.
Another huge plus was the size of the property - plenty of outdoor and indoor spaces for a big group

The Station is a stunning property with many thoughtful touches. the many bedrooms and living areas both inside and out make for a great location for group gatherings. A wonderful location for our family celebration.

Absolutely stunning location, you will not want to leave the house. Perfect place to get away and share some great times with amazing people in your life. Bridget was an incredible host, nothing was a problem, she organised an amazing cheese platter spread and ingredients to make home made pizzas in the pizza oven. Unforgettable experience!
Our stay was utterly flawless. Bridget is a super-host! She goes above and beyond to ensure your stay is special and memorable. I would definitely book to stay here again

What a fantastic location. We were looking for something a bit unique, and large enough for close family and friends over a weekend as an extended celebration for my wife’s 40th….The Station definitely hit the spot.
Fascinating how an original train station was converted in such away, whilst keeping all of its charm.
So much care has gone into with attention to detail being on the mark. And such comfortable beds!
Bridget the owner is also what made the location and the weekend a memorable one. So helpful, so easy to communicate with so obvious the pride that is had but I can’t thank Bridget enough.
We will definitely be back!

Such a wonderful property that exceeded expectations by all of us that stayed there. The house was beautifully presented and Bridget was a great host, with wonderful recommendations for weekend events. We had a private Chef come to the house to cook for the group of us - arranged by Bridget. This was a family trip and there was plenty of space and room for the 12 of us to all be together whilst having our own space at times also.
Thank you again for a wonderful weekend away.

3 families - 6 adults and 6 kids comfortably stayed at The Station. The property has been beautifully renovated and it was a joy to stay there.
Loads of space outside for the kids to explore and with plenty of seating to enjoy the morning and afternoon sunshine. There was plenty of room inside also with enough space to relax.
The kitchen was very well equipped and included some tasty treats for us all to enjoy. I would highly recommend a stay at The Station when in the Barossa Valley. Everything we needed was provided and also close to the surrounding wineries!

We had a fantastic weekend stay at The Station. Bridget was an awesome host with excellent communication. She made sure we had everything we need during our stay and even accommodated the kids for murder mystery party to get them involved. We thoroughly enjoyed our time there and would highly recommend it to family and friends.
Wonderful house for a large group of people. Attention to detail and comfort is perfect.

We loved our stay at The Station. As a group of 7 adults, there was plenty of space for all of us, and lots of options of places to sit around or spread out.
The backyard area is great and has a pool! Not sure if this is advertised but bring your bathers.
Lots of breakfast supplies left, great kitchen with everything you’d need to cook for yourselves. Kapunda is quiet, but the accommodation is so beautifully furnished you could easily just hang out there and do little else. It was only 25 minutes to Tanunda.
Bring a sleep mask though as upstairs is very bright in the mornings and doesn’t have blinds.
Fantastic place to stay, so much character. Had a great weekend.

The Station is a stunning property, filled with comfortable bedrooms, an incredibly well equipped kitchen, a variety of indoor spaces to relax as well as amazing outdoor facilities with a pool.  Bridget is an great host with nothing too much trouble. Bridget helped the family arrange a Vietnamese dinner served on the platform to celebrate by brother's birthday, as well as a  fun 'make your own pizza' night using the wood-fired pizza oven in the courtyard. With Bridget's help and the amazing Station facilities available, a wonderful weekend was had by all 12 family members.  We would highly recommend The Station and would not hesitate to return.
Very clear check in instructions, as well as Bridget’s flexibility and responsiveness made this a super easy stay
Airbnb was a good place to stay at with a group of people. Responsive host.

Unique, beautifully restored, amazing property for a getaway. Drive in any direction to get to great wineries, or spend time in at a historic station with incredible thought given to all the small details. Backyard is a highlight, and it’s just a rare find made all the more better by Bridget who is a warm and thoughtful host always taking care to curate a 5 star experience.

Beautiful accommodation with a relaxed vibe. It was the perfect set up for our group trip. Many outdoor areas to enjoy the serenity and large private bedrooms with super comfy beds.
The house is within walking distance to Main Street, coffee shops etc.
Bridget is very responsive and offers many suggestions. Highly recommend and will stay again!

We stayed at The Railway Station over NYE for 2 nights with our friends & 2 kids. The property is just sublime. 2 nights was just not enough! Bridget was an incredible host & catered for our every need, from beautiful fruit on arrival, to gorgeous crockery, stunning linen, even down to supplying ample quality sunscreen - she has thought of everything & was incredibly helpful & generous. You will not be disappointed by this accomodation & all it has to offer - during our stay we had intended on visiting wineries & exploring the area, but the house was just too gorgeous to warrant venturing out! We truly wished we had booked to stayed longer. It is also worth mentioning that due to the stations beautifully renovated thick walls, there was almost no noise travel between rooms & outside, hence our little ones slept well while we enjoyed the lounge & outdoor areas through the night. Also the fast commercial dishwasher was a lifesaver! The accomodation is flawless & Bridget is wonderful!

Absolutely loved our stay at The Station for my 50th birthday celebrations. Bridget was a dream, willing to help in any way, nothing was a problem, so much attention to detail. Bridget put on a high tea for us and baked delicious treats fresh on the premises, we couldn’t believe it!
She’s such a chilled, friendly and gracious host! Everything was perfect, the beds and linen are to die for! There was even sunblock provided and other bits n bobs to make your stay even more comfortable. I’d move in if I could haha, we loved it that much! Just go, you won’t regret it! You won’t want to leave! All aboard!!!!! Thank you Bridget xx

We had a fantastic weekend away at The Station hosted by Bridget. A private, spacious accommodation close to Barossa. All the amenities you could want with generous little extras. Thanks to Bridget for all your recommendations and flexibility. We will return.
Our group of 8 adults, 6 children (3-10) & 2 (very) little ones found this to be really well suited to our needs. The pool was a hit with all our crew and the games available were well appreciated.
Fabulous location for a weekend getaway

The station is an impossibly beautiful mansion, equipped with a chef's kitchen and fire pit, pizza oven, pool, and private (unused!) train track outside. The linen and the stylings of each room was impeccable. It was cold (middle of winter stay) but Bridget brought over a battalion hot water bottles within the hour of us mentioning the chill, and was an absolutely impeccable host. Nothing was too much trouble, and she was a delight. We arranged to have her man the pizza oven the first night for an additional charge, and the food she made was delicious. She brought over dry wood within the hour too for the outside fire pit when we discovered all the wood was wet and wouldn't burn. It was a lovely private place to stay with a bevvy of friends, and pretend we were fancy as hell for a couple of days. A delight!

Our stay at the station was amazing. The vibe was perfect for a super relaxing little weekend away. Hardly felt the cold even though it was the middle of winter. We had such a great time, thank you Bridget!!

We celebrated an 80th birthday at The Station with multiple generations along for the trip. There was something for everyone and lots of spaces to come together as well as have time apart.
Bridget was a wonderful host for our entire stay, going over and above as well as adding small touches without us asking making our special weekend all the more special.
Thank you for having us and we will definitely be back.
Great spot for an extended family! Will be coming back.
Great place for a large group for a couple of days ! Thank you

Perfect for our group (8 people, all in their own beds). Photos don't do the house justice - tastefully decorated and spotless.
There are several large spaces in the house to relax, and outdoor areas to lounge and follow the sun. Fire pit, pool, table tennis table, all great additions.
Stand out was the hospitality. The option to add catered breakfasts and dinner (home made pizza in the pizza oven) along with a private wine tasting, really added a level of personalization I've never experienced before. Host incredibly lovely and accommodating and we were made to feel very welcome.
Wouldn't hesitate to stay again or recommending to others.
Bridget was always responsive and helpful in providing recommendations for our stay. The linen was very comfortable which made for an enjoyable sleep!
Amazing

The Station was an absolutely fabulous location for our weekend away with friends and Bridget is the most magnificent host organising everything we could have needed even a delicious dinner with the most talented chef Clare for our first night. We had planned to do things in the Barossa during the day, but ended up staying the entire weekend at the property because it was just so brilliant and we didnt want to leave! I cant wait to come back again

The Station is a one-of-a-kind property and it completely exceeded expectations. It feels like a private resort and is so immaculately presented throughout. Our long weekend was a dream and that was really down to Bridget’s incredible hosting. She gave us the best local recommendations and made sure our three day group celebration event ran smoothly. I have never had an AirBnb host go so graciously above and beyond, whilst striking the perfect balance between being helpful and available but allowing us our privacy and space. The memories and photos we have from our weekend here will be treasured by all of us and I hope to visit again one day soon.

Right from Bridget allowing us to view the property a year earlier to see if it suited our group, right down to the prompt communications and meeting us on arrival. Our entire stay was just wonderful and enjoyed by the whole group. Beds so comfortable, plenty of outdoor entertaining spaces to enjoy, beautiful fresh pool. House interiors are stunning and very comfortable, games room, pool towels, outdoor blankets, coffee machine, outdoor candles, bbq and plenty of seating for big groups. It felt very luxurious and comfortable. Thank you again Bridget & all the best
Bridget was the most amazing Airbnb host I have ever had. She was incredibly responsive, very helpful, and the property was stunning. I cannot recommend staying at the station enough.

Wow - what an incredibly special place for me to celebrate my 30th birthday with my nearest and dearest. The 10 of us friends had the best time - such cozy sleep, a lovely evening around the fire, dinner on the platform and a breaky out in the sun by the pool. You will not be disappointed by this place!!

Simply stunning, unique place, has everything you need and a thousand things you didn’t know you needed. Best equipped kitchen I have come across in an Airbnb, super cosy and comfortable beds, lots to do for adults and kids and easy walk to Main Street. This place would be optimal in summer to maximise
Use of the outdoor options but we stayed in the middle of winter and still loved it and made the most of the outdoor fire pit and heating. Bridget was a great host, personally checking us in and giving us detailed instructions on the myriad of different things available to make the stay so enjoyable. Short drive to Barossa and Clare valleys to enjoy some wine.

We booked the Station for a family weekend , thirteen of us,to celebrate 2 milestone birthdays.
The house was spotless, the ammenities were fantastic, the attention to detail with furnishing, plentiful throw rugs, individual bathroom baskets, kitchen facilities with commercial dishwasher, coffee machine with fresh beans, kitchen utensils and platters, bbq, woodfired pizza oven, the list goes on and on.
Bridget organised catering for dinner on Saturday night from the local vietnamese restaurant which was delicious and generous servings and served in lovely platters/ bowls.
The winter weather was miserable but didn't dampen our experience as there was plenty of room for everyone to enjoy the house and the great ammenities.
We will definitely visit again, next time in spring/ summer when we can make use of the pool and gorgeous outdoor spaces.
Place was very spacious and clean
Very spacious home, quiet area and all the facilities you could need .. great place to stay, we will be back again for sure .
Perfect house for our group, has everything you need - great hosts too.

Nick’s house is homely, welcoming and the kitchen is well stocked with good quality appliances, equipment and generous provisions of tea, coffee and milk. It was spotlessly clean. The hosts also left a welcoming message with a bottle of wine and chocolates.
The beds were comfortable, the heating was efficient, overall a very comfortable home.
One of our party is an Airbnb superhost and she asked me to pass on her compliments to the hosts. Highly recommended.
Great location great spot!
Great house and great host
Great place to stay
comfortable accommodation

We had a great stay with Nick.
The location was great, and the accomodation was very spacious and clean!
I would highly recommend Nick for anyone looking for a quiet and relaxing Barossa retreat!

Nick's place in Nuriootpa is perfect for those planning a getaway to the Barossa Valley, plenty of excellent wineries within short driving distance.  The house neat, clean and spacious with plenty of room to cater for larger groups and although being close town is on a pretty quiet street. Would definitely stay here again on our next trip to the Barossa.

Nicks accommodation is spaciouse, warm and very clean. Nick is easy to communicate with and accommodate my family with requests beyond the standard stay. I would totally recommend staying at Nick's air bnb
Lovely clean home with plenty of room for a large group. Just need to be aware the hot water is not unlimited - need to organise showers and stick to a time limit!

Great roomy house in a really quiet street. Everything is easily accessible and it’s a great launching pad for a Barossa holiday. Nick is a terrific host with excellent communication. We couldn’t have asked for any more.
Great big, convenient and clean house to stay in. Absolutely loved the 5 nights spent there and would highly recommend.
Comfortable house.
Excellent hosts highly recommend, great house very clean
Fantastic place to stay, everything you need is there. Great location.
Thanks for providing great accommodation for the crew at Fabtech.
Nick’s place is in a great location, easy to find, spacious and very accommodating.
We had a wonderful weekend at Nick’s place. It is a large house with plenty of room for everyone. It was clean and comfortable. Great location. Nick met us on arrival which was appreciated.
if this place was on the market I would buy it,  fantastic set up, room for everyone and quiet places where you can relax away from everyone. Great BBQ area outside.
Felt very welcomed by Nick when we arrived and the house was very accommodating to our needs.
Fantastic place to stay in the Barossa. Nick was brilliant and easy to communicate with the entire trip. Highly recommend for a perfect stay with family and friends.
Great location, close to everything Barossa and surrounds have to offer. Excellent and welcoming host, felt like we were just at home. Would recommend and would come back!

Kirsten’s home has spectacular views, gorgeous gardens and is a beautifully clean and inviting place to stay. Kirsten was kind and helpful with lots of great suggestions for places to visit in the area. We really enjoyed our stay and highly recommended her home as a peaceful get away in the Barossa.

Great house not being able to use the kitchen was a bit of a bummer. Finding out that the owner was going to be staying in the house was surprising and not what we were expecting. Great house but felt like we had to be in the bedroom for privacy while the owner was in the house. Incredible bath tub
Great house, modern, well decorated and Kirsten is very accomodating. Great place to stay for the weekend!

Amazing setting with magnificent views. Kristen so obviously enjoys sharing her space and is both a generous host and discreet in her ability to truly share her space. She provides a generous hamper of provisions and a whole shelf in the fridge.
The accommodation is sumptuous - as others have mentioned the bath is terrific, the wood burner was also effective in reaching our bedroom, an oil heater was also provided but we did not feel the need. Kirsten is passionate about this off grid experience and it shows in her thoughtful attention to detail.
We really enjoyed getting to know Angaston better, great food, shops and fab bike hire service and cycle track.
Would not hesitate to recommend.

Great spot, everything was fantastic and Kirsten was an excellent and welcoming host. Relaxing by the fire after a day out in the winter rain and cold was a treat and the view across the valley was awesome.
Beautiful views
Beautiful place to stay with amazing views. Overall everything was very clean and tidy and had everything we needed. Watching the sunset on the deck was amazing at night.

Beautiful home and the view is phenomenal - surely the best view of the Barossa! Kirsten was so lovely and communicated well ahead and during my stay. All the facilities were as described and the bed very comfortable. Can absolutely recommend and I will certainly be heading back again next time I stay in the Barossa.

Beautiful spot for anyone who needs to get away and relax, my partner and I loved our stay, the views were tranquil.
We will be back !!
Thank you again Kirsten. :)
The views from Kirsten's house are beautiful and she is a very accommodating host. Great location.
Kirsten has an amazing place. Good stay in a quiet town if you want to travel to different vineyards in the Barossa valley, as it is close by. The place was very clean.

Great location and hosts. You can expect a quiet night’s rest and an interesting and informal chat with your hosts if that’s what you like.  Very clean facilities and a lovely outdoor entertaining area that we would have used if it wasn't winter. Would book again when heading to the Barossa.
Great stay, Mai has a lot of knowledge of wine and nearby wineries which was very helpful. Very accommodating and pleasant stay.
Great location, quiet and peaceful surroundings, friendly and welcoming hosts, enjoyed the warm winter sun coming through the window and hot bath. Excellent heating and cleanliness
Wonderful hosts and great accommodation! If you’re worried about privacy, don’t be. Good privacy for any guest and Mai is lovely and very welcoming.  Perfect location to experience the Barossa! :)
A clean open place, friendly hosts, nice to have the bathroom & toilet so handy to the bedroom.

A very comfortable and peaceful place to stay. Handy location for visiting all parts of the Barossa. Mai and her husband are very friendly and welcoming and happy to recommend places to visit. We would recommend this place to others and certainly hope to go back again ourselves one day. Wendy and John
So super helpful and friendly. Great peaceful spot. Would definately stay again
Vitalii made us feel very welcome in their home. Perfectly located to enjoy the great wineries in the area. Thanks for the pleasant stay Mai and Vitalii.

Great central location to main street in Tanunda and surrounding wineries... a 20 to 25 min flat walk to town with so many beautiful houses to look at on the way. Living space is huge and Mai and Vitali very accommodating and helpful. A great bbq outside for cooking, if you don't want to share the kitchen area.

Mai and Vitalii are probably the best hosts I've ever encountered. Both of them are very welcoming and approachable. Beautiful house with lovely front and back yards, nice and friendly neighbourhood, and surrounded by tones of great wineries. Mai is an expert when it comes to wines and wineries, and knows the surroundings very well. Definitely recommend!
Comfortable place to stay, conveniently located in the heart of the Barossa Valley. Great hosts.

Wow!  What a great place. Julie and Peter have obviously put a lot of love restoring this beautiful lodge over the past 3 years. Just a lovely place to stay. We will definitely visit again. It is great to share with work colleagues, friends and/or family. Location is great - close to Adelaide and on the doorstep of the Barossa. Julie was a perfect host. Can't fault it.
Beautiful house, we have a great stay
Fantastic house and beautiful surroundings. Julie made our stay extra special and we truly valued her professionalism and assistance during our stay. Would highly recommend.

Amazing house and amazing hosts. Julie went above and beyond - putting away our groceries prior to our arrival - which was late at night. The house is clean , comfortable, has everything you need and is a short drive from all the attractions if the Barossa . There were 8 of us and each had our own room. I would highly recommend Julie’s house .

A brilliant venue - well appointed, clean and spacious. Our group of 10 adults were thrilled with the layout and facilities. We hosted a Murder Mystery dinner party and had a ball. Kitchen is well appointed. Quiet at night. Local wildlife - kangaroos and birds - provided entertainment. Host was attentive and provided excellent communication.
Great property for large groups, well equipped with gorgeous country vistas.

A great accomodation for a large family or group of friends. Warm, cosy and spacious you can spread out. Kitchen is well appointed. Showers are hot and beds comfortable. Electric blankets if needed - we didn’t use them. Wildlife around the property and a lovely balcony area to watch the visiting kangaroos. A great vase for exploring the Barossa and Gawler. Host is a great source of ideas for what to do and see. House is one level and has easy access for pram or wheelchair. A great spot to relax or celebrate 🎉

7 adults staying in separate rooms. Beautiful house, very clean and well maintained. Loads of space in every room and plenty of chairs etc for everyone. Comfortable beds, everything we needed. Good aircon for heating in living areas. Julie very welcoming and flexible with us leaving things at the property early.  We had a mouse in a couple of the rooms but understand that might be hard to avoid at times in this location.

Fabulous place for a group stay.  Loads of space and hot water!!!!!!  The oranges from the orange tree in the back garden were outstanding!  We all loved the light fittings throughout and parrot wallpaper in the little nook!

I hosted a relaxing prayer retreat at Julie's bnb and it was absolutely the perfect location. It's so rare to find somewhere with lots of bedrooms and bathrooms and with individual beds rather than bunks.
The views were beautiful, it was lovely and warm in the home, plenty of space to spread out, and ample space for our caterer to prep food.
The Barossa/Adelaide Hills was being hit by a bit of a mice plague when we stayed, which unfortunately affected our stay slightly as we had a few invited guests and one room was inaccessible related to this. Julie made every effort to ensure this didn't affect our stay, but it was fortunate we were down a guest due to illness and didn't need this room.
I would highly recommend this venue and will likely stay again!

this place is a palace. enough room for all of us with excellent fixtures and great kitchen for mass catering. the bathrooms are numerous and beds all very comfy. Julie is a breeze to deal with and great value for what you get.

The house itself is beautifully set up and has everything we need and Julie is a fantastic, attentive host. The views from every window and the rear balcony are beautiful and it's such a peaceful place to stay. We loved waking  up to see kangaroos hopping past. It's an easy, picturesque drive to see all that the Barossa region has to offer. Thanks for having us Julie!!!
Great place for a big family, our first trip to the area and loved it

A big thank you for a wonderful weekend break for our group of friends.
A great location and so much room for us all.
Julie is a great host and nothing was too much trouble.
Will definitely be visiting again.
This is a lovely spot form large gathering of friends. The house is a grand old lady, well appointed and very comfortable. We had a splendid week long stay
Stay was very nice
Great location for a family/friends getaway.
Fantastic location, beautiful surrounds. Has everything you need to host a large group for the weekend.

A beautiful old lady with charm. The kitchen and bathrooms were updated but in keeping with the character of the home. There was plenty of space for our large family of 13, both inside and out. Julie was very helpful and accommodating, especially as we arrived early. Loved the welcome gift basket.
Would highly recommend for a large group.
Julie was a great host. We were looked after very well. Property had loads of space both inside and outside. Kids enjoyed a lot. I would recommend Julie’s place for large groups up to 16 guests.

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay in this beautiful home. The huge space easily accommodated our large group with ample amenities and bedrooms. Made to feel comfortable immediately with contact from Julie at the start of the week and on the day of check in, as well as a lovely welcome hamper. We’d happily stay here again.
Julie is a marvellous host who is highly responsive to any questions that you may have.  Would highly recommend Balmoral to anyone wishing to visit the Barossa as a large group.

A great house to have our family all together, cooking, dining and making memories we won’t forget. We had everything we needed with spaces to suit everyone. Julie was a good host, prompt responses and very personable. We
loved the location and it was easy to explore the Barossa!
Had a great time at the Lodge with my close friends, would highly recommend it!

We had a lovely time at Balmoral Lodge, the new games room is a great addition and we spent lots of our time in there.
We stayed with 4 generations of family and it suited us all.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Balmoral Lodge.  What a great place for a group of friends to enjoy.
A lovely home and base to explore the Barossa. We had a lot of fun 😊

We had a fantastic stay at Balmoral Lodge.
It is a truly unique property and perfect to cater for a family Christmas in July weekend.
The kitchen was perfect for our needs and there was plenty of space to come together as a family as well as have your own private space to retreat if you wished.
The games room was a big hit!
Many rounds of competitive Kelly pool were played well into the night.
The little kids made good use of the lawned area during the day and a highlight was definitely the kangaroos that paid us a visit.
We all agreed this is somewhere we would like to visit again.
Thanks for a peaceful weekend away 💕

A lovely house , that fitted our large tribe for a family reunion. Beautiful big rooms and bathrooms. The games room was awesome and made for lots of fun nights
A great place to stay to explore the Barossa Valley
We will be back

Balmoral Lodge was a beautiful place to spend 5 days. The house was clean, tidy and everything we needed was there. The surroundings were beautiful with plenty of kangaroos and birds. We also enjoyed spending time outside under the stars with the fire.

Our group of friends had a wonderful stay at Julie's place. The big house and many bedrooms made it perfect for us and the surroundings were very peaceful and close to access the Barossa. Julie was ready to communicate with and we enjoyed the lovely welcome platter!

This is our second stay at Balmoral. Great accommodation for our group of 14 adult friends. Plenty of bedrooms and bathrooms and a beautiful big dining room for us to enjoy our meals. Thanks Julie
Loved it

We stayed here for a family birthday - 16 people across 4 generations. Everyone was happy, comfortable and entertained while staying here. The property is just stunning as well as highly functional for large groups. Totally recommend and would definitely return.

Julie and her son Scott were great with communication and the house was easy to find etc. We were 4 couples spending the weekend in the barossa. It was the perfect house for that - plenty of space and very homely - perfect for couples or a couple of families. Kitchen very well stocked with crockery, glassware and cooking equipment. Also a fantastic games room. We all had a fantastic stay. Thank you

Julie's place is a beautiful, stately home in a pretty, peaceful, and quiet location. It is just as described and in the photos. It was perfect for our extended family of 14, including a 1 year old. Beds are very comfy, lovely bathrooms, and lots of space, and we had everything we needed in the kitchen. BBQ was clean and the verandah is a lovely place to sit at sunset. Julie is a very helpful host and was quick to respond and help with suggestions for our trip to the Barossa.
Fantastic place, Easy stay with no hassle, Highly recommended!

We thoroughly enjoyed our second visit to this beautiful home. We loved waking up to the sight of kangaroos, kookaburras, sheep and even a friendly cow next door who loves a pat over the fence!
It's perfect for large groups, close to all that Barossa has to offer while still being close to shops if required.
Julie is a fantastic host and is great to communicate with!
Lovely property and Julie was extremely kind in all of her communication.
We had a great time.
Julie is really helpful and great place to stay for large groups. Very quiet and peaceful environment. Will definitely stay next time.
Fabulous place, Julie was extremely friendly and communicative, before, during, and after our stay - Will defiantly be back again.

We stayed at Balmoral with 4 other couples for the Gather Round weekend. The house is exceptional, and very spacious. Beautiful surroundings, close to Adelaide as well as local wineries. Julie was a very responsive host and had a great information stand setup at the house for local recommendations. Bedding was more than adequate, as was the kitchen and dining areas which we used for a group dinner. Would highly recommend staying at Balmoral if you’re looking to get around the Barossa or stay somewhere a bit quieter out of Adelaide.

The house was perfect for a group of 6 friends. We loved the individual decor in the bedrooms and bathrooms. The kitchen was well equipped and it was beautiful sitting out on the veranda watching the kangaroos. The pool table was also fantastic! Tanunda was a short drive away so the location was also great. I’d highly recommend this fabulous house for a stay in the Barossa.
Julie was great at communication, really friendly and flexible. We would highly recommend staying here again.
Julie was a fantastic host, the play was fantastic and great for larger groups.  Highly recommend👍
The antiques in the house made the house feel so homely. It was such an amazing experience 10/10

A fantastic spot for a family gathering with the multiple bedrooms & bathrooms made it so we were not on top of each other.
The external areas were lovely at night but could do with additional lighting, especially between the games room & the kitchen.
Staying in the middle of winter, we had the air-con on which kept the lounge, kitchen & dining room toasty warm but the bedrooms would benefit from having more heaters. The electric blankets were nice but the room stayed cold.
Sharing a bathroom with family is okay, we all obviously know each other but if you are sharing with friends or acquaintances, the lack of sound proofing may prove awkward.
All in all, in was a wonderful stay, an amazing location which we all loved and getting together as a extended family in one location made for memories that will last forever.
I want to thank Julie for letting us stay and being an outstanding hostess.

I cannot thank Julie enough for a wonderful stay in the Barossa. My friends and I were all from out of town and in the region for a wedding. Julie's homestead was the perfect backdrop for us to catch up and enjoy our time together. Julie is a very responsive and thoughtful host - even putting together a welcome platter for our arrival! The place is absolutely gorgeous, extremely spacious and the decor is tastefully maximalist. We felt so spoilt staying there. Highly recommend!
Nice accommodation and peaceful. Games room is a nice place to hang out

this was the most amazing place, we walked in and felt very at home.the food platter was very welcome after our journey. Everything had been thought about and we lacked for nothing. The groom was easily able to prepare for his wedding here and the photographer had many choices for picture backgrounds.
we hosted a morning after breakfast on the verandah and were lucky to be joined by the Kangaroos. thank you for a magical experience.
The house was absolutely huge. The amenities were amazing - we spent hours playing pool and table soccer. Julie was a great host, even providing a welcome platter!

This house is great for groups or families. Plenty of space for everyone and not feel overcrowded. We had the best time there. Made some wonderful memories. The architectural features of the house, the large bedrooms, the antique furniture all added to the beauty of this grand old home. The verandah overlooks the paddocks with plenty of animals and birds to watch if you just sit and take the time. The games room was great for both adults and the kids. Julie was a fantastic host who was happy to answer any questions we may have had prior to our arrival. Everyone loved the home.
Julie is the perfect host.  Property is amazing, a lot of space that can accommodate families. Very peaceful location.  Highly recommended Julie and her beautiful house.

Julie’s place was amazing! We had an unforgettable weekend with all our closest friends. The furniture and decor was incredible and there was ample room for all of us. Thank you Julie for a wonderful time away :)
What an amazing place for a weekend away. Expansive house with huge bedrooms, lots of bathrooms, amazing kitchen and a beautiful view from the back verandah

The homestead is beautifully furnished and has a comfortable and homely feel. Small details like fans in all rooms (extreme heatwave on our stay) would have made all guests more comfortable. Screens on windows and doors would allow fresh air to circulate. For the price, a small detail like a milk frother would have made for a nicer coffee. Julie's welcome platter was a lovely touch.
Fabulous place, We had so much fun, so much to see with good friends! I highly recommend this place for a big group!

We had an old school friends catch up to celebrate us all turning 60.
The property was perfect!
Plenty of room for a large group and enough bathrooms and bedrooms to suit everyone.
The kitchen was very well equipped and a really good space.
Great dining room and living area with enough room for everyone to get together .
We had a heap of fun in the games room and loved hanging out on the front verandah with the kangaroos having a wine.
Julie was extremely helpful and very accommodating and nothing was too much trouble.
Everyone in our group was impressed with the property and would highly recommend it for a large group of people.
A great house for a get together with friends or family.

the house was very comfortable and the fact that we were able to have separate beds as a group of ladies was much appreciated. it was very clean and had lots of games which we enjoyed of a night. Julie answered our questions in a very timely manner .

This was our second stay at Cockatoo Valley house, and it was just as wonderful. Perfect for families with little kids, Julie is a wonderful host. The rooms are large, there are heated blankets for the beds when it gets cold.
We had a wonderful time and the kids (or perhaps the dads) loved hanging in the games room.

We had a great time at Julie’s house! She was a great attentive host for any questions or needs we had. The place was lovely and the bedrooms were huge and accomodating! The game room was an added bonus with a pool table and other games to enjoy. Lovely expansive property, it’s of games, lots of dvds! Huge kitchen and great bathrooms and beds! Highly recommended, hopefully we can come back again soon! Thanks Julie
Beautiful country style home in a good location and only a short drive to some lovely wineries.  Julie was always prompt with response to questions.  Highly recommended.
