Three good sized rooms with one having its own air conditioning and the others fans. Large and comfortable lounge and a good kitchen.
The highlight would be the old alpacas, sheep and a goat in the back paddock and the treats that were left for us to enjoy.
Kate and Chris (and Kevin) are still working on improvements so I’m sure it will only get better
As the picture suggests it is on the main road into Tanunda but elevated above it so there is a little road noise. Note the great location though and the back bedroom is very quiet.
We loved staying there and a great base to explore the Barossa.
Felt right at home for our relaxing stay.

Beautiful place, great location! Lovely property with animals at the start of the main road in Tanunda.
Little kitchen with everything we needed, 2 toilets with a massive modern bathroom. Beds were comfy with plenty of heating/cooling options. only negative was the lounges sink when you sit on them.
Great location, beautiful views, loved the animals and very walkable. Kate was a gem to communicate with.

The cottage was comfortable and as described. Wonderful amenities and a short walk to many restaurants and shops.
Would definitely recommend!
Beautiful little cottage in the best location to explore all tanunda has to offer.

A wonderful home with a peaceful outlook and views. We really enjoyed our stay! Kate was very helpful and there were so many lovely little touches to make us feel at home. Would definitely stay again.
Nice place. Good location

Kate was very responsive to our queries during our stay. Her place is clean and beautiful and thoughtfully laid out with all sorts of amenities, including breakfast items for the first morning and a lovely bottle of wine. The bathroom is huge! And we loved waking up to see the alpacas and goats in the field right behind.
A great location to explore Barossa Valley and we would definitely stay here again when we come back.
Great location and amenities. Kate was responsive to messages and easy to communicate with
We had a great stay!
Had a fabulous time and will come back. Kate and her Mum made you feel safe and right at home. Thank you for our beautiful stay at your lovely cottage. 🍾🥂💗

Absolutely recommended!
Great space, location, set up. Everything we wanted and needed. Our kids loved the animals out the back. Kate and Chris were happy to help with any questions or tips we had.
We will be staying here again!
Great spot. Host very responsive and helpful. Lovely stay.

Fantastic little place, all the things you need for a country escape.
Remember to duck on door heads if your taller than 5 foot 7 inches!
Enjoy the calm and the fun of the animals out the back, kids will love the play between the goat, llama and shetland pony.
All in all really worth the trip.
Kate was lovely and so were her animals the goat horse alpaca and sheep

We had a wonderful stay at Kate and Chris’ place! The hosts were very responsive and helpful!
The animals are such a lovely touch, it was so nice waking up in the morning and seeing them in the garden!
The home is a great size, the beds were very comfortable and the electric blankets were a great touch, we didn’t feel the cold at all whilst in the house. The location is also great, we walked into town to get breakfast and coffee each morning.
Can’t recommend this place enough! We will definitely be back 😊

Kate was lovely and left clear instructions and a few very nice gifts which were consumed!
We stayed for 3 nights in the middle of winter.
The house is cute and small, with lovely animals in the backyard.
Few things to be aware of
- there is no heating in all room's (but all beds have bed warmers and are incredibly cosy).
- the bathroom can be opened from the hallway or from one of the bedrooms so wasnt as private given we had 3 couples staying.
- The house was cold, the split aircon heating struggles to warm up the place
But overall very enjoyable stay, place is as advertised, so so close to Tanunda we walked over every day and very cute animals in the backyard. Look forwards to returning to the barossa again!
Cosy Cottage & bonus company of the Alpacas, Sheep, Shetland Pony & Charlotte the Goat.
Beautiful home nice and close to town. Loved sitting out in the garden and admiring the surrounds. Will definitely stay here again.

This place is in a great location, central to the Barossa and walking distance into the tanunda town centre it was really wonderful. Our baby thoroughly enjoyed seeing the animals in the mornings outside. This place is definitely an older style eclectic cottage vibe with some short doorways and doors that don’t close properly etc but the beds were comfy and warm, the main bathroom was large and lovely, and the facilities were suitable for a family friendly stay. The hosts communication was really proactive and helpful.
A lovely spot with lovely beds and a gorgeous garden and animals. Nice touches with bacon and eggs and a bottle of wine. Very clean and well appointed

This is a wonderful place to stay.
All our people love coming here for the peace, the wonderful host and their hospitality, and of course the menagerie of farm anaimals that greet you every time you return.
If you're heading to the Barossa, this little gem is well worth your while.
Great location and an awesome space for dogs to play alongside the Alpaca’s and sheep! Kate was great to deal with and provided a lovely bottle of wine, eggs and bacon a brilliant touch to the visit.

We wish we could have stayed longer here - it was a brilliant location at one end of Tununda.
We loved sitting under the old Fig Tree at the end of the day and enjoying a glass of wine as the sun went down - so much so - that on our 2nd night we chose to 'eat in' - however - it is a very pleasant and level walk into town to all the cafes and dining places available there for you.
We also hired e-bikes from the Information Centre and were able to explore much of the area including beautiful vineyards and trails.
The animals out the back are great as a distraction - and the blackbirds sang their hearts our for us!!
The house is spotless - we were very impressed all round.
You do need to stay aware of a couple of low door ways - but we would love to return one day

Great location, and lovely place to stay. Hosts communicated well, and the cottage is dog friendly. Easy to walk to anything you need, and plenty of room inside with everything you might want for your stay.
Lots of space outside as well, and our dog enjoyed watching the animals!
Highly recommended...and we intent to visit again.
Great location, conveniently within walking distance from the shops. Comfortable and well equiped accommodation. Pet friendly with an enclosed yard.
We loved our stay in the Barossa. Kate’s cottage had everything we needed!
We had a great stay in Tanunda. Great location with all the amenities. The alpacas and goats were also very friendly as well!
Kate was super friendly, helpful. A great host
Lots of character! Great place to unwind with the outdoor area & animals.
Lovely cottage with secure garden for dog to play in.

Kate’s place was awesome. We loved watching the llamas and the house was in a perfect location. We had the best seats in the house for the tour down under and it was walking distance to everything. The wifi was great for working remotely too.
beautiful home in a beautiful location

Such a beautiful old cottage, very quaint with a beautiful spotless bathroom. The garden was lovely and had different seating areas, best sitting under the fig tree looking out at the view. The welcome pack was a treat to have everything for breakfast, huge TV and very comfortable lounges. Very quiet and peaceful. Would highly recommend.

Kate defines the term 'Super Host'. A great place with clear communications throughout the stay. I'll be back!
Matt

A fantastic place to stay for 2 nights whilst we explored Kangaroo Island. The unit is clean and tidy and a great place to relax over a drink a wine at the end of the day. We walked next door and sampled the bevvies at Kangaroo Brewery one night. Totally enjoyed staying here. Highly recommend.
Many thanks, Team, Brian and Andrea

Great location, clean, very nice cottage with cute bedrooms, love the shower room but can imagine it’s difficult with 6 people, more coat hangers would have been good, and the eggs and bacon was a bit light for 2 days!
Beautiful house. Air conditioning was great in the heat wave. Animals very cute. Kate was very friendly and helpful. Loved the modern renovations qualit
Thanks for a lovely stay.
Highly recommend

Look no further than! Gorgeous old house, beautiful bathroom and exceptionally clean and functional! Lovely big fig tree in back yard providing shade.
Easy walk into main area with bars, restaurants, coffee and craft.
Perfect choice for a visit to the Barossa- wouldn’t hesitate to book again!
Great property! Very spacious, clean and in a fantastic spot

Thanks for the lovely accommodation and the beautiful view at the back !
The farm animals are hilarious !

One issue we had was very dusty with cob webs behind beds and in corner of living room. Several spiders and webs in back toilet.
Other areas of house, bathroom, kitchen etc were very clean and tidy.
Road noise was a problem and someone using a blower vac very early Friday morning.
A fabulous gem!  Warm and inviting cottage. Beautiful beds with electric blanket. Charming sheep and Alpacas over the back fence. Close to lots of shops and restaurants. Highly recommend. Loved it!

Kate was the most helpful and responsive Airbnb host ever! She even dropped off some kids panadol after the local pharmacy had shut. The house was immaculate and the beds comfortable with nice linen. Kitchen really well appointed and great shower. Very central location. The outdoor area is not terribly useable but otherwise great.
Thanks Kate, we had a lovely stay. Main Street and restaurants in walking distance.

A beautiful spot with a garden and farm animals. Felt like being in the country but only a few minutes walk from cafes, restaurants and the centre of Tanunda. We visit Tanunda frequently and will definitely book Blackbird Cottage again if it’s available. Kate & Chris were very quick to respond to any queries we had.
Great location, very comfortable accommodation.
Absolutely incredible property, so peaceful with beautiful surroundings. Kate was a great host, we couldn’t recommend this place enough!

Black bird cottage is a little slice of paradise. Clean and warm inside with a lovely garden and cute farm animals outside. Kate kindly left wine, milk, bread, butter, bacon and eggs for us. Most of the eggs were double yokers. It was nice that our little dog was welcome. Tanunda shops are an easy 1km walk. The cottage is well equipped, felt like home.

A fantastic house.    Huge amounts of space.  Very clean.  Nice supplies and amenities. Great views.   Cute animals on the property.  Very short walk into town and a short drive to all the wineries in the Barossa.
Great place to explore the Barossa from,  walk to restaurants and shops. our dogs linvestigating the garden. Great views.

Kate's place was fantastic. Great location in Tanunda close to everything. The bathroom felt luxurious and the beds were very comfortable, and the rest of the house was very spacious and full of lovely touches. The animals were very friendly and it was truly a great experience.

Blackbird Cottage is the perfect Barossa accommodation.
Walking distance to all the restaurants of Tanunda but also central to all that the Barossa Valley has to offer.
We loved our stay here.
Our second stay did not disapoint us. highly recommended.

What a delight. Would highly recommend a stay at this lovely home. The property was gorgeous inside and the cottage garden was beautiful. Loved our daily meetings with the animals. Great location as only a short walk to cafes and restaurants. Host was responsive and friendly.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and the yard was perfect for our two golden retrievers. Would recommend and stay again.

This charming and quaint little cottage is set in amongst the heart of Tanunda. Picturesque landscapes with abundance of local restaurants, wine cellars and cafes only a stones throw away. The beautiful cottage has maintained its historical charm, decked out with classique antique furnishings keeping to its 18th century theme.
When you step outside into the peaceful garden whilst enjoying your morning cuppa or afternoon glass of vino you are greeted by the properties friendly alpacas and sheep at the properties back fence.
The owners are full of local knowledge and helpful advice which makes navigating the Barossa Valley a lot easier when it’s your first time visiting.
Highly recommend this accommodation and location especially for those are wine enthusiasts and appreciate a little bit of early settler history.
Beautiful cottage right in town. perfect for small family or for 2-3 couples. we loved our time spent there and will definitely be booking again when I'm in the area!

This house had everything we needed for 3 friends to have a weekend in the Barossa - the main bathroom was huge and the beds were particularly comfy. It was a great base to walk to restaurants on the main street of Tanunda, and an easy drive to some lovely wineries. The alpacas were a bonus and cute company to have at the side of the yard.

A beautiful cottage, clean and tidy and beautiful views out the back. The animal visitors added extra charm and we loved how easy it was to walk to local cafes and shops. We would book again in a heartbeat!

We had a fabulous stay in Tanunda at Kate’s place . It was well equipped and felt like home! There is so much to do just a walk away in the delightful township and local area complete with wineries nearby.

Blackbird is a  fabulous location, has wonderful views and is  perfect place to stay with  dogs. Peaceful, secure and  the house is well appointed to assist you to relax and unwind.  The hosts were extremely friendly and helpful.

Magpie Cottage is conveniently located in Tanunda and we found it to be very cosy and comfortable. The two key things for us are hot showers and comfy beds and Magpie Cottage easily ticked these boxes. A highlight for us was the alpacas and sheep visiting the back fence, very cute and confirmed we were “in the country”.
Kate and Chris were excellent hosts and kept us informed about all we needed to know. The response to our phone call about one of the a/c’s not working was so quick, with (sorry I can’t remember his name) there within minutes after running up the hill to the cottage. It was working, we just needed to give it a couple of minutes after switching it on. 😉

This is truely a luxurious, and very special venue. Attention to the smallest detail was beyond our expectations.
Impeccably maintained and appointed, there was nothing we needed.
An incredible and relaxed time away, spent with friends

What a stunning home!!! Beautiful house and great location with lots of nice touches. We had such a short, rushed stay for a last minute wedding but decided we will definitely come back and stay at this house again! Highly recommend. The photos do not do this gorgeous place justice!

We really enjoyed our stay at Wilsford house. It was beautiful property in a great location. It was a great place to unwind after a long day out at wineries. The house had plenty of space for 6 people and everything we needed including a great bbq area.
Everything provided was above and beyond.
Just perfect in every way!
Beautiful place and very comfortable. Walking distance to Lyndoch for coffee.
Gorgeous home in a stunning location! Very hospitable and welcoming, with a yummy breakfast provided. You’ll love your stay.

Wilsford House was the perfect place for 6 people to stay.  The grounds and home were immaculate.  The wine and food hamper were delicious.  Private ensuites in every room - fabulous! So many beautiful places to be, both outside and inside.   What a relaxing place to be.  Thank you for sharing this wonderful place with us.
We loved our stay at Wilsford House. Melissa our host was exceptional . Such a beautiful space inside and out.
Beautiful home!

Wilford House was above and beyond our expectations!   It was 5 star WOW factor!   We will be back!  We loved the house, the fire pit, the property, the gardens, the bathrooms, the beds, the table setting and so much more!  A huge thank you to Melissa who was amazing and thank you for the amazing fresh produce and well stocked kitchen.  It was greatly appreciated by all.  SO good!  We highly recommend the property.  A great way to enjoy the Barossa!

What a wonderland. The most beautiful property I have ever stayed at and I honestly didn’t want to leave. The little touches around the house to make it homey did not go unnoticed. And what a wonderful surprise it was to find a cheese platter and complimentary wine provided for us. Thank you again Melissa for sharing your home with us. We will certainly be back!

Melissa's place makes you feel right at your own home and is very close by town easy to get grocery. Also,  at night they had a fire place to roast marshmallow which is fantastic for a family to stay and enjoy wine.

Wilsford House is gorgeous!!! the gardens were beautiful, the rooms were great, the bathrooms were fabulous.  We enjoyed the BBQ area.  The lavish breakfast provisions were fantastic - we didn't need anything!!!  I certainly recommend this place for a relaxing comfortable stay!!!! The history was a great read too.

Wilsford House was well beyond our expectations.  A beautiful home with history that had everything you could think of and more.  A lot of care and thought has gone into making the stay a truly memorable experience.  Thanks for looking after us.
We could not have asked for more. All of my group hope to stay again, when we have more time to enjoy the location. Thanks Melissa for making us feel so welcome.
Beautiful old house with lots of family history. Presentation was beautiful. Highly recommend Wilsford House
Thankyou for a wonderful stay. The home was very comfortable, with everything we needed in a fantastic location. Lovely!

Such a beautiful home! We couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay. The area is amazing and it is only a short walk into town. We loved the local touches including a cheese platter, eggs, bacon, fresh fruit and bread. We will definitely be back.
Absolutely amazing Air BnB with the most unexpected but generous hospitality that was very much appreciated. Definitely excelled expectations and will recommending to family and friends!
A great stay - the place was everything we could have wanted and a wonderful base for the Barossa.

If we could give more than 5 stars we would. You’re essentially booking a private winery all to yourself - with the most amazing heritage home with everything you could need and more. We absolutely loved our stay, and are already discussing plans of returning with a group of friends. Thank you for your hospitality - we are truly grateful!
Jon’s eco cabins were a great stay. Very cosy and comfortable with easy access to all of Barossa and eden valley. Perfect for a weekend or overnight stay.

Thanks for providing a lovely place for us to stay Jon. We don’t believe you need to change. From start to finish communication was great and we enjoyed the features the hut had to offer. Very easy booking, check in & check out process. Highly recommend for others to enjoy a stay also. Cam & Sara
good stay, got everything I need

Cute and cosy cabin with a country feeling that isn't far from the city or anything you need. Jon had fantastic communication throughout our entire three night stay and went above and beyond to make our new year's holiday a good one
Cute little cabin that had everything we needed. JB’s communication was great and he went above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable. It was a perfect spot for our little getaway - thanks JB!

This was an absolute oasis after a 37 degree day in the valley. The custom built accommodation feels really luxurious and there was local wine and cheese in the fridge when we stepped through the door. Jon was incredibly helpful setting up a bbq for us and it was great to hear about how he put the really unique pods together and his plans for the future.

We loved our stay! We had a great weekend exploring wineries and it was really nice to stay somewhere quiet and enjoy the Adelaide Hills. We were also appreciative of complementary wine and nibbles provided and recomendations of local places.

Quaint, cosy and perfect for a weekend getaway. Jon was kind enough to include some cheese, olives, cured meats so that we could have a platter, and a delicious bottle of red. Only a few mins drive from a selection of Eden valley cellar doors. Highly recommended!

Great little place, very ideally placed for exploring Eden valley and the Barossa. Jon was great, effectively communicating everything and providing wine and some local cheeses for a really homely stay. Cherry on the top was Maggie, a four legged friend who’s there to greet you every time you arrive. Would definitely stay again and recommend to friends and family looking for a nice and quiet time in the country.

Lovely place with plenty of bird action. Great communication with host and nice touch to offer bottle of locally made wine.
Recommend highly.

An absolutely beautiful little place. Lovely and clean. Gorgeous location. We loved sitting on the little deck with a glass of wine and watching the birds in the garden. Will definitely be coming back in the future.
Loved this place - great eco valued and beautiful cabin. Jon is a lovely host and we loved meeting him and his menagerie

Lovely place to stay. Very clean, comfortable and in a quiet and peaceful location.  Jon left us a lovely bottle of wine with nibbles and cheese that he made himself.  We did call a few hotels in the area in advance to make sure we could get dinner on a Sunday and Mount Pleasant was just a 10 minute drive away.

This is a very peaceful spot with lots of bird life. The cabin offers a unique experience to be off grid but still enjoy the comforts. It is fun to stay in a Nissan Hut ... what great upcycling. Jon has made the interior very comfortable and the inside has plenty of room especially with your private balcony to sip on his provision of a local wine and cheese package. You look out to a small 'mountain" over  an " orchid". (All in large barrels) , inspirational.  In this space we could pick up our books ( yes there is a TV and internet access) but why not enjoy the peace. my husband says great camp kitchen.

We absolutely loved our stay - this is a beautiful spot to relax, unwind and learn more about living an eco-friendly lifestyle. The place was spotless when we arrived, and great attention to detail was paid to the features and amenities (we thought the bed was very comfortable and loved the complimentary local wine and cheese!)
Jon was a fantastic host - we will definitely stay again.
great place to relax, will be back to enjoy outside fire in winter..
Great stay! Clear communication and quiet area of town. Beautiful way to spend a weekend away. We felt very welcome and would absolutely stay again in the future.

Jon’s place was an amazing stay! Very peaceful, quiet and a great place to wind down! Jon was a great host and kindly supplied us with a yummy cheese board and wine on arrival! Will definitely be staying back here in the future.
Friendly, great man cave while riding the Lavender trail

I cannot recommend Jon’s place enough! He is 100% committed to his vision of a self-sustainable property, which I hope to see more of across the world. Jon is also generous with his hospitality, offering a local bottle of wine and cheeses, breakfast cereal and milk, and lighting a fire for the guests each night. He gives clear communication and is an absolute joy to chat with and hear his story!
The place itself is quaint, but has all you need for a long weekend. The balcony looks over the fire pit area and his fruit trees. It’s right in the small town of Springton, but you’d barely know it with the private feel of the space. The bed is very comfortable and there are curtains to block out the sunlight if you’re looking to sleep in.
The location is situated close to the heart of the Barossa but is also close to Adelaide Hills. It’s a nice retreat from the bustle of the main towns. Keep in mind that there aren’t many options close by for cafes or restaurants, however you do have access to cooking facilities in the shed, which was all we needed for our long weekend!
I wouldn’t change anything about our stay and hope we can stay at Jon’s accommodation again in the future!
Amazing stay would definitely come back

We had a wonderful stay at JB's place. It was lovely and clean and exactly as described. The cheese and wine on arrival was an amazing surprise and JB even had the fire iutside lit for us when we got back from dinner. Couldnt recommend this place more

Jon is a fantastic host and made us very welcome with a bottle of local red, cheese and nibbles.
The accommodation was very clean and well maintained with a comfy bed. The huts weren't in a rural location, as we had imagined from the photo however even being right in town it was lovely and quiet.
We would highly recommend Jon's place.

Characterful, comfortable, clean and relaxing.
The eco huts are a great resting spot
Relaxing easy use of camp kitchen space and lovely camp fire setting.
Jon is a friendly host and nothing is too much trouble.
Enjoyed the lovely local wine and cheese - thankyou
We look forward to visiting again
Great spot to rest on a motorbike ride along the Mt Lofty Ranges and surrounds!

Jon's place was clean and comfortable. Checkin was a breeze and everything was clearly laid out and explained. Jon was very generous with some local wine and cheese.  We love the concept of the self contained sustainable accomodation and we wish them all the best with this project.

We enjoyed a wonderful stay at Jon's place this weekend. The cabin was lovely and spacious with everything you need for a relaxing getaway. Jon was a brilliant host, extremely communicative and hospitable. Highly recommend!
Really good place to stay for a couple of days. Jon is helpful and we had a great communication.  I recommend !
This was our second stay at Springton in the bach. As lovely as before, warm fires, comfortable beds and all the creature comforts. Highly recommended!

Very cosy and clean, comfortable bed, has everything you need. Jon is very nice and put the fire on for us, when we arrived it was nice and warm. He even left some bickies, together with a bottle of wine and cheese, you won’t have that anywhere else. We recommend this place for our friends and family

Our stay at Jon's place was a fantastic experience!
The hut was very clean and had everything we needed. Jon provided a cheese board and a bottle of wine that were all locally made. The fire place in the cabin made sure we stayed warm all night long, and made beautiful crackling noises.
Jon had set up a fire pit for us in the courtyard, which was a great touch and a lovely way to spend the evening.
I have already recommended staying here to a number of people and will hopefully be returning again soon!
Such a wonderful little getaway! JB is very nice and great with his communication. Such a peaceful and cosy place. We enjoyed our stay and will be recommending it to all our friends and family. 😊
This was a great location. Loved the support received from Jon and the room was good value. Would recommend to anyone.

We enjoyed our weekend getway in the Barossa. Jon's hut in Springton was very quiet, clean, cosy, eco-friendly and conveniently located for doing wine tatsing in the Barossa. The place was very warm with both the potbelly stove in the evening and reverse cycle A/C for the morning! There was even a surprise welcome gift of wine, cheese (made by Jon) platter and cookies -- very generous. We would recommend this place to family and friends and would definitely come back again!

Jon’s cabin was an absolute joy to stay in. It’s very clean, tidy, warm and welcoming - the photos don’t do it justice! Great amenities for a weekend getaway with a kitchenette and plenty of cutlery/crockery. The wood fire heater was amazing and warmed the whole cabin in no time. Jon was incredibly helpful, lighting the fire before we arrived at night, providing more kindling and wood as needed, and offered great local knowledge. Jon gifted us a very generous cheese and wine hamper upon arrival and had a great variety of breakfast and tea/coffee supplies. Despite the terrible weather during our stay, the cabin was perfect for our needs. Being eco-friendly and sustainable was a big draw card for us too. There are two cabins but we didn’t hear or see the neighbours during our stay so it’s still private. Would definitely recommend staying here!

Had a lovely weekend. Jon, the host, was very welcoming and went to great lengths to ensure we were happy and comfortable.  We arrived on a very cold winter's evening to find the pot-belly stove had been lit and the room was toasty warm. There were delicious nibbles and a bottle of wine, as well as various other basic provisions. In the evenings, Jon lit a fire in a ''globe'' fire pit out the front of the units for guests to warm themselves by. Was a good base from which to do some great day trips. Went to Mt Pleasant Farmers Market for a scrumptious cooked breakfast and had amazing pizzas at Glen Cru Estate nearby. We highly recommend this Airbnb.

Jon’s cabins are located in a small town around the Edan Valley wineries within reach of plenty of easy half-day trips. His off-grid cabins are quaint but have everything you need. The pot belly fire place provided excellent warmth on the cold nights. On arrival we were greeted with a complimentary bottle of local wine and cheese platter. On Sunday morning Jon arranged local ingredients and cooking facilities for a cooked breakfast. His homemade halloumi was an absolute treat. We were looking for a country stay and it’s exactly what we got.

We had a great stay in this cosy cabin, the pot belly fire was perfect for heating the place up and we were welcomed with a bottle of red wine and a delicious cheese platter. Jon went above and beyond with friendly service and provided us with fresh ingredients to make our breakfast in a generous and      unique barbecue area. Would definitely recommend this to anyone exploring the Barossa/hills

We had a great stay in the Tea Tree cabin. Jon was a very welcoming and friendly host.
The cabin was very clean and cosy. The pot belly heater was very toasty. Having it lit prior to arrival was a nice touch. Having the outside fire pit set up was appreciated too.
The cheese and wine patter was a nice surprise on arrival.
We would recommend these cosy cottages to anyone that wants to tour the Adelaide Hills/Barrossa.
Thankyou Jon :-)
An adorable place to stay! Wood burning fireplace inside is perfect for winter and Jon was very hospitable. Lovely little place for a getaway!

A cosy offgrid cabin with everything needed for a romantic weekend away in winter. It offers the perfect base for exploring the Barossa Valley.
Jon is a lovely host who has not forgotten to include those special touches to take the stay to the next level from wine and cheese on arrival to breakfast provisions (cooked on Sunday with eggs from his chooks).
The pub does a fabulous meal and is only a 1 minute walk from the accommodation, they were super busy when we got there and so there was a long wait on service but the food made up for it. The general store offers a good takeaway coffee too.

These cabins are a great place to stay, clean and well looked after. Jon is the perfect host who goes the extra mile to make your stay as cosy as he can. The wine and cheese was a great accompaniment to a great stay.
Job was a great host! Kept the fire on for us and had heaps of local knowledge. The place was very cosy and clean and the wine + breakfast supplied was absolutely superb.
Happy with everything.

Great time had all around relaxing in Springton for the weekend! Heat on when we arrived, fire place stoked and ready to be lit, comfy bed, fluffy towels and delicious reisling from Poverty Hill wines set a great vibe.
If you have the privilege of a conversation with Jon during your stay you're in for a treat. The local pub is friendly too and has a decent pool table and semi-decent juke box ;)

Such a lovely place. We had an awesome little trip. It was cozy and warm- great winter stay. The wine and cheese plater was such a thoughtful touch. Would love to come stay here again. Jon was amazing and very helpful.
We had a lovely time at this eco-responsible accommodation. Jon was very friendly and even included some local cheese and wine for our stay- how could it get better?

Jon was a thoughtful, kind and great host. He went out of his way to ensure we were comfortable and enjoyed our stay. We loved the cabin - the shape and eco-friendly design was awesome.
Springton was a wonderful town to visit- great exhibit during SALA, the Herbig family tree worth a visit and really good and welcoming pub round the corner.

Loved our short Stay at Springton  .. It was lovely to meet our host Jon and  chat around the fire pit which he’d already got going for us … the complimentary bottle of wine (which Jon took the time to ask our preference of red or white before our arrival) the locally made cheese with biscuits and dried fruit  with relaxing  fire pit was a perfect end to our day … communication was 10/10 from beginning to end … Jon was available if we needed anything throughout our stay  … can’t wait to visit again
a lovely little off the grid vacay in a small part of the whole that should be visited
Thank you Jon, had a great stay this weekend. We loved the platter and wine, and the cozy room! Thanks for having us
Cosy, comfortable and great friendly service. 10/10 would stay again.

Jon was a great host and the venue was perfect! Was a great relaxing stay and the win and snacks was a really nice touch.
Look forward to coming up again sometime soon

Great unique eco place to stay. Inside has the feel of a cabin in the mountains except its in the barossa, would be perfect on a cold winters day/ night with the amazing looking fireplace going. Outside has a nice yard with a pretty nice looking firepit and chairs. Situated in a lovely area of the barossa that we hadn't been to before, would definitely recommend
A cozy and clean cabin that feels very spacious. Great value and the owner is excellent.
Great stay.  Lovely town,  with easy access to all in the Barossa.  Great, welcoming host!

The place is cosy, and you overlook an enclosed garden of fruit trees in the making. We booked a 3 bedroom accommodation for myself and two of my friends who came down from Melbourne. We were so looking forward to a relaxing girls trip in the Barossa. We were greeted with a lovely accommodation in Barossa on Sturt, clean and cosy with some thoughtful touches like wine, snacks and breakfast provisions.. Unfortunately our excitement was quickly dampened when we realised that the third bedroom was not made available and I ended up sleeping on the couch for the duration of our stay, not ideal at all.
We booked this cottage because the listing is advertised as a 3-bedroom cottage, a paramount criteria in our selection.  However, because there were only 3 occupants,  the accommodation became a two bedroom cottage! This has never been our experience at any Airbnb accommodation in the past. It would have been beneficial to have this made much clearer in the confirmation email.  A simple "You have booked 2 rooms in Barossa on Sturt ..,,...." would have sufficed. Instead you have to read everything and then somewhere towards the end is a paragraph that is a generic notification explaining which room you are eligible for depending on the number of occupants. 
The listing also did not mention that the house is sited on an incline and may not be appropriate for someone with accessibility issues. You have to climb up a fairly steep gradient to get to the house. Not an issue for us but worth noting. The photos of the house only include the lovely bathtub without revealing the shower is on the bathtub. This again may post challenging to someone with accessibility issues.
We couldn’t get in touch with the hosts after checking in despite numerous phone calls and messages. We were agonising over the sleeping arrangements as we were reluctant to share the room. Furthermore both rooms had queen bed instead of single beds. The host's response on the next day was for us to pay for 5 occupants rate to access the 3rd room.
We don’t have any ill wishes towards our host but want to make sure others don’t get caught out by this technicality.

Do yourself a favour and experience ‘Barossa on Sturt’.

Location - amazing.

Communication and advice regarding The Barossa - outstanding.
There is truly not enough stars available to accurately rate our stay, as 5 out of 5 doesn’t do justice to our experience.

Such a beautiful spot and perfect location for exploring the Barossa. We had Alex over for a wine tasting on the back porch and it was incredible! Managed to even snag a couple of cooler days to utilise the outdoor fire place. Unreal!

Had a lovely stay. Place was spacious with gorgeous yard and views.

Beautiful house in a great location. Very good quality linen and supplies. We loved the suggestions on what is available in the area, and the milk in the fridge :-)
The house was very comfortable and spacious with stunning views from the front and back. Perfect place to sit on the lawn and enjoy the area. Easy to walk to town and nearby restaurants. Thank you for being very considerate hosts.
Beautiful home in the heart of the Barossa - walked to amazing local wineries and golden hour shining through the trees into your home was something special

We had a great stay at this air bnb for a girls trip to the Barossa. It was a beautiful house with vineyard views. We also did a private wine tasting with Alex which we would highly recommend everyone to do.

This was a beautiful place to stay.  Lots of space and very peaceful.  Alex provided lots of information on local attractions, wine tasting, and restaurants.  We would also highly recommend his restaurant (Harvest Kitchen - spectacular food and awesome service).

a great trip to the Barossa in a really nice space. extremely well located and super close to everything you would need for an enjoyable stay.
Tanunda town center is walking distance and there are a raft of wineries and places to eat within a short drive.
The space itself was clean, quite, welcoming, cosy and great to come home to after a long day of eating great food and drinking great wine.
Alex was quick to respond when contacted and was accommodating when we put forward requests.
Overall a lovely place to stay and we would stay there again when heading back to the Barossa.

Beautiful garden and cutest house. We loved the keyless entry, no hassle who takes the key, or need to organise to be back home at the same time etc. Make sure to go to the Harvest Kitchen. Hands down the best food in the Barossa.
Thanks for letting us stay.
Very helpful Host
Great spot and host

If I could give 10 stars, I would. This by far stood out as the highlight of our road trip, as Alex and Liz have thought of every detail for their place. I would highly recommend staying here if in the Barossa, and plan to come back again. Thank you so much!!!

A fabulous house in a great location. Spotlessly clean, eco-friendly products and everything there that you might need. Wood fire with wood and a gorgeous outdoor fire pit. Great back yard for pooch. Hosts were friendly on messages and very responsive. Easy instructions for everything. Thanks so much! We had a beautiful time away.

Had an amazing stay, the place was beautiful and very well presented. Alex was very responsive and made sure we had everything we needed. Would go back again for sure and recommend others to stay. Thanks!

Fabulous stay. Haus was wonderfully presented and very clean.
Great communication and local recommendations. Owner has own wine label and provided a personal tasting overlooking vines which was a real highlight.
Property was fenced in which was great for those taking a furry friend, with a brilliant dog park just down the road near the equally fabulous Barossa Brewery.
Highly Recommended.
We had a great long weekend at the Winemakers Haus, Alex and Liz provided everything we could have needed plus more.
Fijn huis waarin je goed kunt samenkomen, maar ook een privé plek kunt vinden. Als kookliefhebber had ik mijn weg snel gevonden in de goed uitgeruste keuken. Mooie tuin.

We had a lovely stay in this cosy house. It was a cold weekend in the Barossa and the fire place and AC kept the house beautifully warm.
The house was exactly as advertised. It was clean and the kitchen was well appointed with cookware etc.
The house is located with an easy 5-10 minute stroll to the Tanunda main street, and is in close proximity to great wineries such as Turkey Flat Vineyards.
I would love to stay here again.

Beautiful and practical location in Barossa, with great recommendations offered by the hosts. The air BnB felt like a home, it was clean and had everything we needed. Alex kindly hosted a complimentary wine tasting of his sustainable HausWine and explained in depth the process and consideration that goes into creating the wine. We had the pleasure of eating at Alex's restaurant Harvest Kitchen, we left incredibly full and satisfied. It's clear a lot of love and hard work is put into his endeavours and if we know of anyone visiting we will be sure to recommend staying here!

Loved our stay, a very comfortable spacious clean home with everything we needed and more. We really didn’t want to leave. Great place in Tanunda, the heart of the Barossa Valley.  Fabulous restaurant, wineries, bakeries abound.  Highly recommend!

We loved our stay! Alex and Liz are wonderful hosts. We had everything we needed and it was great being able to walk to the Main Street. The accommodation is really comfortable and spacious. We loved our stay at Alex and Liz’s place. The house was set up beautifully and very cosy. The view onto the vineyards was amazing. It was close to town and easy to get around in taxis. They were very easy to communicate with and overall great hosts. Would highly recommend staying here.

We were a party of 6 and found the house had ample room, comfy beds and a well stocked kitchen. Toiletries provided were of high quality. Tanunda itself had great shops and cafes and provided a good base to visit both Eden Valley and the Barossa Valley towns and wineries. Communication with hosts was exceptional as well as their restaurant, Harvest Kitchen, which we highly recommend for lunch...outstanding setting and food, coupled with Alex's own organic wine and attentive staff. Thank you Alex and Liz for a memorable stay.

Very comfortable and well set up for pets and their owners.  Some nice touches (soap, kitchen utensils and consumables, etc).  Check in at 3pm seems a bit late.  Alex was very responsive/communicative.  A very nice stay.

House was overall
Clean and functional, but it needs some modern updates to toilet and bathroom

We enjoyed a three night stay as a family. Lots of space for everyone to kick back, kitchen things, laundry, extra linen, cosy fire at night and central heating given it was mid winter. Convenient location for exploring the Barossa Valley and enjoying food and wine etc. Harvest Kitchen is highly recommended - our favourite meal of our Barossa stay. Thanks for hosting us.

Thank you Alex and Liz for hosting our family. We had a wonderful little getaway to the Barossa. Your house was clean, spacious and suitable for our family with plenty of space in the backyard to play 😊

We are just back from our small vaycay in the Barossa and feel extremely pleased with ourselves and our choices! Four women, a small reunion if you like, retreating back to our large, comfortable and cosy place of rest here of an evening! Plenty of room,clean and accessible to the charming town of Tanunda and surrounds. Easy to locate with everything you need at your fingertips! Thanks Alex we were very happy and will not hesitate in letting people know of our stay!
Katrina

The house had everything, to the point it felt like home as we could find whatever we needed. It was a short walk to the bewery and a 15-minute walk to get to the main street. Great location, easy walk into the Main Street of Tanunda restaurants and pubs. The house was huge!

Downsides are minor but worth mentioning, noise from the road is quite loud on a night when sleeping, bathroom is very dated. Windows dirty, and dining chairs stained. But we still had a good stay.
Lovely home for a relaxing week in the beautiful Barossa Valley. Convenient location. House has everything we needed, including a lovely secure backyard for our dogs.

What a lovely house to stay. Very roomy with everything we needed. Enjoyed the backyard with a beautiful view to the grapevines. Kangaroo visited us on our last morning. Thank you Alex and Liz. We enjoyed our stay.

A great place for a family get together, and to explore the Barossa area. The walk to the Main Street of Tanunda was very manageable, and Turkey Flats winery is only a short stroll away. Thanks Alex and Liz for your efforts to provide excellent accommodation (including zero co products that we also use at home!)
Kim and Richard

We had a fabulous stay, felt right at home, and enjoyed the gorgeous backdrop. Other highlights include the central location and that we were able to include our dog. Can't wait to come back!

We loved our two night stay with our friends.

The house had everything we needed to make our stay a home away from home!
Awesome location - central location

Thanks Alex and Liz, Marty and Greg had a wonderful stay. They especially enjoyed sitting out by the fire relaxing. They loved the house. Thanks for being a wonderful host.

Cute house with nice fittings.

we really enjoyed our stay.

Alex’s place was beautiful and well designed I love all the indoors and the outdoors even better - functional and you have everything you need just bring your bags,  highly recommend 💯

Great air b n b in Tanunda, clean and well equipped. Great communication from Alex, local recommendations and only about a 5 minute walk into the middle of town. The enclosed back yard was perfect for our little dog. Thanks for the great stay, highly recommended.

Alex's place, really enhanced our first Barossa Valley experience, after a busy day of touring it was a joy to come home to such a peaceful and comfortable setting. We cannot recommend this location highly enough, thanks Alex.

We had a really nice stay, thanks Wendy for al the extra goodie’s you supplied, really appreciated it.

We could also walk to some other local wineries and a wine bar (and it was only a very short drive into Tanunda and other wineries). The breakfast hamper supplied was a very welcome addition and was enough for our entire stay. We would love to stay here again in the future!

Our stay at Kate's cottage was a great way to unwind and get away from the hustle and bustle for a weekend. The cottages are in a great location: walking distance from wineries, a distillery and a restaurant. Wendy was an excellent host who put extra effort and thought into making our stay as relaxing and beautiful as possible. The breakfast goodies, snacks and cheese board were a wonderful touch. We would love to come back!
The cottage was immaculate. Very comfortable and clean. Wendy was a fantastic host.

If you want an easy base to explore the Barossa, or a quiet corner to tuck away in that’s walking distance to wineries, a gin distillery, restaurants and a cafe - this place has both! Along with a stocked fridge and pantry (including chic chip cookies for your nightly cuppa), this cozy cottage was sparkling clean. Couldn’t recommend this spot enough, we will definitely be back!

Josh and Jen were respectful and helpful hosts and we loved the spot. Even though the place is attached to the house you feel secluded and gave great privacy. Great new bathroom, kitchenette, plus nice small outdoor area.

Josh and Jen were great hosts.  The accommodation was beautiful with lovely touches.  Bed was lovely and comfy. The view from the room was gorgeous.  Would definitely recommend a stay. Thank you Josh and Jen for sharing your beautiful home.

I had an absolutely incredible stay at 65 on North. The location was perfect - peaceful and quiet, yet still central enough that I was able to easily explore everything that the area had to offer.
The suite itself was modern, well-maintained, and immaculately clean. I was blown away by the attention to detail that had gone into creating this space - everything from the furniture to the décor was perfectly chosen and coordinated. It was clear that the hosts had put a lot of thought and care into making this space feel like a home away from home.
The amenities provided were also exceptional. From the fully equipped kitchen to the luxurious bathroom, I had everything I could possibly need during my stay. What really made this stay stand out was the hospitality of Josh and Jen, who went above and beyond to make me feel welcome and comfortable throughout my stay.
65 on North truly exceeded all of my expectations, and I can't wait to return on my next trip!

We recently spent two night at 65 North and we could not be happier with our experience!  Josh and Jen were amazing hosts, check-in was a breeze and you feel totally secluded with fantastic privacy.  You can tell that they care deeply about their guest’s experience.  If you are looking for wineries, you are walking distance from the historic Yalumba winery. Also, Josh has an encyclopaedic knowledge of local wineries making him a fantastic connection to help plan our winery visits.  The bed was extremely comfortable with high quality linen.  The bathroom was amazing with a rainfall shower that was to die for!  We spent our evenings sipping wine outside out accommodation watching the sunset over the hills of Angaston.  If you are looking for a high quality getaway that wont break the bank, you needn’t look any further! We will definitely be back!

Josh and Jen have created a beautiful stay! The location is perfect, it's peaceful and feels secluded, but it is within walking distance of wineries and places to eat. They have thought of everything a guest needs to make a comfortable and easy stay. The suite is tidy and cosy with great attention to detail - we even got a complimentary bottle of wine upon arrival! You can tell the hosts have been thoughtful and put care into making this space feel homely. We highly recommend a stay and can't wait to visit again. Thanks for having us!

It’s hard to believe Josh & Jen have only been providing Airbnb for a few months, the room and facilities are up there with the best I’ve ever stayed in. The apartment was spotless and very modern and well thought through. The view is amazing and the location great, especially for visiting the wineries.
Great accomodation! Had everything we needed on an amazing property and  beautiful location.
Beautiful outlook, very comfortable, great shower, close to town, very friendly hosts, nice touches like a welcome bottle of lovely local wine.  We enjoyed out stay.
We really enjoyed our stay at 65 on North. Josh and Jen’s suite was very clean and tidy and peaceful and quiet with a nice view. Happily recommend.

Jen and Josh are lovely and very welcoming. The accommodation is clean, modern and peaceful. The location is very convenient to the many Barossa sites including the wineries. The dogs are so gentle and eager for pats. I would easily choose to stay here again if back in the area. Thank you for having us.

The coziest guest suite. Spotlessly clean, extremely comfortable bed, and the several sitting areas and craftily organized kitchenette make the compact space feel bigger than it is. The view from the property is so pretty and it was pleasant to walk the grounds and hear the birds in the morning. The two resident Labrador dogs were always there to greet us and welcomed as many pets as you provide, they brought us tons of joy.
Everything you need to serve as a perfect jumping off point to explore the Barossa - minutes from downtown Angaston and only a few minutes further to Nuriootpa and Tanunda (and only an hour's drive from Clare Valley or Adelaide Hills if you want to explore farther afield).
Suits a private airbnb purpose. Clean and modern.
The place was absolutely beautiful and looked exactly like the pictures. Josh and Jen were quick to respond to messages and help out if needed. I would definitely stay here again.

A great space with lots of thoughtful additions such as extra rugs, cutlery, toaster, Nespresso machine and more.
It’s a lovely space and the outlook is stunning. The area is totally private from the main house.
Yalumba is very close. I did a tour of the winery which includes tastings and a cheese platter and it was well worth it. Nosh was nice for brunch and we enjoyed Otherly for wine and snacks on the first night.
The dogs are part of the welcome, but if you prefer, Josh will make sure they leave you alone. We love dogs so we enjoyed their welcome and greetings over our stay. The hosts are very nice people.
An awesome visit to the Barossa and Josh & Jen’s place was ideal to stay for this. Cosy & comfortable with all you need and a great spot for evening wine and morning coffee.
Great location to cruise around the Barossa. Gorgeous outlook. Brand new place. Friendly doggos! Would definitely recommend!

Great studio with luxurious bed attached to their home but very private.
Very friendly and helpful. A great place to stay

We loved our stay with Josh and Jen and the family. The unit was exactly as shown, everything we needed and more, loved the coffee machine and wine. Perfect place to come back to each evening after exploring the area. Quiet and peaceful, we will definitely book again if in the area.
Josh and Jen were amazing hosts. The place was beautiful and well looked after. I would highly recommend staying here :)

It was a peaceful and tranquil outlook close to the town of Angaston and wineries. Had everything one needs for a weekend away.
Very generous with leaving a beautiful bottle of wine from Barossa.
Heating/cooling and TV provided not that we watched TV.
Bed very comfortable.

Had a relaxing stay in Angaston. The accomodation was just perfect. Clean,comfortable, quiet and private. I enjoyed the picturesque view over the valley and watching the sheep graze in the neighbouring property. Spring is a lovely time to visit the Barossa Valley.
Great place to stay for introverts. Private and peaceful. Nice view. Friendly dogs and host. Clean and modern room.

Lovely relaxing stay overlooking beautiful Barossa Valley. Spotless amenities and Josh and Jen provided the extra little comforts of home.
Highly recommend this property.

What a beautiful setting, Josh and Jen have set it up so well. Easy walk into town but has the benefit of looking over the vineyards which is what you come to the Barossa for. We were provided with excellent instructions to locate the place and get in, all very easy. And enjoyed the friendly greeting from the 2 dogs, they're lovely!
We didn't see much of Josh and Jen but we didn't need to really. Lost Wifi access during our stay and unfortunately it was the internet provider's issue, so not much Josh and Jen could do about it. There was actually pretty good phone reception there so I used my phone data to cover it easily enough.
Thanks so much for the bottle of wine that greeted us on arrival, made good use of that. The apartment is so well set up, made it very flexible to choose whether to go out or eat in. And eating in looking out over to the Yalumba winery was very pleasant!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Loved the views and peaceful surroundings. Josh and Jen were very responsive to any questions that we had and gave several helpful tips about activities in the area while we were there. Definitely recommend it.
Great hosts, and clean, comfortable, modern room. Would happily stay again!
We loved our stay with Josh and Jen! So cosy and a great distance from all Barossa attractions.
We had a lovely stay and the property was beautiful! Would highly recommend ☺️
Lovely clean accommodation. Very quiet and peaceful. The view over the vines was beautiful. Not too far from town.  Loved having the dogs visit us each day!

We really enjoyed our stay at Josh and Jen's for a birthday getaway. The place was immaculate, modern and in a great location. Friendly doggos, beautiful views and really felt like home. Josh and Jen were great hosts and went above and beyond. Definitely recommend to others and will stay again.
Thank you so much for making it a very special  stay for Cameron and Courtney.
Lovely hosts and great location
We had a great time at Josh and Jens. The place is beautifully put together and extremely peaceful. The dogs are lovely and friendly and hosts very warm and welcoming. 10 outta 10!
We really enjoyed our stay in this beautiful location, the room was spacious, modern, very clean and just what we needed after a busy day exploring the Barossa

Loved our stay very much. The room was spotlessly clean, and such a relaxing feel to it. We were able to walk to the main street and a few wineries, which we liked. It was also very quiet, and felt private, even though it's under the main roof of the house.
The only minor thing we had a little trouble with was the steep driveway, as we took a small car. It struggled a bit on the gravel when we had to take off again after stopping to open/shut the gate. This wouldn't stop us from staying again tho, we would just make sure to bring our bigger car!

Josh and Jen's place was too perfect for our trip to Barossa. We enjoyed being visited by their cute dogs too.
The space was a great size, very clean and had everything we needed. The view was also spectacular.

Very clean and cozy place with good access to Angaston and wineries. My son extremely loved the playground and 2 lovely dogs!
As described in the page, no full kitchen but microwave, nespresso machine,pot, dish&glass&cutlery,knife and cutting board are available. So, it looks like a small hotel room but comfortable for short stay.
Google Map didnt show the same adress as shared but we could arive correctly following the google map.

We had a beautiful stay at Josh & Jen’s place. Very clean place with everything we needed for a short stay. Loved the surrounds and the peace and quiet. Easy to check in. Barkley and Sheena are wonderful dogs! We would stay here again! Thankyou!
We loved our weekend stay at Jen and Josh's place! The accommodation is beautiful- the garden is lovely, bedroom is comfortable, bathroom is spacious, two doggies were very cute 🩷
We had a lovely stay here. Conveniently located. Well appointed. Lovely hosts.

We loved our stay at Josh and Jen’s. Beautiful setting, great location and the accommodation was perfect. It was spotless, tidy and with extras to make our stay all the more comfortable. We would love to stay again.

Good spot in a lovely location. Couple of small issues getting in, as a key had been left in the lock on the inside, and getting the TV to work, but both things were resolved very quickly by the hosts, and their communication was great. Would definitely recommend.
Clean place with a beautiful view, walkable to town but still nice and quiet. Highly recommend
Such a peaceful and private place to stay. Had a really lovely time there!
We loved staying at Josh and Jen's place! It was perfect for a little getaway. Beautiful location, clean and cozy.

Josh and Jen’s guest house was very cozy! We loved the serenity of the sheep and grapevine view in the morning.
Thank you for having us!
Great stay just out of town
Lovely location, easy access to everything in the Barossa.  Nice large airy room with excellent ensuite. Nice bottle of wine upon arrival.  Delightful Labradors.  Highly recommend.

We really enjoyed our stay at Josh and Jen’s place. The accommodation itself was clean, comfortable and exactly as described. The surrounds were beautiful and very peaceful and quiet - perfect for a relaxing getaway.

Thank you Josh and Jen, I had a great stay 🙏🤩beautiful accommodation, great shampoo, conditioner and soap. Thanks also for the yummy red wine 🍷. All was perfect!
I definitely will be back 😀, if you have me 😉
All the very best, merry Christmas and a great new year🤩
Excellent airbnb and great host. Felt very welcoming

Josh and Jen’s Studio stay was the perfect weekend getaway. My partner and I had a fantastic time, with easy check in, a great view and great company from the two beautiful labradors that live there. Just across the road from Yalumba wines, this stay was a perfect walking distance to town. The place itself was super clean and neat and provided all the necessary amenities at a great price. Josh and Jen thank you so much for a lovely stay. We will be back!

Had a lovely weekend at Josh & Jen’s place for a Barossa getaway. On arrival we were greeted by their dear old Labradors and felt right at home. The room was cozy, clean and fresh with everything we needed including coffee and wine! The area is so quiet and peaceful, perfect for relaxing and with the Main Street less than 2kms away, it was easy to head out for brunch, dinner or just a walk around beautiful Angaston.
Josh and Jen were thoughtful & helpful and responded quickly to any messages.
Highly recommend this great little place next time you’re heading to this beautiful part of SA.
Great location. Lovely, comfortable accomodation. Easy communication. Thanks a lot!

Such a wonderful and inspiring location of the Barossa region .
Our accommodation in Angaston was amazing and well situated for getting around the immediate surrounds .
Highly valued and recommended!
Thank you both , Jen and Josh .

Private studio within same structure but separate from main house area. Clean and new. Some construction/gardening appears to be underway in the yard but no work was done while we were there so it was peaceful. Nice hosts. Would stay again.
Very nice en tidy place, when we didn't know how to handle the airco, Josh came immediately to help us.

We had the best time here. It was for our anniversary, it was such a quiet and beautiful genuine look at the valley. It felt like home amongst the Barossa. The dogs are SO cute. Everything was super clean, and it was much bigger than we realised! The Barossa in itself was lovely and even if it was raining there’s still plenty to do! Most things, if not, everything was still open! And listening to the rain whilst we went to sleep was a super cozy feeling. Very impressed and would come again!! Angaston location is close to everything, and if you’re not using a car there’s a bus stop close by!

Very clean and modern. Close to restaurants and wineries! Josh and Jen had great communication, were very friendly and considering the BnB is next to their house, we did not hear them once making it a very peaceful stay. Would recommend!
Great room size and view, good location close to all attractions, great area to park a large van if needed ( 9meters long)
The accommodation was excellent. Modern and clean. Great for a couple.
The whole experience was incredible! The area was stunning so was the view! Would stay again
Beautiful property in perfect location to wineries and more. Loved our stay

This place was absolutely amazing. The surrounding nature was stunning. Shane and Mel were so accommodating with everything. Mel was extremely easy to communicate with, she helped us with everything we needed. The place itself is so big and has everything you could need. One of the best Airbnb's I've stayed at!
Beautiful property in the heart of Barossa valley, with plenty of space for a large group.

We chose the venue for a family experience with children and grandchildren to celebrate a birthday.
A chef & waitress were recommended and the dinner in such beautiful surroundings was memorable.
Many thanks

Our stay at the Reserve was amazing.  The grounds of the property are spectacular.  It is very private with plenty of space.  The beds are super comfortable and the general feeling of the place is very country.  We had a group of 8 people and there was plenty of space.  Awesome cupboard full of games which we utilised!  Close to the wineries and cellar doors as well.  Check-in process was very easy and the hosts had great communication.  Would recommend highly for a great stay in the Barossa Valley.

The Reserve Barossa is an AMAZING place to stay in the Barossa Valley!
We had a large group of 10 people and the accommodation was perfect for this - there was plenty of space for everyone and all the rooms/beds were extremely comfortable.
The outdoor area is really beautiful, surrounded by immaculate gardens and vineyards. There are lots of lawn games to play, a fire pit and the pizza oven which was a highlight! The outdoor spa was also heated and ready to go when we arrived.
The house is well equipped with everything that you need, including matches, firelighters and wood, plus extra staple items in the pantry and kitchen drawers that were really helpful during the stay!
Shane and Melissa also spent a lot of time over the phone helping me to organise the trip with recommendations, and very kindly set up an incredible helicopter ride over the Barossa Valley. They are fantastic hosts and really went over and above!!
Thank you for such a great experience!

Best location in the heart of the Barossa !  Plenty of space for a group of friends or family.  Fantastic outlook of surrounding vineyards.  Communication excellent with plenty of local suggestions and checking in for help as required.  Would stay again.

We stayed at the Reserve for a family get together and couldn't of been more happier. It had everything if not more, than what we needed for our 3 night stay. Everything from a fully equipped kitchen to comfy beds. There were a few places to entertain and or simply hang out during the day and night. The lawn out the back was perfect for our morning yoga sessions which by late afternoon became our games area. Which the place had an abundant number of games to choose from. There were plenty of local wineries to explore close by and a fantastic grocery store within a 5 minute drive. Highly recommend this lovely, homely place. Thankyou to the host Melissa and & Shane.

The accomodation was absolutely beautiful. Perfect for a family vacay and there was more than enough room for everyone, including lots of space outside and also car parking. Perfect location and so peaceful.
Amazing location, close to everything but still private. Everything you need is there and the hosts are amazing with very helpful recommendations.
We loved our stay and the host was so helpful providing some great local recommendations. Fantastic!
Beautiful location very central to wineries. Lovely setting and great fire pit and hot tub.

We had a lovely time in Carolyn’s place. A beautiful house with a well-equiped kitchen and enormous backyard for our pup. The location is great too, lots of wineries near by and 2 min drive to cafes and shops.
If you’re thinking of bringing your dog, there is also an off-leash area around the corner.

This beautifully kept cottage and house was a great family home away from home for us. Put Labrador had plenty of space to run about and chase the ball with our son, the back garden was a great place to sit and enjoy the fruits of the vineyards on a warm afternoon, and the beautifully restored home and renovated kitchen was incredible space to relax after a big day with family.

Can’t rate this place highly enough, it was absolutely perfect for 5 people touring the Barossa Valley. The house is absolutely beautiful, the beds were great, the kitchen is brand new and has everything you could possibly need, there are 3 different areas to sit outside and enjoy the beautiful gardens, and Carolyn was an excellent host, she gave us brilliant local recommendations. The shower was excellent too, and the air con and fans in every room.

Great base for exploring the Barossa with easy walks to wineries and restaurants. We loved picking herbs from the garden for dinner and the table tennis and hammock were a bonus. A well stocked kitchen with great amenities.

A beautiful house that made for a wonderful girls trip for 6 girls. The kitchen was perfect to cook brunch and we sat underneath the trees and between the garden beds eating the morning away. The house was prime location and we wandered down to the bakery for donuts and up to jacobs creek winery for a wine tasting. Will definitely be back for a longer stay!

This is our simply one of the best airbnbs we have stayed in.  Wonderful host, very accomodating allowing our fur babies to join us! They loved roaming the fully secure back yard (something we find rare to accomodate as most yards accomodate larger dogs) but we felt at ease knowing the entire yard was secure. We especially loved picking some fresh fruit and veggies from the garden and the location was superb! Highly recommend.

Carolyn’s place is a rustic cottage with lovely renovations at the rear including a large dining room and kitchen, large bedrooms, comfortable loungeroom and a large outdoor rear patio.  Everything was very clean, neat & tidy.  There is a beautiful garden at the front of the house and a huge rear garden including fruit trees, herbs and kitchen gardens.  I loved that we could pick the vegetables and herbs that were ripe.  We enjoyed them all.  Beds were very comfortable, location was great.  Thanks for a lovely stay Carolyn.
Beautiful old home in a great location.  Can highly recommend staying here
Beautiful cottage that’s been nicely renovated including air conditioning which kept the house warm over some cold nights. Large backyard with many sitting areas. Had a fantastic stay!

Great stone cottage that is a perfect mix of the old and new and otherwise cosy and well presented. Beautiful garden that is perfect for pets or kids to run and play while the adults sit back and relax. There is also an abundant herb and veggie garden! Many restaurants a short drive away, an affordable local taxi service as an alternative, or even a 20-30 minute walk. Carolyn was a proactive host and the communication and instructions were helpful and clear.
Enjoyed the weekend with family and friends. Very clean, private and peaceful.  Easy to get to and close to cafes, restaurants etc. Comfy beds, plenty of space.

We had the most wonderful stay with our 2 retrievers- the house was so cosy with the beautiful log fire and the gardens surrounding the house are simply stunning. We would highly recommend coming to stay!

Huge garden, lots of space for us and the dogs to explore, and fully secure. House renovated, great fireplace, but could do with better furniture. 15 min walk into Tanunda town and short drive to all the wonderful Barossa wineries.

Lovely house and good location.
Good to be able to take dog away

Carloyn's home was the ideal location for our weekend getaway in Tanunda, it is a beautiful old cottage set on a large block within easy walking distance to restaurants and shopping. The layout of the cottage was ample for 4 adults and 2 children (plus one fury friend), with a well laid out and equipped kitchen and the added bonus of the large rear lock up yard was perfect for the children to explore.
We had a magic couple of days in Tanunda visiting wineries and restaurants. It was the perfect retreat for our stay.
We stayed here with our two dogs. We loved the location, the house and the fenced yard. It was a great base to explore the Barossa
Nice place, doesnt have a cottagey feel but would be nice for families to stay.
This cottage is magical, perfect for families. The check in process was effortless, Carolyn was great to deal with and the location was on point. We’d definitely stay here again.
Had a great stay.

Lovely, spacious, character home in an excellent location for exploring the Barossa Valley. And most wonderfully,  doggo friendly! A rare gem with a huge enclosed yard where my pooch loved to explore. Thank you for hosting (all of us 🐕!), we'll definitely be back!
The place was lovely and worked well for our needs. Close to town and easy to get around. Gardens are really nice.
Great place to stay. great for dogs. Really nice garden. unfortunately it was difficult for elderly parents as the rear steps were to high. The second toilet is outside.

We had such a lovely time away exploring all Barossa had to offer. This cute cottage is well worth the stay, fantastic location and very dog friendly. Carolyn was fantastic with communication. Cannot wait to stay again in the future 😊

This house could be wonderful. However, it's in need of a complete renovation. The curtains/blinds are old, dirty and broken. One bedroom doesn't even have a blind. The curtains are poor quality, with car lights from the road at night making the front bedroom unusable. The corresponding window lock was broken. All the windows are in need of restoration and the glass needs cleaning.
The bathroom doorknob comes off in your hand. The laundry is a mess, outside an old toilet. The bedrooms smell and there is a noisy possum in the roof. The hall carpet has a large stain. The furniture is an eclectic group of odd items. The bedrooms have only 1 small lamp. The home lighting is generally poor with outside lighting inadequate.
There is a large yard that's been lovely, but not maintained. The side fence had a large gap in it that we barricaded to stop dogs escaping. A broken chair had been placed in another gap. Only a small area of the yard has been updated, the rest needs work. Kitchen was OK.

The house is really lovely. It’s an old heritage house that has been restored in a respectful way so that the original vibe has been retained. Where it has been modernised it’s to ensure that the necessary mod cons are available. The house was much better than I expected and we really loved the vibe of the house. It’s spacious, comfortable, mod cons  and with effective air conditioning. The block is big and almost rural. The setting is idyllic. The host is friendly and helpful. Tbh I couldn’t fault our experience. It was great. We would very much want to stay again
We had a nice stay at this property, would stay again.
Loved our time here! Great outdoor area and house full of charm. Super responsive hosts - just terrific

Everything was excellent and super close to restaurants, wineries and lovely walks.
The home itself was comfy, and well provisioned with everything in working order.
Great stay.
lovely homely feel to the place. the heating worked well and the fire in loungeroom was heavenly.
Lovely place, nice and clean.

We had a wonderful stay atCarolyn’s beautiful place! Great location, 5min walk to Tanunda main st, with lots of eateries & lovely shops! The place was immaculate, stocked with everything you need even down to milk & tim tams (not to mention a lovely vegie garden) wish we could have stayed longer!!
Lovely cottage, close to town and wineries with a cosy wood fire. We enjoyed our stay and would come back.
My Family had a wonderful time, the kids loved feeding the chickens and playing in the yard with the dog. Thank you for having us!!

This is such a beautiful home! We were so impressed by the little touches that made it so welcoming and peaceful. The bathroom is truly stunning, the backyard is large and functional and we felt right at home. You won’t regret booking this place for a Barossa getaway!

Highly recommend this charming cottage, which is easily within walking distance to the main street of Tanunda. Very clean and well equipped. Thanks Rainer!

Immaculate cottage located close to town. Attention to detail was appreciated, including the music on arrival setting the atmosphere for a wonderful stay.

A tastefully appointed, immaculately presented cottage in a quiet, central Tanunda location. Perfect for our daily winery visits and well positioned to local eateries. Rainer was a brilliant host. We cannot wait to come back.

Perhaps one of the best AirBNB experiences I’ve ever had. So many beautiful little touches from the little Easter eggs to the bottle of wine and fresh bread and hot cross buns being delivered in the morning.
