A lovely place to get away 🤍
Great place on a beautiful property. Had everything you need and was exceptionally clean. Central location to everything but also felt secluded and private. Great communication from the hosts.

We loved our stay at the loft!! It was absolutely beautiful — from the quiet and peaceful surroundings, to the animals, the cozy furnishings, the very thoughtful touches and super comfy beds…everything was perfect! Kent was a fantastic host, always responsive and helpful. The breakfast with the sun pouring through the windows was such a treat, we felt so relaxed. The location was also great as it’s close to some wonderful wineries and restaurants. However we loved the place so much that we actually chose to stay in and enjoy wine and cheese at the loft instead! We’d love to come back and highly recommend this place to anyone.
Everything was perfect. Just what we needed. thank you for having us.

First impressions were of a beautiful setting, and well appointed cottage.
However, travelling as brother and sister, with a booking for two people, we discovered the sofa bed on the property was broken and not unusable.
On calling the provided host’s phone number it went to a message bank.
Other staff on the property, with limited English speaking ability, attempted to help us.
The woman contacted and spoke to Lynn, Awesome, by using a different phone number and at that point, I was able to actually speak to her.
She told me that I should’ve booked the sofa bed, an extra $50, and then it would’ve been made up. I had brought my own linen and didn’t need that service. I feel if I book a property with advertised facilities that I should be able to use those facilities.
At no time did she offer to come to the property to assist, offered no compromise or alternative to HOW we would be able organise satisfactory sleeping arrangements.
Ultimately it led to our decision to leave.
Great location amongst a vineyard

The listing was clean and the surrounding area was beautiful with such a treat to have the winery right on your doorstep. A couple of concerns for us included an unresponsive contact number and the kitchen did not have a stove despite the description stating that there is a capacity to cook meals.
Great location enjoyed the stay Thank you for having us!

This accommodation was the peaceful home away from home I needed. Beautiful quiet surrounds, property well kept and easy to find. The hosts were accommodating and responsive. A lovely spot for a weekend away.
Great place, thank you!

Our weekend at the shiraz cottage was amazing! Lovely stay in the middle of the winerie. We had the chance to try some of their delicious wines. Absolutely beautiful view. The perfect stay for a weekend in the Barossa!
Peaceful stay! Lovely gardens!

Beautiful stay
& wonderful host.
Highly recommend!

Place is lovely and modern, beautiful views but main bedroom was extremely hot, no aircon or fan in room. No face cloths provided, and no milk or black tea. It’s the little things that counts.  A bit expensive for what you get
Amazing place, would love to come back for another stay :)

We came up from Melbourne to spend a few days at the Barossa and felt really lucky to find this place. The pictures really don’t do it justice. Beautiful scenery right in a vineyard. Modern house with central heating and cooling. Great place to explore all the wineries of the Barossa valley.
Very nice location to stay.
Great location, heart of the Barossa, close to wineries and other amenities. Will stay again. Great host.
great place to relax and rest.

Gorgeous, peaceful location to base your Barossa explorations from.
Comfortable bedding and great shower head makes you feel at home

Beautiful views, photos didn’t do justice
The winery situated next to the property is now closed which was disappointing to find out as it’s mentioned in the booking. Also don’t remember seeing in the ad that the cottage next door was literally next door, with only a wall between us and they’re were guest there so didn’t feel as private as it said, could hear the other guest snoring through the walls, no aircon or fan in the bedroom, there is aircon in the main area but could definitely do with a fan in the bedroom. Worth the stay for the picturesque views and little escape, would stay again if booked out both cottages next time :)
nice place in a great location, nice quiet and seculded place which was what we were after. bed was extremely comfortable and had a lovely sleep

We spent a few nights here and used it as a base to explore the Barossa valley. Location is brilliant, central but quiet, and it’s nice to have a drink on the verandah overlooking vineyards.
A couple of small things that could be improved:
There was no hand soap/wash in the bathroom.
No milk supplied so tea and coffee had to be black.
There is a washing machine but no powder/capsules supplied.
TV isn’t a smart TV so stuck watching free to air and ads if you want to watch a movie at night.

This is my first unsatisfactory review and I certainly don’t give it lightly.
The bedroom had a very strong dead animal smell. We couldn’t locate where it was coming from and we contacted the owner to ask her to call us. She did not do so. I was not provided with any contact phone number and my repeated requests for contact via phone went unanswered.
The owner sent a cleaner to the house who advised that there was a dead possum in The roof and the smell was ongoing and they were aware of it. We were offered a reed diffuser. I was pretty unimpressed that the home would be rented for 260 bucks a night with a dead animal in the roof. This occurred at 9pm so it was really upsetting.
We left the property at 10pm.
As a side note, the house is poorly stocked- limited furniture, only one glass ( extra dropped off when I asked) and no linen for the extra blankets. Carpets dirty and very stained.
Don’t recommend:
lived up to expectations and more

A lovely spot - very clean and comfortable. beautiful views across the vineyards from the rooms and the verandah, which is great to relax on after a day out. The place feels very private- there's another unit right next door but the layout is such that it is private and quiet
Great place to stay, beautiful spot

The view into the vineyard in autumn colours is lovely. The accommodation is more like a motel stay than a hosting. It could be a wonderful spot but lacks soul and essence of the Barossa. There is a big bed, a bathroom, a sofa bed, a microwave, a bar fridge, and little else. We didn't opt for the up sell of $120 tasting board etc on arrival. Make sure you pack the bare essentials milk/breakfast, phone usb plug & a torch. The property is not suitable for frail or mobility limited persons as its access is a steep set of garden rock steps with no lighting/handrail and the bathroom floor is slippery when wet. Although it "sleeps 3", we missed that it also is not child friendly, we included our child on our booking they were not accommodated. Great place if passing through and just need a bed.
Great place to stay in the Barossa and is within a 10-20 minute drive of alot of wineries and restaurants in the area. The cottage was clean, and the host was very responsive.

I had a lovely time at the Shiraz Cottage, it was quiet and beautiful, the host left very clear instructions and it was easy to find and access, lovely place --- perfect for a weekend out of the city.
Great spot in the middle of the Barossa. Recommended.

We had a nice time at this gorgeous and quiet accommodation. The cottage was spacious for 3 people and my friends and enjoyed the lovely views of the gardens and vineyard.
The only thing I was unprepared for was the instruction to take our rubbish with us, as no outdoor bin was provided. We didn’t have much waste, but it makes it difficult to explore the Barossa on the day of check out, when you have a back of rubbish in your boot.
Other than this it was a great place to stay, clean and comfortable
Very peaceful location with vineyard views, and close to wineries, cafes etc

Lovely little cottage set amongst beautiful gardens and vineyards. Super close to lots of great cellar doors and towns for eating out. Also, a responsive and easy to deal with host. Would be happy to stay again.
This was a fantastic stay! The cottage was comfortable and clean and the view was incredible.
We will definitely be back! Such a beautiful setting and so close to everything but still very private. Great value.
The house was messy and items were missing and the house was damaged didn’t stay the night
It has modern, stylish and very comfortable accommodation with a delightful outlook to the garden and vineyards.
Awesome spot, great communication
Absolute stunning little cottage to stay at. Very Beatiful and private. Thoroughly enjoyed my stay and will return again. Highly recommend. 10/10
Beautiful place to stay and highly recommend. Sad we had to leave for Sydney, we could have stayed far longer.
Such a beautiful stay! Lovely local areas to go for walks and a close proximity to heaps of wineries. Would highly recommend to any couple wanting a nice little getaway
Had a great weekend at this beautiful little cottage with its amazing views and so peaceful! Would definitely recommend to others!!
Great location!!!!!

If you want to stay somewhere in the Barossa, this cottage should be your #1 pick.  Super quiet and serene surroundings, amazing views straight out of your window, the decor and furnishings are modern, clean, and functional - there's nothing to fault! Plus all of the big wineries are within easy reach, as well as the local 1847 winery where this cottage is hosted.

Loved our stay here!The place was very clean, modern,had everything we needed to feel at home and was an easy drive to all the sites we wanted to see.The communication was super easy and quick and the place looks exactly like it does in the pictures.Would highly recommend staying here while visiting the Barossa region!

Great place to stay! We were able to both unwind and relax while also being so close to all the wineries and areas we wanted to check out. Bonus points for waking up and having a coffee while looking out to the vineyards.

We absolutely loved our stay! Very peaceful and quiet, its just what we wanted. Very responsive host and details on entry were very easy to understand even though it was a little hidden away (which we loved). Thankyou!
Great space, very clean.

Room itself is slightly outdated with bare bones amenities.
Great location though and it made up for everything. Wish I could’ve tried the wines.

The chalet is confortable, clean and is practically situated if one wants to tour the Barossa Valley and its main cellar doors and atractions. The parking is conveniently just a few minutes from the house steps to reach it and the garden is very charming. From the terrace one can enjoy a beautiful view of the vineyard and the rolling hills ahead, surrounded by pretty and colourful flower beds. It’s a romantic, quiet and private little retreat. The kitchen is fine if one wants to pop a bottle and snack some cheese or such, but it is ill equipped for a real cooking session, but then: there are enough restaurants and breackfast venues of all sorts in the vicinity 🙃 (a list is provided at the location)! We had a fine stay!
Amazing accomodation in the heart of Rowland Flat. The views of the garden and adjacent vineyard were magical.
Beautiful place, nice surroundings and convenient location.

Great place to stay to see the Barossa. Quiet and peaceful. Accomodation has separate entrance and is distant to main house. Beautiful gardens and lovely new buildings surrounded by vineyards ( 2 side by side cottages but very private)
Would absolutely stay here again.
recommended for a really good night's rest! Quiet and dark and private.
Comfortable bed, modern bathroom, private and peaceful surroundings.
Perfect place to stay nice and central to the Barossa fantastic value for money and great host’
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in peaceful surroundings.
Beautiful place to stay. I love being able to look out to the vineyard when I woke up in the morning. Just amazing!
Absolutely beautiful spot, really quiet and serene. Not far from town and most wineries are a short drive away. Would love to be back again one day!
My fault but being a cottage I just presumed there would be cooking facilities, no cook top or oven, at the very least there should be a BBQ.. Location cottage, bed etc was great

The gardens and vineyards around the place were awesome. The serenity was nice although of a night time was a little too quiet and tucked away for us.
Only the wire door locked as the other door wouldn’t lock with the keys provided. We felt a little on edge.

We stayed here in winter.. Finding the entry in the dark took us a few shots, but then inside it was well equipped with heaters and the air-conditioning worked a treat.
As a ceoliac I'm used to give everything in the kitchen a sweep. I was just a bit sad, that the only provided tea towel was put on top of the toaster.
Everything else was very nice. Their garden and the outlook to the vineyard are just beautiful, the surroundings and everything you want to go to is easy to reach by car in a couple of minutes.
Great property in a very peaceful spot. Perfect for a quiet getaway in the Barossa.
Thankyou

It's just a short 5-10 minute drive to the restaurants in Tanunda and Nuriootpa, and there are plenty of wineries in the area to explore. This property offers both charm and convenience, making it a fantastic base for discovering the Barossa Valley. We’ll definitely be back!
Worth the stay!
Very tranquil spot once we found it! Instructions could of been a bit more specific

Nice location, beautiful outdoors, clean place & responsive host. A small cooking hob would be useful though.

We really enjoyed our stay! Being our first trip to the Barossa, we really appreciated recommendations from the host on what to see and do, as well as opening hours. The cottage was exactly as listed. Check in was seamless. We are looking forward to coming back to the Barossa for a longer trip!

Very nice area and great amenities. Was unaware that the place is a duplex however was not overly disappointed despite - this may very well have been in the description and I simply didn’t notice. Thank you!
Very comfortable and quiet place to stay in a vineyard.

To quote Darryl Kerrigan of The Castle, “How’s the serenity?”

Escape to this perfect den for those seeking a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. The vineyard ambiance adds an extra touch of charm!

Lovely place to stay, and at a very fair price.
Will be back!

Overall we had a lovely stay in a well designed and appointed cottage Great location and very peaceful with kangaroos and kookaburras nightly Hower some of little things were disappointing including no breakfast provisions,dirty fridge with huge amount of dirty brown stained ice around freezer,a water bottle 1/4 full,and ice cube trays 1/4 full which we couldn’t get to freeze .A welcome note with air conditioner on for our arrival would have been nice as well as maybe a bottle of local wine(We were very grateful for a bottle delivered on our last night) .The lounge clock wasn’t working(needed battery) and I couldn’t find a bottle opener to open a beer. The outside chairs needed a cushion and the fountain was full of green mould and didn’t work,and garden overgrown. Having paid a cleaning fee we were very surprised to be told we had to take all our rubbish away,with no outside bins on premises .Overall a lovely comfortable place,great bed and bathroom but stay spoilt by little things
Beautiful location with lovely views over the vines. Bed was very comfortable and it was very quiet. Perfect for a nice weekend touring wineries in the region.

This place was really great. The setting was lovely, really out of a postcard. The place was comfortable and really convenient to wineries - which is what we came for.

Overall our impression was very positive and we would certainly recommend this for others. We would also stay again we were fortunate ‘enough to get back to Barossa Valley.

Basic accomodation in the middle of a garden and vineyard. Comfy bed. There are no "special little touches " but if you come self-contained it is beautiful surrounds.

Beautiful place to stay. Picture-perfect views, quiet, and convenient location. Close to restaurants, pub, and a local grocer and most wineries are a short drive away.

Beautiful cottage with roses and lavender bushes in bloom. Quiet and private, surrounded by vineyards, short drive to Tanunda.
The bed soft warm and comfy, almost like sleeping in a cloud, was good to rest there after days of exploring Barossa.
Bathroom very modern, freshly renovated, beautiful shower, fluffy white towels.
Very happy with our stay at Petit Verdot cottage.

Beautyful cottage, nice view and silent. The kitchen was spartanly equipped without oven and stove. Lynn was very frendly and helpful.
We can recommend this cottage very well.

Such a lovely and spacious home, very comfortable, stylish and in a great location. Everything we could want. The host, Tyson, went above and beyond, even offering restaurant and winery recommendations when we were stuck for ideas. We’ve already marked it in our calendar for future visits.

Lovely house . Very comfortable and has everything you need . Close to town. Very peaceful area. Tyson was very easy to communicate with and very responsive.
We will definitely be back!!!
Great place and central location

Wir fühlten uns wie die Könige! Riesige Wohnung mit grossen Zimmern und ebenso riesigem Wohnbereich inklusive Küche. Alles ist neu und blitzsauber. Der Kühlschrank hat ein Wasser- und Eisauslass! Wow.. was the word echoed as we entered the door.  Easy check in, great communication.  We had 5 guests stay and the house was big enough for us, and more. Lovely presented house!

Had an awesome time staying at The Gaff. The sofa bed was surprisingly comfy, and the space was perfect for relaxing after a day of winery visits. Lisa was a great host – she let us do our thing and made sure we had everything we needed. Will stay again :)

I had a relaxing stay at The Gaff. As a solo traveller the place felt safe, which gave me peace of mind throughout my trip, while still offering plenty of privacy. The accommodation was very comfortable, Lisa provided the gaff with takeaway menus and personal favourite wineries to visit. Highly recommend!
great host and such a beautiful relaxing spot. Very happy with our stay :)

Location very close to Barossa Valley, just a short drive for a lovely day out in the vines. Would definitely stay here again.

Was such a great stay had so much fun would definitely go back again. Lisa left us some nice treats which was nice to see. Really enjoyed the fact there was a fire place first time I’ve ever seen one was a great stay
Beautiful place and very cooperative host! It was everything in the pictures. Highly recommended

Great location, overall a great stay.
A beautiful home to stay!! We absolutely love it. Very clean and tidy and the location is incredible

5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Perfection in the Barossa. Murphy’s place was just a street back from the main tourist area of Tanunda making it very walkable but still quiet. The house had everything we needed and more. Highly recommend.

We loved this place - it was perfect for us and our son and his family. It’s in a great location and easy to walk to everything with short drives to great vineyards. Clean and lovely home. Well come again!
A fabulous place so close to the main street and restaurants. Will definitely stay again.

Friendly and responsive hosts. Central location, very short walk to a few good restaurants . Nice and quiet location with separate living areas making it good for a group of you want some space. very clean and tidy. would stay again.
Such a beautiful place! Great restaurants within a few minutes walk and central location to all surrounding wineries. Comfortable bed and furniture. Thank you so much for letting us stay!

Thank you very much. Had a great short stay. Great location and lovely house. Will be back soon time.

Absolutely stunning house! It was everything we could have asked for a pre-wedding get away with the girls. We want to live here haha

Great farm stay experience
It's a lovely cottage for 2 people. The surroundings are amazing and great for pups too.
Very nice cottage, thankyou.
Homely, comfortable, relaxing. Fully self sufficient. Not accustomed to watching tv in the bedroom but usually tired from a day of exploring. Such a treat to habitat such history.

overall, we were happy with our stay and would recommend to others.
Great little cottage. Exactly like the pictures. So peaceful and had everything we needed. Would recommend and extra plus dog friendly.

fantastic stay at little Eden! what a gem! one of the few places that was even better in person!

Beautiful

Cosy and historic cottage in Eden Valley. Great for visiting the local area.

Absolutely loved our stay here. Gorgeous cottage. Thought of everything we needed. Could not recommend it more highly.
Fantastic stay, excellent cosy home perfect for a couple and in a great location

Nice quiet place to stay. Lovely fireplace. Just wish have another TV in living room. Beautiful spa. Very cosy.

Everything has been thought through in this beautiful gem in the Barossa! It really is something special. The only problem was we had to leave!! We will definitely be back. 5 stars from us! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Most beautiful place I have very stayed.
